engine:addDirs.label: Add directives key
engine:addDirs.description: Append a `directives` key to a frame object only when the directive list is non-empty (TS-parse omits the key otherwise). parser-substrate Phase 5a.

engine:affineBin.label: solve: affineBin
engine:affineBin.description: Phase 12 — extract both operands of a binary affine op (add/sub/mul/div) via affineOf; combine via affineCombine when both extract; any non-affine operand ⇒ { ok = false }. Internal helper.

engine:affineCall.label: solve: affineCall
engine:affineCall.description: Phase 12 — route an `ECall` head to its affine combiner: `add`/`mul`/`div` ⇒ binary combine; `negate` ⇒ negation; `sub` ⇒ negation (unary, the prefix-minus spelling) or subtraction (binary) by arity; any other head ⇒ { ok = false }. Internal helper.

engine:affineCombine.label: solve: affineCombine
engine:affineCombine.description: Phase 12 — combine two extracted affine terms by op: add ⇒ pairwise sum; sub ⇒ pairwise difference; mul ⇒ affineMul (one side must be constant); div ⇒ affineDiv (divisor must be a nonzero constant). Internal helper.

engine:affineDiv.label: solve: affineDiv
engine:affineDiv.description: Phase 12 — divide two affine terms: linear only when the divisor `r` is a NONZERO constant (coeff 0, k ≠ 0) — scale the numerator by 1/r; a non-constant divisor (k/x reciprocal) or a zero divisor ⇒ { ok = false }. Internal helper.

engine:affineMul.label: solve: affineMul
engine:affineMul.description: Phase 12 — multiply two affine terms: linear only when ONE side is a constant (coeff 0) — scale the other by it; BOTH non-constant (x*x quadratic) ⇒ { ok = false } (the quadratic fence). Internal helper.

engine:affineNeg.label: solve: affineNeg
engine:affineNeg.description: Phase 12 — negate a single affine operand (prefix `-e` / `negate e`): extract via affineOf, flip the signs of coeff and k; a non-affine operand ⇒ { ok = false }. Internal helper.

engine:affineOf.label: solve: affineOf
engine:affineOf.description: Phase 12 — extract an affine term `coeff·x + k` (over the single variable `varName`) from an `Expr`: a number `ELit` ⇒ {0, v}; `EVar varName` ⇒ {1, 0}; `add`/`sub`/`mul`/`div`/`negate` (+ unary `sub`) recurse and combine; a DIFFERENT var, a non-number literal, a non-affine head, x*x (quadratic), or k/x (reciprocal) ⇒ { ok = false }. The single-var linear fence (multi-var is P13). Internal helper.

engine:affineSub.label: solve: affineSub
engine:affineSub.description: Phase 12 — `sub` dispatch by arity: ONE operand ⇒ negation (prefix-minus's `sub [e]` spelling); TWO operands ⇒ binary subtraction. Internal helper.

engine:afterEmit.label: After-emit layout state
engine:afterEmit.description: Update the layout state after emitting token `tk`: a bracket-opener pushes the suspend sentinel; a bracket-closer pops it; an opener (`= -> then else do of where`) arms `pendingOpen` (only when not bracket-suspended); anything else clears it. Returns `{ stack, pendingOpen }`. Internal layout helper.

engine:allAtoms.label: All atoms
engine:allAtoms.description: All 2^n atoms over a key list: each atom is the SUBSET of keys that fire (a key list). Built recursively: atoms of the tail, plus each of those with the head added. Internal helper.

engine:allCasesEmpty.label: empty: allCasesEmpty
engine:allCasesEmpty.description: Phase 6 Step 3 / type-substrate P1(a.6) — variant-sum fold reached only after emptyVariantFace's whole-variant gate. All case payloads must be empty; an empty gated case list is Void-like.

engine:allEnum.label: enumerate: allEnum
engine:allEnum.description: Phase 15 — true when EVERY branch of an intersection is a SeEnum (the exact-intersection precondition). Internal helper.

engine:allFiredOk.label: All-fired ok
engine:allFiredOk.description: The $all half of atomSat: every $all predicate in localKeys must fire in atom. Explicit head/tail recursion (mirrors pattern-algebra's allMember idiom — no all/some-with-lambda). Internal helper.

engine:allGrounded.label: All grounded
engine:allGrounded.description: True when every requested var is in the grounded set (the safety condition). Internal helper.

engine:allKeysInCtorDef.label: All keys in ctor def
engine:allKeysInCtorDef.description: Every field name in `recFields` appears in `ctorDef`. Mirrors `argKeys.every((k) => ctorDef.includes(k))`.

engine:allMember.label: All member
engine:allMember.description: True when `x` is a wsMember of every branch (WsIntersect; empty ⇒ true). Internal helper.

engine:allOrderedBranches.label: All branches ordered
engine:allOrderedBranches.description: True when every Ws marker in `branches` is markerOrdered (explicit recursion). Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:allOrderedKeys.label: All keys ordered
engine:allOrderedKeys.description: True when every predicate key's Ws marker is markerOrdered — the whole-pattern dispatch test selecting the structured partition over the 2^N fallback. Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:allToEmptyIntersect.label: All to empty intersect
engine:allToEmptyIntersect.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the `⊤ = ∩∅` derivation witness: `SeAll` rewrites to the nullary meet `SeIntersect []` (§3.2 `∩∅ = ⊤`). The equality claim is lawNullaryIntersect. Any other shape passes through unchanged.

engine:altBranches.label: Alt branches
engine:altBranches.description: Flatten a Pat into its alternation branches: PEmpty ⇒ [] (drops out); PAlt ⇒ the concatenation of both sides' branches (associativity); any other Pat ⇒ a singleton. Internal helper (structured partition, ACI-canonical alt).

engine:anaAddEdgeUnique.label: analyze: add edge unique
engine:anaAddEdgeUnique.description: Insert edge `e` into relation `r` only if not already present (dedup). Keeps the relation a set.

engine:anaAddSpellingTargets.label: analyze: add spelling targets
engine:anaAddSpellingTargets.description: Add every knownId a spelling may denote (anaSpellingTargets) to the deduped callee accumulator. `joined` is the comma-framed id list anaJoinedIds builds once per body.

engine:anaAddUnique.label: analyze: add unique name
engine:anaAddUnique.description: Append `name` to `acc` only if not already present (dedup). Used to collect a deduped callee list.

engine:anaAnalyzeGroups.label: analyze: analyze each group
engine:anaAnalyzeGroups.description: Map analyzeGroup over every SCC group, yielding a List {ids, verdict}.

engine:anaAnalyzeGroupsTail.label: analyze: analyze each group (tail)
engine:anaAnalyzeGroupsTail.description: Recurse on the tail of the group list for anaAnalyzeGroups (keeps it free of case-in-let).

engine:anaAnyUngathered.label: analyze: a resolved callee was not gathered
engine:anaAnyUngathered.description: True when some row of `resolved` ({id, callees}: a bodied record's callees resolved against the whole registry) names a callee with no gathered record (`gatheredIndex`, over every record the seam passed, natives included). The seam gathers exactly the subject's reach; a missing callee means the gather lost it (a discovery failure, a truncated or hand-built record set), and treating it as a sink would assume, without evidence, that it terminates. A certified native counts as a sink only when it is present as a native record.

engine:anaAppliedCallee.label: analyze: applied callee of an apply form
engine:anaAppliedCallee.description: The applied reference of one `$ callee args…` form for anaAppliedRefsIn: when the callee is a variable whose root (totSpellingRoot) no binder in `bound` binds, append {spelling, argc} with argc the number of arguments applied to it. A bound callee (a parameter, a pattern variable, a local closure), a lambda literal and a computed callee are left to the group audit (totUncheckedApply).

engine:anaAppliedHead.label: analyze: applied reference of a call node
engine:anaAppliedHead.description: The applied reference a call node `f args` contributes for anaAppliedRefsIn: none for the `if` guard form or a list literal's synthetic appendItem (totIsListLiteral, a construction); the callee of the `$` apply form (anaAppliedCallee); a `$dyn:` var-head call when no binder in `bound` binds its root; every other string head. Each is the record {spelling, argc}.

engine:anaAppliedRefsIn.label: analyze: applied references in a body
engine:anaAppliedRefsIn.description: Collect, as {spelling, argc} records, every reference the core Expr applies to arguments without a binder in `bound` providing it (anaAppliedHead): each string call head (except the `if` form and a list literal's synthetic appendItem), the variable callee of a `$` apply, and each `$dyn:` var-head call, with the number of arguments applied. The kernel-gate entry starts `bound` at the function's params; lambda params and arm pattern vars extend it, so a bound callee is left to the group audit (totUncheckedReference: a callback is refused, a checked local closure accepted). Arm guards are walked like bodies.

engine:anaAppliedRefsInArm.label: analyze: applied references in a match arm
engine:anaAppliedRefsInArm.description: anaAppliedRefsIn over one match arm, `bound` already extended by the arm's pattern variables: its guard when present (it runs before the body), then its body.

engine:anaAppliesUnchecked.label: analyze: body applies an unchecked reference
engine:anaAppliesUnchecked.description: True when an applied reference of the record's body (anaAppliedRefsIn, `bound` starting at its params) denotes no registry id (anaSpellingTargets against `registryIds`; `joined` is anaJoinedIds registryIds) — a class-method name resolved by dispatch, a host leaf the registry does not hold, a bundle or instance member path (`m.k.run`), or a free local recursive binding, any of which may run code the analysis never gathered — or over-applies a bodied function (anaOverApplies: the extra arguments invoke its result).

engine:anaBuildEdges.label: analyze: build direct edges
engine:anaBuildEdges.description: Build the full directed call-graph edge set {from, to} over a function list: for each function, its callees ∩ knownIds become edges. Concatenated across functions (order-irrelevant — used as a relation).

engine:anaBumpPartial.label: analyze: census bump partial
engine:anaBumpPartial.description: Add `n` to the census accumulator's `partial` count, leaving the others. Returns the updated census record.

engine:anaBumpTotal.label: analyze: census bump total
engine:anaBumpTotal.description: Add `n` to the census accumulator's `total` count, leaving the others. Returns the updated census record.

engine:anaBumpUnknown.label: analyze: census bump unknown
engine:anaBumpUnknown.description: Add `n` to the census accumulator's `unknown` count AND append the group's member ids to the Unknown worklist. Returns the updated census record.

engine:anaCalleesHaveDyn.label: infer: callees list contains the $dyn indirect-dispatch token
engine:anaCalleesHaveDyn.description: True when the callee-id list `callees` contains the `$dyn` sentinel — the marker the TS seam emits for an INDIRECT / dynamic dispatch (a non-string call/apply head or pipe stage). String membership fold.

engine:anaCalleesIn.label: analyze: collect callees (walk)
engine:anaCalleesIn.description: Collect every knownId an ECall head OR an EVar name of the core Expr may denote into the deduped accumulator: the body's distinct spellings (anaSpellingsIn, guards included) each resolved once through anaSpellingTargets, so canonical, dotted, bare and var-head spellings of one function all reach its id. EVar is the var-ref callee edge (effect-visibility Phase 1 — a fn referenced by name in argument/let-value position is a reach edge like a call head; a data var finds no id, no edge and no $dyn). A spelling bound by an enclosing lambda or arm pattern is skipped (it denotes the local); a function parameter that shadows a function name is not visible here and may add a false edge, which only adds requires or gathers one more function — sound. The TS perf-branch mirror is collectCalledFunctions(includeVarRefs) in constraint-inference.ts.

engine:anaCalleesInArms.label: analyze: collect callees in match arms
engine:anaCalleesInArms.description: Fold anaCalleesIn over each match arm's guard (when present — it runs before the body) and body (arm pattern bindings do not affect callee collection — the conservative over-approx). Threads the accumulator.

engine:anaCalleesInFields.label: analyze: collect callees in record fields
engine:anaCalleesInFields.description: Fold anaCalleesIn over a record's field values ({name, value} records). Threads the accumulator.

engine:anaCalleesInList.label: analyze: collect callees in arg list
engine:anaCalleesInList.description: Fold anaCalleesIn over a list of argument/child expressions, threading the deduped callee accumulator.

engine:anaCalleesJoined.label: analyze: collect callees against a joined id list
engine:anaCalleesJoined.description: anaCalleesIn with the comma-framed id string (anaJoinedIds knownIds) supplied by the caller, so a caller resolving many bodies against one id list builds it once (verdictTagForIn).

engine:anaCanonArm.label: analyze: canonicalize trusted heads (arm)
engine:anaCanonArm.description: anaCanonGo over one match arm: its body, and its guard when present.

engine:anaCanonGo.label: analyze: canonicalize trusted heads (walk)
engine:anaCanonGo.description: Rewrite every string call head of the core Expr through anaCanonicalHead, keeping each node's other fields (mapSet over the node, so marks such as a list literal's `lit` survive). Lambda bodies, match scrutinees, arm guards and bodies, constructor arguments and record field values are walked.

engine:anaCanonicalHead.label: analyze: canonical trusted head
engine:anaCanonicalHead.description: The head the size-change oracle should see for a string call head: its canonical registry id when the spelling denotes exactly one registry id (anaSpellingTargets) and that id is a trusted std primitive (totIsTrustedPrimitive: std:sub, std:gt, std:gte, std:lt, std:lte, std:and, std:or); otherwise the spelling unchanged. A bare `gt` in a registry that also holds a user `gt` is ambiguous and stays a spelling, so it yields no fact. `$dyn:` heads and the `if` form are never rewritten. A string call head is resolved globally (a lambda or pattern binder never shadows one; a local is called through a var head).

engine:anaCanonicalizeTrusted.label: Canonicalize trusted primitive heads
engine:anaCanonicalizeTrusted.description: The kernel projection's identity resolution for the size-change oracle (2026-10-03): rewrite each string call head of a lowered body that denotes exactly one registry id, that id being a trusted std primitive, to the canonical id (anaCanonicalHead). The oracle reads positivity, bound and descent facts only off canonical ids (totIsTrustedPrimitive), so a user function sharing a primitive's name, or an ambiguous spelling, yields none. verdictTagForIn applies it to every gathered body before the analysis.

engine:anaCensusGo.label: analyze: census fold
engine:anaCensusGo.description: Fold anaCensusOne over every group result, threading the census accumulator.

engine:anaCensusOne.label: analyze: census one group
engine:anaCensusOne.description: Fold one {ids, verdict} group result into the census accumulator: a Total group adds its member count to `total`; an Unknown group adds its count to `unknown` AND its ids to the Unknown worklist; a Partial group adds its count to `partial`. Counts by member-id count (the census counts functions, not SCCs).

engine:anaCertifiedNativeLeaves.label: analyze: certified terminating native leaves
engine:anaCertifiedNativeLeaves.description: The ids of the bodyless registry functions certified as terminating leaves (the native-leaves block above): a native that only computes on its argument data or performs one host IO act, never evaluating caller-supplied code. A reached bodyless function whose id is not listed makes the kernel-gate verdict Unknown (verdictTagForIn). Takes a unit argument so a body reads the list, not a reference to it.

engine:anaComposeAdd.label: analyze: compose add
engine:anaComposeAdd.description: Add the composed edge {from = e1.from, to = e2.to} (the path through the matching intermediate e1.to == e2.from) to the accumulator, deduped. Built via a `let` then the literal.

engine:anaComposeInner.label: analyze: compose inner (e1 over r)
engine:anaComposeInner.description: Fold one edge e1 against every edge of r, adding each meeting composition to the accumulator. Inner loop of one closure round.

engine:anaComposeOuter.label: analyze: compose outer (r over r)
engine:anaComposeOuter.description: Fold every edge of `gs` as e1 against the full relation `allR` (via anaComposeInner), accumulating the composed edges. Outer loop of one closure round.

engine:anaComposePair.label: analyze: compose pair
engine:anaComposePair.description: If e1 and e2 meet at an intermediate (e1.to == e2.from), add the composed edge e1.from → e2.to; else leave the accumulator unchanged. One transitive-closure composition step.

engine:anaCountUnanalyzable.label: analyze: count unanalyzable
engine:anaCountUnanalyzable.description: Count the functions whose `analyzable` flag is False (the bodies that did not lower to core Expr — the 56 Err cases). Bucketed separately, NEVER folded into Total (D-3f-4).

engine:anaCountUnanalyzableTail.label: analyze: count unanalyzable (tail)
engine:anaCountUnanalyzableTail.description: Recurse on the tail of the function list for anaCountUnanalyzable (keeps it free of case-in-let).

engine:anaEdgeEq.label: analyze: edge eq
engine:anaEdgeEq.description: Equality of two call-graph edges: same `from` AND same `to` node. Drives dedup + set-equality of the reachability relation.

engine:anaEdgeMember.label: analyze: edge member
engine:anaEdgeMember.description: True when edge `e` (exact from/to) occurs in relation `r`. Fold anaEdgeEq over r.

engine:anaEdgeSetEq.label: analyze: edge set eq
engine:anaEdgeSetEq.description: Set-equality of two relations (mutual edge-subset) — the closure fixpoint stop-test (the round added no new edge).

engine:anaEdgesFrom.label: analyze: edges from one function
engine:anaEdgesFrom.description: Build the direct call-graph edges {from, to} out of one function: for each deduped callee `c`, an edge {from = fromId, to = c}. Edges built via a `let` then the literal (the inline-record-in-arg surprise).

engine:anaEdgesSubset.label: analyze: edges subset
engine:anaEdgesSubset.description: True when every edge of relation `s1` occurs in `s2`. Half of the closure fixpoint stop-test.

engine:anaFilterAnalyzable.label: analyze: filter analyzable
engine:anaFilterAnalyzable.description: Keep only the functions whose `analyzable` flag is True (a body that lowered to core Expr). The Unanalyzable functions (the 56 Err cases) are EXCLUDED from the call graph — their callers lose that edge (sound under-approx; D-3f-4) — and counted separately by anaCountUnanalyzable.

engine:anaFilterAnalyzableTail.label: analyze: filter analyzable (tail)
engine:anaFilterAnalyzableTail.description: Recurse on the tail of the function list for anaFilterAnalyzable (keeps it free of case-in-let).

engine:anaGroupByEmit.label: analyze: group-by emit
engine:anaGroupByEmit.description: Emit the SCC group of the worklist head `f`: collect all members in f's SCC (anaMembersOf over the FULL function list), mark their ids assigned, and prepend the group to the partition built from the rest of the worklist (threading the grown assigned set).

engine:anaGroupByGo.label: analyze: group-by walk
engine:anaGroupByGo.description: Walk the worklist, emitting one group per not-yet-assigned head (its whole SCC) and skipping already-assigned heads. Threads the `assigned` id-set so each SCC is emitted once. Helper for sccPartition.

engine:anaGroupBySkip.label: analyze: group-by skip
engine:anaGroupBySkip.description: Advance to the tail of the `remaining` worklist, threading the `assigned` id-set unchanged. Used both for an already-assigned head and after emitting a group.

engine:anaGroupHasPartial.label: analyze: group has @partial member
engine:anaGroupHasPartial.description: True when ANY member of the group is declared @partial (declaredPartial). The per-group @partial fold (D-3f-3).

engine:anaIndexHas.label: analyze: index has key
engine:anaIndexHas.description: True when the record `index` (built by fromEntries) holds `key`.

engine:anaIsNative.label: analyze: native record
engine:anaIsNative.description: True when a gathered function record is a bodyless (native or host-leaf) function: the kernel seam marks such a record `native = True`. A record without the field (hand-built groups, the census) is not native.

engine:anaJoinedIds.label: analyze: joined ids
engine:anaJoinedIds.description: The known ids framed as one comma-separated string with a leading and trailing comma (`,a:f,b:g,`). A bare spelling `n` denotes exactly the ids whose text is preceded by a comma and ends with `:n,`, so one native substring test settles the common no-match case (locals, builtins) and one native split recovers each matching module; registry ids hold no comma.

engine:anaMapIds.label: analyze: map ids
engine:anaMapIds.description: Project the `id` field of every function in the list into a List String (the call-graph node set / a group's member-id list). Order-irrelevant (used as a set).

engine:anaMapIdsTail.label: analyze: map ids (tail)
engine:anaMapIdsTail.description: Recurse on the tail of the function list for anaMapIds (keeps it free of case-in-let).

engine:anaMembersOf.label: analyze: members of
engine:anaMembersOf.description: Every function in the list that is in the same SCC as node `fid` (the SCC group of fid). Keeps the full function records (id/params/body/… — the checkMutualTotality input).

engine:anaMembersOfTail.label: analyze: members of (tail)
engine:anaMembersOfTail.description: Recurse on the tail of the function list for anaMembersOf (keeps it free of case-in-let).

engine:anaOverApplies.label: analyze: applied reference over-applies a bodied function
engine:anaOverApplies.description: True when one of `targets` is a bodied function whose param count (`arities`, a record from id to param count built over the gathered bodied records) is below `argc`. The evaluator binds a bodied callee's params, evaluates its body and applies any leftover arguments to the result when it is callable (json-logic.ts, the eta-reduction spill): an invocation of a value the analysis never checked. A native receives every argument and never spills, so natives are absent from `arities`.

engine:anaOverAppliesOne.label: analyze: applied reference over-applies one function
engine:anaOverAppliesOne.description: True when `t` has a param count in `arities` (it is a gathered bodied function) below `argc` (anaOverApplies).

engine:anaReachClose.label: analyze: reach close (bounded exact fixpoint)
engine:anaReachClose.description: The transitive closure of the call-graph edge relation under repeated squaring. Callers derive `fuel` from the finite node set (`|V| + 1`), which is an exact deterministic bound rather than a repository-size constant. The loop saturates in ceil(log2(longest-path)) rounds and anaReachCloseStep is self-tail/compiled stack-safe.

engine:anaReachCloseStep.label: analyze: reach close step
engine:anaReachCloseStep.description: Stack-safe self-tail fixpoint loop. Compute the next squaring round; return at equality, otherwise continue with the expanded relation until the exact node-derived round bound is exhausted. The self-tail call compiles to the standard loop form.

engine:anaReachRound.label: analyze: reach round
engine:anaReachRound.description: One closure round: `r` plus the composition of every meeting edge pair, deduped. Seeds the accumulator with `r` itself, so the round is non-shrinking (next ⊇ r).

engine:anaReachStep.label: analyze: reach step
engine:anaReachStep.description: Level-synchronous forward reachability over an adjacency list ({id, callees} rows): add the not-yet-visited callees of the frontier, then continue from them. Returns every node reachable in one or more steps (a node is in its own result iff it lies on a cycle). Callers pass fuel = node count + 1, which every productive level reduces by at least one new node, so the bound is never reached on a closed adjacency; if it were, the marker `$reach-fuel-exhausted` is returned with the partial set so the caller can refuse instead of under-approximating. Self-tail.

engine:anaReachable.label: analyze: reachable
engine:anaReachable.description: True when node `a` reaches node `b` in the closed relation `r` (the edge {from = a, to = b} is present). Built via a `let` then anaEdgeMember.

engine:anaReachedGroups.label: analyze: SCC groups of reached records
engine:anaReachedGroups.description: Partition function records into strongly-connected groups from per-record forward reach sets ({id, reach} rows from anaReachStep): u and w share a group iff u == w, or each reaches the other. Each group is the checkMutualTotality input shape.

engine:anaRefUnchecked.label: analyze: applied reference is unchecked
engine:anaRefUnchecked.description: True when the applied reference `r` ({spelling, argc}) denotes no registry id, or over-applies a gathered bodied function (anaOverApplies).

engine:anaReqAddUnique.label: infer: add constraint unique
engine:anaReqAddUnique.description: Insert constraint `c` into `acc` only if its dedup key is not already present (the structural dedup). Keeps the requires list a set by key, first-occurrence-wins (matching the TS seenKeys order).

engine:anaReqCollect.label: infer: collect requires over reached functions
engine:anaReqCollect.description: Fold each reached function's `requires` list into the deduped accumulator (anaReqUnion). The transitive requires-union over the reached set.

engine:anaReqEdges.label: infer: edges from pre-extracted callees
engine:anaReqEdges.description: Build the directed call-graph edge set {from, to} over function records carrying a pre-extracted `callees` id-list (the TS-seam form; parallel to anaBuildEdges, which extracts callees from a core Expr body). Concatenated across functions (order-irrelevant — used as a relation). REUSES anaEdgesFrom + totConcat.

engine:anaReqIsReached.label: infer: is g reached from target
engine:anaReqIsReached.description: True when node `gid` is the target itself (eq targetId gid) OR reachable from it in the closed relation `r`. The membership predicate for the reached-function set (self ∪ transitive callees) — matching the TS BFS whose own-requires are seeded and whose visited set is reached from the direct callees.

engine:anaReqKeyEq.label: infer: constraint dedup-key equality
engine:anaReqKeyEq.description: Equality of two marshalled constraints by their seam-computed dedup-key STRING (`c.key` = the legacy `${specId}::${JSON.stringify(args[0])}`). Plain string `eq` — sound because the structural key was pre-computed host-side (the kernel-precedent: std `eq` is shallow on records/variants, so structural equality is computed in the marshal seam and compared here as a String, NOT by value over the `{$tag}`/`{$var}` shapes).

engine:anaReqMember.label: infer: constraint member
engine:anaReqMember.description: True when constraint `c` (by its dedup key) occurs in the constraint list `cs`. Fold anaReqKeyEq over cs — the dedup membership test.

engine:anaReqReached.label: infer: reached functions
engine:anaReqReached.description: Every function record in the list that is reached from `targetId` (the target itself, or transitively reachable in the closed relation `r`). Keeps the full records (id/callees/requires) so the union step can read their requires.

engine:anaReqReachedHasDyn.label: infer: any reached function performs an indirect dispatch
engine:anaReqReachedHasDyn.description: True when ANY function in the reached set carries the `$dyn` indirect-dispatch token in its callees — i.e. the target transitively reaches an effect-OPAQUE dispatch. Folds anaCalleesHaveDyn over the reached functions; the predicate that gates the effect-opaque sentinel arm in inferRequiresFor (the D-4b FLOOR).

engine:anaReqReachedTail.label: infer: reached functions (tail)
engine:anaReqReachedTail.description: Recurse on the tail of the function list for anaReqReached (keeps it free of case-in-let).

engine:anaReqSubtract.label: infer: subtract declared requires (tail-threaded)
engine:anaReqSubtract.description: Keep each constraint of `cs` whose dedup key is NOT present in `declared`, preserving order. The set-difference inferred − declared underlying findUndeclaredRequiresFor.

engine:anaReqUnion.label: infer: union a requires list into the accumulator
engine:anaReqUnion.description: Fold anaReqAddUnique over a constraint list `cs`, threading the deduped accumulator. Unions one function's declared requires into the running transitive set.

engine:anaSameScc.label: analyze: same SCC
engine:anaSameScc.description: True when `u` and `v` are in the same strongly-connected component: the same node (u == v), or MUTUALLY reachable (u →* v AND v →* u) in the closed relation. The SCC equivalence the partition groups by.

engine:anaSpellingTargets.label: analyze: spelling targets
engine:anaSpellingTargets.description: The knownIds a call-head or variable spelling may denote. Stored bodies keep their source spellings (bare code names, `Module.name`, var-head `$dyn:` calls) while registry ids are canonical `module:name`, so an exact-membership test missed nearly every real call (2026-10-02: every Fenel-bodied system function, std:map included, was vacuously Total at the kernel gate). Normalization: strip `$dyn:`; the exact id; a dotted spelling is the id whose last dot reads as the colon (`publicdemo.statistics.f` ⇒ `publicdemo.statistics:f`); a bare name is EVERY id whose code name it is (an import or the module's own definition: over-approximated across modules, which only adds call-graph edges); any other colon spelling names nothing known. `joined` is anaJoinedIds knownIds, so a bare name costs one native substring test (and one split when it matches). A spelling that is a local variable may gain a spurious edge — harmless (the conservative direction). Field reads (`row.args`) find no id.

engine:anaSpellingsIn.label: analyze: spellings in a body
engine:anaSpellingsIn.description: Walk the 7-case core Expr collecting every ECall head and every EVar name, deduped, in first-occurrence order: the raw spellings anaCalleesIn resolves once each. A list literal's synthetic `appendItem` (totIsListLiteral) is a construction, not a call: its elements are walked, its head is not collected. The apply form `$` is application, a language-core form the evaluator runs directly (never a call to the registry's `($)` function): its head is not collected, its callee and arguments are walked (the group audit judges what it invokes, totUncheckedApply). A variable, or a var-head (`$dyn:`) call, whose root (totSpellingRoot) an enclosing lambda or arm pattern binds is a local and is skipped (exact: such a spelling denotes the local, never a function; the function's own params are not visible here and stay conservative). ELambda/EMatch (arm guards included — a guard runs before its body)/EConstruct/ERecord recurse their subterms.

engine:anaVerdictTagOf.label: analyze: verdict tag of subject in results
engine:anaVerdictTagOf.description: Find the {ids, verdict} group result whose member-ids include `subjectId` and return its verdict TAG; a subject absent from every group ⇒ "Unknown" (the soundness-conservative default — never a silent Total). Walks the analyzeFunctions results. Internal helper.

engine:anaVerdictTagOver.label: analyze: verdict tag over an adjacency
engine:anaVerdictTagOver.description: verdictTagFor's decision over a precomputed adjacency ({id, callees} rows whose callees are ids of `functions`): the subject's forward reach, the refusal of a missing or unlowered reached record, and the SCC verdicts (own group first, then the callee groups, singletons before multi-member groups). verdictTagForIn calls it with callees resolved once against the whole registry and restricted to the bodied records.

engine:anaVerdictToTag.label: analyze: verdict tag of a Totality
engine:anaVerdictToTag.description: Project a Totality verdict to its string tag: Total ⇒ "Total", Unknown ⇒ "Unknown", Partial ⇒ "Partial". The kernel-gate consumes the string (the `$`-key-free pre-computed fact the marshal seam threads into verifyProof). Internal helper.

engine:analyzeCallees.label: analyze: callees of a body
engine:analyzeCallees.description: The deduped list of registry-function callees of a core Expr body: the knownIds its call heads and EVar references may denote under spelling normalization (anaSpellingTargets; the effect-visibility Phase 1 var-ref edge included). Seeds anaCalleesIn with an empty accumulator. The directed call-graph edges out of a function; the kernel gate's reachable-set gather (kernel.ts subjectTotalityVerdict) follows exactly these.

engine:analyzeFunctions.label: analyze: analyze functions
engine:analyzeFunctions.description: The analyze skeleton: filter the analyzable functions (the Unanalyzable bodies are excluded from the call graph — their callers lose that edge, sound under-approx), partition into SCCs (sccPartition), and run analyzeGroup per group. Returns a List {ids, verdict} — one entry per SCC. The per-function lowering of a stored JSON-Logic body to core Expr (via jsonLogicToExpr) happens in the census RUNNER BEFORE this (so both callee-extraction and the totality walk see core Expr).

engine:analyzeGroup.label: analyze: analyze one group
engine:analyzeGroup.description: The verdict for ONE SCC group: Partial when any member is declared @partial (D-3f-3), else the rung-3c checkMutualTotality verdict (Total | Unknown) over the group's {id, params, body} members. Returns {ids, verdict} — the member ids the verdict covers, plus the three-valued Totality. The headline compose: SCC-discovery + checkMutualTotality certify (or flag) a real mutual group.

engine:andVerdict.label: And verdict
engine:andVerdict.description: Final tri-state verdict for closedAnd: false-seen ⇒ Just false; else unknown-seen ⇒ Nothing; else Just true. Internal helper.

engine:annDepArg.label: Annotation dependent arg
engine:annDepArg.description: One argument of a lowercase-headed annotation type application: a `{mk = "ref"}` marker whose name is lowercase-initial (a–z or `_`, the TS isLowerInitial) becomes the value marker `{mk = "value", name}`; anything else (an uppercase ref, a nested app, a raw number/string, a lowered value expression) passes through. modules-as-values Phase 2d.

engine:annTypeMarker.label: Annotation type marker
engine:annTypeMarker.description: Normalise an annotation's `{mk}` type marker like the TS parser's `liftDepApp`: in every `app` marker with a lowercase (non-A–Z) head, each bare lowercase-initial `ref` arg becomes a `{mk = "value"}` marker (a sibling value reference, walkType ⇒ `{var}`); applied recursively through app args, tuple items, arrow params/return and record fields. Uppercase-headed applications and every other marker pass through. modules-as-values Phase 2d.

engine:antijoinRows.label: rel-solve: antijoinRows
engine:antijoinRows.description: decide-substrate Phase 4T Step C — one negated atom over the rows: bind each row (zipBindings), keep it iff NO fact row matches the atom under those bindings (negAtomMatches). Internal helper.

engine:anyEmpty.label: empty: anyEmpty
engine:anyEmpty.description: Phase 6 Step 3 / type-substrate P1(a.6) — keyed-product emptiness. The entire product first passes scoped embedded/effective coordinate, eager-plan, reserved-wire, and enforcing-occurrence checks; only then does anyEmptyFold prove emptiness from any empty factor. An empty ready product is inhabited.

engine:anyEmptyT.label: empty: anyEmptyT
engine:anyEmptyT.description: Phase 6 Step 3 — the tuple (product) emptiness fold: empty iff ANY item type is empty (mOr-fold of emptyW over the bare TtTuple item types); an empty item-list ⇒ Just false. Internal helper.

engine:anyEq.label: Any eq
engine:anyEq.description: True when some element of `vals` is `eq` to `x` (the WsEnum scan). Internal helper.

engine:anyMember.label: Any member
engine:anyMember.description: True when `x` is a wsMember of some branch (WsUnion). Internal helper.

engine:appendFieldsToLastCtor.label: Append fields to final constructor
engine:appendFieldsToLastCtor.description: Append separator-less continuation fields to the current final constructor while preserving every preceding constructor. Signature-substrate Phase 2 multiline-ADT layout repair.

engine:applicableOperationsFor.label: Applicable operations for
engine:applicableOperationsFor.description: structural-dispatch Phase 3 — the universe-view `applicableOperationsFor(value)`: the ids of every function whose FIRST parameter ACCEPTS a value of `valTypeName` — either the param's type-constructor name equals `valTypeName` (nominal accept) OR the param is a type variable (TtVar — polymorphic, accepts any type). A nullary function (no params) accepts nothing. The LIGHT arm — runs the nominal/polymorphic accept check, no decider (a predicate-bounded param's ⊆-accept is the deferred ⊆ tail). The function list is supplied by the TS reflection seam.

engine:applicableOperationsForFold.label: universe-views: applicableOperationsForFold
engine:applicableOperationsForFold.description: structural-dispatch Phase 3 — the head/tail fold behind applicableOperationsFor: walk the marshalled function list, appending `f.id` when its first param accepts `valTypeName` (firstParamAccepts). Internal helper.

engine:applyCompare.label: Apply compare
engine:applyCompare.description: Apply a comparison op to two numbers ⇒ Bool (lt / lte / gt / gte). Internal helper.

engine:applyComparisonNarrow.label: narrow: apply comparison
engine:applyComparisonNarrow.description: Upsert a variable's narrowed type into both branch envs from a comparison against a numeric literal: existing = the var's current trueEnv binding (default $all); trueEnv gets normMarker(existing ∩ trueConstraint), falseEnv gets normMarker(existing ∩ falseConstraint). The constraints: > ⇒ true (lit,∞) / false (-∞,lit]; >= ⇒ true [lit,∞) / false (-∞,lit); < / <= symmetric; ==/=== ⇒ true {lit} / false (all ∖ {lit}). Internal helper.

engine:applyCtorLayoutTail.label: Apply constructor layout tail
engine:applyCtorLayoutTail.description: Fold orphaned post-vclose constructor-layout events in source order: a field event appends to the current final constructor; a constructor event appends a peer. A top-level declaration cannot appear here because layout prefixes it with vsemi. Signature-substrate Phase 2.

engine:applyDollarPair.label: Apply-$ pair
engine:applyDollarPair.description: Peel one (param, value, body) from an `ECall "$"` arg list: requires exactly 2 args with arg0 an ELambda of exactly 1 param. Returns Nothing when the shape doesn't match (genuine `($)` call).

engine:applyFieldOwnerMutationsKernel.label: Apply field owner mutations
engine:applyFieldOwnerMutationsKernel.description: Apply an atomic multi-owner upsert/delete request to the server-loaded current owner graph. Duplicate mutation targets and missing deletes are structured errors; the host never reconstructs mutation semantics with a Map.

engine:applyNegAtoms.label: rel-solve: applyNegAtoms
engine:applyNegAtoms.description: decide-substrate Phase 4T Step C — fold the negated atoms as antijoin row filters over the tuple-set (a row survives every negAtom whose instantiation has NO matching fact). Internal helper.

engine:applyResiduals.label: Apply residuals
engine:applyResiduals.description: Apply each residual conjunct as a row filter in turn (a row survives only if EVERY residual is proven true). Internal helper.

engine:applyWhereOpt.label: Apply where clause
engine:applyWhereOpt.description: The statement-level `where`-clause attach: a non-empty bindings list ⇒ `SWhere { body, bindings }` (the faithful additive case `desugar` lowers to let), an EMPTY list (no `where`) ⇒ the bare body unchanged. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 4.

engine:argIsStringTyped.label: Arg is string-typed
engine:argIsStringTyped.description: Per-arg string-typed predicate. CeLit string → True; CeVar with dotted access → True; CeCall with callDomainOf.resultDomain=DomRef → True; otherwise False.

engine:arity.label: Arrow arity
engine:arity.description: signature-substrate Phase A — the arity of the FLATTENED spine (flatten first, then count): `(A) -> ((B) -> C)` and `(A,B) -> C` both have arity 2 — the currying calling convention makes them the same value set. Non-arrow values have arity 0.

engine:armAssume.label: fork: arm-assume
engine:armAssume.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — build a forkable arm's POSITIVE assumption + captures: PatWildcard ⇒ { assume=Nothing, captures=[] }; PatVar n ⇒ { assume=Nothing, captures=[{name=n, expr=scrutinee}] } (the var binds the whole scrutinee); PatLit L ⇒ { assume=Just (eq scrutinee (ELit L)), captures=[] }; PatConstruct C args ⇒ forkCtorAssume (eq scrutinee (EConstruct C [fresh vars/lits]) + the payload captures). Internal helper.

engine:arrowAlgebraCurryLayers.label: arrow-algebra: curry layers
engine:arrowAlgebraCurryLayers.description: signature-substrate Phase A — right-nest a non-empty flat param list into 1-ary TtArrow layers over the given returns (each layer's single param re-derived at ordinal 0; the outer raw threaded onto every synthesized layer — the ttArrowFlatten raw-threading precedent, in reverse). Internal helper.

engine:arrowAlgebraReindex.label: arrow-algebra: reindex arrow
engine:arrowAlgebraReindex.description: signature-substrate Phase A — repair a TtArrow's param container to the P3 container law after a structural re-presentation (positional keys re-derived to their ordinals; named keys untouched). Non-arrow values pass through. Internal helper.

engine:arrowAlgebraReindexFrom.label: arrow-algebra: reindex params from
engine:arrowAlgebraReindexFrom.description: signature-substrate Phase A — re-derive container-relative positional identity across a whole param list, ordinals counting from the given start. Internal helper.

engine:arrowAlgebraReindexParam.label: arrow-algebra: reindex param
engine:arrowAlgebraReindexParam.description: signature-substrate Phase A — re-derive one arrow param's container-relative positional identity at its new ordinal (index, wireName, name, authoring-input view all re-agree; the opaque token and the type/raw payloads ride unchanged). NamedField-keyed params are identity-stable across re-presentation and pass through untouched. Internal helper.

engine:arrowAlgebraWrapParam.label: arrow-algebra: wrap param
engine:arrowAlgebraWrapParam.description: signature-substrate Phase A — wrap a param TYPE as a computed TtArrowParam with ordinal positional identity (name/wireName "_<ordinal>", PositionalFieldInput/PositionalField <ordinal>, synthetic token; raw = the wrapped type's own raw). The identity-total spelling for unnamed computed slots per the field-identity Phase-3 container law. Internal helper.

engine:arrowAlgebraWrapParamsFrom.label: arrow-algebra: wrap params from
engine:arrowAlgebraWrapParamsFrom.description: signature-substrate Phase A — wrap a list of param TYPES as computed TtArrowParams, ordinals counting from the given start. Order-preserving. Internal helper.

engine:arrowClosureContains.label: set-algebra: arrowClosureContains
engine:arrowClosureContains.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.2 / 8λ.2-r / 8λ.5 — a `{__fenelFn}` lambda CLOSURE's SeArrow membership (the 8λ.1 GAP flip): the closure type-CHECKS through the trusted CHECK judgment. Read `params` (a list of param-name strings) + `body` (raw JSON-Logic) through dynamic-key `mapGet` own-property reads; lift the body to a core Expr (bodyToExpr — the D1 marshal seam); REBUILD the term as an `ELambda` and hand the WHOLE membership question to `checkExpr` against the goal arrow (8λ.2-r SUBSUMPTION: the previous duplicated arity-check + param-bind here missed the vacuous-domain gate and falsely refuted on curried arities — checkLambda now owns arity/vacuous/curry/shadowing in ONE place; check.fenel, bare-name same-module reuse). 8λ.5: an OPTIONAL `fix` envelope slot (a non-empty string — the recursion self-name; the fix-marked closure the recursion synthesizer emits and the invoke self-bind executes) routes to `checkExprFix` — the chk.fix rule (premise + structural-descent side condition); ABSENT or non-string ⇒ the plain `checkExpr` route, byte-preserved. A body whose lift fences / a non-SeArrow goal ⇒ Nothing. Closure CAPTURES are not bound (a free body var ⇒ honest Nothing — the documented v1 fence). THIS is what makes type-checking a lambda kernel-reachable: the kernel witness rule re-checks `{closure} ⊆ SeArrow` through this arm. Internal helper to setAlgebraArrowContains.

engine:arrowDropList.label: set-algebra: arrowDropList
engine:arrowDropList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — drop the first `n` elements of a list (n≤0 ⇒ unchanged; exhausted ⇒ []). Internal helper to arrowDropParams.

engine:arrowDropParams.label: set-algebra: arrowDropParams
engine:arrowDropParams.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — drop the first `n` params of a SeArrow (the partial-application residual signature); a non-SeArrow set ⇒ unchanged. Internal helper.

engine:arrowFlatten.label: set-algebra: arrowFlatten
engine:arrowFlatten.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.2-r — CURRY-NORMALIZE a SeArrow: while the codomain is itself a SeArrow, pull its params up (`SeArrow ps (SeArrow qs r)` ⇒ `SeArrow (ps++qs) r`). Sound at the VALUE-SET level because Fenel's calling convention curries both ways (under-application yields a partial, over-application spills onto a callable result — probe-verified json-logic.ts:1871/:1887), so the flat and curried spellings denote the SAME set of function values. Non-SeArrow ⇒ unchanged. Internal helper.

engine:arrowIdMembership.label: set-algebra: arrowIdMembership
engine:arrowIdMembership.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 / 8λ.1-r / signature-substrate Phase 2 — the registered-fn signature membership: resolve fnId → its arrow signature marker via the `fnTypeMarker` ctx-native (Nothing ⇒ unresolved ⇒ Nothing; not pure ⇒ effectful referent ⇒ Nothing; not trusted ⇒ advisory/unadmitted signature ⇒ Nothing); use typeToSetProjection and widen degradation to SeAll BEFORE dropping the first `dropN` params (the partial-application residual), then decide via arrowSigMembership (the vacuous-goal gate precedes its exactness-fenced DIRECT variance core). Internal helper. Rides the decider ctx (fnTypeMarker is a ctx-native — the SeWhere/SeRef membership class).

engine:arrowParamsInhab.label: set-algebra: arrowParamsInhab
engine:arrowParamsInhab.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — the all-params-inhabited Kleene-AND fold for setAlgebraArrowEmpty: a param decidably EMPTY ⇒ Just false (not-all-inhabited — the vacuous-fn escape); all params decidably nonempty ⇒ Just true (an empty param list ⇒ Just true — a thunk ()→R is empty iff R is); any undecided ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:arrowPartialBaseId.label: set-algebra: arrowPartialBaseId
engine:arrowPartialBaseId.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — the underlying-callable id of a `{__fenelPartial}` read through dynamic-key `mapGet` own-property reads: `fn` a String ⇒ Just it; `fn` a `{$ref: id}` ⇒ Just the id; a closure / anything else ⇒ Nothing (residual-of-a-closure is the 8λ.2 CHECK face). Internal helper.

engine:arrowPartialContains.label: set-algebra: arrowPartialContains
engine:arrowPartialContains.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — a `{__fenelPartial}` value's SeArrow membership: the residual signature = the underlying callable's signature minus the `collected` leading args. Read `collected` (its length = the drop count) + `fn` (the base callable id); a string / `{$ref}` base ⇒ arrowIdMembership baseId collectedN; a closure / absent base ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:arrowRefContains.label: set-algebra: arrowRefContains
engine:arrowRefContains.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — a `{$ref: id}` value's SeArrow membership: id must be a String ⇒ arrowIdMembership id 0 (no dropped params — a bare reference is the full signature); else Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:arrowSigAligned.label: set-algebra: arrowSigAligned
engine:arrowSigAligned.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.2-r — the signature-membership verdict against the FLATTENED goal (registered signatures are already flat — signatureFromSig; the goal may be hand-built curried, so a 2-ary registered fn IS a member of `(A)→((B)→C)` by partial application — the currying bridge): EQUAL arities ⇒ the variance core; sig arity < goal arity ⇒ the value applied to the goal's arity over-applies past its own (declared-semantics UB; the runtime arg-drop is a fenced quirk) ⇒ Just false, gated on the sig codomain provably CALLABLE-FREE (a callable codomain would absorb the extras — legit curried spill) + goal params decidably NONEMPTY; sig arity > goal arity ⇒ the goal-applied value is a PARTIAL (a callable) ⇒ Just false when the goal codomain is provably callable-free (+ the nonempty gate); else Nothing. Internal helper to arrowSigMembership.

engine:arrowSigMembership.label: set-algebra: arrowSigMembership
engine:arrowSigMembership.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1-r / 8λ.2-r — the membership verdict for a RESOLVED signature against a goal SeArrow: (0) 8λ.2-r — the VACUOUS gate FIRST: any goal param domain decidably EMPTY ⇒ Just true (∀x∈∅ holds for any callable, and the callers only reach here for resolved registered fns — callable by construction; runs BEFORE the exactness fence because vacuous membership never reads the signature; also corrects the 8λ.1-r claim that the variance conjunction 'IS the literal membership condition' — it is only when every goal domain is nonempty); (1) the EXACTNESS fence — any SeAll anywhere in the projected signature (seHasAll) ⇒ Nothing: SeAll is the MARSHAL'S I-don't-know (free type var / $el / $type / opaque-no-pure / open map ⇒ TmAll ⇒ SeAll), NOT a declared ⊤ (false accept + false refutation both probe-confirmed at 8λ.1-r); (2) the UNGATED variance core (setAlgebraArrowSub) — sound both directions for a specific value's signature over NONEMPTY goal domains (the declared signature is ground truth, the same axiom every dispatch rests on). Internal helper to arrowIdMembership.

engine:arrowSomeParamEmpty.label: inhabit: arrowSomeParamEmpty
engine:arrowSomeParamEmpty.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — does SOME SeArrow param have a decidably-EMPTY domain (⇒ the vacuous-function witness inhabits — the param is never supplied)? Any Just true ⇒ true; else false. Internal helper to seWitnessArrow.

engine:arrowSub.label: subset: arrowSub
engine:arrowSub.description: Phase 6 Step 2b / decide-substrate 8λ.1-r / 8λ.2-r / floor-kernel Phase 2 / type-substrate P1(a.7) — arrow variance (north-star §6), CURRY-NORMALIZED + EMPTINESS-GATED on BOTH SIDES. UNREACHED from sound mode as of P1(a.7) (two implemented refuters survive every verdict: validation's registered-name paramCount, and the flatten-vs-written-arity divergence); retained registered as the arrow-recovery anchor. Phase-2 STOP-clause soundness fix (the F-differential reconciliation): both sides FLATTEN first (ttArrowFlatten — the 8λ.2-r Se* arrowFlatten mirrored onto the Tt* face; ⟦(A,B)→C⟧ = ⟦(A)→((B)→C)⟧ under the currying calling convention, so the old written-arity refutation of a flat-vs-curried pair was a false Just false where setAlgebraSubsetArrowArm proves Just true). Then: (1) a WANT-arrow with SOME param type decidably EMPTY (someParamEmptyW — e.g. `(Void)→X`) ⇒ Just true UNCONDITIONALLY (`∀x∈∅` holds vacuously for every callable); (2) a decidably-EMPTY have-arrow (emptyArrow) ⇒ Just true (∅ ⊆ want — the 8λ.1-r find); else EQUAL flattened arities take the variance verdict (arrowSubVariance, its Just-false gated on the have-arrow being decidably NONEMPTY) and RESIDUAL arity mismatches take the gated callable-tail refutation (ttArrowArityTail — all want-params provably inhabited ∧ the shorter side's codomain provably callable-free, the setAlgebraArrowSubAligned mirror; else Nothing). Internal helper.

engine:arrowSubVariance.label: subset: arrowSubVariance
engine:arrowSubVariance.description: decide-substrate 8λ.1-r — arrowSub's variance core: (p1->r1) ⊆ (p2->r2) iff params CONTRAVARIANT (want-params ⊆ have-params, pairwise) AND result COVARIANT (have-return ⊆ want-return). `nonemptyKnown` (the caller's emptyArrow verdict) gates a Just-false: only a decidably-NONEMPTY have-arrow certifies the refutation witness (a maybe-empty have ⇒ honest Nothing). Internal helper to arrowSub.

engine:assignBoth.label: assign: both
engine:assignBoth.description: Eager boolean conjunction used by the assignability marker walk. Returns True only when both operands are True.

engine:atomNewVars.label: Atom new vars
engine:atomNewVars.description: Collect the EVar argument names of an atom that are NOT already bound (deduped, first-appearance order) — the vars this atom introduces. Internal helper.

engine:atomSat.label: Atom satisfiable
engine:atomSat.description: Conservative atom satisfiability (pattern.ts isAtomSatisfiable): reject when some $all predicate does NOT fire, and when a firing predicate is a proven subset of a non-firing one. Only proven-unsatisfiable atoms are filtered; uncertain atoms pass. Internal helper.

engine:autoCaseName.label: type-algebra: autoCaseName
engine:autoCaseName.description: Derive an untagged-union case name directly from TraversalType. Exact List/Maybe/Result recognition, nominal handles, wrapper recursion, and structural kind selection are Fenel-owned; current field spellings never participate.

engine:autoLabel.label: validation-hints: autoLabel
engine:autoLabel.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — central SetExpr → human-readable description labeller. Walks the canonical `$tag` Se* ADT (SeAll/SeNone/SeWhere/SeRef/SeEnum/SeInterval/SePattern/SeComplement/SeUnion/SeIntersect/SeDiff) and emits the label string, resolving each leaf in-Fenel (lblWhere predicate introspection / autoLabelNamed / lblEnumReprs+autoLabelEnum / autoLabelInterval / lblClassifyPattern+lblPattern). The TS marshaller marshalSetExprForLbl is deleted; dispatchedAutoLabel normalises to `$tag` via setExprToTag. Mirrors validation-hints.ts:autoLabel (now a thin shim).

engine:autoLabelEnum.label: validation-hints: autoLabelEnum
engine:autoLabelEnum.description: Phase 8b sub-step 1 — `$enum` arm. ≤5 reprs → "one of: a, b, c"; >5 → "one of N options". Internal helper.

engine:autoLabelInterval.label: validation-hints: autoLabelInterval
engine:autoLabelInterval.description: Phase 8b sub-step 1 — `$interval` arm. Assemble per-bound parts with Unicode comparators (≥/>/≤/<) and join with " and ". Empty bounds → "any value". Internal helper.

engine:autoLabelNamed.label: validation-hints: autoLabelNamed
engine:autoLabelNamed.description: Phase 8b sub-step 1 — `$named` arm dispatch. Chain of startsWith checks (format:url:* / format:path:* / format:* / list:* / ℤ / ℕ / etc.) + URL/PATH preset lookups. Internal helper.

engine:autoLabelPathExt.label: validation-hints: autoLabelPathExt
engine:autoLabelPathExt.description: Phase 8b sub-step 1 — `format:path:ext:a|b|c` rendering. Split on `|`, single → "extension .a"; multi → "extension in {.a, .b, .c}". Internal helper.

engine:autoLabelPathPreset.label: validation-hints: autoLabelPathPreset
engine:autoLabelPathPreset.description: Phase 8b sub-step 1 — PATH_PRESET_LABELS lookup (14 entries: posix / windows / portable / absolute / relative / no-traversal / no-current / no-hidden / no-empty-segment / no-trailing-sep / no-null-byte / no-reserved / no-alt-stream / no-trailing-space-or-dot). Internal helper.

engine:autoLabelUrlPreset.label: validation-hints: autoLabelUrlPreset
engine:autoLabelUrlPreset.description: Phase 8b sub-step 1 — URL_PRESET_LABELS lookup (10 entries: web / secure / strict / ws / ftp / nosubdomain / noquery / nofragment / noport / nolocalhost). Internal helper.

engine:backIsArith.label: flow: backward is arithmetic?
engine:backIsArith.description: True for the four invertible binary arithmetic ops (+ - * /). Internal helper.

engine:backwardArith.label: flow: backward arith
engine:backwardArith.description: The binary-arith backward arm: read the two arg markers; if exactly the left is a var ⇒ infer the right side, invert onto the left (idx 0); if exactly the right is a var ⇒ infer the left side, invert onto the right (idx 1); both-or-neither var ⇒ env unchanged. Internal helper.

engine:backwardInfer.label: Backward infer
engine:backwardInfer.description: Backward flow inference: given a binary-arithmetic expression (as an ExprMarker), a declared canonical SetExpr output constraint, and the known-input env (a plain assoc list carrying canonical SetExpr values), infer the constraints the inputs must satisfy. Only `+ - * /` with exactly two args and exactly ONE variable side narrows: infer the known side's type, invert the output constraint onto the variable (with SeAll on the variable side), and—when the inverted constraint is not SeAll—intersect it into the variable's env binding via normMarker over SeIntersect. Every conservative case returns the env unchanged. unified-static-analysis Phase 3b-flow / floor-kernel Phase 4.

engine:backwardOneVar.label: flow: backward one var
engine:backwardOneVar.description: Invert the output constraint onto a single variable side: build the input markers ($all in the variable slot, the known side's inferred type in the other — knownIdx), invert (then normalize), and — unless the inverted constraint is $all — intersect it into the variable's current env binding (default $all). Returns the env unchanged when the constraint is $all. Internal helper.

engine:baseMaxOfIntersect.label: enumerable: baseMaxOfIntersect
engine:baseMaxOfIntersect.description: solver-extension Phase 2 — the attained max of a SeIntersect of interval branches GIVEN the base: fold via the SHARED seIntervalFold, then baseMaxOfInterval on the combined hi (so `x > 2 and x < 6` ⇒ Just 5). A non-interval branch ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:baseMaxOfInterval.label: enumerable: baseMaxOfInterval
engine:baseMaxOfInterval.description: solver-extension Phase 2 — the attained maximum of an interval's hi bound GIVEN the base: a discrete base (Int/Nat) ⇒ Just (intToNumber (hiBoundInt hb)) — inclusive endpoint OR step-in for an exclusive bound; Char ⇒ Just (hiBoundChar hb); a non-discrete (ℝ) base delegates to maxOfInterval (inclusive-only); an unbounded hi ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:baseMaxOfUnion.label: enumerable: baseMaxOfUnion
engine:baseMaxOfUnion.description: solver-extension Phase 3 — the attained max of a discrete `SeUnion`: enumerate via `enumerableSet base`, then the std `maximum` native (tier-1). A non-enumerable union ⇒ Nothing; the empty union ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:baseMinOfIntersect.label: enumerable: baseMinOfIntersect
engine:baseMinOfIntersect.description: solver-extension Phase 2 — the attained min of a SeIntersect of interval branches GIVEN the base: fold via the SHARED seIntervalFold (tighter lo/hi), then baseMinOfInterval on the combined lo (so `x > 2 and x < 6` ⇒ Just 3). A non-interval branch ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:baseMinOfInterval.label: enumerable: baseMinOfInterval
engine:baseMinOfInterval.description: solver-extension Phase 2 — the attained minimum of an interval's lo bound GIVEN the base: a discrete base (Int/Nat) ⇒ Just (intToNumber (loBoundInt lb)) — the inclusive endpoint, OR the step-in for an exclusive bound; Char ⇒ Just (loBoundChar lb); a non-discrete (ℝ) base delegates to minOfInterval (inclusive-only — the honesty fence); an unbounded lo (Nothing) ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:baseMinOfUnion.label: enumerable: baseMinOfUnion
engine:baseMinOfUnion.description: solver-extension Phase 3 — the attained min of a discrete `SeUnion`: enumerate the whole union via `enumerableSet base` (which steps each interval branch), then the std `minimum` native (tier-1 — orders numbers AND chars/strings). A non-enumerable union (an unbounded branch / non-discrete base) ⇒ Nothing; the empty union ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:bindConstructPatternSubs.label: Bind construct pattern subs (iteration)
engine:bindConstructPatternSubs.description: Per-sub-pattern iteration for PatConstruct's bind. Walks subs alongside an index counter; for each non-trivial sub (NOT PatLit / PatWildcard — note the skip differs from the guard's): field-load + allocLocal + LocalSet + recursive bindWasmPattern. PatVar IS recursed into here (aliases the field local).

engine:bindLlvmClosureParams.label: LLVM lowering: bindLlvmClosureParams
engine:bindLlvmClosureParams.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:bindLlvmOnePatternSub.label: LLVM lowering: bindLlvmOnePatternSub
engine:bindLlvmOnePatternSub.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:bindLlvmPattern.label: LLVM lowering: bindLlvmPattern
engine:bindLlvmPattern.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:bindLlvmPatternSubs.label: LLVM lowering: bindLlvmPatternSubs
engine:bindLlvmPatternSubs.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:bindOneConstructSub.label: Bind one construct sub
engine:bindOneConstructSub.description: Per-sub-pattern bind for PatConstruct. Skip on PatLit / PatWildcard. Else: LocalGet scrut + field-load + allocLocal + LocalSet + recursive bindWasmPattern. The bind recursion is what makes nested PatVar inside PatConstruct alias the field local (not the outer scrutinee).

engine:bindWasmPattern.label: Bind Wasm pattern
engine:bindWasmPattern.description: Emit field-load instructions AND bind every name introduced by pattern into ctx.locals. Top-level PatVar aliases the scrutinee local via setLocalAlias; PatConstruct iterates args, allocLocal+LocalSet for each non-trivial sub then recurse. PatLit + PatWildcard are no-ops. The caller (emitWasmMatchArms) snapshots/restores around this so bindings don't leak.

engine:bindingNames.label: Binding names
engine:bindingNames.description: Extract the `.name` field from each {name, value} binding into a List<String>. Used by JsLet's flat-IIFE arm to build the params list.

engine:bindingNamesContain.label: Binding names contain
engine:bindingNamesContain.description: Predicate: is `name` the .name of any binding in the list? Used by referencesName's JsLet arm to detect shadowing.

engine:bindingToLetItem.label: Binding to let item
engine:bindingToLetItem.description: Lower one SLet binding `{name, value}` to a separate `{let: {name: value}}` do-item (the TS parser emits one single-binding `{let}` per source `let` statement; the Fenel parser merges consecutive lets into one SLet, so the inverse re-splits). parser-substrate Phase 5a.

engine:bindingValueStrs.label: Binding value strings
engine:bindingValueStrs.description: Serialize each binding's `.value` into a List<String>. Used by JsLet's flat-IIFE arm to build the IIFE values list.

engine:bodyEmptyUnder.label: Body empty under
engine:bodyEmptyUnder.description: Does `pat` denote the EMPTY language `∅` given a name→true INDEX `empt` of already-known-empty productions? PEmpty ⇒ true; PSeq ⇒ either side empty (`∅·x = ∅`); PAlt ⇒ both sides empty (`∅|∅ = ∅`); PRep ⇒ `∅` only when it REQUIRES ≥1 rep (`mn>0`) AND the child is `∅` (a `mn==0` rep matches ε ⇒ nullable, NOT `∅`; for valid `min≤max` reps `mx==0 ⇒ mn==0`, so the old `mx==0` shortcut wrongly emptied a nullable exhausted bounded-rep — the algebra-differential bug the all-unbounded-rep corpus missed); PRed ⇒ child empty; PRef ⇒ in `empt`; PEps/PEpsV/PMatch ⇒ false (they accept ε-with-value / a token). The boolean (non-allocating) form of `isPEmpty ∘ simplifyEmpty` — used to compute the empty-set without rebuilding trees. Internal helper. parser-substrate Phase 8.

engine:bodyOf.label: Body of
engine:bodyOf.description: The body pattern of production `name` in a name→Pat env INDEX (a `fromEntries`-built record; PEmpty when absent — an unbound ref is dead). 7h S2: O(1) `mapGet` read replacing the O(|g|) `findEntry` scan. Internal helper.

engine:boolMapStable.label: Bool map stable
engine:boolMapStable.description: Positional equality of two `[{ name, val: Bool }]` assumption maps (both built by `map … g` over the same env ⇒ same length + order). True ⇒ the Kleene nullability iteration has converged. Internal helper.

engine:bothVariant.label: disjoint: bothVariant
engine:bothVariant.description: Phase 2.4 — the variant-arm gate of disjoint: true iff both operands are kind "$variant". Gates disjointVariant so a variant-vs-non-variant (or any other) pair falls to the unchanged disjointLeaf cascade (byte-identity preserved). Internal helper.

engine:boundIsJust.label: propagate: bound is Just
engine:boundIsJust.description: True when an interval bound marker is a present (Just) bound; Nothing = unbounded. Internal helper.

engine:boundValue.label: set-algebra: boundValue
engine:boundValue.description: Phase 7b-continuation — numeric extraction for a confirmed-numeric Bound.

engine:boundsOfKeys.label: Boundaries of keys
engine:boundsOfKeys.description: All boundary points induced by every predicate key's Ws marker (concatenated; deduped + min-extended by partitionReps). Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:boxBoolFuncType.label: boxBool func type
engine:boxBoolFuncType.description: Build the (i32) -> externref WasmFuncType for the $fenel.boxBool runtime helper used by coerceDomain when produced=DomBool, target=DomRef.

engine:boxNumFuncType.label: boxNum func type
engine:boxNumFuncType.description: Build the (f64) -> externref WasmFuncType for the $fenel.boxNum runtime helper used by coerceDomain when produced=DomNum, target=DomRef.

engine:branchBounds.label: Branch boundaries
engine:branchBounds.description: The union of every branch marker's boundaries (WsUnion/WsIntersect). Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:branchSingleCase.label: iso: branchSingleCase
engine:branchSingleCase.description: ISO-2 helper: extract the SOLE case of a single-case-variant branch (`Just c`), or `Nothing` for any other branch shape (a non-variant ⇒ the union is untagged). Internal helper.

engine:branchSingleField.label: iso: branchSingleField
engine:branchSingleField.description: ISO-4 helper: extract the SOLE field of a single-field-presence record branch (`Just f`), or `Nothing` for any other branch shape (a non-record ⇒ cross-base intersect). Internal helper.

engine:bridgeNames.label: subset: bridgeNames
engine:bridgeNames.description: Phase 5 (E-named) — both sides yield a nominal name (TtNamed or TtOpaque) ⇒ is have's name a Subsumable subset of want's (namedSubsetCheck)? The positive-only bridge body (gated by ssNominalBridge's ≥1-TtNamed check). Internal helper.

engine:buildApp.label: Build application
engine:buildApp.description: Fold an application head + argument list into Syntax (parseApp parity): a qualified-method SVar head (`Foldable.foldr`) ⇒ SMethod (checked FIRST, before the construct lift); no args ⇒ an uppercase SVar lifts to a 0-arg SConstruct, else the head passes through; with args ⇒ uppercase SVar head ⇒ SConstruct, lowercase SVar ⇒ SCall, a non-var head ⇒ SCall "apply" [head, …args]. The arg LIST is run through liftCtorArgs first (uppercase-ident args ⇒ nullary SConstruct — the head lift, now applied to args too). parser-substrate Phase 3b; arg-lift = the bug-(c) fix; SMethod arm fenel-surface-extensions Phase 6.

engine:buildAppU.label: Build application (unit-aware)
engine:buildAppU.description: buildApp + the `f ()` nullary-call rule: a SOLE unit argument is dropped, the head becoming a nullary SCall (lowercase) / SConstruct (uppercase) / SMethod (qualified-method head `Foldable.foldr ()` ⇒ 0-arg method) — `f ()` ⇒ `{call:["f"]}` (TS-parity), NOT the bare-var passthrough. Other arg lists delegate to buildApp. parser-substrate Phase 4h; SMethod arm fenel-surface-extensions Phase 6.

engine:buildAssigns.label: Build assigns
engine:buildAssigns.description: Build `<param> = $t<idx>` JsSAssign statements for each param, in order. Pairs with buildTempConsts. Phase 6b2.

engine:buildClosureBodyParams.label: Build closure body params
engine:buildClosureBodyParams.description: Produce a List<{name, domain=DomRef}> from a List<String> of names. Each entry pre-binds one positional slot at indices 0..N in the body frame. Forward-recursive walk + appendItem snoc.

engine:buildClosureBodyParamsWithEnv.label: Build closure body params (with env)
engine:buildClosureBodyParamsWithEnv.description: Prepend "$env" to the lambda params and delegate to buildClosureBodyParams. Two-step so the body file can keep the empty-acc seeding explicit.

engine:buildConPat.label: Build constructor pattern
engine:buildConPat.description: The case-arm head-pattern reduction: an UPPERCASE ident ⇒ PatConstruct { ctor, args } (no-ctorDef shape — no `fields`); a lowercase ident ⇒ PatVar { name }. Mirrors jlsTaggedPattern's positional fallback. parser-substrate Phase 3c (T4).

engine:buildConstructFields.label: Build construct fields
engine:buildConstructFields.description: Given a ctor name, lowered args, and a (possibly empty) fields list, build the JsObject.fields entries. First entry is `{key="$tag", value=JsLit ctor}`; subsequent entries iterate over args zipped with fields[i] (named-key) or `_<i>` (positional fallback).

engine:buildCtor.label: Build constructor
engine:buildCtor.description: A type-def constructor from its name + flat ELEM list: `{name, fields}` where fields run `foldCtorElems` (bare atoms / `:Type` markers ⇒ explicit PositionalField `_<i>` occurrences, `name:` markers ⇒ named application-typed fields, `afield` markers ⇒ named arrow-typed fields). parser-substrate Phase 4 (D2), field-identity Phase 2a.

engine:buildDataCtor.label: Build data constructor
engine:buildDataCtor.description: A dependent-ADT constructor from its name + full type-signature marker: `{name, type, fields}` where `type` is the verbatim sig marker (carried for the future dependent checker) and `fields` is its `dataCtorFields` arrow-spine decomposition. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 7 (D-G).

engine:buildDecls.label: Build declarations
engine:buildDecls.description: Re-assemble a decl-LINE list into the Program element list `[{frame, directives}]`: consecutive `@name args` directive lines accumulate and attach to the FOLLOWING real decl frame (the loader's collectLeads behaviour, fenel-module.ts:216). parser-substrate Phase 4 (D1).

engine:buildDeclsGo.label: Build declarations (go)
engine:buildDeclsGo.description: buildDecls' walk: thread a directive accumulator + the output element list; a directive line appends to the accumulator, a real frame flushes the accumulator onto `{frame, directives}` and resets. At end of input a NON-EMPTY accumulator means directives that annotate nothing: they emit a `dangling` frame (naming the first of them) instead of being silently dropped (declaration-annotations Phase 1 A.1). Internal decl-grammar helper. parser-substrate Phase 4 (D1).

engine:buildIIFEFrame.label: Build IIFE frame
engine:buildIIFEFrame.description: Build a single IIFE wrap string: `((<name>) => <innerStr>)(<valueStr>)`. List-builder + `join ""` pattern keeps the 7-piece concat readable.

engine:buildList.label: Build list literal
engine:buildList.description: Lower a list of item Syntaxes to the nested `appendItem`-chain of SCalls over a `SLit {value = []}` base (jlsArrayItems parity — args are [item, acc], left-folded). parser-substrate Phase 3b.

engine:buildListGo.label: Build list (go)
engine:buildListGo.description: buildList's left-fold: wrap the accumulator with `SCall appendItem [item, acc]` for each item in order. Internal expr-grammar helper. parser-substrate Phase 3b.

engine:buildLlvmClosureParamList.label: LLVM lowering: buildLlvmClosureParamList
engine:buildLlvmClosureParamList.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:buildLlvmDomainTypedParamList.label: LLVM lowering: buildLlvmDomainTypedParamList
engine:buildLlvmDomainTypedParamList.description: Phase 5b34 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:buildLlvmEntryParamList.label: LLVM lowering: buildLlvmEntryParamList
engine:buildLlvmEntryParamList.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:buildLlvmEntryParamListLoop.label: LLVM lowering: buildLlvmEntryParamListLoop
engine:buildLlvmEntryParamListLoop.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:buildLlvmPtrParamList.label: LLVM lowering: buildLlvmPtrParamList
engine:buildLlvmPtrParamList.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:buildMatchChain.label: Build match chain
engine:buildMatchChain.description: Fold a CeMatch's arms list into a nested JsTernary chain. Forward recursion builds the rest of the chain first (via tail), then wraps it as the else of the current arm's ternary. Result is structurally identical to the TS oracle's backwards iteration.

engine:buildMatchFail.label: Build match fail
engine:buildMatchFail.description: Construct the `$fenel.matchFail($scrut)` call used as the innermost else of a CeMatch's chained ternary.

engine:buildNamedConPat.label: Build named-field constructor pattern
engine:buildNamedConPat.description: A named-field constructor pattern (`Ctor { f = p, … }`) ⇒ `PatConstruct { ctor, args, fields }` (args in field order, `fields` the field-name list) — the marshal authors `{$tag:ctor, <field>:<subpat>}` via marshalPatterns' `fields[i]` key. parser-substrate Phase 4h.

engine:buildRecord.label: Build record literal
engine:buildRecord.description: Lower explicit source `{name = value}` fields to SRecord regardless of field count or value shape. Preserve list-literal markers and genuine appendItem calls for the source-to-IR marshal; legacy raw-IR key-as-function compatibility belongs to its separate adapter.

engine:buildSection.label: Build operator section
engine:buildSection.description: Lower a `(op)` section to the opAsLambda shape (fenel-parser.ts:2650): SLambda { params = [a, b], body = SCall fnId [SVar a, SVar b] } with fnId = (fixityOf table notation).fnId — the table row's emission codeName, key-as-fnId on a custom-op miss. `enc` is the operator's encoded token (Design E); notation recovered via splitVal. parser-substrate Phase 3b (T2).

engine:buildSourceSigFrame.label: Build source signature frame
engine:buildSourceSigFrame.description: Bind one parsed source signature at its declaration boundary. sourceBindSignature is Fenel-owned; this helper seats its compatibility marker and authoritative scheme sidecar directly on the grammar frame. Signature-substrate Phase 2.

engine:buildStmts.label: Build statements
engine:buildStmts.description: Re-nest a Stmts-list (statement ITEMS — let/bind bindings `{letb=true, bnd}` or bare exprs `{letb=false, expr}`) into Syntax, mirroring the adapter's jlsDoOp (the oracle re-nests the TS parser's flat `{do:[...]}`). 1 statement ⇒ the bare value (TS unwraps); ≥2 ⇒ leading lets ⇒ SLet over the rest, mid-stream lets nest recursively, pure segments ⇒ SDo. parser-substrate Phase 3c.

engine:buildTailChain.label: Build tail chain
engine:buildTailChain.description: Recurse on the tail of an arms list to build the inner-arm chain. Factored out so buildMatchChain stays single-case nested (layout-friendlier).

engine:buildTempConsts.label: Build temp consts
engine:buildTempConsts.description: Build `const $t<idx> = arg` JsSConst statements for each tail-call arg, in order. Phase 6b2.

engine:buildTemplate.label: Build template string
engine:buildTemplate.description: Lower a backtick template (begin chunk `C0`, first interpolation `E0`, the `[{chunk, expr}]` mid pairs, the final `end` chunk) to `SOp { op = "cat", operands }` (the operator-key carrier ⇒ the oracle's `{cat:[…]}`). Chunks become `SLit` operands; EMPTY-string chunks are DROPPED (parseInterp pushes a chunk only when its `v` is truthy); exprs are kept verbatim. parser-substrate Phase 7e Sn=3.

engine:buildTyApp.label: Build type application
engine:buildTyApp.description: Fold a TypeExpr application head marker + a list of atom-arg markers into a marker: no args ⇒ the head passes through; with args ⇒ `{mk = "app", head = head.name, args}` (the test walker resolves Maybe/List/Result via the std helpers, an unregistered head via `$el`). parser-substrate Phase 4 (D1).

engine:buildWasmImports.label: Build WasmFuncImport list
engine:buildWasmImports.description: Walk the builder's raw imports list (each {module, name, typeIdx}), dereferencing `imp.typeIdx` against the types list to resolve each import's funcType. Emits WasmFuncImport records with the resolved funcType inline. Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:1790-1795.

engine:bumpName.label: Bump name
engine:bumpName.description: The derived-sibling name of production `m` at step `k`, BOUNDED per-lineage (parser-substrate 7h): an ORIGINAL name (no `@`) gets ONE suffix `m@k` — a fresh lineage BORN at step k (the step at which the original was first referenced; re-entry into a fresh production). An ALREADY-derived name (`base@birth`, contains `@`) is returned UNCHANGED — same lineage, one more token consumed under the same stable name. So a derivative is named `base@birth` (O(1) length), NOT the cumulative `base@b1@b2@…@k` chain the pre-7h version appended every step (the O(k)-name-length term that was the dominant super-linear cost — S0 cubic diagnosis). The lineage `(base, birthStep)` is INVARIANT as the derivative consumes tokens, and collision-free: at any step there is exactly ONE live derivative per `(base, birth)` (deriveProductions maps over the deduped reach), and genuinely-distinct lineages (`Expr@6` vs `Expr@7`, born at different steps) stay distinct. Original production names never contain `@`, so the membership test is exact. Internal helper.

engine:cAlt.label: Containment alt
engine:cAlt.description: Recognizer alternation smart constructor (pattern.ts mkAlt): a PEmpty branch drops out; eps OR eps collapses to eps; else PAlt. Internal helper.

engine:cAltC.label: Containment alt (canonical)
engine:cAltC.description: ACI-canonical alternation: flatten both operands' branches, dedup by showPat, rebuild a right-nested PAlt — the Brzozowski-finiteness normaliser that keeps the structured walk's states bounded + the showPat memo effective. Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:cSeq.label: Containment seq
engine:cSeq.description: Recognizer sequencing smart constructor (pattern.ts mkSeq): PEmpty on either side annihilates; PEps on the left drops to the right, on the right drops to the left; else PSeq. DELIBERATELY collapses eps (recognizer-only) unlike pattern-algebra's value-preserving mkSeq. Internal helper.

engine:callClosureFuncType.label: callClosure_<N> func type
