engine:coerceLlvmResolved.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:coerceLlvmUnknownToPtr.label: LLVM lowering: coerceLlvmUnknownToPtr
engine:coerceLlvmUnknownToPtr.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:collectAllItems.label: Collect all items
engine:collectAllItems.description: Append every item of a list to an accumulator.

engine:collectApplyChain.label: Collect apply chain
engine:collectApplyChain.description: Walk a right-nested `ECall "$" [ELambda [p] body, v]` chain, peeling (param, value) pairs (snoc, source order) until the body is no longer that shape; returns { pairs, body }.

engine:collectAtomArgVars.label: Collect atom arg vars
engine:collectAtomArgVars.description: Append the direct EVar-argument names of one atom's arg list to the grounded set (deduped). Internal helper.

engine:collectClassRecordsAcc.label: representations: collectClassRecordsAcc
engine:collectClassRecordsAcc.description: Phase 10b sub-step 3 — internal accumulator-threaded walk for representationalClasses. Iterates names left-to-right + snocs each resolved ClassSeed onto `acc`. Order preserved via appendItem (head -> tail processing pairs with snoc-acc to give input-order output).

engine:collectDynFreeVar.label: Collect $dyn free var
engine:collectDynFreeVar.description: Recognise the `$dyn:<varName>` sentinel that CoreCall uses to encode indirect calls through a captured function value. Adds the referenced name to the free set when the prefix matches and the name isn't already bound.

engine:collectFieldIdentitiesKernel.label: Collect field identities
engine:collectFieldIdentitiesKernel.description: Fenel-native field identity kernel. Accepts typed declaration roots with explicit realm/mode, the physical/embedded lock view, external live fields, and an identity-kind index; returns structured errors or a complete deterministic occurrence/entity/lock projection.

engine:collectFreeVars.label: Collect free variables
engine:collectFreeVars.description: Walk a CoreExpr collecting names referenced but not bound locally. The 10-arm walker that mirrors `convert`'s recursion shape but accumulates a deduped free-var list instead of producing a converted tree. Used by the CoreLambda case in `convert` to compute the captures list.

engine:collectFreeVarsLetBindings.label: Collect free vars (let bindings)
engine:collectFreeVarsLetBindings.description: Walk a CoreLet.bindings list scanning each value's free vars with the CURRENT local set, then extending local with the bound name. Returns `{innerLocal, free}` for the caller to scan the let-body with the extended scope.

engine:collectFreeVarsList.label: Collect free vars (list)
engine:collectFreeVarsList.description: Iterate over a list of CoreExpr children, threading the free-vars accumulator through every step. Used by CoreCall.args / CoreDo.exprs / CoreConstruct.args cases.

engine:collectFreeVarsMatchArms.label: Collect free vars (match arms)
engine:collectFreeVarsMatchArms.description: Walk a CoreMatch.arms list, scanning each arm body with the pattern-extended local-bindings set.

engine:collectFreeVarsRecordFields.label: Collect free vars (record fields)
engine:collectFreeVarsRecordFields.description: Walk a CoreRecord.fields list, scanning each field value's free vars and threading the accumulator forward.

engine:collectKeys.label: Collect pattern keys
engine:collectKeys.description: Accumulate the distinct PMatch predicate keys reachable in a Pat (the per-state predicate set, order-preserving, deduped). Internal helper.

engine:collectLeads.label: Collect leading lets
engine:collectLeads.description: Walk from the head of a statement list, accumulating consecutive let/bind bindings (`s.bnd`) into a list; stop at the first non-let. Returns `{bindings, rest}` (jlsCollectLeadingLets mirror). Internal expr-grammar helper. parser-substrate Phase 3c.

engine:collectList.label: Collect list chain
engine:collectList.description: Recognise a LIST-LITERAL appendItem chain (every node `lit`-marked, bottoming at `SLit []`) and rebuild the source array literal (items in order). Returns Just [items] for a list-literal chain, Nothing otherwise — a genuine appendItem call (unmarked nodes) or a non-list rest stays a call. parser-substrate Phase 5a / Phase 7k Class A.

engine:collectParamNames.label: Collect param names
engine:collectParamNames.description: Walk a list of JsonLogic nodes, expecting JlString; accumulate string values. Errors on non-string.

engine:collectPatternBindings.label: Collect pattern bindings
engine:collectPatternBindings.description: Walk a CorePattern, accumulating bound names. PatVar binds its `name`; PatConstruct recurses into sub-patterns; PatLit / PatWildcard bind nothing.

engine:collectPatternBindingsForJs.label: Collect pattern bindings (JS)
engine:collectPatternBindingsForJs.description: Accumulator-threaded walk over a CorePattern, collecting `{name, value}` entries where `value` is the JsMember-chain access path through the scrutinee. The TS oracle mutates an `accum` array; the Fenel translation threads the accumulator through recursion. Two-arm PatConstruct dispatch as in emitPatternGuard.

engine:collectPatternBindingsList.label: Collect pattern bindings (list)
engine:collectPatternBindingsList.description: Iterate over a list of sub-patterns, threading the accumulator through collectPatternBindings.

engine:collectPatternBindingsLoop.label: Collect pattern bindings (loop)
engine:collectPatternBindingsLoop.description: Iterate over a PatConstruct's sub-patterns, building the JsMember-chain access path for each and recursing into collectPatternBindingsForJs.

engine:collectRefs.label: Collect refs
engine:collectRefs.description: The list of `PRef` names directly inside `pat` (structural — recurses through Seq/Alt/Rep/Red but NOT through a ref's body, since PRef is a leaf here). Internal helper.

engine:collectReprEntriesAcc.label: representations: collectReprEntriesAcc
engine:collectReprEntriesAcc.description: Phase 10b sub-step 3 — internal accumulator-threaded walk for representationsForTarget. Iterates class names left-to-right + for each, snocs {typeName, instance} onto `acc` when dispatchLookupOne returns Just.

engine:collectTypeNames.label: Collect type names
engine:collectTypeNames.description: Phase 7a / field-identity Phase 3 — collect every named reference and Fenel-recognized tagged-phantom entity name reachable in an identity-total TraversalType. Returns a deduplicated insertion-ordered list.

engine:combineFork.label: fork: combine
engine:combineFork.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — merge two fork sub-results { paths, complete }: concat the path lists; complete = both complete UNLESS the merged count exceeds the budget (⇒ complete=false, the overflow signal — consumers degrade to Nothing). No truncation (eager pruning bounds the real explosion; the budget is a completeness flag). Internal helper.

engine:compToSet.label: set-algebra: compToSet
engine:compToSet.description: Map (op, value, varSide) to a canonical `Se*` SetExpr covering the five comparison output shapes (SeEnum, SeDiff-of-SeEnum, SeInterval-lo, SeInterval-hi, SeAll). `isNumeric` is pre-classified at the marshaller (`typeof value === 'number'`); body uses `flipComp` for the varSide swap. decide-substrate Phase 3: emits the registered `$tag` Se* DIRECTLY (the CompToSetResult / Cts* intent marker + its TS unmarshaller RETIRED). The Aggregable-composition lift's comparison arm (recognizeAggregableComposition). Internal helper.

engine:compileFieldSlotsError.label: Compiler field slots error
engine:compileFieldSlotsError.description: Validate one compiler/reflection slot list. Current compiler wire names must be non-empty and unique; UUID/key/ordinal validity and duplicate semantic keys delegate to fieldSemanticSlotsError after a positional-wire-only canonical projection. Nothing means valid.

engine:compileFieldSlotsErrorWithSourceH.label: Compiler field slots error with SourceHandles
engine:compileFieldSlotsErrorWithSourceH.description: Source-registry compiler validation: preserve compiler wire, duplicate, ordinal, and UUID laws while admitting only rigorously validated lock-less SourceHandles.

engine:compileHasUnresolvedConstructorWi.label: Compiler exact constructor wire fence
engine:compileHasUnresolvedConstructorWi.description: Detect any constructor in an Expr or match pattern whose projected runtime wire name remains in or enters the reserved @ctor namespace.

engine:compileResolveCalls.label: Resolve compile calls
engine:compileResolveCalls.description: Resolve bare ECall heads through the explicit defining-module binding index. Fenel owns lookup and the recursive Expr rewrite; the host only marshals the current module's declaration bindings.

engine:compileResolveConstructorWires.label: Resolve compile constructor wires
engine:compileResolveConstructorWires.description: After exact constructor metadata selection, recursively project EConstruct and PatConstruct semantic targets to their runtime ADT wire tags for every compiler backend.

engine:compileResolveValueRefs.label: Resolve function value references
engine:compileResolveValueRefs.description: Rewrite every variable that names a global function (a bare lowercase name bound by no binder in scope) to `$fn:<runtime key>`, the key a call head of the same spelling resolves to through the module binding index: the canonical id when the index lists it, the bare name otherwise. Backends lower it to the runtime reference a call uses (JS `$fenel[key]`); binders in scope shadow globals.

engine:compileSlotWireNames.label: Compile slot wire names
engine:compileSlotWireNames.description: Project current wireName values from key-bearing CompileFieldSlot metadata to seed closure conversion's lexical visible-bindings set.

engine:compileUnresolvedHeads.label: Collect unresolvable references
engine:compileUnresolvedHeads.description: Walk a resolved Expr with the lexical binders in scope (parameters, lambda parameters, pattern binders; never `_`) and collect every reference no target can compile correctly: a `$dyn:<path>` head whose root is no binder in scope, a variable whose root is no binder in scope and which names no global function (dotted, qualified, `_` or uppercase), or a dotted string head the binding index left unresolved.

engine:compilerConstructorCatalogPlan.label: Compiler constructor catalog plan
engine:compilerConstructorCatalogPlan.description: Classify record/variant constructors from registry TraversalTypes, validate identity-total fields, deduplicate repeated semantic profiles, and pre-plan the unscoped base/conflict slice. The result is a policy-owned immutable catalog for the host cache.

engine:compilerConstructorProjectionPlan.label: Compiler constructor projection plan
engine:compilerConstructorProjectionPlan.description: Apply canonical owner scope and function-boundary preferences to a Fenel-decided constructor catalog. Same-owner drift is rejected under explicit scope; unresolved spellings are reported as ambiguity metadata.

engine:compilerFunctionTypeOwnerIds.label: Compiler function type owners
engine:compilerFunctionTypeOwnerIds.description: Validate the complete function-boundary TraversalType forest, then collect the canonical semantic owner ids explicitly named in type positions. Applied-type heads and their arguments are both visible; field keys, raw payloads, presentation metadata and SetExprs are deliberately invisible.

engine:comprehend.label: Comprehend
engine:comprehend.description: The ONE comprehension-builder ⟦{x | P x}⟧: lower a predicate `Expr` over `varName` to the canonical `Se*` SetExpr. TOTAL. The decidable fragment: literal true/false ⇒ SeAll/SeNone; `x == v` (either orientation) ⇒ SeEnum; `x != v` ⇒ SeDiff SeAll (SeEnum [v]); ordered comparisons over number/string literals ⇒ SeInterval (var-on-right flips the op; bool/other bounds fence); and/or/not ⇒ SeIntersect/SeUnion/SeComplement; compound affine terms `coeff·x + k` invert (the P12 widening — eq ⇒ SeEnum [k/a], comparisons ⇒ the possibly-flipped interval, zero-coeff ⇒ SeAll/SeNone). Everything else ⇒ the SeWhere fence carrying the residual Expr (`comprehendClosed` is the no-fence face). Absorbs predicateToSet + whereToSetExpr's math (decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage A).

engine:comprehendClosed.label: Comprehend (closed)
engine:comprehendClosed.description: The all-or-nothing face of comprehend: Just the SetExpr when the WHOLE predicate lowered into the decidable fragment; Nothing when any SeWhere fence appears anywhere in the result (a comprehend-fence SeWhere carries the residual predicate as `Expr`, which must not leak into `$`-key/JSON-Logic consumers). The boundary consumers (the `$where` extraction wrapper) route through this. decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage A.

engine:comprehendWhere.label: Comprehend (where)
engine:comprehendWhere.description: The `$where`-predicate entry of the ONE recognizer (replaces `whereToSetExpr`): walk the pre-marshalled JsonLogicExpr ADT to Maybe SetExpr. JleAnd/JleOr fold all-or-nothing with the 0 ⇒ SeAll/SeNone, 1 ⇒ child-as-is, n ⇒ SeIntersect/SeUnion shortcuts; JleNot ⇒ SeComplement; JleModEq ⇒ SeRef (the `multiple:N` named set); JleIn ⇒ SeEnum; JleComp (legacy, no longer marshalled) reconstructs the comparison Expr and routes through comprehendClosed; JleExpr (the NEUTRAL lift — the marshal's fall-through via jsonLogicToExpr) ⇒ comprehendClosed over the lifted Expr — the arm through which the `$where` path inherits the affine inversion. JleOther ⇒ Nothing. decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage A.

engine:conformCongruent.label: conformable: scalar congruence
engine:conformCongruent.description: array-substrate Phase 4 — the non-map (scalar / rank-0 `Array [] a = a`, or any other shape) arm of `conformable`: mutual subset (`subsetW` both directions = type equality). A scalar conforms only to an equal scalar type. Internal helper.

engine:conformMap.label: conformable: conformMap
engine:conformMap.description: array-substrate Phase 4 — the total-array conformance rule: key/index EQUALITY (`decideSubset (keys have) (keys want)` AND the reverse — mutual subset = equality, the § 2b headline; `Vec 3` vs `Vec 4` fails here while the partial-dictionary `ssMap` would pass `Vec 3 <: Vec 4`) ∧ covariant values (`subsetW` over the value types). Internal helper.

engine:conformable.label: Conformable types (array shape-conformance)
engine:conformable.description: array-substrate Phase 4 — `conformable have want` decides whether two array TYPES conform (a Tri): the KEY/index domains are EQUAL (`decideSubset` BOTH directions — total-array equality, not the partial-dictionary `⊆` ssMap uses) AND the values are covariant (`subsetW` one direction). `$opaque`-transparent (peels the `Array` wrapper to the inner `$map`). Non-map shapes (scalars) fall to mutual-subset congruence. The containment-family member for total arrays; the sound `Nothing` surfaces honest undecidability (treated as non-conformant at a hard boundary). design/array-substrate.md § 2b.

engine:conformableMapArm.label: conformable: map arm
engine:conformableMapArm.description: array-substrate Phase 4 — the `$map`/array arm of `conformable`: both sides must be `$map`-shaped, then `conformMap`; a map-vs-non-map ⇒ Just false (a kind mismatch — an array does not conform to a scalar/record). Internal helper.

engine:constraintBindingsFor.label: Constraint bindings for owner
engine:constraintBindingsFor.description: Select constraint bindings for one exact structural scope and owner. Current field codenames are never consulted or returned.

engine:constraintFieldsFor.label: Constraint fields for owner
engine:constraintFieldsFor.description: Project identity-bearing targets from Fenel-selected constraint bindings for one exact scope and owner.

engine:constraintsAllPassed.label: validation-hints: constraintsAllPassed
engine:constraintsAllPassed.description: Phase 8b sub-step 2 — true if every constraint's `passed` is true. Empty list → true (vacuous truth). Used by validateWithHints's $intersect arm. Internal helper.

engine:constraintsAnyPassed.label: validation-hints: constraintsAnyPassed
engine:constraintsAnyPassed.description: Phase 8b sub-step 2 — true if any constraint's `passed` is true. Empty list → false. Used by validateWithHints's $union arm. Internal helper.

engine:constructFuncType.label: construct func type
engine:constructFuncType.description: Build the (externref, i32) -> externref WasmFuncType for the $fenel.construct runtime helper. Used by lowerWasmTaggedRecord to materialise a freshly-tagged AdtHandle of the given $tag with N fields.

engine:containmentAtomicNamed.label: disjoint: atomicNamed
engine:containmentAtomicNamed.description: floor-kernel Phase 3c — true when a named domain is one of the scalar atom sorts (number/string/boolean); array and unknown domains do not justify a named-vs-structural disjoint claim. Internal helper.

engine:containmentConservative.label: containment: conservative
engine:containmentConservative.description: Phase 6 Step 1 — the same-shape no-positive-proof fall-through of disjoint: a check-1 Just false (a leaf proven NON-disjoint) ⇒ Just false (honest Tri, decision C-1); else Nothing. Both collapse to false under the Bool boundary (isDisjointType's conservative false). Internal helper to disjoint.

engine:containmentNamedDomain.label: disjoint: namedDomain
engine:containmentNamedDomain.description: floor-kernel Phase 3c — registry-backed named value-domain classification with no TS hierarchy flag: String descendants (including str:*) ⇒ string; Bool/Boolean ⇒ boolean; Number descendants ⇒ number; residual format/list/multiple prefixes use the shared Fenel classifier; char:* remains unknown because it accepts both codepoint numbers and one-character strings. Internal helper.

engine:containmentNamedPair.label: disjoint: namedPair
engine:containmentNamedPair.description: floor-kernel Phase 3c — decide a named pair from exact-name inhabitance or differing value domains. Internal helper.

engine:containmentProven.label: containment: proven
engine:containmentProven.description: Phase 6 Step 1 — isJustTrue over a Tri (Maybe Bool): `Just true` ⇒ true, `Just false`/`Nothing` ⇒ false. Internal helper to disjoint (the `return true` short-circuit gate). Mirrors maybe-bool.ts:isJustTrue.

engine:containmentStringNamed.label: disjoint: stringNamed
engine:containmentStringNamed.description: type-substrate P1(a.5) — true when a named domain is the STRING scalar sort. Split out because the string sort is the one atom an `$arrow` genuinely accepts (a fnId name), so it is the one exclusion ttNamedSortExclusive must make on the arrow column. Internal helper.

engine:containsRelHead.label: Contains relation head
engine:containsRelHead.description: Walk an `Expr` for any `ECall` whose head is a relation/rule in the facts env (anywhere, including under or/not/match/construct/record). True ⇒ the conjunct is NOT a pure residual ⇒ the stage-1 disjunction/negation fence fires. Internal helper.

engine:containsRelHeadArms.label: Contains relation head (arms)
engine:containsRelHeadArms.description: containsRelHead over EMatch arm bodies — true if any arm body mentions a relation/rule head. Internal helper.

engine:containsRelHeadFields.label: Contains relation head (fields)
engine:containsRelHeadFields.description: containsRelHead over ERecord field values — true if any field value mentions a relation/rule head. Internal helper.

engine:containsRelHeadList.label: Contains relation head (list)
engine:containsRelHeadList.description: containsRelHead over an Expr list — true if any element mentions a relation/rule head. Internal helper.

engine:convert.label: Convert CoreExpr to CeExpr
engine:convert.description: Structural CoreExpr → CeExpr transform with one twist: every CoreLambda is rewritten to a CeClosure carrying explicit captures. All other 9 cases mirror their input shape with sub-expressions converted recursively. Helper to makeClosuresExplicit — the 10-arm walker.

engine:convertLetBindings.label: Convert CoreLet bindings
engine:convertLetBindings.description: Walk a CoreLet.bindings list, converting each binding's value with the CURRENT visible-bindings then extending the set with the bound name (matches JSON-Logic let semantics). Returns `{bindings, innerVisible}` so the caller can convert the body with the extended scope.

engine:convertList.label: Convert CoreExpr list
engine:convertList.description: Iterate over a list of CoreExpr children, converting each via `convert` and appending to the accumulator. Threading helper used by the CoreCall.args, CoreDo.exprs, CoreConstruct.args cases.

engine:convertMatchArms.label: Convert CoreMatch arms
engine:convertMatchArms.description: Walk a CoreMatch.arms list, converting each arm body with the pattern-extended visible-bindings set. The pattern itself flows through unchanged.

engine:convertRecordFields.label: Convert CoreRecord fields
engine:convertRecordFields.description: Walk a CoreRecord.fields list, converting each field's value while preserving the field name. Threading helper for the CoreRecord case.

engine:cphAffine.label: comprehend: cphAffine
engine:cphAffine.description: Stage A — the affine fall-through (P12 math via the reused affineOf family): extract BOTH operands, normalise `lhs REL rhs` to `a·x REL k` (a = l.coeff − r.coeff, k = r.k − l.k), then orient (a>0), flip (a<0), or constant-fold (a=0). Either side non-affine ⇒ the SeWhere fence. Internal helper.

engine:cphAffineBuild.label: comprehend: cphAffineBuild
engine:cphAffineBuild.description: Stage A — build the SetExpr from the normalised `a·x REL k`: a = 0 ⇒ a constant comparison `0 REL k` (cphAffineConst ⇒ SeAll/SeNone); a > 0 ⇒ `x REL (k/a)` (op unchanged); a < 0 ⇒ the same with REL flipped (flipRel — reused). Internal helper.

engine:cphAffineConst.label: comprehend: cphAffineConst
engine:cphAffineConst.description: Stage A — the zero-coefficient (constant) case: evaluate `0 REL k` ⇒ SeAll when true, SeNone when false (`x == x` ⇒ SeAll, `x + 1 == x` ⇒ SeNone fall out here). Internal helper.

engine:cphAffineOriented.label: comprehend: cphAffineOriented
engine:cphAffineOriented.description: Stage A — build `x REL bound` post-normalisation: eq ⇒ SeEnum [bound] (the headline `2*x+5==6 ⇒ 0.5`); lt/lte/gt/gte ⇒ cphVarLeft (the var-on-left builder — var-on-right is already folded into the normalisation, so routing it again would double-flip). Internal helper.

engine:cphAnyWhere.label: comprehend: cphAnyWhere
engine:cphAnyWhere.description: Stage A — true when any branch in the list contains a SeWhere (seHasWhere lifted over lists). Internal helper.

engine:cphBoundOk.label: comprehend: cphBoundOk
engine:cphBoundOk.description: Stage A — interval bounds must be number- or string-valued (BoundNumber / BoundString are the decidable bound kinds); anything else fences. Internal helper.

engine:cphBranches.label: comprehend: cphBranches
engine:cphBranches.description: Stage A — map `comprehend varName` over an `and`/`or` operand list, accumulating SetExpr branches (no 0/1 shortcuts — those are the `$where` path's convention, applied in cphwAnd/cphwOr). Internal helper.

engine:cphCompare.label: comprehend: cphCompare
engine:cphCompare.description: Stage A — comparison `varName OP lit` ⇒ SeInterval (var-on-left uses OP directly; var-on-right flips OP) when the bound is a number or string (bool/other literal bounds FENCE — divergence 2); non-var-vs-lit falls through to the affine path. Internal helper.

engine:cphDispatch.label: comprehend: cphDispatch
engine:cphDispatch.description: Stage A — route an `ECall` head to the matching comprehend fragment builder (eq / neq / and / or / not / comparisons); unknown heads ⇒ the SeWhere fence. Internal helper.

engine:cphEq.label: comprehend: cphEq
engine:cphEq.description: Stage A — `varName == lit` (either orientation) ⇒ SeEnum [lit]; anything else falls through to the affine path (cphAffine), which inverts a compound `coeff·x + k == …`, or fences. Internal helper.

engine:cphNeq.label: comprehend: cphNeq
engine:cphNeq.description: Stage A — `varName != lit` (either orientation) ⇒ SeDiff SeAll (SeEnum [lit]) — the complement-of-singleton the old compToSet CtsDiffEnum arm emitted; non-var-vs-lit fences (no affine-neq exists at HEAD). Internal helper.

engine:cphNot.label: comprehend: cphNot
engine:cphNot.description: Stage A — `not p` ⇒ SeComplement over `comprehend p`; empty operands fence. Internal helper.

engine:cphVarLeft.label: comprehend: cphVarLeft
engine:cphVarLeft.description: Stage A — `var OP lit` (variable on the LEFT): lt ⇒ (-∞, v); lte ⇒ (-∞, v]; gt ⇒ (v, +∞); gte ⇒ [v, +∞). Emits the canonical SeInterval (Maybe-wrapped {value, inclusive} bounds — the live wire shape). Internal helper.

engine:cphVarRight.label: comprehend: cphVarRight
engine:cphVarRight.description: Stage A — `lit OP var` (variable on the RIGHT, so OP flips): lt ⇒ (v, +∞); lte ⇒ [v, +∞); gt ⇒ (-∞, v); gte ⇒ (-∞, v]. Internal helper.

engine:cphwAnd.label: comprehend: cphwAnd
engine:cphwAnd.description: Stage A / floor-kernel Phase 4 — fold the children of a JleAnd via cphwFold (short-circuit on Nothing), then the 0 ⇒ SeAll / 1 ⇒ child-as-is / n ⇒ normalized SeIntersect shortcuts. Bottom-up intersect normalization is Fenel-owned here; the former recursive TS wrapper walk is retired. Internal helper.

engine:cphwComp.label: comprehend: cphwComp
engine:cphwComp.description: Stage A — the legacy JleComp arm: map the op notation to its codeName (opNotationToCodeName — reused), rebuild the two-operand comparison Expr in the marshalled orientation, and route through comprehendClosed. Internal helper.

engine:cphwFold.label: comprehend: cphwFold
engine:cphwFold.description: Stage A — left-fold comprehendWhere over a JleAnd/JleOr children list threading the accumulated SetExpr list; short-circuits to Nothing on the first non-extractable child (the all-or-nothing extraction contract). Internal helper.

engine:cphwOr.label: comprehend: cphwOr
engine:cphwOr.description: Stage A — fold the children of a JleOr via cphwFold (short-circuit on Nothing), then the 0 ⇒ SeNone / 1 ⇒ child-as-is / n ⇒ SeUnion shortcuts (the old wtsBuildOr convention). Internal helper.

engine:cswAnyRecComp.label: set-algebra: cswAnyRecComp
engine:cswAnyRecComp.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.4 — cswSetIsRecComp over SeIntersect branches (any). Internal helper.

engine:cswArgBinds.label: set-algebra: cswArgBinds
engine:cswArgBinds.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — positional ctor-pattern arg binds: PatVar ⇒ bind to the i-th field var; PatWildcard ⇒ no bind; a lit / nested ctor / unknown arg ⇒ Nothing (the arm would constrain or split the field space — v2). Arity must equal the field count. Internal helper.

engine:cswBinds.label: set-algebra: cswBinds
engine:cswBinds.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the selected arm's substitution env: a ctor pattern binds each PatVar arg to its field var by POSITION (declaration order — arity must match; a lit/nested arg ⇒ Nothing); a var pattern binds the name to the whole ctor expr; the scrutinee var x always binds to the ctor expr (the body may reference it). Internal helper.

engine:cswBoundVar.label: set-algebra: cswBoundVar
engine:cswBoundVar.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — recover the comprehension's bound var from the v1 pred fragment: an EMatch whose scrutinee is an EVar ⇒ Just its name; anything else (incl. a JsonLogic pred, which matches no Expr ctor) ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:cswCertOp.label: set-algebra: cswCertOp
engine:cswCertOp.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — an operand's numeric certification: a numeric ELit, or a field var whose domain certifies numeric (the certs list). Internal helper.

engine:cswCerts.label: set-algebra: cswCerts
engine:cswCerts.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the certified-numeric field-var names (cswNumericSet fields) — the same-type guarantee the order-negation flip requires. Internal helper.

engine:cswCmpVals.label: set-algebra: cswCmpVals
engine:cswCmpVals.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — compare two ground values with the Step-1 runtime semantics: eq/neq via deepEqValue (structural); order via the same-type std comparisons (cross-type ⇒ false, matching the live eq/lt family). Internal helper.

engine:cswCompArgs.label: set-algebra: cswCompArgs
engine:cswCompArgs.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — extract the comparison's two operands (eufTwoArgs) and dispatch the negation. Internal helper.

engine:cswCompValid.label: set-algebra: cswCompValid
engine:cswCompValid.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — a single-comparison conjunct's validity: negate it and ask satCombined whether domAtoms ∪ {¬conjunct} is UNSAT (Just false ⇒ no field assignment falsifies the conjunct ⇒ valid). Non-comparison heads / non-2-arg ⇒ "nothing". Internal helper.

engine:cswConjuncts.label: set-algebra: cswConjuncts
engine:cswConjuncts.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — flatten an `and`-spine into a conjunct list (the trivial DNF-free decomposition the v1 honesty fence allows). Internal helper.

engine:cswConjunctsList.label: set-algebra: cswConjunctsList
engine:cswConjunctsList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — cswConjuncts folded over an `and`'s operand list. Internal helper.

engine:cswCtorArgs.label: set-algebra: cswCtorArgs
engine:cswCtorArgs.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the field-var EVar list for cswCtorExpr, declaration order. Internal helper.

engine:cswCtorExpr.label: set-algebra: cswCtorExpr
engine:cswCtorExpr.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the symbolic ctor value as an Expr: EConstruct c over the per-field vars (positional, declaration order). What the scrutinee var substitutes to. Internal helper.

engine:cswDecide.label: set-algebra: cswDecide
engine:cswDecide.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 / 8μ.4 — the arm's core: FIRST the v2 named-predicate unfold (cswNamedUnfold — an inline EMatch passes through with recName ""; a named-call pred `ECall f [EVar x]` resolves f's body via the fnBody seam native to the v1 EMatch fragment, carrying recName = f so the IH conjunct discharge can fire; anything else / unknown fn ⇒ Nothing). Then recover the bound var (the EMatch scrutinee's EVar name), statically select the matching arm, substitute pattern vars to field vars, PROVE the and-spine (per-conjunct validity over the field-domain atoms, WITH the IH discharge for a `recName t` conjunct whose field domain is the comprehension of recName) or REFUTE (ground witness). emptyA threads the ctor set's emptiness for the definite-invalid gate. Internal helper.

engine:cswDomAtoms.label: set-algebra: cswDomAtoms
engine:cswDomAtoms.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the field-domain BOUNDS ATOMS: per field, the numeric order atoms its set implies for the field var (cswFieldAtoms), merged into the satCombined `{ eqs, neqs, ltes, lts }` shape (eqs/neqs empty — domains only bound). Internal helper.

engine:cswDomAtomsLoop.label: set-algebra: cswDomAtomsLoop
engine:cswDomAtomsLoop.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the cswDomAtoms fold. Internal helper.

engine:cswFieldAtoms.label: set-algebra: cswFieldAtoms
engine:cswFieldAtoms.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — one field set's order-atom delta for a term: SeInterval/SeEnum via the Phase-7 domBoundsAtoms (numeric bounds only — honest); SeIntersect recurses EVERY branch (membership in an intersection implies membership in each branch ⇒ all branch atoms are sound — the $refined projection shape); everything else ⇒ empty. Internal helper.

engine:cswFieldAtomsList.label: set-algebra: cswFieldAtomsList
engine:cswFieldAtomsList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — cswFieldAtoms folded over SeIntersect branches. Internal helper.

engine:cswFieldDomIsRec.label: set-algebra: cswFieldDomIsRec
engine:cswFieldDomIsRec.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.4 — find the ctor field whose per-field var name (cswFieldVarName) is v, and test whether its domain set is the comprehension of recName (cswSetIsRecComp). A field-var not among the ctor fields ⇒ false (the conjunct calls recName on something that isn't a field the IH covers). Internal helper.

engine:cswFieldVarName.label: set-algebra: cswFieldVarName
engine:cswFieldVarName.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 / field-identity Phase 3 — the per-field symbolic variable `?ihf:<tagged FieldKey token>`. It is independent of wire spelling and collision-free for same-spelled fields with different UUIDs. Internal helper.

engine:cswFieldWitness.label: set-algebra: cswFieldWitness
engine:cswFieldWitness.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — one field set's witness via the DIRECT per-shape faces: SeEnum ⇒ seWitnessEnum; SeInterval ⇒ seWitnessInterval; anything else ⇒ Nothing (inhabit's composite faces can reach the membership ctx seams — excluded for kernel-premise ctx purity). Internal helper.

engine:cswGroundAnd.label: set-algebra: cswGroundAnd
engine:cswGroundAnd.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — ground `and`: any false ⇒ false (dominates — short-circuit-sound); all true ⇒ true; else unknown. Internal helper.

engine:cswGroundCmp.label: set-algebra: cswGroundCmp
engine:cswGroundCmp.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — a ground comparison: both operands must be ELits. Internal helper.

engine:cswGroundCmpL.label: set-algebra: cswGroundCmpL
engine:cswGroundCmpL.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — cswGroundCmp's left-operand unwrap. Internal helper.

engine:cswGroundCmpR.label: set-algebra: cswGroundCmpR
engine:cswGroundCmpR.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — cswGroundCmp's right-operand unwrap. Internal helper.

engine:cswGroundEval.label: set-algebra: cswGroundEval
engine:cswGroundEval.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the pure ground evaluator over the witness-substituted conjunct fragment: bool lits, `and` spines (false dominates), and comparisons over two ELits (deepEqValue for eq/neq — the Step-1 structural semantics; the same-type std comparisons for order). Anything non-ground ⇒ "unknown" (no refutation). Internal helper.

engine:cswIsCmp.label: set-algebra: cswIsCmp
engine:cswIsCmp.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the comparison head set (eq/neq/lt/lte/gt/gte). Internal helper.

engine:cswIsFalseLit.label: set-algebra: cswIsFalseLit
engine:cswIsFalseLit.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the constant-false conjunct (ELit false / EConstruct False). Internal helper.

engine:cswIsIH.label: set-algebra: cswIsIH
engine:cswIsIH.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.4 — the INDUCTION-HYPOTHESIS discharge: a conjunct `ECall recName [EVar v]` — the SAME recName the pred unfolded from — where the field var v's domain is the comprehension of recName (a SeWhere whose pred is `ECall recName [EVar _]`, binder-name-insensitive; or an SeIntersect containing one — the $refined-projection shape). ⇒ true (the Park premise `t ∈ T ⇒ P(t)` discharges the IH; verifyMuInduction re-derives the premise, so this is not a proposer trust). recName "" (inline pred) ⇒ false — the IH is unreachable for inline preds (the finite-tree self-containment theorem, STEP B). Internal helper.

engine:cswIsTrueLit.label: set-algebra: cswIsTrueLit
engine:cswIsTrueLit.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the constant-true conjunct (ELit true / EConstruct True — the two Bool spellings, the forkResidualFalse mirror). Internal helper.

engine:cswIsV1Fragment.label: set-algebra: cswIsV1Fragment
engine:cswIsV1Fragment.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.4 — the v1 pred fragment guard for an unfolded fn body: an EMatch whose scrutinee is an EVar (the fn's formal param). Anything else (guards live at arm level, a non-EMatch body, a non-var scrutinee) ⇒ false ⇒ the unfold fences. Internal helper.

engine:cswNamedUnfold.label: set-algebra: cswNamedUnfold
engine:cswNamedUnfold.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.4 — the v2 NAMED-PREDICATE one-level unfold. An inline EMatch pred passes through unchanged with recName "" (the 8μ.3 inline path — no fn resolution, no IH). A named-call pred `ECall f [EVar x]` (single bare-var arg — anything else stays Nothing) resolves f's body via the `fnBody` seam native (a registry fn-body read + jsonLogicToExpr lift; the ctx-guarded seam of design/mu-induction.md §4a): Nothing (unknown fn / lift fence) ⇒ Nothing (honest); a v1 EMatch-fragment body ⇒ Just { pred = body, recName = f } (the body's own scrutinee var becomes the bound var; recName carries f so cswProveOne can discharge the IH). A non-fragment body ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:cswNegSat.label: set-algebra: cswNegSat
engine:cswNegSat.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the negation table (the fork-driver §1 discipline): ¬eq ⇒ neq and ¬neq ⇒ eq are EXACT (the Step-1 structural eq is a total complement — any operand terms); an ORDER negation flips ONLY when BOTH operands are certified numeric (an ELit number / a field var with a numeric domain) — cross-type order atoms are false BOTH ways, so an uncertified flip would strengthen unsoundly ⇒ "nothing". Internal helper.

engine:cswNegSatOrder.label: set-algebra: cswNegSatOrder
engine:cswNegSatOrder.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the certified order negations: ¬(a<b) ⇒ b≤a; ¬(a≤b) ⇒ b<a; ¬(a>b) ⇒ a≤b; ¬(a≥b) ⇒ a<b. Internal helper.

engine:cswNonempty.label: set-algebra: cswNonempty
engine:cswNonempty.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the definite-invalid gate: the pred is false over the WHOLE ctor set, which refutes the subset ONLY when the ctor set is decidably nonempty (∅ ⊆ anything). Just false on decidably-nonempty, else Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:cswNumericAny.label: set-algebra: cswNumericAny
engine:cswNumericAny.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — cswNumericSet over SeIntersect branches (any). Internal helper.

engine:cswNumericSet.label: set-algebra: cswNumericSet
engine:cswNumericSet.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — true when a field set certifies its members NUMERIC: domNumeric (numeric-bounded SeInterval / all-numeric SeEnum), or an SeIntersect with ANY numeric branch (every member is in each branch). The negated-order certificate source. Internal helper.

engine:cswPatMatchClass.label: set-algebra: cswPatMatchClass
engine:cswPatMatchClass.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — classify an arm pattern against ctor-c values: wildcard/var ⇒ select (catch-all); lit ⇒ skip (a non-coercing ctor value is a $tag record, never eq a lit — Step-1); ctor c' ⇒ select iff c'==c else skip ($tag distinctness); anything else ⇒ abort (conservative). Internal helper.

engine:cswPredIsRecCall.label: set-algebra: cswPredIsRecCall
engine:cswPredIsRecCall.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.4 — a comprehension pred IS a recName self-call: `ECall recName [EVar _]` (single bare-var arg — binder-name-insensitive). Anything else ⇒ false. Internal helper.

engine:cswProve.label: set-algebra: cswProve
engine:cswProve.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the PROVE fold over the conjuncts: any definite-invalid ⇒ "false" (dominates); all valid ⇒ "true"; else "nothing". Internal helper.

engine:cswProveOne.label: set-algebra: cswProveOne
engine:cswProveOne.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 / 8μ.4 — one conjunct's validity class: a true lit ⇒ valid; a false lit ⇒ definite-invalid; the INDUCTION HYPOTHESIS (cswIsIH — a `recName v` conjunct on a field var v whose domain is the comprehension of recName) ⇒ valid (the Park premise grants exactly `t ∈ T ⇒ P(t)`; see the STEP B section header); a single comparison ⇒ negation + satCombined over the field-domain atoms (cswCompValid); anything else ⇒ "nothing" (the honesty fence — no DNF, no nested branching). recName is "" for an inline pred (the IH never fires — sound). Internal helper.

engine:cswRefuteConjs.label: set-algebra: cswRefuteConjs
engine:cswRefuteConjs.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — true when SOME conjunct ground-evaluates to a definite false at the witness assignment (short-circuit-sound: membership requires the pred to evaluate TRUE, so any false conjunct — or an earlier throw — keeps the witness outside ⟦pred⟧). Internal helper.

engine:cswSatVerdict.label: set-algebra: cswSatVerdict
engine:cswSatVerdict.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the satCombined read: Just false (UNSAT — the negated conjunct is impossible under the field domains) ⇒ "true" (the conjunct is valid); anything else ⇒ "nothing" (satCombined never returns Just true). Internal helper.

engine:cswSelectArm.label: set-algebra: cswSelectArm
engine:cswSelectArm.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — static arm-selection for a ctor-shaped scrutinee: skip arms whose pattern provably can't match a c-value (distinct-ctor patterns — $tag distinctness; lit patterns — a non-coercing ctor value never structurally equals a lit); SELECT the first ctor-c or catch-all (var/wildcard) arm; a guard on the selected arm / a non-simple ctor arg / an unknown pattern shape / no matching arm ⇒ Nothing. Returns Just { body, binds }. Internal helper.

engine:cswSetIsRecComp.label: set-algebra: cswSetIsRecComp
engine:cswSetIsRecComp.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.4 — true when a field set IS the comprehension of recName: a SeWhere whose pred is `ECall recName [EVar _]` (the Park-substituted tail domain, VERBATIM — probe 4), or an SeIntersect with ANY such branch (the $refined-projection wrap — membership in the intersection implies membership in the comprehension branch). Internal helper.

engine:cswSingleVarArg.label: set-algebra: cswSingleVarArg
engine:cswSingleVarArg.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.4 — a call's SINGLE bare-var argument: exactly one arg that is an EVar ⇒ Just its name; any other arity or a non-EVar arg ⇒ Nothing (the v2 fragment guard — a nested recursive arg like `f (tail t)` or arity ≠ 1 fences here). Internal helper.

engine:cswSnoc.label: set-algebra: cswSnoc
engine:cswSnoc.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — append one { lhs, rhs } atom to an atom list. Internal helper.

engine:cswTryRefute.label: set-algebra: cswTryRefute
engine:cswTryRefute.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the REFUTE face: witness every field via the DIRECT per-shape faces (never the search-widened composites — ctx purity), ground-substitute the witnesses into the conjuncts, and ground-eval; a definitively-false conjunct exhibits a concrete member of the ctor set failing the pred ⇒ Just false (the witness's existence proves nonemptiness). No witness / no ground-false ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:cswWitnessBinds.label: set-algebra: cswWitnessBinds
engine:cswWitnessBinds.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the ground substitution env: each field var binds to an ELit of its set's witness (SeEnum head / SeInterval inclusive bound — the DIRECT per-shape faces only); any unwitnessable field ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:ctorClosureParamDomains.label: Constructor → inner-closure param domains
engine:ctorClosureParamDomains.description: Phase 5b23 — tag-keyed table from constructor name to its inner closure's expected param-domain list (Maybe (List WasmDomain)). Today covers Field (picture) / Animate (animation) / Wave (sound) — all arity-1 closures whose param is a record-handle (Point / Time). Returns Nothing for non-closure-wrapping ctors so the seeding short-circuits.

engine:curryType.label: Curry arrow type
engine:curryType.description: signature-substrate Phase A — normalize an arrow to the fully-curried right-nested 1-ary presentation: flatten the spine first (ttArrowFlatten — so nested flat segments in return position are absorbed), then right-nest one 1-ary layer per param, threading the outer raw onto every synthesized layer. layerize∘flatten makes the normal-form round-trips `curryType (uncurryType t) ≡ curryType t` and `uncurryType (curryType t) ≡ uncurryType t` hold by construction. A 0-ary arrow is its own curried form; non-arrow values pass through.

engine:dataCtorFields.label: Data-ctor fields
engine:dataCtorFields.description: Decompose a `data` constructor's full type-signature marker into fields (the TS `arrowToFields` mirror): walk the `{mk=arrow}` spine collecting named or explicit-positional params via `foldArrowParams`, recursing into `ret`; the final non-arrow `ret` is the RETURN type (not a field). A nullary ctor (non-arrow type) ⇒ `[]`. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 7 (D-G), field-identity Phase 2a.

engine:dateWidgetFor.label: widget-hint: dateWidgetFor
engine:dateWidgetFor.description: Phase 3b-3d — pick the UI widget for a date-typed SetExpr: always date-picker, with config {min?,max?} lifted from an interval's Just bounds (raw bound .value, no isNumber guard — date precision lives in $where). Returns a WidgetHint. The `!set` case (empty config) is handled by the TS wrapper. Mirrors widget-hint.ts:dateWidgetFor.

engine:decMax.label: Decrement max
engine:decMax.description: Decrement a PRep `max`, keeping the `-1` unbounded sentinel fixed. Internal helper.

engine:decNumLen.label: Decimal number length
engine:decNumLen.description: The length of a decimal numeric literal: integer digits + an optional fractional part (`.` only when the next char is NOT another `.`, so `1..5` keeps the `..` range operator) + an optional scientific exponent. Internal lexer helper.

engine:decidePatternDisjoint.label: Decide pattern disjoint
engine:decidePatternDisjoint.description: Decide L(pa) intersect L(pb) empty. When every reachable predicate is Ws-ordered ⇒ the STRUCTURED interval-endpoint partition (linear, exact — reproduces regex-derivative.ts distinctRanges on the char fragment); when any predicate is opaque ⇒ the generic 2^N atom-enumeration Brzozowski walk. predInfo is the TS-precomputed [{ key, isAll, subsetOf, ws }] table; pa/pb are Pats whose PMatch carry opaque predicate keys. The port of pattern.ts patternDisjoint + the structured partition (Phase 1a-cont). regex-derivative-to-fenel Phase 1.

engine:decidePatternSubset.label: Decide pattern subset
engine:decidePatternSubset.description: Decide L(pa) subset of L(pb). When every reachable predicate is Ws-ordered (intervals/enums/all and boolean combinations) ⇒ the STRUCTURED interval-endpoint partition (linear, exact — reproduces regex-derivative.ts distinctRanges on the char fragment); when any predicate is opaque ($where/$named/non-char) ⇒ the generic 2^N atom-enumeration Brzozowski walk (decides opaque preds via structural atom inclusion). predInfo is the TS-precomputed [{ key, isAll, subsetOf, ws }] table; pa/pb are Pats whose PMatch carry opaque predicate keys. The port of pattern.ts patternSubset + the structured partition (Phase 1a-cont). regex-derivative-to-fenel Phase 1.

engine:declGrammar.label: Declaration grammar
engine:declGrammar.description: Build the declaration environment from Program/Decls, the refinement-enabled DeclTy profile of typeGrammarProfile and the expression grammar. Annotation Ty productions remain separate and unchanged. Declaration type markers and source-bound signature schemes are lowered through the existing Fenel programToFrames body before their permanent host marshalling boundary.

engine:declarationBodyApplies.label: Body applies
engine:declarationBodyApplies.description: True when the definition's body applies the constructor named typeName.

engine:declarationClashStep.label: Clash walk step
engine:declarationClashStep.description: One declaration of the clash walk: a named one is checked against its namespace, then, when it registers a function, against the code names seen so far. `_` passes.

engine:declarationCodeNameCheck.label: Code name check
engine:declarationCodeNameCheck.description: A second function of one effective code name clashes with the first, unless both are declarations of one name, which the duplicate check already reports.

engine:declarationCodeNameError.label: Code name clash error
engine:declarationCodeNameError.description: Build the error for two functions registered under one effective code name.

engine:declarationCodeNameStep.label: Code name step
engine:declarationCodeNameStep.description: Check a declaration that registers a function against the first function of its effective code name.

engine:declarationCodeNameText.label: Code name clash text
engine:declarationCodeNameText.description: The message for a code-name clash: which code name, and which two functions register it.

engine:declarationConstructsSignatureTyp.label: Constructs signature type
engine:declarationConstructsSignatureTyp.description: True when the definition's body applies the constructor its signature's type names.

engine:declarationDuplicateError.label: Duplicate error
engine:declarationDuplicateError.description: Build the error for a second declaration of one name in one namespace.

engine:declarationDuplicateText.label: Duplicate text
engine:declarationDuplicateText.description: The message for a duplicate: `duplicate definition "foo": declaration 1 in FILE and declaration 5 in FILE.` and what to do.

engine:declarationGroupClashes.label: Declaration group clashes
engine:declarationGroupClashes.description: The name clashes among the files of one module (a union group), given the declarations of all of them. Each file has already passed declarationNameClashes alone; across files the rule sees every named definition (functions and named instances share one namespace, and an instance-file value has no function id) and every declaration that registers a function, for its code name. The source of truth for fenel-module.ts's mirror of the same name.

engine:declarationHasName.label: Has name
engine:declarationHasName.description: True when the declaration is named, and named declName.

engine:declarationNameClashes.label: Declaration name clashes
engine:declarationNameClashes.description: Every name clash among declarations, in source order: a second definition, signature or type declaration of one name, and a second function registered under one effective code name (the @codeName, or the name when there is none). `_` never clashes, and neither do the type and parameters of two instances. A code-name clash between two declarations of the same name is left to the duplicate it already is. The source of truth for fenel-module.ts's mirror of the same name.

engine:declarationNamedSiteText.label: Named site
engine:declarationNamedSiteText.description: A declaration's name and site for a message: `"foo" (declaration 1 in FILE)`.

engine:declarationNamespace.label: Declaration namespace
engine:declarationNamespace.description: The namespace a declaration's name lives in: signatures, definitions and type declarations each have their own. Nothing for a module header, an import or a fixity, which name nothing there.

engine:declarationRawNameCheck.label: Raw name check
engine:declarationRawNameCheck.description: A second declaration of a name in one namespace is a duplicate; the first one seen stays the one later duplicates are reported against.

engine:declarationRawNameStep.label: Raw name step
engine:declarationRawNameStep.description: Check a named declaration against the first declaration of its name in its namespace.

engine:declarationSelectionConflicts.label: Selection conflicts
engine:declarationSelectionConflicts.description: Every conflict among file-top selections, in source order: a name selected from a source other than the one its first selection named. One name selected twice from one source is fine; own members are not selections. Run on one file's selections and on all the files of a module together. The source of truth for fenel-module.ts's mirror of the same name. modules-as-values Phase 5c-1a.

engine:declarationSelectionError.label: Selection conflict error
engine:declarationSelectionError.description: Build the error for a name selected from two sources.

engine:declarationSelectionSiteText.label: Selection site
engine:declarationSelectionSiteText.description: Where a selection sits, for an error message: `SOURCE (declaration N in FILE)`, with N counting from 1.

engine:declarationSelectionStep.label: Selection walk step
engine:declarationSelectionStep.description: One selection of the conflict walk: the first selection of a name is remembered; a later one from another source is a conflict, one from the same source passes.

engine:declarationSelectionText.label: Selection conflict text
engine:declarationSelectionText.description: The message for a selection conflict: `"map" is selected from two sources: std (declaration 2 in FILE) and picture (declaration 3 in FILE).` and what to do.

engine:declarationSharedAcrossFiles.label: Shared across files
engine:declarationSharedAcrossFiles.description: True for the declarations the cross-file rule sees: a named definition, or any declaration that registers a function.

engine:declarationSiteText.label: Declaration site
engine:declarationSiteText.description: Where a declaration sits, for an error message: `declaration N in FILE`, with N counting from 1 in source order.

engine:declarationUnnamedBodyErrors.label: Unnamed body errors
engine:declarationUnnamedBodyErrors.description: A `_` definition must be a constructor application of the type its signature names, so that it is exactly one instance of that type.

engine:declarationUnnamedBodyText.label: Unnamed body text
engine:declarationUnnamedBodyText.description: The end of the message refusing a `_` body: name the type to construct, or say the signature names none.

engine:declarationUnnamedDirectiveErrors.label: Unnamed directive errors
engine:declarationUnnamedDirectiveErrors.description: A `_` declaration carries no directives: it has no name for them to attach to, so they would be silently discarded.

engine:declarationUnnamedError.label: Unnamed error
engine:declarationUnnamedError.description: Build one refusal of a `_` declaration; the message starts `unnamed declaration #N: the "_" signature at declaration I in FILE` and continues with text.

engine:declarationUnnamedErrors.label: Unnamed declaration errors
engine:declarationUnnamedErrors.description: Every refusal of a `_` declaration in one file, in source order: a `_` signature not immediately followed by a `_` definition, a `_` definition not immediately preceded by a `_` signature, a `_` definition with parameters, a `_` definition that is not a constructor application of its signature's type, and a `_` declaration that carries directives. An empty list means every `_` pair is exactly one instance. The source of truth for fenel-module.ts's mirror of the same name.

engine:declarationUnnamedOpen.label: Unnamed open
engine:declarationUnnamedOpen.description: A `_` signature: number it, and wait for its definition. Its own directives are refused now.

engine:declarationUnnamedOrphan.label: Unnamed orphan
engine:declarationUnnamedOrphan.description: A `_` definition with no `_` signature right before it: number it and refuse it, then check its parameters and directives too.

engine:declarationUnnamedPair.label: Unnamed pair
engine:declarationUnnamedPair.description: A `_` definition right after its `_` signature: check its parameters, that its body constructs the signature's type, and its directives.

engine:declarationUnnamedParameterErrors.label: Unnamed parameter errors
engine:declarationUnnamedParameterErrors.description: A `_` definition takes no parameters: it is an instance value, not a function.

engine:declarationUnnamedPrefix.label: Unnamed prefix
engine:declarationUnnamedPrefix.description: The start of every unnamed-declaration message: `unnamed declaration #N: the "_" signature at declaration I in FILE` (or definition).

engine:declarationUnnamedStep.label: Unnamed walk step
engine:declarationUnnamedStep.description: One declaration of the unnamed walk: a `_` definition right after a waiting `_` signature pairs with it; anything else leaves that signature unpaired, then is visited on its own.

engine:declarationUnnamedUnpaired.label: Unnamed unpaired
engine:declarationUnnamedUnpaired.description: The waiting `_` signature was not followed by its definition: refuse it and stop waiting.

engine:declarationUnnamedVisit.label: Unnamed visit
engine:declarationUnnamedVisit.description: Visit a declaration no `_` signature is waiting for: a `_` signature opens the next unnamed declaration, a `_` definition is an orphan, anything else passes.

engine:declarationUnpairedSignatureError.label: Unpaired signature error
engine:declarationUnpairedSignatureError.description: The refusal of a `_` signature that is not immediately followed by a `_` definition.

engine:declassifyInterval.label: set-algebra: declassifyInterval
engine:declassifyInterval.description: containment-substrate Phase 1b — marshalled Interval ADT → raw {lo, hi} interval payload (faithful inverse of the TS unmarshalInterval). Used when normalize rebuilds SeInterval nodes from internally-marshalled intervals. Internal helper.

engine:decodeEsc.label: Decode string escape
engine:decodeEsc.description: Resolve a double-quote string escape char to its value: n⇒newline, t⇒tab, \⇒backslash, "⇒quote, else the char verbatim (`fenel-parser.ts:104`). Internal lexer helper.

engine:decodeEscTmpl.label: Decode template escape
engine:decodeEscTmpl.description: Resolve a backtick-template escape char: n⇒newline, t⇒tab, \⇒backslash, `⇒backtick, $⇒dollar, else the char verbatim (`fenel-parser.ts:153`). Internal lexer helper.

engine:decomposeFindCase.label: decompose: findCase
engine:decomposeFindCase.description: Phase 7a — locate a variant case by name. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeFindField.label: decompose: findField
engine:decomposeFindField.description: Phase 7a — locate a DcvField by name; return value wrapped in Maybe. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesList.label: decompose: matchesList
engine:decomposeMatchesList.description: Phase 7a — accept any array. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesMap.label: decompose: matchesMap
engine:decomposeMatchesMap.description: Phase 7a — accept any DcvObject. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesMaybe.label: decompose: matchesMaybe
engine:decomposeMatchesMaybe.description: Phase 7a — accept null OR recurse with inner type. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesMu.label: decompose: matchesMu
engine:decomposeMatchesMu.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — recognize canonical List μ-shapes after the root semantic-slot preflight. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesRecord.label: decompose: matchesRecord
engine:decomposeMatchesRecord.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — DcvObject + every declared current-wire field present (or exact canonical Maybe) + per-field shape match. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesRecordFields.label: decompose: matchesRecordFields
engine:decomposeMatchesRecordFields.description: Phase 7a — per-declared-field optional-detection + shape match. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesShapeHead.label: decompose: matchesShapeHead
engine:decomposeMatchesShapeHead.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — first half of the validated TraversalType shape dispatcher. Kept below the compiled-parser declaration budget; helper, tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesShapeTail.label: decompose: matchesShapeTail
engine:decomposeMatchesShapeTail.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — second half of the validated TraversalType shape dispatcher. Kept below the compiled-parser declaration budget; helper, tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesTuple.label: decompose: matchesTuple
engine:decomposeMatchesTuple.description: Phase 7a — accept an array of the right length with per-element shape match. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesTupleItems.label: decompose: matchesTupleItems
engine:decomposeMatchesTupleItems.description: Phase 7a — pairwise shape-match over items + declared types. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:decomposeMatchesUnit.label: decompose: matchesUnit

engine:decomposeMatchesVariant.label: decompose: matchesVariant
