engine:fixityOf.description: The fixity row { fnId, prec, assoc } for an operator `notation` in `table` — a linear scan; the unmatched (custom operator) default is { fnId = notation, prec = 9, assoc = "l" } (the TS `?? {assoc:l,prec:9}` + key-as-fnId `{call:[op,…]}` fall-through). Internal fixity-resolve helper.

engine:fixupClosureExportIndices.label: Fix up closure export indices
engine:fixupClosureExportIndices.description: Walk the builder's pendingExports list (each with sentinel `index = -1` from commit 8's addPendingExport) replacing each index with `importCount + i` so closure-body exports land at the correct function-index space position. Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:1776-1779.

engine:flattenConjunctList.label: Flatten conjunct list
engine:flattenConjunctList.description: Recurse flattenConjuncts over an `and` operand list, threading the accumulator. Internal helper.

engine:flattenConjuncts.label: Flatten conjuncts
engine:flattenConjuncts.description: Flatten a predicate `Expr` into its conjunct list: an `ECall "and" args` recurses into each arg (so nested and-trees flatten too — Step-0 probe 3); anything else is a single conjunct appended verbatim. Internal helper.

engine:flipComp.label: set-algebra: flipComp
engine:flipComp.description: Phase 7c-continuation sub-step 1 — comparison-op string flip used by whereToSetExpr when the value-variable is on the right side of a comparison. `>=` ↔ `<=`, `>` ↔ `<`; other ops pass through unchanged. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:flipComp.

engine:flipOp.label: narrow: flip op
engine:flipOp.description: Flip a comparison op for the literal-on-the-left case (> ↔ <, >= ↔ <=, ==/=== unchanged). Internal helper.

engine:flipRel.label: solve: flipRel
engine:flipRel.description: Phase 12 — flip a comparison op when the leading coefficient is negative: lt↔gt, lte↔gte; eq is unchanged (it is symmetric). Internal helper.

engine:floorCaseBranches.label: iso: floorCaseBranches
engine:floorCaseBranches.description: ISO-2 helper: map each variant case to its single-case-variant floor branch (the tagged disjoint reading — branch Cᵢ carries ONLY case Cᵢ, whose tag-singleton forces the union disjoint). Threads the original raw FenelType. Internal helper.

engine:floorCaseBranchesAcc.label: iso: floorCaseBranchesAcc
engine:floorCaseBranchesAcc.description: ISO-2 helper: accumulator-threaded build of the single-case-variant branches (order-preserving — appendItem appends to the END, so the acc grows head→tail in case order). Internal helper.

engine:floorComplementEach.label: floor-axioms: complementEach
engine:floorComplementEach.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — wrap every branch in SeComplement (order-preserving). Internal helper to intersectToNegUnion.

engine:floorComplementEachAcc.label: floor-axioms: complementEachAcc
engine:floorComplementEachAcc.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — accumulator fold for floorComplementEach. Internal helper.

engine:floorEnumMergeFold.label: floor-axioms: enumMergeFold
engine:floorEnumMergeFold.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — concat every all-enum branch's values into one SeEnum (Nothing on a non-enum branch). Internal helper to singletonUnionToEnum.

engine:floorLawEqByEmpty.label: Floor law eq (by emptiness)
engine:floorLawEqByEmpty.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — denotational equality by SYMMETRIC-DIFFERENCE EMPTINESS: mAnd (decideEmpty (lhs∖rhs)) (decideEmpty (rhs∖lhs)) — the judgment-iso face (PropSubset s t ⟺ empty(s ∩ ¬t), decide-substrate Phase 2), riding decideEmpty's bounded witness-search fall-through. Decides strictly more than the subset face on the finite data fragment (the measured tri-precision gap the Phase-1 ledger records).

engine:floorLawEqBySubset.label: Floor law eq (by subset)
engine:floorLawEqBySubset.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — denotational equality by MUTUAL SUBSET via the trio: mAnd (isSubset lhs rhs) (isSubset rhs lhs). Kleene-Tri: both Just true ⇒ Just true; either refuted ⇒ Just false; else Nothing (fenced).

engine:floorLawVerdicts.label: Floor law verdicts
engine:floorLawVerdicts.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the full verdict record for one FloorLawClaim: per-direction subset verdicts (fwd = lhs ⊆ rhs, bwd = rhs ⊆ lhs), per-direction symmetric-difference emptiness (empFwd = empty(lhs∖rhs), empBwd = empty(rhs∖lhs)), and the two equality faces (bySubset / byEmpty, the mAnds). One call per ledger row; the Phase-1 harness pins the table.

engine:floorOne.label: floor-axioms: floorOne
engine:floorOne.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the singleton list [x] via appendItem (the record-field inline-list-literal parser limitation workaround; see the file header). Internal helper.

engine:floorPair.label: floor-axioms: floorPair
engine:floorPair.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the two-element list [x, y] via appendItem chaining, order-explicit (appendItem appends to the END). Internal helper.

engine:floorSingletonEach.label: floor-axioms: singletonEach
engine:floorSingletonEach.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — one singleton SeEnum per value (order-preserving). Internal helper to enumToSingletonUnion.

engine:floorSingletonEachAcc.label: floor-axioms: singletonEachAcc
engine:floorSingletonEachAcc.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — accumulator fold for floorSingletonEach. Internal helper.

engine:floorToDiff.label: Floor to diff
engine:floorToDiff.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the `∖ = ∩ ∘ ¬` derivation witness (bwd, partial): a binary `SeIntersect [a, SeComplement b]` merges back to `SeDiff a b`; any other shape ⇒ Nothing (no diff preimage). Left-inverse of diffToFloor (the round-trip law is discharged in the Phase-1 harness).

engine:floorToDiffBranches.label: floor-axioms: floorToDiffBranches
engine:floorToDiffBranches.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — floorToDiff helper: exactly two branches with the second a SeComplement ⇒ Just (SeDiff first inner); else Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:floorToDiffSecond.label: floor-axioms: floorToDiffSecond
engine:floorToDiffSecond.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — floorToDiff helper: the second branch must be a SeComplement; returns its inner. Internal helper.

engine:floorUncomplementEach.label: floor-axioms: uncomplementEach
engine:floorUncomplementEach.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — unwrap every branch's SeComplement (Just inners), Nothing the moment a branch is not a complement. Internal helper to negUnionToIntersect.

engine:floorUncomplementEachAcc.label: floor-axioms: uncomplementEachAcc
engine:floorUncomplementEachAcc.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — accumulator fold for floorUncomplementEach (Nothing on a non-complement branch). Internal helper.

engine:flowAddIncoming.label: flow: add incoming edge types
engine:flowAddIncoming.description: Fold the edges into a node's env: for each edge into `id` carrying a slot, look the source node's inferred type up in result.nodes and (when present) bind it to the slot, overwriting any same-slot binding (last incoming edge wins, matching the TS env.set order). Internal helper.

engine:flowDegLookup.label: flow: in-degree lookup
engine:flowDegLookup.description: Search the in-degree assoc list [{id, deg}] for an id, returning Just its current degree or Nothing (the id is not a node). The sibling of envLookup over the in-degree table. Internal helper.

engine:flowEdge.label: flow: one edge
engine:flowEdge.description: Classify one edge: source = the from-node's inferred type ($all when absent); proof = needsCheck carrier of (source, expected) when the target node declares a binding for the edge's slot, else the always-ok { proven } default. Internal helper.

engine:flowEdgeProof.label: flow: edge proof
engine:flowEdgeProof.description: The assignability proof for one edge: when the target node exists, has the edge's slot, AND declares a binding for it ⇒ a needsCheck carrier of (source, expected) the TS seam resolves through checkAssignable; otherwise the always-ok { needsCheck = False, ok = True, confidence = "proven" } default. Internal helper.

engine:flowEdges.label: flow: edges pass
engine:flowEdges.description: Map each edge (in input order) to { source, proof }: the source type read from result.nodes ($all when absent) + the assignability proof classified by flowEdgeProof. Aligned to the input-edge order so the TS seam zips it with the edge array. Internal helper.

engine:flowForward.label: flow: forward pass
engine:flowForward.description: Fold the topo order, threading the result.nodes assoc list: per node, infer its output type (flowInferNode) and append { id, set }; skip an order entry with no matching node. Internal helper.

engine:flowInferNode.label: flow: infer one node
engine:flowInferNode.description: Infer a node's canonical SetExpr output: start the env from its bindings, add the types arriving on incoming declared-slot edges (from already-computed result.nodes), infer via inferExprType when it has an expression (else SeAll), then intersect the declared type when present via normMarker over SeIntersect. Internal helper.

engine:flowKahn.label: flow: kahn step
engine:flowKahn.description: One Kahn iteration over the threaded state { order, indeg, queue }: pop the queue head, append it to the order, decrement each of its out-edge targets' in-degrees (enqueuing any that reach 0), recurse with one less fuel. Empty queue or exhausted fuel ⇒ return the accumulated order (cyclic / unreached nodes stay omitted — sound). Internal helper.

engine:flowKahnDec.label: flow: kahn decrement out-edges
engine:flowKahnDec.description: Fold a node's out-edges into the Kahn state, decrementing each target's in-degree and enqueuing any that reach exactly 0 (a target with no in-degree entry — a non-node — is left untouched, no enqueue). Internal helper.

engine:flowKahnDecEdge.label: flow: kahn decrement one edge
engine:flowKahnDecEdge.description: Decrement the in-degree of one edge's target; if its new in-degree is exactly 0 (and it has an in-degree entry — i.e. it is a real node), enqueue it. Internal helper.

engine:flowNode2Lookup.label: flow: result-node lookup
engine:flowNode2Lookup.description: Search result.nodes [{id, set}] for an id, returning Just its inferred canonical SetExpr or Nothing (not yet inferred / absent). Internal helper.

engine:flowNodeLookup.label: flow: node lookup
engine:flowNodeLookup.description: Search the node-marker list for a node by id, returning Just the whole marker or Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:flowTopoOrder.label: flow: topo order (Kahn)
engine:flowTopoOrder.description: Kahn's-algorithm topological order of the node ids. Seed the in-degree of each node (the count of all edges into it), queue the in-degree-0 nodes in node order, then peel: pop a node, decrement each successor's in-degree, enqueue any that reach 0. Fuel-bounded (length nodes + 1 — each node is processed at most once); a cyclic node never reaches in-degree 0 and is OMITTED. Internal helper.

engine:flushChunk.label: Flush chunk
engine:flushChunk.description: Append `cur` to `chunks` only when non-empty (defensive against leading/trailing/double `vsemi`). Internal parse-file helper. parser-substrate Phase 5b1.

engine:flushPending.label: Flush pending ctor field
engine:flushPending.description: Close an open named ctor field: if a field name is pending, append `{name, type = namedFieldType patoms}` to the fields, advance the containing-list occurrence index, and clear the pending state; else pass through. Internal decl-grammar helper. parser-substrate Phase 4 (D2), field-identity Phase 2a.

engine:foldArrowParams.label: Fold data-ctor arrow params
engine:foldArrowParams.description: Walk one `{mk=arrow}` marker's param list into ctor fields, threading the containing-list occurrence ordinal `{i, fields}`: a named param keeps its name and advances i; a bare param becomes `_<i>` with an explicit PositionalField i and advances i. Mirrors the TS `arrowToFields`. Internal decl-grammar helper. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 7 (D-G), field-identity Phase 2a.

engine:foldBinOp.label: Fold binop
engine:foldBinOp.description: Left-fold a JsAst arg list (length >= 2) into nested JsBinOp. `add(a, b, c)` → `((a + b) + c)`.

engine:foldConcat.label: Fold concat
engine:foldConcat.description: Left-fold a JsAst arg list (length >= 1) into nested `$fenel.concat(...)` calls. 1-arg input returns the arg unchanged.

engine:foldCtorElems.label: Fold ctor elems
engine:foldCtorElems.description: Walk a ctor's flat ELEM list into the field list, threading `{pname, patoms, idx, fields}` where idx is the containing-list occurrence ordinal: a `name:` marker flushes any open named field then opens a new one; an `afield` marker appends a named arrow field; a `pos` marker flushes and appends an explicit PositionalField; a bare atom with NO open named field is likewise positional; a bare atom inside an open named field accumulates as its type application spine. Internal decl-grammar helper. parser-substrate Phase 4 (D2), field-identity Phase 2a.

engine:foldTypes.label: Fold types to arrow
engine:foldTypes.description: signature-substrate Phase A — right-fold a list of types to the curried arrow chain: `[t]` is `Just t`, `[t1, …, tn]` is the nested 1-ary chain `t1 -> (t2 -> … -> tn)` (each layer a fresh 1-ary TtArrow via mkArrow), `[]` is Nothing — no exceptions, the empty fold has no arrow. "Fold a list of types with arrow and you've built a signature."

engine:forall.label: Forall
engine:forall.description: Quantifier builder over a type argument: `forall varName pred typeSet` ≡ the ∀ / Π form ≡ subset (every) — `typeSet` is the type's base set supplied pre-extracted (full `$type`→set extraction is deferred to P7, since a Fenel body can't read `$`-keyed type internals). Builder-only; P6 inherits the type-extraction. expr-substrate Phase 5.

engine:forkAllRefuted.label: fork: all-refuted
engine:forkAllRefuted.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — true-verdict fold behind satSymbolicPaths: each path is refuted iff its residual is the constant `False` (forkResidualFalse — an unsatisfiable leaf) OR its path atoms ∪ its residual's atoms (noWhereFold over the residual) are UNSAT (satCombined ⇒ Just false). If EVERY path is refuted, return Just false (an empty path list = everything pruned = unsat ⇒ Just false too); a single non-refuting path ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:forkArmCatchAll.label: fork: arm-catchall
engine:forkArmCatchAll.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — true when a pattern matches EVERY value (PatWildcard / PatVar) — the only projection that is the universe, hence the only dead-arm-pruning trigger. Internal helper.

engine:forkArmDead.label: fork: arm-dead
engine:forkArmDead.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — true when arm k is UNREACHABLE: its negative domain (forkArmNegDomain over the prior patterns) decides EMPTY (setAlgebraDecideEmpty ⇒ Just true). Only fires when a prior arm is a catch-all (the union covers the universe ⇒ SeNone) — a sound dead-arm prune. Internal helper.

engine:forkArmDisjointAll.label: fork: arm-disjoint-all
engine:forkArmDisjointAll.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — true when a projection is provably disjoint (setAlgebraIsDisjoint ⇒ Just true) from every prior arm's projection; any non-`Just true` ⇒ false. Internal helper.

engine:forkArmNegDomain.label: fork: arm-neg-domain
engine:forkArmNegDomain.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the NEGATIVE domain on arm k's scrutinee: `complement(SeUnion ⟦prior projections⟧)`. A catch-all prior ⇒ SeNone directly (the union is the universe); no priors ⇒ SeAll (nothing excluded); else SeComplement of the SeUnion of the prior projections. decideEmpty of this only proves Just true for the SeNone (catch-all) case ⇒ sound dead-arm pruning. Internal helper.

engine:forkArmProject.label: fork: arm-project
engine:forkArmProject.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — project a forkable arm pattern to its matched-set OVER-approximation as a SetExpr: PatWildcard / PatVar ⇒ SeAll (a catch-all — EXACT); PatLit L ⇒ SeEnum [L] (EXACT); PatConstruct C ⇒ SeCtor C [] (all values tagged C — the sound top over-approx of `C args`). Non-forkable patterns never reach here (forkableMatch fences the match). Internal helper.

engine:forkArmUnshadowed.label: fork: arm-unshadowed
engine:forkArmUnshadowed.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — true when arm k is provably NOT shadowed by any earlier arm: its projection (forkArmProject) is provably DISJOINT (setAlgebraIsDisjoint ⇒ Just true) from EVERY prior arm's projection. Over-approximation is the sound direction for disjointness (subsets of disjoint sets are disjoint) ⇒ a lifted shadowable is a real witness-safe path. Any unprovable pair ⇒ false (stay shadowed — conservative). No priors (k=0) ⇒ true. Internal helper.

engine:forkAt.label: fork: at
engine:forkAt.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — the path-threaded fork walker behind forkPaths. `ECall "if"|"?:"` ⇒ forkIfChain (fork per chain link); a forkable `EMatch` ⇒ forkMatchArms (fork per arm); every other node (incl. a fenced/guarded/complex EMatch, a lambda, a non-branch ECall/EConstruct/ERecord/ELit/EVar) ⇒ a residual LEAF at the current path condition. `state` = { atoms, opaque, shadowable }; `path` names the structural position (for fresh match-var uniqueness). Internal helper.

engine:forkBothCertNumeric.label: fork: both-cert-numeric
engine:forkBothCertNumeric.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — true when BOTH operands of a 2-arg order call are certified numeric (forkCertNumeric each); a non-2-arg list ⇒ false. Internal helper.

engine:forkCapLookup.label: fork: cap-lookup
engine:forkCapLookup.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — find a name in the captures env (a list of { name, expr }); Just expr on hit, Nothing otherwise. Internal helper.

engine:forkCertMember.label: fork: cert-member
engine:forkCertMember.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — true when an Expr is eufValEq-equal to some member of the certs list (the numeric-certified term set). Internal helper.

engine:forkCertNumeric.label: fork: cert-numeric
engine:forkCertNumeric.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — true when an Expr is certified NUMERIC: a numeric-valued `ELit`, OR a term eufValEq-equal to a member of the certs list (a read/EVar whose resolved domain / return type is numeric). The negated-order certificate's per-operand check. Internal helper.

engine:forkCtorArgs.label: fork: ctor-args
engine:forkCtorArgs.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — walk a ctor pattern's simple args at index i, threading the payload-expr accumulator + the capture accumulator: PatVar n ⇒ a fresh `?fork:<path>:<i>` EVar (bound to n in captures); PatWildcard ⇒ a fresh EVar (no capture); PatLit L ⇒ ELit L (no capture). Returns { exprs, captures }. The fresh name is DOT-FREE (`/`+`:` separators — the collectFreeVars field-access constraint). Internal helper.

engine:forkCtorAssume.label: fork: ctor-assume
engine:forkCtorAssume.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — the ctor-pattern arm assumption: build the payload exprs (fresh `?fork:` EVars for var/wildcard args, ELit for lit args) + the captures (each PatVar arg ⇒ its fresh var), then `eq scrutinee (EConstruct C [payload…])`. Positional (no field metadata) — datatype distinctness keys on the ctor NAME; injectivity on the shared signature. Internal helper.

engine:forkEqExprs.label: fork: eq-exprs
engine:forkEqExprs.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — map a { lhs, rhs } atom list to `ECall op [lhs, rhs]` predicate Exprs at a fixed op name. Internal helper.

engine:forkFirstWitness.label: fork: first-witness
engine:forkFirstWitness.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — witness fold behind solveSymbolicPaths: walk the feasible paths IN ORDER, SKIPPING shadowable ones (a k≥1 match-arm path — positive-only assumptions can't rule out earlier-arm shadowing); for a witness-safe path, solve `forkWitnessExpr` — the first Just w wins; all exhausted ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:forkFirstWitnessDom.label: fork: first-witness-dom
engine:forkFirstWitnessDom.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — the DOMAIN-AWARE witness fold behind solveSymbolicPaths: walk the feasible paths IN ORDER, SKIPPING shadowable ones; for a witness-safe path, rebuild forkWitnessExpr, find its single free var, and — when that var has a domain (domMap) — solve `inhabit (SeIntersect [domain, comprehend v witnessExpr])` (ENUM-FIRST: the domain leads so the intersect fold seeds on the enumerable member, making an interval-only pred witnessable under an enum domain); no domain / not-single-free-var ⇒ plain `solve` (unchanged). The first Just w wins; all exhausted ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:forkIfChain.label: fork: if-chain
engine:forkIfChain.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — fork the chained `if` arg list (walkIf-shaped): at index i, cond=args[i], then=args[i+1]; a trailing else (i == n-1) recurses directly. TRUE world assumes cond (splitCondInto — atoms + opaque), prunes if refuted, recurses the then; FALSE world assumes ¬cond (negateCondInto — the negation table), prunes, recurses the rest of the chain (i+2). combineFork merges the two worlds under the budget. Internal helper.

engine:forkIsOrder.label: fork: is-order
engine:forkIsOrder.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — true when a call head is an ORDER relation (lte / lt / gte / gt) — the negated-order certificate's candidate set. Internal helper.

engine:forkLeaf.label: fork: leaf
engine:forkLeaf.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — emit a single residual LEAF path at the current path condition: `{ paths = [{ atoms, opaque, residual = expr, shadowable }], complete = true }`. The terminal of every non-branch descent. Internal helper.

engine:forkMatchArms.label: fork: match-arms
engine:forkMatchArms.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 / decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — fork a forkable EMatch per arm, threading the PRIOR arm patterns (arms j<k). DEAD-ARM PRUNING (8μ.3): if the per-scrutinee NEGATIVE domain `complement(SeUnion ⟦prior patterns⟧)` decides EMPTY (only fires when a prior wildcard/var covers the universe ⇒ SeNone ⇒ Just true — an arm after a catch-all is unreachable), the arm contributes NO paths. Else build the arm's POSITIVE assumption + captures (armAssume), split into the path atoms, and set shadowable = state.shadowable OR (arm NOT provably-disjoint from every prior arm). The 8μ.3 SHADOWABLE LIFT: when the arm's projection is provably disjoint from ALL prior projections (SeCtor distinctness / distinct-lit) the k≥1 arm is NO LONGER shadowed (its value can never be caught by an earlier arm) ⇒ the witness face may compute it (`case x of Just v -> …; Nothing -> …` arm-2 witness now reachable). Prune if refuted, then recurse forkAt over the CAPTURE-SUBSTITUTED arm body. combineFork accumulates the arms under the budget. Internal helper.

engine:forkPaths.label: Fork paths
engine:forkPaths.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — the FORK DRIVER: walk a (post-PE, post-mint) residual `Expr`, forking the world at each residual branch point (`if`/`?:` per chain link, forkable `EMatch` per arm) and threading a PATH CONDITION (`{ eqs, neqs, ltes, lts }` atoms + an `opaque` list). Prunes EAGERLY — a `satCombined`-refuted prefix kills the subtree before it explodes. Returns `{ paths: List { atoms, opaque, residual, shadowable }, complete }`: each surviving path is a feasible behavior (branch-selected residual + captures substituted); `budget` caps the live path count (overflow ⇒ complete=false ⇒ consumers degrade to Nothing). Guarded/complex matches + lambda bodies + branch-in-argument stay opaque residual leaves (honest v1 fences). The composed satSymbolicPaths / solveSymbolicPaths faces consume it.

engine:forkPathsSeeded.label: fork: paths-seeded
engine:forkPathsSeeded.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — the seeded fork entry: walk a residual `Expr` from an EXPLICIT initial path-condition state `{ atoms, opaque, shadowable, certs }` (path "0"). `forkPaths` is the thin empty-seed wrapper (empty atoms/opaque/certs, shadowable=false); the branching faces seed `atoms` with the domains' numeric BOUNDS ATOMS (global, path-independent facts) + `certs` with the numeric-certified read terms (the negated-order certificate source). Public shape + behavior of `forkPaths` UNCHANGED. Internal helper.

engine:forkPriorsCatchAll.label: fork: priors-catchall
engine:forkPriorsCatchAll.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — true when SOME prior arm pattern is a catch-all (wildcard/var). Internal helper.

engine:forkPriorsProject.label: fork: priors-project
engine:forkPriorsProject.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — project every prior arm pattern to its SetExpr over-approximation (forkArmProject), accumulating a branch list. Internal helper.

engine:forkRefuted.label: fork: refuted
engine:forkRefuted.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — true when the accumulated path atoms are UNSAT (satCombined ⇒ Just false) — the eager-prune predicate. Any other verdict (Nothing / Just true never fires) ⇒ false (keep the subtree). A refuted PREFIX kills the whole subtree (monotone — adding atoms preserves unsat). Internal helper.

engine:forkResidualFalse.label: fork: residual-false
engine:forkResidualFalse.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — true when a path's residual LEAF predicate is the constant boolean false (`ELit false` or `EConstruct "False"` — the two spellings of the Bool `False`). Such a leaf is unsatisfiable regardless of the path atoms ⇒ the path is refuted (this is what makes an `else False` dead-branch die, lifting the D-B fence). Internal helper.

engine:forkRevArgs.label: fork: rev-args
engine:forkRevArgs.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — reverse a 2-arg list `[x, y]` to `[y, x]` (the operand swap for the ¬(a≤b) ⇒ b<a flip); a non-2-arg list is returned unchanged. Internal helper.

engine:forkSubst.label: fork: subst
engine:forkSubst.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — substitute a match arm's captures into its body: every `EVar n` in the captures env becomes the captured EXPR (a fresh `?fork:` var or the scrutinee Expr); all other nodes recurse structurally (ECall.args / ELambda.body / EMatch.scrutinee+arm-bodies / EConstruct.args / ERecord.fields); ELit passes through. Mirrors substituteCaptures but returns the captured Expr (not ELit-wrapped). Internal helper.

engine:forkSubstArms.label: fork: subst-arms
engine:forkSubstArms.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — forkSubst over EMatch arm bodies, preserving each arm's pattern (and guard when present). Internal helper.

engine:forkSubstFields.label: fork: subst-fields
engine:forkSubstFields.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — forkSubst over ERecord field values, preserving each field name. Internal helper.

engine:forkSubstList.label: fork: subst-list
engine:forkSubstList.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — forkSubst over an Expr list (ECall.args / EConstruct.args), threading the accumulator. Internal helper.

engine:forkWitnessDomSingle.label: fork: witness-dom-single
engine:forkWitnessDomSingle.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — dispatch a single-free-var witness path: look the var up in the domMap; a domain ⇒ the domain-aware intersect-inhabit (forkWitnessDomVar); else plain solve. Internal helper.

engine:forkWitnessDomSolve.label: fork: witness-dom-solve
engine:forkWitnessDomSolve.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — solve one witness-safe path domain-aware: rebuild forkWitnessExpr, collectFreeVars; a SINGLE free var WITH a domain ⇒ `inhabit (SeIntersect [domain, comprehend v we])` (domain enum-first); else plain `solve we` (the Phase-3 behavior — single-unknown fence honored by solve). Internal helper.

engine:forkWitnessDomVar.label: fork: witness-dom-var
engine:forkWitnessDomVar.description: decide-substrate Phase 7 — the domain-aware witness solve for a free var `v`: a domain in the domMap ⇒ `inhabit (SeIntersect [domain, comprehend v we])` (domain enum-first — the intersect fold seeds on the enumerable member); no domain ⇒ plain `solve we`. Internal helper.

engine:forkWitnessExpr.label: fork: witness-expr
engine:forkWitnessExpr.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — rebuild the full path condition as an `and`-conjunction for the witness face — the LOSSLESS FULL condition (eq atoms + the residual + the neq/order atoms + the raw opaque conjuncts), so solve either witnesses it or honestly abstains. ORDER MATTERS for solve (not for meaning): the ENUM-seeding conjuncts (eq atoms + the residual, usually the leaf `==`) come FIRST, then the neq/order atoms, then opaque — solve's intersect fold must seed on an enumerable set before narrowing by intervals (a bare-interval-first fold can't enumerate). A single conjunct returns bare; else a residual `ECall "and"`. Internal helper.

engine:forkableMatch.label: fork: forkable-match
engine:forkableMatch.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — true when EVERY arm of an EMatch is fork-safe: guard-free (a `guard` key FENCES the whole match) AND its pattern is fork-safe (patForkable — wildcard / var / lit / ctor-of-simple-args). One non-forkable arm fences the whole match (it stays an opaque residual leaf). Internal helper.

engine:formDefaultsPlan.label: form-runtime: defaults plan
engine:formDefaultsPlan.description: Fenel-owned default record construction from field default facts. Registry HasDefault lookup is still supplied by the TS wrapper as a named boundary blocker; Fenel owns omission and record assembly semantics.

engine:formDefinitionFields.label: field-meta: formDefinitionFields
engine:formDefinitionFields.description: Phase 10c sub-step 1 — resolve a FormDefinition's input fields. Same shape as entitySchemaFields — the wrapper accepts def.type / def.fields (legacy column) and emits EsfInput; the body dispatches identically. Publish-surface fnId preserves a per-domain entry in the matrix. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedFormDefinitionFields`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/field-meta.ts:formDefinitionFields.

engine:formFieldsPlan.label: form-runtime: fields plan
engine:formFieldsPlan.description: Fenel-owned form field ordering plan. The wrapper supplies fields resolved through the Fenel-bodied formDefinitionFields helper; this body is the canonical form-runtime field list entrypoint.

engine:formRecordDrillPlan.label: form-runtime: record drill plan
engine:formRecordDrillPlan.description: Fenel-owned drill-in plan for record fields in slide forms. Child field facts are supplied by the Fenel field edit plan; this body owns parent-path prefixing and sub-slide grouping.

engine:formSessionPlan.label: form-runtime: session plan
engine:formSessionPlan.description: Fenel-owned form session plan. Owns default/initial/current value merge, submit/saving label precedence, validation error projection, render-mode fallback, and field session rows. Solid maps the plan to JSX and host IO leaves.

engine:formSlidePlan.label: form-runtime: slide plan
engine:formSlidePlan.description: Fenel-owned slide/group plan for progressive forms. Owns explicit-slide resolution, layout-section grouping, and one-slide-per-field fallback.

engine:formSuccessPlan.label: form-runtime: success plan
engine:formSuccessPlan.description: Fenel-owned post-submit success display choice. Link typed values become link plans; other returned typed values become typed-read plans; missing values become thank-you plans.

engine:formValidationPlan.label: form-runtime: validation plan
engine:formValidationPlan.description: Fenel-owned validation display projection. Converts stable path-addressed errors into an error map and summary facts shared by admin, widget, public, and slide renderers.

engine:formatSetError.label: validation-hints: formatSetError
engine:formatSetError.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — "Must be …" error-message companion to autoLabel. Walks the canonical `$tag` Se* ADT and emits per-variant error messages for the leaf constraints (SeRef / SeEnum / SePattern / SeInterval, with ASCII comparators for intervals to match the TS oracle exactly); every other variant (the `_` arm) falls through to the generic "Value does not satisfy constraint" (formatSetError only handles leaf constraints per the TS oracle). The TS marshaller marshalSetExprForLbl is deleted; dispatchedFormatSetError normalises to `$tag` via setExprToTag. Mirrors validate.ts:formatSetError.

engine:formatSetErrorEnum.label: validation-hints: formatSetErrorEnum
engine:formatSetErrorEnum.description: Phase 8b sub-step 1 — formatSetError's `$enum` arm. ≤5 reprs → "Must be one of: …"; >5 → "Invalid option". Internal helper.

engine:formatSetErrorInterval.label: validation-hints: formatSetErrorInterval
engine:formatSetErrorInterval.description: Phase 8b sub-step 1 — formatSetError's `$interval` arm. ASCII comparators (>=, >, <=, <) + "Must be " prefix. Matches the TS oracle byte-for-byte. Internal helper.

engine:formatSetErrorNamed.label: validation-hints: formatSetErrorNamed
engine:formatSetErrorNamed.description: Phase 8b sub-step 1 — formatSetError's `$named` arm. `format:*` → "Invalid X format"; ℤ/ℕ → specials; otherwise → "Must be in set X". Internal helper.

engine:formatSetExpr.label: set-syntax: formatSetExpr
engine:formatSetExpr.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — top-level formatter entry. Walks the canonical `$tag` Se* ADT (SeAll/SeNone/SeWhere/SeRef/SeEnum/SeInterval/SePattern/SeComplement/SeUnion/SeIntersect/SeDiff) and emits the human-readable text DSL string. Leaf resolutions inline (display name / enum value reprs / interval bounds with the $expr carve-out via `lookup` / regex via rxhPatternToRegex∘rxhReadPat); the named-range `Name[lo..hi]` short-form is detected in the SeIntersect arm. Math glyphs hardcoded (Phase-2 Symbolable flag). The TS marshaller marshalSetExprForFmt is deleted; dispatchedFormatSetExpr normalises to `$tag` via setExprToTag. Mirrors set-syntax.ts:formatSetExpr (now a thin shim).

engine:freezeTypeFields.label: type-algebra: freeze fields
engine:freezeTypeFields.description: Validate the ordered identity-bearing field snapshot before the host B3 edge wraps it in a `$record`. No name-keyed map or host-side identity policy participates.

engine:functionArrowType.label: Function arrow type
engine:functionArrowType.description: signature-substrate Phase 1 — THE canonical arrow projection of a function spec (design/signatures-and-contracts.md §6): the marshaled `$arrow {params: fn.params, returns: fn.returns}` on the Tt face, flatten-normalized via ttArrowFlatten (a signature's identity is its flattened arrow; written arity is presentation). `requires` is never in it — capability constraints are contract judgment 2, not value type. Host seam: `dispatchedFunctionArrowType` (engine-bodies-dispatch.ts) owns the one `$`-key boundary marshal; non-arrow input rides through unchanged (ttArrowFlatten is identity off arrows).

engine:functionUsages.label: Function usages
engine:functionUsages.description: Phase 7a — scan a list of functions for ones whose signature references `targetName`; return FunctionUsageEntry records. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedFunctionUsages`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/type-traversal.ts:functionUsages.

engine:functionValueTypes.label: Function value types
engine:functionValueTypes.description: Phase 7a — union of names reachable from a function's params + returns. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedFunctionValueTypes`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/type-traversal.ts:functionValueTypes.

engine:functionsMatchingReturn.label: Functions matching return
engine:functionsMatchingReturn.description: structural-dispatch Phase 4a — the ⊆-arm universe-view `functionsMatchingReturn(expectedType)`: the ids of every function in the marshalled list whose return type `typeSubsumes` (is a subtype of) the expected type, matching by genuine subtype precision (refined leaves via the shipped set:decideSubset). The editor's FunctionPicker consumes this in-process to filter its candidate functions + constructors by the expected type — replacing the browser-side `typeMatches`. The HEAVY sibling of Phase-3's LIGHT nominal `functionsReturning`.

engine:functionsMatchingReturnFold.label: type-subsumes: functionsMatchingReturnFold
engine:functionsMatchingReturnFold.description: structural-dispatch Phase 4a — the head/tail fold behind functionsMatchingReturn: append `f.id` whenever `typeSubsumes f.returnType expected`. Internal helper.

engine:functionsReturning.label: Functions returning
engine:functionsReturning.description: structural-dispatch Phase 3 — the universe-view `functionsReturning(T)`: the ids of every function in the marshalled function list whose return type's head type-constructor NAME equals `typeName` (nominal eq via typeConstructorName). `functionsReturning("Number")` ⇒ the arithmetic family; `functionsReturning("Maybe")` ⇒ the Maybe-shape returners (head / lookup / tail). A no-match ⇒ [] (not an error). Computed as the `solve ∘ materialize` SHAPE — registry→records→filtered set — in the DIRECT-FOLD form (the relational queryRel form is the deferred Instance-domain shape). The function list is supplied by the TS reflection seam (engine-bodies-dispatch.ts), the LIGHT arm (no decider; D3).

engine:functionsReturningFold.label: universe-views: functionsReturningFold
engine:functionsReturningFold.description: structural-dispatch Phase 3 — the head/tail fold behind functionsReturning: walk the marshalled function list, appending `f.id` whenever `typeConstructorName f.returnType` equals `typeName`. Internal helper.

engine:getCategory.label: identifiable: getCategory
engine:getCategory.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — category name for a type via the Categorizable typeclass. Returns `Just String` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetCategory`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getCategory.

engine:getCodeName.label: identifiable: getCodeName
engine:getCodeName.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — Fenel-language code identifier for a type via the Codeable typeclass. Returns `Just LocaleString` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetCodeName`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getCodeName.

engine:getDefaultInlineView.label: identifiable: getDefaultInlineView
engine:getDefaultInlineView.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — default TypeView name for compact / inline rendering of a type, via the Viewable typeclass. Sister to `getDefaultView`; same typeclass, different method. Returns `Just String` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetDefaultInlineView`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getDefaultInlineView.

engine:getDefaultView.label: identifiable: getDefaultView
engine:getDefaultView.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — default TypeView name for full rendering of a type, via the Viewable typeclass. Returns `Just String` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetDefaultView`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getDefaultView.

engine:getDescription.label: identifiable: getDescription
engine:getDescription.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — description / documentation for a type via the Describable typeclass. Returns `Just LocaleString` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetDescription`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getDescription.

engine:getEmoji.label: identifiable: getEmoji
engine:getEmoji.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — default emoji glyph for a type via the Emojiable typeclass. Sister to `getIcon`; used by chat / Telegram / terminal surfaces that prefer compact emoji. Returns `Just String` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetEmoji`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getEmoji.

engine:getExamples.label: identifiable: getExamples
engine:getExamples.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — sample values for the storybook surface, via the Exemplifiable typeclass. Returns `Just (List Any)` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetExamples`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getExamples.

engine:getFieldFuncType.label: getField func type
engine:getFieldFuncType.description: Build the (externref, i32) -> externref WasmFuncType for the $fenel.getField runtime helper. Used by PatConstruct's sub-pattern recursion when the pattern lacks named-field metadata (positional fallback).

engine:getFieldNamedFuncType.label: getFieldNamed func type
engine:getFieldNamedFuncType.description: Build the (externref, externref) -> externref WasmFuncType for the $fenel.getFieldNamed runtime helper used by the dotted CeVar chain.

engine:getIOAction.label: identifiable: getIOAction
engine:getIOAction.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — runtime IO handler action name for a function via the IOInvokable typeclass. The `ioAction` field is plain `String` in the spec — the body wraps it in `Just`. Returns `Just String` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetIOAction`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getIOAction.

engine:getIcon.label: identifiable: getIcon
engine:getIcon.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — default icon identifier (e.g. lucide name) for a type via the Iconable typeclass. Returns `Just String` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetIcon`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getIcon.

engine:getLabel.label: identifiable: getLabel
engine:getLabel.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — display label for a type via the Labelable typeclass. Pattern-matches on `dispatchLookupOne "Labelable" typeName` and extracts the `label` field. Returns `Just LocaleString` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetLabel`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getLabel.

engine:getLayout.label: identifiable: getLayout
engine:getLayout.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — layout strategy identifier ("canvas" / "list" / "grid" / "tree" / custom) for a type via the Layout typeclass. Returns `Just String` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetLayout`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getLayout.

engine:getListInstancesAction.label: identifiable: getListInstancesAction
engine:getListInstancesAction.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — handler that returns the live deployments created by an io-invokable function, via the IOInvokable typeclass. Same Maybe-flatten pattern as `getStopAction`. Returns `Just String` when the io call has a list-instances handler; `Nothing` otherwise. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetListInstancesAction`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getListInstancesAction.

engine:getRepresentation.label: representations: getRepresentation
engine:getRepresentation.description: Phase 10b sub-step 3 — lookup a (typeName, targetId) representational instance. Returns Maybe Value (methods-only — the wrapper reconstructs a ClassInstance shape with NO scope and priority=wrapper-side Date.now(); rights R3a §4.8 dropped the fabricated scope="account", which after the ownership flip made every reconstructed row invisible). The body is a thin pass-through over dispatchLookupOne; the surface preserves the legacy TS shape for backwards-compat. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetRepresentation`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/representations.ts:getRepresentation.

engine:getSound.label: identifiable: getSound
engine:getSound.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — default sound identifier (jingle codeName) for a type via the Soundable typeclass. Audio analogue of `getIcon`. Returns `Just String` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetSound`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getSound.

engine:getStopAction.label: identifiable: getStopAction
engine:getStopAction.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — companion stop-action for an io-invokable function via the IOInvokable typeclass. The `stopAction` field is itself `Maybe String` — the body returns `methods.stopAction` directly (no outer `Just`-wrap), so the wrapper sees a single canonical Maybe. Returns `Just String` when the io call is stoppable; `Nothing` otherwise (no instance OR instance without `stopAction`). Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetStopAction`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getStopAction.

engine:getStoryboard.label: identifiable: getStoryboard
engine:getStoryboard.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — storyboard rows (args, output, description?) for a callable, via the Storyboardable typeclass. Returns `Just (List FunctionExample)` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetStoryboard`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getStoryboard.

engine:getSymbol.label: identifiable: getSymbol
engine:getSymbol.description: containment-substrate Phase 2 Step 3 (design §10.3) — display math GLYPH for a type/former via the Symbolable typeclass. The general symbol projection: `getSymbol "union"` resolves the `Symbolable "union"` instance to `Just "∪"`. Pattern-matches on `dispatchLookupOne "Symbolable" formerName` and extracts the `symbol` field. Returns `Just String` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. The EXACT `getIcon` / `getEmoji` sibling (same dispatchLookupOne shape). Retires the formatter-hardcoded glyph strings (set-syntax.fenel formatter + ExpressionDisplay.tsx) into the representation substrate. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetSymbol`.

engine:getTags.label: identifiable: getTags
engine:getTags.description: Phase 10b sub-step 1 — tag list for a type via the Taggable typeclass. Returns `Just (List String)` on hit, `Nothing` on miss. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedGetTags`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:getTags.

engine:gradeEvidence.label: Grade evidence
engine:gradeEvidence.description: The validateVerified Evidence dispatch, Fenel-bodied (expr-substrate Phase 6b0; External arm added 6b Q1 arm A): Axiom ⇒ pass (Assumed); SolverChecked ⇒ pass (SolverChecked); SampleTested ⇒ pass with samplesChecked = count (SampleTested); KernelProven ⇒ uncheckable with the reserved-kernel reason (Unknown); External ⇒ pass (Assumed — the un-re-checkable external attestation; A-minimal, the provenance lives in the evidence value); any other tag ⇒ uncheckable 'Unknown Evidence variant' (Unknown). Returns a plain-record marker { law, status, es, reason?, samplesChecked?, hasSamples }; the TS delegate maps `es` to the EpistemicStatus value (TS-side output grading, the 6b Q1 lock) and reconstructs the exact LawValidationResult key set.

engine:groundedVars.label: Grounded vars
engine:groundedVars.description: Collect the set of var names that appear as a direct `EVar` argument of some grounding atom (post rule-unfold), deduped. The Datalog safety basis. Internal helper.

engine:groupDecls.label: Group declarations
engine:groupDecls.description: Group leading `@directive` decl-LINE chunks with the FOLLOWING real decl chunk (directives attach to the next decl — the loader's collectLeads / buildDecls behaviour): accumulate directive chunks, and on each real chunk emit the vsemi-joined run of (pending directives ++ the decl). Trailing directives with NO following decl are emitted as their own final group, which buildDecls turns into a `dangling` frame the loader marshal rejects — they used to be silently DROPPED here (declaration-annotations Phase 1 A.1). parser-substrate Phase 5b1.

engine:groupDeclsGo.label: Group declarations (go)
engine:groupDeclsGo.description: groupDecls' walk: thread `{ pending directives, out groups }` — a directive chunk accumulates, a real chunk closes a group `joinChunks (pending ++ [chunk])` and resets. At end of input any STILL-PENDING directives are emitted as a final directive-only group (they annotate nothing); dropping them was silent data loss (declaration-annotations Phase 1 A.1). Internal parse-file helper. parser-substrate Phase 5b1.

engine:growNames.label: Grow names
engine:growNames.description: Worklist BFS over the reachability graph (6b lever-A — replaces the old whole-accumulator re-scan): `seen` is the accumulated reachable set, `frontier` the names discovered last round. Each round collects refs of ONLY the frontier's bodies (via the env index `gidx`), keeps the unseen ones (`notSeen`), and recurses with them as the new frontier — terminating when nothing fresh appears. 7h S2: `gidx` is the name→Pat index (O(1) bodyOf) and `notSeen` does O(1) set-membership, so a round is O(|frontier|·refs + |seen|) and the BFS is O(diameter·|g|) per step (the wide-shallow grammar's diameter is small) — replacing the prior O(|g|²)-per-step linear scans. No fuel bound needed (seen grows monotonically, bounded by |g|). Internal helper.

engine:guardMarker.label: Guard marker
engine:guardMarker.description: Emit the raw `PatGuard { pat, cond }` marker for a guarded match arm — the pattern-position carrier the ledgered match-pattern marshal authors into `{$guard:[pat,cond]}`. `pat` is a raw Pattern ADT value; `cond` is the lowered guard JSON-Logic. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 3.

engine:hasCaptureArrow.label: Has capture arrow
engine:hasCaptureArrow.description: True when `ast` contains a JsArrow whose body freely references any of `params` (a param-capturing closure). JsArrow arm delegates to referencesAnyName (handles nesting + shadowing); other arms recurse to locate arrows. Phase 6b2 loop-safety check.

engine:hasCaptureArrowBindings.label: Has capture arrow (bindings)
engine:hasCaptureArrowBindings.description: OR-fold of hasCaptureArrow over a {name, value} binding list's values. Phase 6b2.

engine:hasCaptureArrowFields.label: Has capture arrow (fields)
engine:hasCaptureArrowFields.description: OR-fold of hasCaptureArrow over a {key, value} field list's values. Phase 6b2.

engine:hasCaptureArrowList.label: Has capture arrow (list)
engine:hasCaptureArrowList.description: OR-fold of hasCaptureArrow over a JsAst list. Phase 6b2.

engine:hasCaseNamed.label: universe-views: hasCaseNamed
engine:hasCaseNamed.description: structural-dispatch Phase 3 — true when a variant's case list contains a TtVariantCase whose `name` equals the given name. Internal helper for variantShapeName.

engine:hasFieldFuncType.label: hasField func type
engine:hasFieldFuncType.description: Build the (externref, i32) -> i32 WasmFuncType for the $fenel.hasField runtime helper. PatConstruct's per-sub-position presence check (positional) — strictness gate so a two-arm pattern that distinguishes with-field vs without-field on the same ctor fails the with-field arm correctly.

engine:hasFieldNamedFuncType.label: hasFieldNamed func type
engine:hasFieldNamedFuncType.description: Build the (externref, externref) -> i32 WasmFuncType for the $fenel.hasFieldNamed runtime helper. Phase 21.1 named-field presence check; symmetric with hasField but keyed by interned field name.

engine:hasNamed.label: widget-hint: hasNamed
engine:hasNamed.description: Phase 3b-3b — is a named handle present in a SetExpr? SeRef → handle == name; SeIntersect → some branch; SeUnion → all branches; else false. Dual-reads the canonical $tag Se* ADT then the legacy $-key form. Mirrors widget-hint.ts:hasNamed; dispatched from the TS wrapper.

engine:hasStringTypedArg.label: Has string-typed arg
engine:hasStringTypedArg.description: Walk args looking for the Phase 21.5.2 string-typed signal: CeLit string, CeVar with dotted access, or CeCall whose callDomainOf returns DomRef. Used by isStringTypedEq to route eq/neq through litEq when at least one arg is structurally string-typed.

engine:hasTailSelf.label: Has tail self-call
engine:hasTailSelf.description: True when `ast` contains a self-call (`$fenel.<name>`) in TAIL position with arity == |params|. Tail positions: body root, JsTernary then/else (not cond), JsLet body (not bindings), last JsSequence element. Does not descend into JsArrow bodies / call args / binops / objects / arrays. The gate for the JsLoopFn rewrite. Phase 6b2.

engine:hasTailSelfLast.label: Has tail self-call (last)
engine:hasTailSelfLast.description: Recurse to the last element of a JsSequence's expr list — the only tail position in a sequence — and test it via hasTailSelf. Phase 6b2.

engine:hiBound.label: Upper boundary
engine:hiBound.description: The membership-transition point a WsInterval upper bound induces: an inclusive `hi` exits JUST PAST at `hi.value + 1`, an exclusive `hi` exits AT `hi.value`; a Nothing (unbounded) bound induces no boundary. Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:hiBoundChar.label: enumerable: hiBoundChar
engine:hiBoundChar.description: solver-extension Phase 2 — the INCLUSIVE Char upper endpoint of an interval bound { value, inclusive }: inclusive ⇒ value (the Char); exclusive (c < value) ⇒ the PREVIOUS codepoint (charFromCode (sub (charCode value) 1)). Internal helper.

engine:hiBoundInt.label: enumerable: hiBoundInt
engine:hiBoundInt.description: solver-extension Phase 1 — the INCLUSIVE integer upper endpoint of an interval bound { value, inclusive }: inclusive ⇒ numberToInt value; exclusive (x < value) ⇒ value − 1 over ℤ (intSub (numberToInt value) (numberToInt 1)). Internal helper.

engine:hiOf.label: propagate: hiOf
engine:hiOf.description: The HI bound of a full SeInterval marker, cleaned through numBound. Nothing for a non-interval (defensive). Internal helper.

engine:humanizeCodeName.label: Humanize code name
engine:humanizeCodeName.description: Phase 3v.4d (module-substrate) — turn a camelCase / snake_case / kebab-case codeName into a Title-Case display label ("runTelegramCollector" → "Run Telegram Collector"; all-caps words like "URL" stay verbatim). Used by displayLabel's read-time fallback when a function declares no explicit @label. The TS oracle at implementations/typescript/engine/src/fenel-module.ts:humanizeCodeName is still called at registry-stamp time by the loader's auto-label code path; this Fenel body is the user-code call-time dispatch.

engine:humanizeCodeNameWalk.label: humanizeCodeName: walk
engine:humanizeCodeNameWalk.description: Phase 3v.4d (module-substrate) — recursive char-fold helper for humanizeCodeName. Walks name from index i, accumulating into acc with a space inserted before curr when (prev, curr, next) hits a camel-case boundary (pass 1 — lower-or-digit-then-upper) or a caps-then-camel boundary (pass 2 — upper-upper-lower).

engine:iconOfValue.label: identifiable: iconOfValue
engine:iconOfValue.description: Phase 10b sub-step 2 — icon for a specific value, falling back to its type's Iconable instance. Resolution order over the `__icon` / `icon` fields then `getIcon typeName`. No `canonical` lift — getIcon already returns String. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:iconOfValue.

engine:identJoin.label: Dotted-ident join length
engine:identJoin.description: Extra length contributed by whitespace-free `.IDENT` dotted-ident joins from `j` (the `a.b.c` greedy join — a `.` followed by an ident-start char, repeated). Internal lexer helper.

engine:idrToNorm.label: set-algebra: idrToNorm
engine:idrToNorm.description: Phase 1b — IntervalDiffResult → canonical Se* SetExpr; declassifies the marshalled IDR intervals back to the raw SeInterval payload (the faithful inverse of unmarshalInterval).

engine:ifNthArg.label: If nth arg
engine:ifNthArg.description: Get the nth arg from a list. Returns JlNull on out-of-range (callers pre-check length).

engine:ifTailExcept.label: If tail except
engine:ifTailExcept.description: Walk args, dropping the element at `excludeIdx` and collecting everything before it.

engine:ifTailFrom.label: If tail from
engine:ifTailFrom.description: Get the tail starting at index `idx`. Functional equivalent of Array.slice without truncation.

engine:implAllOk.label: Impl all ok
engine:implAllOk.description: The subset-implication half of atomSat: every firing key passes implRowOk against every localKey (explicit recursion over the firing set). Internal helper.

engine:implPairOk.label: Atom impl pair ok
engine:implPairOk.description: The subset-implication contradiction check for one ordered key pair (i fires, j tested): ok unless i and j differ, j does NOT fire, and i is a subset of j (then every element satisfying i satisfies j, so the atom is unsatisfiable). Internal helper.

engine:implRowOk.label: Impl row ok
engine:implRowOk.description: The subset-implication check for ONE firing key i against every j in localKeys (explicit recursion). Internal helper.

engine:impliesInteger.label: widget-hint: impliesInteger
engine:impliesInteger.description: Phase 3b-3b — does a SetExpr imply integer-valued numbers? SeRef(ℤ/Int/ℕ/Nat) / SeIntersect(some branch) / SeEnum(all values integer) → Bool; else false. Dual-reads the canonical $tag Se* ADT then the legacy $-key form. Mirrors widget-hint.ts:impliesInteger; dispatched from the TS wrapper.

engine:importFrame.label: Import frame
engine:importFrame.description: Assemble the `{import_decl: {module, names}}` loader frame for a structured selective import (key order module-then-names, byte-matching fenel-parser.ts:parseImportDecl). A directive-carrying import emits {} — the loader marshal rejects it, mirroring the TS parser's directives-on-import throw. signature-substrate Phase 4-prep (D0b).

engine:inAllBranches.label: enumerate: inAllBranches
engine:inAllBranches.description: Phase 15 — true when a value is a member of every remaining SeEnum branch's value list (vacuously true for no branches). Internal helper for filterInAll.

engine:inInterval.label: set-algebra: inInterval
engine:inInterval.description: Phase 7b-continuation — value in interval? Type-mismatch guard.

engine:inclusiveEndpoints.label: search: inclusiveEndpoints
engine:inclusiveEndpoints.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — the ≤2 inclusive endpoints of a SeInterval generator (the untyped P5 candidate set): the lo value when the lo bound is inclusive, the hi value when the hi bound is inclusive; an exclusive or unbounded side contributes nothing (ℝ has no canonical successor). Internal helper.

engine:inferApplied.label: infer: applied (key-as-fnId)
engine:inferApplied.description: Infer a key-as-fnId application {fnId:[...args]} where the op string IS the fnId and every arg is an actual argument: resolve the fnId's declared return-type from the threaded return-table when saturated (arg-count ≥ arity); miss / under-application ⇒ $all. This is the unrecognised-op tail — placed AFTER the known arith/compare/cat/min-max/map/filter/merge/if switch so a std op never resolves through the table. Internal helper.

engine:inferArgsAtDom.label: Infer args at uniform domain
engine:inferArgsAtDom.description: Walk args; for each one inferOrPropagate at the supplied target domain. Used by the $dyn: + isStringTypedEq paths (both want every arg at DomRef).

engine:inferArith.label: infer: arith
engine:inferArith.description: Infer + - * / %: one arg ⇒ unary (`-` negates, others are identity); ≥2 args ⇒ left-fold the inferred inputs through the binary propagate transfer. Internal helper.

engine:inferArithFold.label: infer: arith fold
engine:inferArithFold.description: Left-fold a non-empty list of inferred input markers, seeding from the first; each step applies the binary propagate transfer. Internal helper.

engine:inferArithFoldGo.label: infer: arith fold go
engine:inferArithFoldGo.description: Accumulator-threaded left fold: propagate op [acc, t] for each remaining input t. Internal helper.

engine:inferArithUnary.label: infer: arith unary
engine:inferArithUnary.description: Unary arithmetic: `-` ⇒ propagate negate over the first arg; any other op ⇒ the first arg's type unchanged (the legacy unary-+/*/etc identity). Internal helper.

engine:inferArr.label: infer: array
engine:inferArr.description: Infer an array literal: empty ⇒ SeNone; else a canonical SeUnion of each element's inferred type, normalized through normMarker. Internal helper.

engine:inferBranchDom.label: Infer branch domain
engine:inferBranchDom.description: Decide the result domain of a CeIf when no outer target is supplied. Returns then-branch's domainOf if known, else else-branch's, else DomRef as the safe fallback. Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:988.

engine:inferCall.label: infer: call
engine:inferCall.description: Infer a {call:[fnId, ...args]} application: the fnId rides as args[0] (a Lit string), the remaining args are the actual arguments. Resolve the fnId's declared return-type from the threaded return-table when the call is saturated (actual-arg-count ≥ arity); a non-Lit head / miss / under-application ⇒ $all. Internal helper.

engine:inferCallArgsWithDomains.label: Infer args with per-position expected domains
engine:inferCallArgsWithDomains.description: Parallel walk over args + argDomains. Per-position expected domain drives inferOrPropagate. When argDomains runs out before args, defaults to DomRef (mirrors the TS oracle's `argDomains[i] ?? DOM_REF`).

engine:inferCallSiteInstance.label: Infer call-site instance
engine:inferCallSiteInstance.description: modules-as-values Phase 2d, the call-site type rule. Request {scheme, arguments, expected, path}: scheme is a method's boundary scheme (class parameters quantified in header order, the flattened arrow as bodyTraversal); arguments holds one Maybe TraversalType per argument (Just a ground type, Nothing unknown); expected is a Maybe TraversalType (ground). Exact full application only. Returns CallSiteSolved (each class parameter a nullary nominal, each argument's and the result's solved type), CallSiteUnfixed (the source names of the parameters nothing fixed) or CallSiteRejected (diagnostics).

engine:inferCat.label: infer: cat
engine:inferCat.description: Infer cat (string concatenation): no args ⇒ the empty-string point set {""}; one arg ⇒ that element unchanged (the reduce-no-seed identity); ≥2 ⇒ the variadic propagate cat fold. Internal helper.

engine:inferCeCall.label: Infer CeCall domain
engine:inferCeCall.description: CeCall arm of inferDomains. Three dispatch paths: $dyn:<varName> indirect (each arg propagates DomRef, result DomRef); isStringTypedEq (each arg propagates DomRef, result DomBool); default (per-arg expected from callDomainOf, result from callDomainOf.resultDomain).

engine:inferCeDo.label: Infer CeDo domain
engine:inferCeDo.description: CeDo arm of inferDomains. Sequential walk; the return domain is the last expr's. Seeded with `last = DomUnknown` so the empty-exprs base case returns DomUnknown (mirrors the TS oracle's `let last = DOM_UNKNOWN`).

engine:inferCeIf.label: Infer CeIf domain
engine:inferCeIf.description: CeIf arm of inferDomains. Cond propagates DomBool; then/else recurse via inferDomains. Branch agreement: same dom-tag → that domain; otherwise DomRef (the safe boundary type).

engine:inferCeLet.label: Infer CeLet domain
engine:inferCeLet.description: CeLet arm of inferDomains. Each binding's value recurses; the binding's name gets the inferred value-domain unconditionally (fresh binding, not a param refinement). Then the body recurses; the body's domain is the let's result domain.

engine:inferCeVarDom.label: Infer CeVar domain
engine:inferCeVarDom.description: CeVar arm of inferDomains. Dotted names refine the HEAD to DomRef and return DomRef (the chain's leaf is always externref). Undotted names read the env entry, defaulting to DomUnknown when absent.

engine:inferCompare.label: infer: compare
engine:inferCompare.description: Infer a comparison op: exactly two args ⇒ the binary propagate transfer over their inferred types; any other arity ⇒ the undecided {true,false}. Internal helper.

engine:inferDomains.label: Forward-walk type inference
engine:inferDomains.description: Forward-walk type inference. 10-arm CeExpr dispatch propagating expected argument domains into the per-call HasDomainEnv via getDomain / setDomain natives. Param domains start DomUnknown; refine the first time the body uses them in a typed context. Lets the lowering pick f64 for `add a b` and externref for `concat a b` without source-level annotations. Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:290 (the TS oracle deleted in Phase 21.7.1).

engine:inferDynCall.label: Infer $dyn: indirect call domain
engine:inferDynCall.description: $dyn:<varName> branch of inferCeCall. Refines the indirect-call var to DomRef; each arg propagates DomRef. Returns DomRef (closures travel as externref handles through the call boundary).

engine:inferExprType.label: Infer expr type
engine:inferExprType.description: Forward inference: bottom-up abstract interpretation of a JSON-Logic expression (received as an ExprMarker) under a variable→canonical-SetExpr environment, producing the registered Se* SetExpr directly. Literals become SeEnum point sets; variables look up the env (falling back to a default arg, then SeAll); operators propagate through the Fenel transfer leaf; if/array/merge build canonical unions. The TS delegate owns only Expression→ExprMarker transport, env canonicalization, and the final normalize. unified-static-analysis Phase 3b-3 / floor-kernel Phase 4.

engine:inferExprTypeNarrow.label: Infer expr type (narrowing)
engine:inferExprTypeNarrow.description: Forward inference WITH liquid-type narrowing through if-conditions: a 3-arg `if` narrows the condition (narrowFromCondition), recurses on the then-branch in the narrowed true-env and the else-branch in the narrowed false-env, and unions the two branch types; every other expression delegates to the forward inferExprType walk. Composes both Fenel bodies bare-name (one dispatch) and returns canonical SetExpr; the TS delegate pairs it with the unchanged input env. unified-static-analysis Phase 3b-3c / floor-kernel Phase 4.

engine:inferFilter.label: infer: filter
engine:inferFilter.description: Infer filter: ≥1 arg ⇒ the inferred element type (arg[0]); else ⇒ $all. Internal helper.

engine:inferFlow.label: Infer flow graph types
engine:inferFlow.description: Flow-graph type inference: topologically sort the nodes (Kahn's algorithm — a cyclic node never reaches in-degree 0 and is OMITTED, getting no inferred type, never an error), forward-propagate types through each node's expression (env = its bindings ∪ the already-inferred types arriving on its incoming edges; output = inferExprType, intersected with the declared type when present), then classify each edge: its source type (the from-node's inferred type, $all when absent) plus an assignability proof — the always-ok { proven } default when the target slot is undeclared, else a needsCheck carrier of (source, target) the TS seam resolves through checkAssignable. Returns `{ nodes, edges }` over `$`-free markers; the TS delegate owns the FlowNode/FlowEdge marshal + the Map-typed FlowTypeMap rebuild. The port of fenel-check's inferFlow orchestrator onto the Fenel inference substrate, composing inferExprType / normMarker / checkAssignable. unified-static-analysis Phase 3b-flow.

engine:inferIf.label: infer: if
engine:inferIf.description: Infer if: ≥3 args ⇒ the union of the then-branch and else-branch types; exactly 2 ⇒ the then-branch; else ⇒ $all. No condition-narrowing (the dormant inferNodeNarrow handles that). Internal helper.

engine:inferIfNarrow.label: narrow: infer if
engine:inferIfNarrow.description: Narrow a 3-arg if: narrowFromCondition the condition (arg 0), recurse inferExprTypeNarrow on the then-branch (arg 1) in the true-env and the else-branch (arg 2) in the false-env, then union the two branch types. Internal helper.

engine:inferLetBindings.label: Infer + set let-binding domains
engine:inferLetBindings.description: Walk CeLet.bindings, inferring each binding's value domain and setting the env entry for its name. Unlike propagateCeVarDomain this is unconditional (fresh binding, not a refinement).

engine:inferLlvmArgsAtDom.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmArgsAtDom
engine:inferLlvmArgsAtDom.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferLlvmCallArgsWithDomains.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmCallArgsWithDomains
engine:inferLlvmCallArgsWithDomains.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferLlvmCeCall.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmCeCall
engine:inferLlvmCeCall.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferLlvmCeDo.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmCeDo
engine:inferLlvmCeDo.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferLlvmCeIf.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmCeIf
engine:inferLlvmCeIf.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferLlvmCeLet.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmCeLet
engine:inferLlvmCeLet.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferLlvmCeVarDom.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmCeVarDom
engine:inferLlvmCeVarDom.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferLlvmDomains.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmDomains
engine:inferLlvmDomains.description: Phase 21.8.1 / signature-substrate Phase 2 — LLVM forward-walk type inference. 10-arm CeExpr dispatch propagating expected argument domains into the per-call HasDomainEnv via getDomain / setDomain natives. Param domains start LlvmDomUnknown; the target-prefixed constructor avoids the WasmDomain DomUnknown collision. Refine the first time the body uses them in a typed context.

engine:inferLlvmDynCall.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmDynCall
engine:inferLlvmDynCall.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferLlvmLetBindings.label: LLVM inference: inferLlvmLetBindings
engine:inferLlvmLetBindings.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferMap.label: infer: map
engine:inferMap.description: Infer map: ≥2 args ⇒ the inferred type of the mapper expression (arg[1]); else ⇒ $all. Internal helper.

engine:inferMatchPatternBindings.label: Infer match pattern bindings
engine:inferMatchPatternBindings.description: Public browser entry: consume the shared JSON-Logic-to-Syntax Result, solve the first canonical Pattern with the rank-1 kernel, and publish only structured meta-free bindings. Plain record patterns are outside the canonical Pattern ADT and fence as AnnotationRequired.

engine:inferNarrowAt.label: narrow: infer nth (narrowing)
engine:inferNarrowAt.description: Index into the arg-marker list and recurse inferExprTypeNarrow on the element in the given env; out of range ⇒ $all. Internal helper.

engine:inferNarrowOp.label: narrow: infer op
engine:inferNarrowOp.description: The narrowing-aware op arm: a 3-arg (or more) `if` narrows into branches; any other op (or shorter `if`) delegates to the forward inferExprType. Internal helper.

engine:inferNot.label: infer: not
engine:inferNot.description: Infer !/not: ≥1 arg ⇒ propagate boolean negation over the first arg's type; no args ⇒ the undecided {true,false}. Internal helper.

engine:inferNth.label: infer: nth arg
engine:inferNth.description: Index into the arg-marker list and infer the element's type; out of range ⇒ $all. Internal helper.

engine:inferOp.label: infer: op
engine:inferOp.description: Infer an operator application from its op string + already-marshalled argument markers: arithmetic (+ - * / %, left-fold through propagate), comparison (> >= < <= == != === !==, binary propagate), and/or/in ⇒ {true,false}, !/not ⇒ propagate negation, if ⇒ then/else union, cat ⇒ string-concat fold, substr ⇒ String, merge ⇒ union of inputs, map ⇒ mapper output, filter ⇒ element type, min/max ⇒ variadic propagate. The unrecognised-op tail resolves a function application's RETURN type through the threaded fnId → TraversalType + arity table and typeToSetExpr when saturated; misses and partial applications remain conservatively unconstrained. Internal helper.

engine:inferOrPropagate.label: Propagate or recurse
engine:inferOrPropagate.description: Dispatch helper used by every CeCall / CeConstruct / CeRecord / CeMatch arg-walk site. CeVar → propagateCeVarDomain; else → inferDomains (recurse for nested CeVar references; the returned domain is discarded).

engine:inferOrPropagateLlvm.label: LLVM inference: inferOrPropagateLlvm
engine:inferOrPropagateLlvm.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:inferPipe.label: infer: pipe
engine:inferPipe.description: Infer a {pipe:[stage1, stage2, …]} application: the result type is the LAST stage's return-type. When the last stage is a bare fnId (a Lit string), resolve it from the return-table as a 1-arg application (the piped value is its single argument); an empty pipe / a last stage that is not a bare fnId (a lambda / partial-application marker) ⇒ $all. Internal helper.

engine:inferRequiresFor.label: infer transitive requires for a function
engine:inferRequiresFor.description: The transitive `requires` set for `target`: union the target's OWN declared requires (own-first, matching the TS seed order) with every reached function's declared requires, deduped by the structural (class spec-id, args[0]) key. Builds the call-graph edges from the pre-extracted callees (anaReqEdges), takes the exact node-count-bounded reachability closure (anaReachClose — SHARED with the SCC census, the genuine 2-birds), collects the reached set (anaReqReached, self-inclusive), and folds. THE `$dyn` ARM (Phase 4b, D-4b FLOOR): if any reached function performs an INDIRECT dispatch (anaReqReachedHasDyn — its callees carry the `$dyn` token), union the effect-OPAQUE `dynSentinel` (marshalled IN by the seam — the `$`-key Constraint a `.fenel` body cannot author) so the target can never be certified pure. SOUND over-approximation closing the Phase-4 D-4-4 deferral. `functions` MUST contain `target` and every function transitively reachable from it (the TS marshal seam pre-resolves this reachable set host-side). The SOURCE OF TRUTH for the legacy TS `inferTransitiveRequires` (kept as the bootstrap perf branch — see the module header).

engine:inferSyntaxType.label: Infer Syntax type
engine:inferSyntaxType.description: Boundary entry for browser/loader parity: prepare exact schemes, infer surface Syntax, generalize deterministically, and return a structured outcome.

engine:inferSyntaxTypeFinish.label: Infer Syntax type finish
engine:inferSyntaxTypeFinish.description: Discharge refinement residuals, generalize and publish one inferred surface-Syntax expression (inferSyntaxType).

engine:inferTopLevelSignatures.label: Infer top-level signature batch
engine:inferTopLevelSignatures.description: Public registry entry: derive registered constructor schemes, partition exact surface call edges, solve SCCs dependency-first, and return only atomically published meta-free schemes.

engine:inferTraversalEquation.label: Infer traversal equation
engine:inferTraversalEquation.description: Focused unifier entry used by conformance tests; metas are supplied as InferenceType, ground leaves as TraversalType-converted types.

engine:inferVar.label: infer: var
engine:inferVar.description: Resolve a variable marker: look the name up in the env; if bound, return its canonical SetExpr; else if the var carries a default arg, infer that; else SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:inferenceAddBoundNames.label: Inference add bound names
engine:inferenceAddBoundNames.description: Extend a lexical-name set without relying on host map insertion order.

engine:inferenceAddMeta.label: Inference add free meta
engine:inferenceAddMeta.description: Append a meta descriptor once, retaining first structural occurrence.

engine:inferenceAddRecursiveReturnMetaId.label: Inference add recursive return meta id
engine:inferenceAddRecursiveReturnMetaId.description: Add one preallocated meta result to the SCC return-id set.

engine:inferenceAddUniqueName.label: Inference add unique name
engine:inferenceAddUniqueName.description: Append one canonical target id once while retaining deterministic first occurrence.

engine:inferenceAlphaMapping.label: Inference alpha mapping
engine:inferenceAlphaMapping.description: Alpha-normalize generalized metas to the first collision-free a0,a1,… names in structural order, reserving authored ids and source spellings.

engine:inferenceAnnotation.label: Inference annotation required
engine:inferenceAnnotation.description: Return an AnnotationRequired outcome containing one stable diagnostic.

engine:inferenceAppFromTraversal.label: Inference application from traversal
engine:inferenceAppFromTraversal.description: Interpret TtApp only through its mechanically reattached authoritative scheme sidecar. Binder identity and nominal reference are disjoint; an untagged TtApp is genuinely value-dependent and fences.

engine:inferenceAppendProjection.label: Inference append projection
engine:inferenceAppendProjection.description: Retain a deferred field obligation until later equations reveal the receiver's structural record type.

engine:inferenceAppendResidual.label: Inference append residual
engine:inferenceAppendResidual.description: Append a ground directional refinement residual to solver state.

engine:inferenceApply.label: Inference apply substitution
engine:inferenceApply.description: Recursively replace every solved meta; the result is used before generalization/publication.

engine:inferenceApplyCallable.label: Inference apply callable type
engine:inferenceApplyCallable.description: Apply inferred argument types to a callable: exact call, partial result arrow, or proven callable-result spill; scalar overapplication fences.

engine:inferenceApplyCases.label: Inference apply substitution to cases
engine:inferenceApplyCases.description: Apply the solved substitution recursively to variant cases.

engine:inferenceApplyFields.label: Inference apply substitution to fields
engine:inferenceApplyFields.description: Apply the solved substitution recursively to semantic fields.

engine:inferenceApplyList.label: Inference apply substitution to list
engine:inferenceApplyList.description: Apply the solved substitution recursively to a list of types.

engine:inferenceArrowFieldKeyValid.label: Inference arrow field key valid
engine:inferenceArrowFieldKeyValid.description: Arrow schemes may carry either embedded UUID NamedFields or syntactically valid lock-less SourceHandles. Positional validity stays delegated to the FieldKey kernel.

engine:inferenceArrowFromTraversal.label: Inference arrow from traversal
engine:inferenceArrowFromTraversal.description: Convert one TraversalType arrow and its semantic-keyed parameters.

engine:inferenceArrowLike.label: Inference arrow-like type
