engine:inferenceArrowLike.description: Is a type a function type, or exactly the system `Maybe` of one? These are the declared types a lowered reference or a closure inhabits (a method field holds a reference; a `Maybe (a -> b)` field holds `Just` one). Anything else, a type variable included, is not.

engine:inferenceArrowSlotsError.label: Inference arrow semantic slots error
engine:inferenceArrowSlotsError.description: Validate the flattened arrow parameter container under UUID-or-SourceHandle named identity.

engine:inferenceArrowSlotsErrorFrom.label: Inference arrow semantic slots error from
engine:inferenceArrowSlotsErrorFrom.description: Inference-local arrow container validation: retain duplicate key/wire and positional ordinal laws while admitting valid repository SourceHandles before lock embedding.

engine:inferenceAssumptionLookup.label: Inference SCC assumption lookup
engine:inferenceAssumptionLookup.description: Find a current-SCC monomorphic arrow assumption by canonical id.

engine:inferenceAuthoredPublicationFence.label: Inference authored publication fence
engine:inferenceAuthoredPublicationFence.description: Only a structurally valid, genuinely value-dependent authored type may publish outside bounded rank-1 inference. Other conversion failures remain batch-atomic errors.

engine:inferenceAuthoredSignatureTrust.label: Inference authored signature trust
engine:inferenceAuthoredSignatureTrust.description: Classify the transitional P2 trust posture from the active implementation origin. A complete authored signature retains the repository's historical SC-sig admission until P4/P4b replaces that axiom with certificates; the evidence is explicitly only AuthoredSignature, never a validation verdict.

engine:inferenceAuthoringLiteralChecks.label: Authoring literal membership checks
engine:inferenceAuthoringLiteralChecks.description: Retain a reader-scoped literal membership refusal without treating an undecided check as a mismatch or inventing another typing fact.

engine:inferenceBareTypeConstructor.label: Inference bare type constructor
engine:inferenceBareTypeConstructor.description: Does a member's type hold a type constructor applied to nothing (the host's spelling of a higher-kinded argument such as the `Maybe` in `Functor Maybe`)? The solver has no application-head normalization, so such a member fences instead of letting the constructor reach an application head.

engine:inferenceBindMeta.label: Inference bind meta
engine:inferenceBindMeta.description: Bind a fresh meta after kind and occurs checks.

engine:inferenceBindMetaState.label: Inference bind meta
engine:inferenceBindMetaState.description: Extend the immutable substitution with one solved metavariable.

engine:inferenceCall.label: Inference call
engine:inferenceCall.description: Infer a named/local call with independent callee instantiation and left-to-right argument inference.

engine:inferenceCallableForResolution.label: Inference callable row for resolution
engine:inferenceCallableForResolution.description: Project one exact routing row to the current SCC assumption, an already-published generalized scheme, or an authored external scheme.

engine:inferenceCallableLookup.label: Inference callable lookup
engine:inferenceCallableLookup.description: Lookup an exact registry-resolution row by source call spelling.

engine:inferenceCallsIn.label: Inference calls in surface Syntax
engine:inferenceCallsIn.description: Exact, lexical-scope-aware call/reference walk over all surface Syntax cases; registry rows contribute canonical target ids.

engine:inferenceCallsInFields.label: Inference calls in record fields
engine:inferenceCallsInFields.description: Collect graph edges from every SRecord field value.

engine:inferenceCallsInLetBindings.label: Inference calls in let bindings
engine:inferenceCallsInLetBindings.description: Collect a sequential SLet graph: each initializer sees only earlier binders; the returned bound set includes every binding.

engine:inferenceCallsInList.label: Inference calls in Syntax list
engine:inferenceCallsInList.description: Surface call-graph fold over a Syntax list.

engine:inferenceCallsInMatchArms.label: Inference calls in match arms
engine:inferenceCallsInMatchArms.description: Collect graph edges under each arm's pattern binders and optional guard.

engine:inferenceCandidateCallees.label: Inference top-level candidate callees
engine:inferenceCandidateCallees.description: Compute canonical callees for one top-level body, starting with its parameter binders.

engine:inferenceCandidateDependenciesRea.label: Inference candidate dependencies ready
engine:inferenceCandidateDependenciesRea.description: Check every canonical dependency of one candidate against the current publication frontier.

engine:inferenceCandidateDependenciesTru.label: Inference candidate dependencies are trusted
engine:inferenceCandidateDependenciesTru.description: Meet one candidate's exact surface callees against the current trust frontier.

engine:inferenceCandidateIds.label: Inference candidate ids
engine:inferenceCandidateIds.description: Project deterministic canonical ids from a candidate list.

engine:inferenceCandidateParams.label: Inference candidate params
engine:inferenceCandidateParams.description: Allocate independent absent parameter metas and convert authored parameter slots through the audited traversal boundary.

engine:inferenceCandidateQuantified.label: Inference candidate quantified sidecar
engine:inferenceCandidateQuantified.description: Use an explicit source/type scheme unchanged, or derive KType host compatibility binders in Fenel from Authored HostSpec slots only.

engine:inferenceCandidateReturn.label: Inference candidate return
engine:inferenceCandidateReturn.description: Allocate an independent absent return meta or convert the authored return traversal.

engine:inferenceCanonicalApplicationView.label: Inference canonical application view
engine:inferenceCanonicalApplicationView.description: Expose arguments only for exact system-owned Maybe/Result/List applications. Intrinsic list literals carry that same durable List identity so public scheme round-trips preserve the bridge; public spelling alone is never authority.

engine:inferenceCanonicalContainerPair.label: Inference canonical container pair
engine:inferenceCanonicalContainerPair.description: True only when two non-app/application-or-structural standard views name the same constructor; ordinary application pairs retain exact nominal head comparison.

engine:inferenceCanonicalContainerView.label: Inference canonical container view
engine:inferenceCanonicalContainerView.description: Project exact standard nominal applications and their parser-canonical structural expansions to a unifier-only name/argument view.

engine:inferenceCanonicalFieldsFromTrave.label: Inference canonical structural fields from traversal
engine:inferenceCanonicalFieldsFromTrave.description: Convert and sort record/variant fields by semantic FieldKey so host/source insertion order cannot affect schemes.

engine:inferenceCanonicalListTailField.label: Inference canonical List tail field
engine:inferenceCanonicalListTailField.description: Find the unique semantic Cons field whose type is the recursive nominal List tail; two recursive candidates are not a canonical spine.

engine:inferenceCanonicalListTailType.label: Inference canonical List tail type
engine:inferenceCanonicalListTailType.description: Recognize the nominal recursive List tail type without consulting wire spelling or field order.

engine:inferenceCanonicalListView.label: Inference canonical List view
engine:inferenceCanonicalListView.description: Recognize the exact opaque List Nil/Cons spine, locate its unique recursive tail by type, and expose the sole other semantic field as the element argument.

engine:inferenceCanonicalMaybeView.label: Inference canonical Maybe view
engine:inferenceCanonicalMaybeView.description: Recognize only the parser-canonical undiscriminated Nothing | Just p:0 structural expansion and expose its type argument.

engine:inferenceCanonicalPositionalPaylo.label: Inference canonical positional payload
engine:inferenceCanonicalPositionalPaylo.description: Extract the sole p:0 payload of one canonical standard constructor case.

engine:inferenceCanonicalRecursiveReturn.label: Inference canonical recursive return branches
engine:inferenceCanonicalRecursiveReturn.description: Reuse the output-union normalizer while retaining an explicit empty branch worklist.

engine:inferenceCanonicalResultView.label: Inference canonical Result view
engine:inferenceCanonicalResultView.description: Recognize only the parser-canonical undiscriminated Err p:0 | Ok p:0 structural expansion and expose both type arguments.

engine:inferenceCanonicalSyntaxFields.label: Inference canonical Syntax record fields
engine:inferenceCanonicalSyntaxFields.description: Stable field ordering independent of host object insertion order.

engine:inferenceCanonicalVariantDiscrimi.label: Inference canonical variant discriminator
engine:inferenceCanonicalVariantDiscrimi.description: The standard expanded Maybe/Result/List views are undiscriminated variants; tagged lookalikes never enter the nominal/structural bridge.

engine:inferenceCapabilityMethodCallable.label: Inference capability method callable
engine:inferenceCapabilityMethodCallable.description: Project one source record field into an exact callable scheme. Curried arrows flatten through the shipped law; a scalar field is a nullary method, never a host-synthesized arrow.

engine:inferenceCapabilityMethodEntity.label: Inference capability method entity
engine:inferenceCapabilityMethodEntity.description: Peel declaration wrappers and project method callables from a registered dispatch-interface record scheme.

engine:inferenceCapabilityMethodFields.label: Inference capability method fields
engine:inferenceCapabilityMethodFields.description: Derive only the exact method names selected from one registered dispatch-interface record. Source binding diagnostics fence the record instead of licensing a partial host reconstruction.

engine:inferenceCaseByName.label: Inference variant case by name
engine:inferenceCaseByName.description: Lookup one unique converted constructor by nominal name.

engine:inferenceCaseListContainsUnion.label: Inference case list contains union
engine:inferenceCaseListContainsUnion.description: Detect an output-only union below any variant payload.

engine:inferenceCaseNamesUnique.label: Inference constructor names unique
engine:inferenceCaseNamesUnique.description: Reject duplicate variant constructors at the authored traversal boundary.

engine:inferenceCasesFromNames.label: Inference variant cases from names
engine:inferenceCasesFromNames.description: Rebuild converted constructors in sorted nominal order.

engine:inferenceCasesFromTraversal.label: Inference variant cases from traversal
engine:inferenceCasesFromTraversal.description: Convert, validate unique constructors, and canonicalize variants independently of declaration insertion order.

engine:inferenceClassifyRecursiveReturnB.label: Inference classify recursive return branch
engine:inferenceClassifyRecursiveReturnB.description: Classify one applied top-level branch, recursively flattening unions and retaining direct SCC-return edges as dependencies.

engine:inferenceClassifyRecursiveReturnB.label: Inference classify recursive return branches
engine:inferenceClassifyRecursiveReturnB.description: Partition top-level normalized output branches into concrete branches and direct deferred-return dependencies after applying all non-return constraints.

engine:inferenceCollectMetas.label: Inference collect free metas
engine:inferenceCollectMetas.description: Collect free metas by first structural occurrence.

engine:inferenceCollectMetasCases.label: Inference collect metas from cases
engine:inferenceCollectMetasCases.description: Collect free metas from variant cases in canonical order.

engine:inferenceCollectMetasFields.label: Inference collect metas from fields
engine:inferenceCollectMetasFields.description: Collect free metas from semantic fields in their canonical order.

engine:inferenceCollectMetasList.label: Inference collect metas from list
engine:inferenceCollectMetasList.description: Collect free metas from a list in structural order.

engine:inferenceCollectResolvedReference.label: Inference collect resolved reference
engine:inferenceCollectResolvedReference.description: Record a canonical call-graph target for an unbound value/call spelling; unresolved or ambiguous rows are left for the inference diagnostic path.

engine:inferenceConstructorCallable.label: Inference constructor callable
engine:inferenceConstructorCallable.description: Convert one TraversalType constructor payload to a trusted, total polymorphic callable scheme.

engine:inferenceConstructorHasSourceDiag.label: Inference constructor has source diagnostics
engine:inferenceConstructorHasSourceDiag.description: Report whether any declaration-binding diagnostic applies to the selected constructor index.

engine:inferenceConstructorHeadKind.label: Inference constructor head kind
engine:inferenceConstructorHeadKind.description: Derive the authoritative nominal constructor kind from the registered entity's declaration-scoped binders.

engine:inferenceConstructorPattern.label: Inference constructor pattern
engine:inferenceConstructorPattern.description: Instantiate a constructor scheme, unify its result with the scrutinee, then bind payload patterns.

engine:inferenceConstructorResult.label: Inference constructor result
engine:inferenceConstructorResult.description: Build the nominal result of a data constructor; parameterized owners retain an explicit kinded scheme application.

engine:inferenceConstructorResultArgumen.label: Inference constructor result arguments
engine:inferenceConstructorResultArgumen.description: Project an entity's declaration-scoped binders to rigid result arguments in source order.

engine:inferenceConstructorSchemeBody.label: Inference constructor scheme body
engine:inferenceConstructorSchemeBody.description: Every constructor is callable from SConstruct; nullary constructors therefore have an exact zero-parameter arrow into their nominal owner.

engine:inferenceDeclarationDeclaredField.label: Inference declaration declared field
engine:inferenceDeclarationDeclaredField.description: The declared type of one non-obligation field of a single-constructor declaration. A field the declaration does not declare is unknown (a nominal value may retain undeclared data), so it fences instead of being reported missing. Any other failure to read or convert the declared field (an unbound scheme variable, a kind error, duplicate field keys, two fields with one spelling, a value-dependent type, …) says the DECLARATION evidence is unusable, not that the expression is ill-typed: it fences too, quoting the original diagnostic (inferenceDeclarationEvidenceFence).

engine:inferenceDeclarationEvidenceFence.label: Inference declaration evidence fence
engine:inferenceDeclarationEvidenceFence.description: Turn a failure to read a declaration field's type into the record-projection fence, quoting the original diagnostic code and message, as inferenceInstantiateDeclarationField does for unification.

engine:inferenceDeclarationFieldType.label: Inference declaration field type
engine:inferenceDeclarationFieldType.description: Convert only the requested field of a single-constructor declaration, under the declaration's own binders. An erased obligation (the row's `obligations` verdict: a law or superclass field) fences, since a value of the type need not carry it; a field the declaration does not declare fences, since a nominal value may retain undeclared data (never the definite `projection-field-missing`); a value-dependent field fences in the converter, and an unowned nominal spelling fences here.

engine:inferenceDeclarationFields.label: Inference declaration constructor fields
engine:inferenceDeclarationFields.description: The field list of a declaration's only constructor: a record, or a variant with exactly one case, seen through a refinement or a tag. A multi-case variant (a value may hold another constructor), an opaque declaration (its values are host carriers; its pure view is never unfolded), a μ body or an alias is Nothing, so projection fences instead of guessing.

engine:inferenceDeclarationReceiverShape.label: Inference declaration receiver shape
engine:inferenceDeclarationReceiverShape.description: Does a nominal receiver have the shape of a value of its declaration's type? A bare nominal (`ItNamed`) fits only a declaration with no binders; an application must apply every binder and have kind Type. A bare or partially applied receiver (a host binding typed `Iso`, or `Iso String`) is no value type of the declaration, so its fields are unknown: an explicit fence, as it was before any declaration evidence was in scope.

engine:inferenceDeclarationRows.label: Inference declaration rows
engine:inferenceDeclarationRows.description: Select the host's nominal declaration rows (status `declaration`) carried beside the exact callable rows, each with its erasure verdict settled here (inferenceDeclarationWithErasure). They are projection evidence, never callables: no source spelling starts with `$decl:`.

engine:inferenceDeclarationWithErasure.label: Inference declaration with erasure verdict
engine:inferenceDeclarationWithErasure.description: One declaration row with its erasure verdict decided in Fenel from the facts the host marshalled: `erasureFields` (per field: its name, whether it is a law field by the registry's own rule, and the head of a superclass-shaped field, a head applied to the class parameter) and `erasureHeads` (per such head: whether a capability is registered for it and its owners). `obligations` lists every field a value of the type need not carry (a definite or an undecided obligation, so a read of it fences); `undecidedObligations` the subset whose classhood the facts cannot settle (so a value lacking it is never excused, inferenceDefiniteObligation).

engine:inferenceDeclaredFieldArrowLike.label: Inference declared field arrow-like
engine:inferenceDeclaredFieldArrowLike.description: Is a declaration field's declared type (converted under the declaration's own binders) arrow-like (inferenceArrowLike)? A field type that does not convert is not.

engine:inferenceDeferProjection.label: Inference defer record projection
engine:inferenceDeferProjection.description: Create a result meta for a field read whose receiver is not solved yet. This is an obligation, not an open-row type, and cannot escape generalization.

engine:inferenceDeferredRecursiveReturnU.label: Inference deferred recursive return union
engine:inferenceDeferredRecursiveReturnU.description: Recognize only an output union with a direct branch that is one of the current SCC's preallocated return metas. Nested recursive occurrences are deliberately excluded and retain the ordinary occurs-check fence.

engine:inferenceDefiniteObligation.label: Inference definite obligation
engine:inferenceDefiniteObligation.description: Is a declaration field a definite erased obligation (in the row's `obligations` verdict and not among its `undecidedObligations`)? Only such a field may be absent from a value of the type.

engine:inferenceDependencyTargetTrusted.label: Inference dependency target is trusted
engine:inferenceDependencyTargetTrusted.description: Require an outside dependency certificate from an atomically published plan or an authored external row. Current-SCC assumptions are checked as one trust unit.

engine:inferenceDependencyTargetsReady.label: Inference dependency targets ready
engine:inferenceDependencyTargetsReady.description: A target is ready when external, in the current SCC, or already atomically published.

engine:inferenceDependencyTargetsTrusted.label: Inference dependency targets are trusted
engine:inferenceDependencyTargetsTrusted.description: Conjoin trust evidence for every canonical outside callee.

engine:inferenceDiagnostic.label: Inference diagnostic
engine:inferenceDiagnostic.description: Build one stable signature-inference diagnostic record.

engine:inferenceDiagnosticIsFence.label: Inference diagnostic is annotation fence
engine:inferenceDiagnosticIsFence.description: Classify unsupported/indeterminate diagnostics separately from exact invalid equations.

engine:inferenceDirectRecursiveReturnBra.label: Inference direct recursive return branch
engine:inferenceDirectRecursiveReturnBra.description: Test whether one already-applied top-level union branch is an unsolved current-SCC return meta.

engine:inferenceDischargeReadyProjection.label: Inference discharge ready projections
engine:inferenceDischargeReadyProjection.description: Whenever unification solves a receiver, discharge every newly ready field obligation before returning the state. Unsolved obligations remain explicit and fence at generalization.

engine:inferenceDischargeResidual.label: Inference discharge one refinement residual
engine:inferenceDischargeResidual.description: After substitution is ground, prove the directional inferred-set subset of the declared refinement. Plain declared bases accept a more precise inferred refinement; a plain inferred base denotes SeAll.

engine:inferenceDischargeResiduals.label: Inference discharge refinement residuals
engine:inferenceDischargeResiduals.description: Discharge every post-solve refinement obligation with decideSubset; no residual may be generalized or silently retained.

engine:inferenceDo.label: Inference do sequence
engine:inferenceDo.description: Infer every SDo expression in order and return the final expression's type.

engine:inferenceDottedValuePath.label: Inference dotted value path
engine:inferenceDottedValuePath.description: Split a dotted runtime value spelling into its lexical root and nonempty projection tail. A dotless spelling and malformed empty root remain exact names.

engine:inferenceDrop.label: Inference drop types
engine:inferenceDrop.description: Drop n entries from a list (bounded by list length).

engine:inferenceEffectiveCallables.label: Inference effective callable rows
engine:inferenceEffectiveCallables.description: Build the one callable view used while solving an SCC; current assumptions override published/external rows.

engine:inferenceEnsureProjectionsDischar.label: Inference ensure projections discharged
engine:inferenceEnsureProjectionsDischar.description: Open-row polymorphism is outside the shipped scheme representation, so an unresolved receiver obligation must fence instead of publishing a guessed closed record.

engine:inferenceEntityConstructorCallabl.label: Inference entity constructor callables
engine:inferenceEntityConstructorCallabl.description: Peel declaration wrappers and derive the value-level constructor surface from a registered entity TraversalType.

engine:inferenceEnvironmentDynamicOpaque.label: Inference environment dynamic call is opaque
engine:inferenceEnvironmentDynamicOpaque.description: Distinguish unknown higher-order parameters/host bindings from locally inferred let/where functions whose bodies were already checked in this solve.

engine:inferenceEnvironmentDynamicOpaque.label: Inference environment dynamic call opacity by exact name
engine:inferenceEnvironmentDynamicOpaque.description: Read the dynamic-call provenance flag for one already-selected lexical binder. A miss is conservatively opaque.

engine:inferenceEnvironmentLookup.label: Inference environment lookup
engine:inferenceEnvironmentLookup.description: Head-first lexical lookup; new bindings are prepended so inner scope wins.

engine:inferenceEnvironmentLookupBinding.label: Inference environment binding lookup
engine:inferenceEnvironmentLookupBinding.description: Head-first lexical lookup of the whole binding (its scheme and the opaque reads its generalization carried); new bindings are prepended so inner scope wins.

engine:inferenceEnvironmentMetas.label: Inference collect environment metas
engine:inferenceEnvironmentMetas.description: Collect metas reachable from monomorphic environment schemes under the current substitution (a parameter meta solved to {a: t} blocks t too); generalized rigids do not contribute.

engine:inferenceEnvironmentOwnsMonomorph.label: Inference environment owns monomorphic meta
engine:inferenceEnvironmentOwnsMonomorph.description: Recognize a still-monomorphic lexical binder by exact meta identity; this provenance distinguishes a higher-rank-required use from an ordinary ground mismatch.

engine:inferenceErasureVerdict.label: Inference erasure verdict
engine:inferenceErasureVerdict.description: The erasure verdict of one declaration field (`obligation`, `undecided` or `ordinary`), the obligation-erasure rule of `seedFromType`: a law field (`Verified P`) is a definite obligation; a field without the superclass shape is ordinary; a superclass-shaped field is an obligation exactly when its head is a registered class: definite when a capability is registered for the head; ordinary when the head has no owner, or exactly one owner that is no registered class; undecided otherwise (several owners, or one the registry cannot key), and undecided when the host marshalled no facts for the head.

engine:inferenceErr.label: Inference error
engine:inferenceErr.description: Build the Err payload used internally by the solver.

engine:inferenceExternalCallableByTarget.label: Inference external callable by target
engine:inferenceExternalCallableByTarget.description: Find external signature evidence by canonical target id, independent of the source spelling used at this call site.

engine:inferenceExternalCallableLookup.label: Inference external callable lookup
engine:inferenceExternalCallableLookup.description: Find a prepared external callable by exact source spelling.

engine:inferenceExternalTrustUsable.label: Inference external trust is usable
engine:inferenceExternalTrustUsable.description: Decode the already-validated host boundary trust tag without inventing a default; unknown tags remain untrusted.

engine:inferenceFencedDiagnostics.label: Inference fenced diagnostics
engine:inferenceFencedDiagnostics.description: Concatenate exact carried diagnostics in lexical target order without rewriting them.

engine:inferenceFencedRowKey.label: Inference fenced row key
engine:inferenceFencedRowKey.description: Build an injective sortable key from the exact source spelling and canonical target identity.

engine:inferenceFencedRowKeys.label: Inference fenced row keys
engine:inferenceFencedRowKeys.description: Collect each exact fenced (source spelling, target identity) pair once before deterministic verdict joining.

engine:inferenceFencedRowLookup.label: Inference fenced row lookup
engine:inferenceFencedRowLookup.description: Lookup one exact fenced row by its already-canonical source spelling.

engine:inferenceFencedRowsContainInvalid.label: Inference fenced rows contain invalid
engine:inferenceFencedRowsContainInvalid.description: Compute the fence verdict join: Invalid dominates AnnotationRequired.

engine:inferenceFencedRowsOutcome.label: Inference fenced rows outcome
engine:inferenceFencedRowsOutcome.description: Join every relevant exact callable fence in Fenel, independent of host resolver iteration order.

engine:inferenceFieldByToken.label: Inference field by token
engine:inferenceFieldByToken.description: Lookup a validated internal field by canonical semantic token.

engine:inferenceFieldFromTraversal.label: Inference field from traversal
engine:inferenceFieldFromTraversal.description: Convert one identity-total TraversalType field to the solver field shape.

engine:inferenceFieldListContainsUnion.label: Inference field list contains union
engine:inferenceFieldListContainsUnion.description: Detect an output-only union below any semantic field type.

engine:inferenceFieldOtherThanToken.label: Inference field other than token
engine:inferenceFieldOtherThanToken.description: Return the sole non-matching field after a caller has established an exact width-two canonical payload.

engine:inferenceFieldTokensUnique.label: Inference field tokens unique
engine:inferenceFieldTokensUnique.description: Reject duplicate semantic FieldKeys at every authored traversal boundary.

engine:inferenceFieldsFromTokens.label: Inference fields from tokens
engine:inferenceFieldsFromTokens.description: Rebuild fields in sorted semantic-token order.

engine:inferenceFieldsFromTraversal.label: Inference fields from traversal
engine:inferenceFieldsFromTraversal.description: Convert calling-convention fields in source order while enforcing exact semantic FieldKey uniqueness.

engine:inferenceFindCase.label: Inference find case
engine:inferenceFindCase.description: Find a variant case by nominal constructor name.

engine:inferenceFindField.label: Inference find field
engine:inferenceFindField.description: Find a field by its canonical semantic FieldKey token, never wire spelling.

engine:inferenceFirstAbsentParam.label: Inference first absent parameter
engine:inferenceFirstAbsentParam.description: Find the first absent native-active parameter slot with its actionable source name.

engine:inferenceFirstReadyProjection.label: Inference first ready projection
engine:inferenceFirstReadyProjection.description: Find the first pending field obligation whose receiver has become structural under the current substitution.

engine:inferenceFlattenArrow.label: Inference flatten arrow
engine:inferenceFlattenArrow.description: Normalize a curried arrow to the shipped flat calling-convention form, then re-derive positional keys, tokens, and wire names at their flattened ordinals.

engine:inferenceFlattenArrowChecked.label: Inference checked arrow flatten
engine:inferenceFlattenArrowChecked.description: Flatten one arrow through the shipped law and reject any merged container that violates semantic-key, wire-name, or positional-ordinal identity; lock-less SourceHandles remain valid named identities.

engine:inferenceFresh.label: Inference fresh meta
engine:inferenceFresh.description: Allocate one KType metavariable and return {type,state}; no process-global counter is used.

engine:inferenceFreshKind.label: Inference fresh meta of kind
engine:inferenceFreshKind.description: Allocate one metavariable of an explicit kind; higher-kinded scheme variables therefore never collapse to KType while instantiating.

engine:inferenceFreshLambdaParams.label: Inference fresh lambda params
engine:inferenceFreshLambdaParams.description: Allocate one monomorphic meta per lambda binder and prepend it to the lexical environment.

engine:inferenceFreshQuantified.label: Inference fresh quantified mapping
engine:inferenceFreshQuantified.description: Allocate one fresh meta per quantified variable, in scheme order.

engine:inferenceFromTraversal.label: Inference from traversal type
engine:inferenceFromTraversal.description: Convert the complete audited TraversalType vocabulary to InferenceType. TtUnknown/accessor/cycle and genuine TtEl values fail closed.

engine:inferenceGeneralizableMetas.label: Inference filter generalizable metas
engine:inferenceGeneralizableMetas.description: Remove environment- and residual-reachable metas before quantification.

engine:inferenceGeneralizationMapping.label: Inference generalization mapping
engine:inferenceGeneralizationMapping.description: The deterministic meta-to-rigid mapping inferenceGeneralize quantifies a solved, flattened type with: its free metas not free in the environment or an undischarged residual, alpha-normalized to a0, a1, … in structural order.

engine:inferenceGeneralize.label: Inference generalize
engine:inferenceGeneralize.description: Apply substitution and the shipped FieldKey-normalized arrow flattening law, then deterministically quantify free metas not free in the environment or an undischarged residual.

engine:inferenceGeneralizeChecked.label: Inference checked generalization
engine:inferenceGeneralizeChecked.description: Generalize only after every deferred record projection is solved, and refuse an invalid post-flatten arrow container.

engine:inferenceGeneralizeWith.label: Inference generalize with authored variables
engine:inferenceGeneralizeWith.description: Generalize a top-level assumption at its own parameter width while retaining the declaration-scoped authored rigid prefix in its original order. The source parameters stay the top-level arrow (positional ones re-derived at their ordinals, as the flattening law does); a returned function (a solved return arrow) is flattened and re-keyed positionally (_0, _1, …) as a nested arrow, the shape the loader gives an authored a -> (b -> b). Flattening it into the source parameters would change the published width and merge two parameter containers.

engine:inferenceGeneralizeWithChecked.label: Inference checked generalization with authored variables
engine:inferenceGeneralizeWithChecked.description: Retain authored variables only after every deferred record projection is solved, and refuse invalid post-flatten arrow publication.

engine:inferenceGeneralizedOpaqueReads.label: Inference generalized opaque reads
engine:inferenceGeneralizedOpaqueReads.description: modules-as-values Phase 5a (re-review 2026-10-02): the opaque reads a let generalization must carry. A remembered field read through an opaque type's pure view (inferenceRecordOpaqueRead) that mentions a metavariable inferenceGeneralize quantifies would otherwise lose its provenance: each use instantiates that variable afresh, and the original stays unsolved. Every such read is returned over the scheme's own rigids (the same mapping, inferenceGeneralizationMapping), for inferenceInstantiateBinding to re-record at each use. Reads that mention no generalized variable stay in the state as they are; the generalization itself is unchanged.

engine:inferenceGroundBuiltinNominalIden.label: Inference admitted ground builtin identity
engine:inferenceGroundBuiltinNominalIden.description: Admit only raw intrinsic compatibility spelling or the exact system owner for String, Number, and Boolean. The raw form exists for isolated authoring fixtures; custom owners, Int, and Bool remain distinct.

engine:inferenceGroundBuiltinNominalPair.label: Inference ground builtin nominal pair
engine:inferenceGroundBuiltinNominalPair.description: Recognize only the intrinsic and exact-system representations of String, Number, and Boolean; public spelling alone never equates a custom nominal owner.

engine:inferenceGroupContainsId.label: Inference group contains id
engine:inferenceGroupContainsId.description: Test canonical membership in an SCC group.

engine:inferenceGroupDependenciesReady.label: Inference SCC dependencies ready
engine:inferenceGroupDependenciesReady.description: An SCC is schedulable only after every outside inferred dependency has a generalized published scheme.

engine:inferenceGroupDependenciesReadyGo.label: Inference SCC dependencies ready loop
engine:inferenceGroupDependenciesReadyGo.description: Check each remaining member against the complete SCC. Keeping wholeGroup fixed is load-bearing for mutual recursion: shrinking the membership group with the iteration tail would misclassify a back-edge as an unpublished outside dependency.

engine:inferenceGroupDependenciesTrusted.label: Inference SCC dependencies are trusted
engine:inferenceGroupDependenciesTrusted.description: A solved SCC may be promoted only when every member's exact outside dependencies have usable certificates.

engine:inferenceGroupIsRecursive.label: Inference SCC is recursive
engine:inferenceGroupIsRecursive.description: A multi-member SCC or a singleton with a self edge is recursive.

engine:inferenceGroupTotal.label: Inference SCC totality proved
engine:inferenceGroupTotal.description: Run the shipped mutual size-change/structural totality checker over the exact current SCC after resolving its source call spellings to canonical member ids and lowering to core Expr. Fails closed when the projection did not account for the dependency walk: a recursive SCC whose projected totality graph is empty (instead of the checker's non-recursive vacuity rule), or any member-to-member dependency edge (candidate.callees) with no size-change graph beside it, so a recognised decreasing call can never hide an unchecked edge.

engine:inferenceGroupTrust.label: Inference SCC trust
engine:inferenceGroupTrust.description: Plan inference trust independently from useful scheme synthesis; effect-opaque HOF calls, untrusted dependencies, and unproved recursion remain advisory.

engine:inferenceHigherKindedBinders.label: Inference higher-kinded binders
engine:inferenceHigherKindedBinders.description: Does a declaration bind a type constructor (a binder of kind other than Type)? Substituting a constructor into an application head needs application-head normalization the unifier does not have, so such an unfold fences.

engine:inferenceHostAddBinder.label: Inference host compatibility binder
engine:inferenceHostAddBinder.description: Add one free host-spec TtVar as a deterministic KType SchemeVar. Lexically bound mu variables and prior structural occurrences do not create binders.

engine:inferenceHostCollectArrowFields.label: Inference host binder fields in calling order
engine:inferenceHostCollectArrowFields.description: Collect binders through arrow parameters in their already-flattened calling order.

engine:inferenceHostCollectCandidatePara.label: Inference host binder authored params
engine:inferenceHostCollectCandidatePara.description: Collect only Authored HostSpec parameter slots; source-sidecar and Absent placeholder TraversalTypes cannot manufacture compatibility binders.

engine:inferenceHostCollectCaseNames.label: Inference host binder variant cases
engine:inferenceHostCollectCaseNames.description: Collect variant payload binders in canonical constructor then semantic FieldKey order.

engine:inferenceHostCollectFieldTokens.label: Inference host binder canonical fields
engine:inferenceHostCollectFieldTokens.description: Collect binders through structural record/variant fields in canonical semantic FieldKey order.

engine:inferenceHostCollectStructuralFie.label: Inference host binder structural fields
engine:inferenceHostCollectStructuralFie.description: Canonicalize structural field order before assigning q0,q1,... compatibility identities.

engine:inferenceHostCollectTraversal.label: Inference host binder traversal
engine:inferenceHostCollectTraversal.description: Fenel-owned compatibility binder discovery over the audited TraversalType semantic spine. TtEl/TtApp require an explicit kinded sidecar rather than a host guess.

engine:inferenceHostCollectTypes.label: Inference host binder traversal list
engine:inferenceHostCollectTypes.description: Collect host compatibility binders through an ordered list of TraversalType children.

engine:inferenceHostTraversalCaseByName.label: Inference host traversal case lookup
engine:inferenceHostTraversalCaseByName.description: Lookup a raw traversal variant case by constructor name.

engine:inferenceHostTraversalFieldByToke.label: Inference host traversal field lookup
engine:inferenceHostTraversalFieldByToke.description: Lookup a raw traversal field by its canonical semantic FieldKey token.

engine:inferenceIf.label: Inference if
engine:inferenceIf.description: Require a Boolean condition and synthesize the normalized union of both branch outputs.

engine:inferenceInfer.label: Inference surface Syntax
engine:inferenceInfer.description: Generate and solve constraints directly over all fourteen surface Syntax cases; SLet/SWhere survive and therefore support real let/generalization semantics. SAnn infers its expression; the written type is never returned unchecked (the call-site rule checks it).

engine:inferenceInferList.label: Inference infer expression list
engine:inferenceInferList.description: Infer a Syntax list left-to-right, threading substitutions and fresh ids.

engine:inferenceInitialState.label: Inference initial state
engine:inferenceInitialState.description: Create deterministic solver state; fresh ids derive from the supplied declaration/SCC path.

engine:inferenceInitialStateWith.label: Inference initial state with declarations
engine:inferenceInitialStateWith.description: modules-as-values Phase 5a — solver state carrying the host's nominal declaration rows, the evidence a field projection needs to unfold a nominal record application (inferenceProjectNominal). Rows ride in the state so a deferred projection discharged later by unification sees them too. `opaqueProvenance` records the field types read through an opaque type's pure view and the nominal owners whose declarations were unfolded (inferenceOpaqueProvenanceSettled).

engine:inferenceInstantiate.label: Inference instantiate scheme
engine:inferenceInstantiate.description: Instantiate every quantified rigid at a use site with independent fresh metas.

engine:inferenceInstantiateBinding.label: Inference instantiate lexical binding
engine:inferenceInstantiateBinding.description: Instantiate a lexical binding's scheme (inferenceInstantiate) and re-record, at this use's fresh metas, every opaque read its generalization carried (inferenceGeneralizedOpaqueReads): a use of a let-generalized value whose type came from a field read through an opaque type's pure view is that read again, so the nominal owners its instance reaches are never unfolded (modules-as-values Phase 5a, re-review 2026-10-02).

engine:inferenceInstantiateDeclarationFi.label: Inference instantiate declaration field
engine:inferenceInstantiateDeclarationFi.description: Instantiate a declaration's binders once with fresh metas across its self type and one converted field type, then unify the self type with the receiver: nominal congruence substitutes the receiver's arguments. The receiver's shape is checked against the declaration first (inferenceDeclarationReceiverShape), and a unification failure here is a fence too: this step only instantiates the declaration, so a disagreement says the receiver's type and its declaration evidence disagree, never that the expression is ill-typed.

engine:inferenceInvalid.label: Inference invalid
engine:inferenceInvalid.description: Return an Invalid outcome containing one stable diagnostic.

engine:inferenceJoin.label: Inference branch join
engine:inferenceJoin.description: Build a canonical output-only branch union: recursively flatten, structurally key, deduplicate, and lexicographically order branches.

engine:inferenceKindAfterApplication.label: Inference kind after application
engine:inferenceKindAfterApplication.description: Consume one KArrow input per type argument, validating every argument kind and returning the residual/result kind.

engine:inferenceLambda.label: Inference lambda
engine:inferenceLambda.description: Infer a rank-1 lambda with fresh monomorphic binders.

engine:inferenceLetBindings.label: Inference let bindings
engine:inferenceLetBindings.description: Sequential SLet inference: infer then generalize each value before extending the environment; the binding carries the opaque reads its generalization quantified over (inferenceGeneralizedOpaqueReads). The generalization context is the lexical environment plus the current SCC's recursive-monomorphic callable rows: those rows are the recursive bindings of the textbook ftv(SΓ), so a nested let can never quantify a member's own monomorphic metas.

engine:inferenceLexicalSpellingBound.label: Inference lexical spelling is bound
engine:inferenceLexicalSpellingBound.description: A dotted runtime value is lexical when its root is bound; otherwise the complete spelling remains available to exact qualified module/function routing.

engine:inferenceLiteral.label: Inference literal
engine:inferenceLiteral.description: Infer ground scalar and homogeneous array literals; arbitrary host objects require structural Syntax.

engine:inferenceLiteralArrayItems.label: Inference literal array items
engine:inferenceLiteralArrayItems.description: Infer a homogeneous list literal, unifying every item with one fresh element meta.

engine:inferenceMapKeysEq.label: Inference map-key equality
engine:inferenceMapKeysEq.description: Decide exact equality of two ground map key domains by mutual subset.

engine:inferenceMarkEffectOpaque.label: Inference mark effect-opaque
engine:inferenceMarkEffectOpaque.description: Record that an indirect higher-order call occurred. The HM type remains useful, but no registered scheme containing this call may be promoted as a trusted pure arrow without effect-row evidence.

engine:inferenceMatch.label: Inference match
engine:inferenceMatch.description: Infer the scrutinee, pattern environments, guards, and output union of a surface match.

engine:inferenceMatchArmPatternReference.label: Inference match-arm pattern references
engine:inferenceMatchArmPatternReference.description: Collect constructor-namespace references from every arm pattern of one match expression.

engine:inferenceMatchArms.label: Inference match arms
engine:inferenceMatchArms.description: Infer every reachable arm under pattern bindings and join branch outputs as an output-only union.

engine:inferenceMatchGuard.label: Inference optional match guard
engine:inferenceMatchGuard.description: Infer an optional arm guard and require Boolean when present.

engine:inferenceMatchPatternReferences.label: Inference match pattern references
engine:inferenceMatchPatternReferences.description: Public authoring-boundary projection of the exact constructor spellings needed by every arm of a converted match; unsupported surface patterns require no host lookup.

engine:inferenceMemberCarriesDeclaredFie.label: Inference member carries declared fields
engine:inferenceMemberCarriesDeclaredFie.description: May a member be used as a whole value of its declared type (bound by a let, passed to a lambda or a function, returned)? Only when its value carries every field the declaration declares, except a definite erased obligation (a law or superclass field; one whose erasure is undecided is not excused), and every carried declared field whose value is not closed data (`openFields`) is declared arrow-like (inferenceDeclaredFieldArrowLike). A named instance often omits declared fields (no completeness check at load; class defaults are filled by dispatch only), and once the member flows on, every later projection reads the declaration, not the value: so a missing field, missing declaration evidence or a declaration that is not one single-constructor record fences here. A type member's value is a type and carries no fields. A direct projection `b.m.f` does not come here: its first field is read against the value (inferenceMemberFirstField).

engine:inferenceMemberFirstField.label: Inference member first field
engine:inferenceMemberFirstField.description: Project the first segment after `bundle.member`. The member row lists the fields its frozen value carries: a field the value does not carry (an erased law or superclass obligation, or no such field) fences. A carried field projects through the member's nominal type (inferenceMemberProjectCarried), which also fences retained data the declared type does not declare (an instance's `label` / `priority`). A carried field whose value is not closed data (unevaluated loader source or a reference, `openFields`) inhabits its declared type only when that type is a function type or `Maybe` of one (inferenceArrowLike): any other declared type fences.

engine:inferenceMemberProjectCarried.label: Inference member project carried field
engine:inferenceMemberProjectCarried.description: Project a field the member's frozen value is known to carry through the member's nominal type. The value is the registry's own record, never an opaque carrier, so this read neither consults nor extends the opaque provenance (inferenceProjectNominalEvidence); any other declared type projects as usual.

engine:inferenceMemberValue.label: Inference member value
engine:inferenceMemberValue.description: Type one `bundle.member` value row and project the remaining segments. The member's declared scheme is instantiated once; an ambiguous, fenced or unmarshalled row is terminal. A value's type has kind Type: a declared type whose kind is not Type (a constructor the instance under-applies, e.g. `Iso` or `Iso String`, whose arity the host carries as application-kind evidence) is no value type and fences.

engine:inferenceMethod.label: Inference method
engine:inferenceMethod.description: Infer `{method: [cls, method, ...args]}`. With no arguments, a spelling the host marshalled as a modules-as-values Phase 5a member value row (`$member:cls.method`, an uppercase bundle's named instance such as `DrawingDemo.pointLineChartViewable`) is that member's VALUE, as the runtime's methodOp zero-argument branch returns it; anything else, a genuine zero-argument class method such as `Monoid.mempty` included, stays an application of the complete spelling.

engine:inferenceMismatchNeedsHigherRank.label: Inference exact mismatch needs higher rank
engine:inferenceMismatchNeedsHigherRank.description: Classify only exact unification disagreements that can arise from incompatible callable instances; occurs-check and ordinary fence diagnostics retain their own verdicts.

engine:inferenceMonoScheme.label: Inference monomorphic scheme
engine:inferenceMonoScheme.description: Wrap an inference type as a scheme with no quantified variables.

engine:inferenceNamedConstructorPattern.label: Inference named constructor pattern
engine:inferenceNamedConstructorPattern.description: Instantiate a constructor scheme, unify its result, then align every named payload pattern by its resolved semantic FieldKey.

engine:inferenceNamedPatternFieldNames.label: Inference named pattern field names
engine:inferenceNamedPatternFieldNames.description: The wire names of the constructor payload fields a well-formed named constructor pattern mentions (each selected by its semantic FieldKey). A malformed pattern mentions none here; inferenceNamedPatternList reports it.

engine:inferenceNamedPatternList.label: Inference named pattern list
engine:inferenceNamedPatternList.description: Check the selected named constructor sub-patterns against payload parameters by semantic FieldKey, never source/wire order. Named record patterns may omit payload fields; every supplied field must still resolve exactly.

engine:inferenceNamedPatternListGo.label: Inference named pattern list go
engine:inferenceNamedPatternListGo.description: Walk an already key-validated named constructor pattern, resolving each supplied payload solely by semantic FieldKey. Omitted constructor fields bind nothing.

engine:inferenceNominalIdentities.label: Inference nominal identities
engine:inferenceNominalIdentities.description: Collect, once each, the owner identity of every nominal (a named type or an application head) anywhere in an inference type.

engine:inferenceNominalIdentitiesCases.label: Inference nominal identities in cases
engine:inferenceNominalIdentitiesCases.description: Collect the nominal owner identities mentioned by a variant's payloads.

engine:inferenceNominalIdentitiesFields.label: Inference nominal identities in fields
engine:inferenceNominalIdentitiesFields.description: Collect the nominal owner identities mentioned by a field list.

engine:inferenceNominalIdentitiesList.label: Inference nominal identities in type list
engine:inferenceNominalIdentitiesList.description: Collect the nominal owner identities mentioned by a list of inference types.

engine:inferenceNormalizeUnion.label: Inference normalize union
engine:inferenceNormalizeUnion.description: Canonical union normalization used for every branch join; singleton unions collapse to their branch.

engine:inferenceOccurs.label: Inference occurs check
engine:inferenceOccurs.description: True when an unsolved meta occurs structurally in a candidate replacement.

engine:inferenceOccursList.label: Inference occurs in type list
engine:inferenceOccursList.description: Occurs-check helper over a list of InferenceType values.

engine:inferenceOpaqueProvenanceSettled.label: Inference opaque provenance settled
engine:inferenceOpaqueProvenanceSettled.description: After the whole expression is solved: no nominal owner whose declaration typed a field was also reached through an opaque type's pure view. inferenceProjectNominal refuses such an unfold when the opaque read came first; this closes the other order (the projection was typed before the equation that made its receiver an opaque read was solved). A violation is a fence, never Invalid.

engine:inferenceOpaqueReachedIdentities.label: Inference opaque-reached identities
engine:inferenceOpaqueReachedIdentities.description: The nominal owners reached through an opaque type's pure view so far: those mentioned by every remembered opaque read under the current substitution.

engine:inferenceOutcomeFromError.label: Inference outcome from error
engine:inferenceOutcomeFromError.description: Turn an internal diagnostic into Invalid or AnnotationRequired without guessing a type.

engine:inferenceParamsFromTypes.label: Inference params from types
engine:inferenceParamsFromTypes.description: Build stable positional arrow params from a type list.

engine:inferencePattern.label: Inference pattern
engine:inferencePattern.description: Infer/check the four Pattern cases and return the arm-local environment.

engine:inferencePatternBoundNames.label: Inference pattern bound names
engine:inferencePatternBoundNames.description: Collect every lexical binder introduced by a Pattern.

engine:inferencePatternFieldKeysUnique.label: Inference pattern field keys unique
engine:inferencePatternFieldKeysUnique.description: Validate the identity-bearing slots attached to a named constructor pattern before any payload binding is published.

engine:inferencePatternList.label: Inference pattern list
engine:inferencePatternList.description: Check constructor sub-patterns against payload parameter types, extending the arm environment.

engine:inferencePatternListReferences.label: Inference pattern-list constructor references
engine:inferencePatternListReferences.description: Collect constructor-namespace references from nested Pattern payloads.

engine:inferencePatternObligationFence.label: Inference pattern obligation fence
engine:inferencePatternObligationFence.description: modules-as-values Phase 5a — a constructor pattern types its fields from the constructor's parameters, laws and superclass fields included, but a value of the type need not carry an erased obligation (a named instance's value never does), and the match reads every field the pattern mentions. So a pattern mentioning a field that the scrutinee owner's declaration row lists as an obligation (the check inferenceDeclarationFieldType applies to projection) fences, named or positional. Without a declaration row in the state, nothing changes.

engine:inferencePatternReferenceRows.label: Inference pattern reference rows
engine:inferencePatternReferenceRows.description: Project constructor-namespace references to separate callable and resolver spellings for the descriptor-only authoring bridge.

engine:inferencePatternReferences.label: Inference pattern constructor references
engine:inferencePatternReferences.description: Collect constructor-namespace references from one Pattern while recursively visiting its payload patterns.

engine:inferencePatternScrutinee.label: Inference pattern scrutinee
engine:inferencePatternScrutinee.description: Instantiate an authored scrutinee scheme, or allocate a fresh meta when the editor has not inferred the scrutinee yet.

engine:inferencePickReadyGroup.label: Inference pick ready SCC
engine:inferencePickReadyGroup.description: Pick the first dependency-ready SCC and return it with the remaining groups; sorted input makes the choice canonical.

engine:inferencePlanAuthoredCandidate.label: Plan one authored top-level signature
engine:inferencePlanAuthoredCandidate.description: Validate and prepare one complete authored candidate as a Result so the public batch planner can traverse linearly without immutable-list snoc.

engine:inferencePositionalParam.label: Inference positional parameter
engine:inferencePositionalParam.description: Build one internal arrow parameter with stable positional identity.

engine:inferencePreallocateCandidate.label: Inference preallocate candidate
engine:inferencePreallocateCandidate.description: Build one monomorphic top-level arrow assumption from authored slots plus fresh independent absent metas.

engine:inferencePreallocateGroup.label: Inference preallocate SCC
engine:inferencePreallocateGroup.description: Preallocate every member of an SCC before checking any body, preserving monomorphic recursion.

engine:inferencePrepareCallables.label: Inference prepare callables
engine:inferencePrepareCallables.description: Convert exact-resolution callable rows to internal schemes, retaining status/target/trust facts. A modules-as-values Phase 5a member value row whose declared type does not prepare becomes a terminal fenced row for its own spelling (inferenceUnpreparedMemberRow) instead of failing the batch.

engine:inferencePrepareEnvironment.label: Inference prepare environment
engine:inferencePrepareEnvironment.description: Convert boundary environment rows `{name,scheme:{quantified,bodyTraversal}}` to internal schemes.

engine:inferencePrepareScheme.label: Inference prepare scheme
engine:inferencePrepareScheme.description: Convert a boundary scheme carrying bodyTraversal into the internal TypeScheme representation.

engine:inferencePreparedCallableRow.label: Inference prepared callable row
engine:inferencePreparedCallableRow.description: The prepared form of one resolved row. A modules-as-values Phase 5a member value row (`$member:bundle.member`) also keeps the field names its frozen value carries (`valueFields`) and, among them, those whose value is not closed data (`openFields`: unevaluated loader source or a reference, a host fact).

engine:inferencePrependBinding.label: Inference prepend binding
engine:inferencePrependBinding.description: Prepend one lexical scheme binding (newest-first shadowing).

engine:inferencePrependGeneralizedBindin.label: Inference prepend generalized binding
engine:inferencePrependGeneralizedBindin.description: Prepend one let/where binding: its generalized scheme and the opaque reads that generalization carried (inferenceGeneralizedOpaqueReads), re-recorded at each use (inferenceInstantiateBinding). A local let/where value was checked in this solve, so a dynamic call through it is not effect-opaque.

engine:inferencePrependItem.label: Inference prepend item
engine:inferencePrependItem.description: Construct a list in source/structural order; appendItem is snoc, so recursive builders use an explicit singleton prefix.

engine:inferenceProjectApplication.label: Inference project application field
engine:inferenceProjectApplication.description: A nominal application receiver projects through its head's declaration; an application whose head is a type variable has no declaration and fences.

engine:inferenceProjectNominal.label: Inference project nominal field
engine:inferenceProjectNominal.description: Project one field of a nominal (application) receiver through the one declaration row for its exact owner identity. A nominal owner reached through an opaque type's pure view in this expression (inferenceOpaqueReachedIdentities) is never unfolded; an unfold is remembered so a later opaque read still fences (inferenceOpaqueProvenanceSettled).

engine:inferenceProjectNominalEvidence.label: Inference project nominal field by evidence
engine:inferenceProjectNominalEvidence.description: Project one field of a nominal (application) receiver through the one declaration row for its exact owner identity. Missing or duplicated evidence, source-binding diagnostics and higher-kinded binders fence before any field is read.

engine:inferenceProjectOne.label: Inference project one field
engine:inferenceProjectOne.description: Project one dotted-path segment from an exact structural record, transparently peeling refinement/tag wrappers and an opaque wrapper whose pure view is a structural record (inferenceProjectOpaqueView), or from a nominal (application) whose single-constructor record declaration the state carries (inferenceProjectNominal); unresolved metas become deferred obligations.

engine:inferenceProjectOpaqueView.label: Inference project opaque view
engine:inferenceProjectOpaqueView.description: Project one field through an opaque type's pure view. Only an exact structural record there (seen through refinements, tags and nested opaque views) is read, and the field type read is remembered (inferenceRecordOpaqueRead), so no nominal it mentions is unfolded later. A nominal (application) reached here is never unfolded: the opaque value is its host carrier, which holds only its own data, and nothing evidences that the declaration's fields are accessible on it. An unsolved view is not deferred either (its later solution would be projected without the opaque context). Both fence.

engine:inferenceProjectPath.label: Inference project dotted path
engine:inferenceProjectPath.description: Walk every runtime dotted-path segment left-to-right, threading deferred obligations and substitutions.

engine:inferencePrune.label: Inference prune
engine:inferencePrune.description: Follow metavariable substitutions to the current representative.

engine:inferencePublishGroupAssumptions.label: Inference publish SCC assumptions
engine:inferencePublishGroupAssumptions.description: Generalize and validate every solved member together; any invalid post-flatten arrow aborts the batch before publication. The canonical SCC id and size are threaded unchanged across the batch.

engine:inferencePublishPatternBindings.label: Inference publish pattern bindings
engine:inferencePublishPatternBindings.description: Publish each solved arm-local binding as a monomorphic scheme. Pattern binders are values, not let-bound definitions; any still-unsolved meta fences instead of becoming an unsound forall.

engine:inferencePublishedLookup.label: Inference published lookup
engine:inferencePublishedLookup.description: Find an atomically published top-level scheme by canonical function id.

engine:inferencePublishedSlot.label: Inference published slot
engine:inferencePublishedSlot.description: Turn one loader slot fact into its authoritative publication plan. Authored payloads are retained by the host boundary; absent obligations receive Fenel-owned inference provenance.

engine:inferenceQuantifiedById.label: Inference quantified variable lookup by identity
engine:inferenceQuantifiedById.description: Find a declaration-scoped SchemeVar by its authoritative binder id. Source spelling is diagnostic only.

engine:inferenceQuantifiedByName.label: Inference quantified variable lookup
engine:inferenceQuantifiedByName.description: Find a declaration-scoped SchemeVar by source spelling.

engine:inferenceQuantifiedRows.label: Inference quantified rows
engine:inferenceQuantifiedRows.description: Build SchemeVar values corresponding to an alpha mapping.

engine:inferenceRawCasesFromTraversal.label: Inference raw variant cases from traversal
engine:inferenceRawCasesFromTraversal.description: Convert a list of TraversalType variant cases before constructor-name validation/canonicalization.

engine:inferenceRawFieldsFromTraversal.label: Inference raw fields from traversal
engine:inferenceRawFieldsFromTraversal.description: Convert a list of TraversalType fields in calling/source order; public wrappers validate semantic-key uniqueness and optionally canonicalize structural products.

engine:inferenceRecordFieldByWire.label: Inference record field by wire spelling
engine:inferenceRecordFieldByWire.description: Resolve one runtime dotted-path segment against the record's wire projection. Semantic FieldKey remains the unifier identity; duplicate wire projections are rejected as ambiguous.

engine:inferenceRecordFields.label: Inference record fields
engine:inferenceRecordFields.description: Infer structural record fields, retaining supplied semantic tokens or stable local tokens when the Syntax has no registered owner.

engine:inferenceRecordNominalUnfold.label: Inference record nominal unfold
engine:inferenceRecordNominalUnfold.description: Remember that a field was typed through the declaration of a nominal owner, so a later opaque read reaching that owner still fences (inferenceOpaqueProvenanceSettled).

engine:inferenceRecordOpaqueRead.label: Inference record opaque read
engine:inferenceRecordOpaqueRead.description: Remember a field type read through an opaque type's pure view. Every nominal owner it mentions, now or once its metavariables are solved, was reached through the opaque value's host carrier.

engine:inferenceRecordOpaqueReads.label: Inference record opaque reads
engine:inferenceRecordOpaqueReads.description: Remember several field types read through an opaque type's pure view (inferenceRecordOpaqueRead): a use of a let-generalized binding re-records the reads its generalization carried, at this use's fresh metas (inferenceInstantiateBinding).

engine:inferenceRecursiveMonomorphicCall.label: Inference recursive monomorphic call
engine:inferenceRecursiveMonomorphicCall.description: Identify an exact current-SCC call after lexical shadowing, so only occurs-shapes created by recursive monomorphic reuse become the polymorphic-recursion fence.

engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnClosurePa.label: Inference recursive return closure pass
engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnClosurePa.description: Propagate the current concrete output branches across direct SCC-return dependencies, then canonicalize to prevent duplicate-growth.

engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnClosurePl.label: Inference recursive return closure plan
engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnClosurePl.description: Expand one plan from the previous closure snapshot; same-pass writes never leak into peers.

engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnEquationB.label: Inference recursive return equation by meta
engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnEquationB.description: Resolve one original SCC return meta to its deferred output equation.

engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnMetaIds.label: Inference recursive return meta ids
engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnMetaIds.description: Collect the original preallocated return metas which identify direct output dependencies inside the current SCC.

engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnPlanByMet.label: Inference recursive return plan by meta
engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnPlanByMet.description: Lookup one deferred output plan by its original SCC return meta.

engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnPlans.label: Inference recursive return plans
engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnPlans.description: Build one finite output-equation plan per deferred SCC return. A return already constrained elsewhere contributes an anchor branch, so that fact propagates through the same closure.

engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnResidualD.label: Inference recursive return residual dependencies
engine:inferenceRecursiveReturnResidualD.description: Retain an unconstrained representative only for dependency components with no concrete output anchor; dropping it would guess a narrower return.

engine:inferenceRegisteredCapabilityMeth.label: Inference registered capability method callables
engine:inferenceRegisteredCapabilityMeth.description: Derive exact kinded callable schemes for selected dispatch-interface methods entirely in Fenel.

engine:inferenceRegisteredConstructorCal.label: Inference registered constructor callables
engine:inferenceRegisteredConstructorCal.description: Derive constructor schemes for registry entity rows entirely in Fenel; the host supplies only audited type traversal, binders, owner, and stable target prefix.

engine:inferenceReindexArrowParam.label: Inference reindex arrow param
engine:inferenceReindexArrowParam.description: Re-derive one internal positional parameter's flattened key, token, and wire name; named FieldKeys are representation-stable.

engine:inferenceReindexArrowParams.label: Inference reindex arrow params
engine:inferenceReindexArrowParams.description: Apply the shipped arrow container law to an internal inference parameter list.

engine:inferenceRemoveProjection.label: Inference remove projection
engine:inferenceRemoveProjection.description: Remove one pending projection by its unique result-meta identity.

engine:inferenceReplace.label: Inference replace variables
engine:inferenceReplace.description: Replace rigid variables or metas according to an explicit mapping, recursively.

engine:inferenceReplaceCases.label: Inference replace cases
engine:inferenceReplaceCases.description: Apply a rigid/meta replacement mapping through variant cases.

engine:inferenceReplaceFields.label: Inference replace fields
engine:inferenceReplaceFields.description: Apply a rigid/meta replacement mapping through fields.

engine:inferenceReplaceList.label: Inference replace type list
engine:inferenceReplaceList.description: Apply a rigid/meta replacement mapping through a type list.

engine:inferenceReplacementLookup.label: Inference rigid replacement lookup
engine:inferenceReplacementLookup.description: Find an instantiation/generalization replacement by rigid/meta id.

engine:inferenceResidualMetas.label: Inference collect residual metas
engine:inferenceResidualMetas.description: Collect metas reachable from undischarged refinement residuals; these are never generalized.

engine:inferenceResolutionLookup.label: Inference resolution lookup
engine:inferenceResolutionLookup.description: Resolve one source spelling through the registry-authored exact routing rows.

engine:inferenceResolveExactCallable.label: Inference resolve exact callable
engine:inferenceResolveExactCallable.description: Resolve a complete source spelling through registry routing after lexical exact/root lookup has missed. Qualified module/function spellings are never split here.

engine:inferenceResolveQualifiedMember.label: Inference resolve qualified member
engine:inferenceResolveQualifiedMember.description: modules-as-values Phase 5a (A6): after lexical exact/root lookup missed, read `bundle.member` (exactly the first two segments) against the host's member value row; later segments are projections. A function member or a miss has no member row and keeps the exact callable route; a member row, once found, is terminal (no shorter prefix, no callable fallback).

engine:inferenceResolveRecursiveReturnEq.label: Inference resolve recursive return equations
engine:inferenceResolveRecursiveReturnEq.description: Compute a bounded fixed point over one SCC's deferred output-union equations. Fuel is exactly the equation count: enough for every simple dependency path, with no repository-size ceiling or widening.

engine:inferenceResolveValue.label: Inference resolve value scheme
engine:inferenceResolveValue.description: Resolve an exact lexical value, then a bound-root dotted field projection, then (modules-as-values Phase 5a) a host member value row for an unbound `bundle.member` prefix, then an exact registry callable row. Unbound qualified names without a member row retain their complete spelling.

engine:inferenceSccAdvanceReachRow.label: Inference SCC advance reach row
engine:inferenceSccAdvanceReachRow.description: Advance one source by one graph layer, expanding only its fresh frontier through the immutable direct-adjacency index.

engine:inferenceSccCloseReachRows.label: Inference SCC close reach rows
engine:inferenceSccCloseReachRows.description: Compute exact transitive reachability with a node-count-bounded native fold; every source expands each reachable node at most once.

engine:inferenceSccDirectRows.label: Inference SCC direct rows
engine:inferenceSccDirectRows.description: Project each candidate's already-resolved callees to the internal candidate graph; external sinks cannot participate in mutual reachability.

engine:inferenceSccFrontierActive.label: Inference SCC frontier active
engine:inferenceSccFrontierActive.description: Whether any source still has a fresh reachability layer to expand.

engine:inferenceSccIndexContains.label: Inference SCC index contains
engine:inferenceSccIndexContains.description: Read one canonical graph id from an opaque null-prototype index.

engine:inferenceSccIndexedGroups.label: Inference SCC indexed groups
engine:inferenceSccIndexedGroups.description: Emit SCCs by first unassigned candidate and retain member order, byte-identical to the prior mutual-reachability grouping law.

engine:inferenceSccNameIndex.label: Inference SCC name index
engine:inferenceSccNameIndex.description: Build a hostile-key-safe constant-time membership index for canonical graph node ids.

engine:inferenceSccOpenReachRow.label: Inference SCC open reach row
engine:inferenceSccOpenReachRow.description: Seed one source's exact reachability frontier from its direct internal callees.

engine:inferenceSccSameIndexed.label: Inference SCC indexed mutual reachability
engine:inferenceSccSameIndexed.description: Two candidate ids share an SCC exactly when identical or mutually present in the closed per-source reachability indexes.

engine:inferenceSignatureTrustUsable.label: Inference signature trust is usable
engine:inferenceSignatureTrustUsable.description: Only a proved inference derivation or an explicitly trusted primitive may support downstream registered-arrow trust; Advisory never does.

engine:inferenceSolveGroupAssumptions.label: Inference solve SCC assumptions
engine:inferenceSolveGroupAssumptions.description: Infer every body against the SCC's shared monomorphic assumptions and its own exact module/import routing rows, threading one substitution; no member publishes early.

engine:inferenceSolveGroupAssumptionsGo.label: Inference solve SCC assumptions loop
engine:inferenceSolveGroupAssumptionsGo.description: Infer each remaining body against the complete SCC's shared monomorphic assumptions. Direct recursive-return branches of output unions are deferred as finite equations; every other constraint is unified immediately.

engine:inferenceSolveRecursiveReturnPlan.label: Inference solve recursive return plans
engine:inferenceSolveRecursiveReturnPlan.description: Bind each SCC return to its finite normalized concrete closure plus any genuinely unconstrained dependency representative.

engine:inferenceSolveTopLevelGroup.label: Inference solve one SCC
engine:inferenceSolveTopLevelGroup.description: Preallocate, solve monomorphically, reject undischarged residuals/metas and effect-row-polymorphic dynamic calls, then atomically generalize the group.

engine:inferenceSolveTopLevelGroups.label: Inference solve SCC worklist
engine:inferenceSolveTopLevelGroups.description: Dependency-order SCC worklist; each successful group becomes visible only as a complete generalized batch.

engine:inferenceSourceDiagnosticAppliesT.label: Inference source diagnostic applies to constructor
engine:inferenceSourceDiagnosticAppliesT.description: Conservatively associate a source-scheme diagnostic with one constructor index. Exact constructors/<index> paths affect only that constructor; malformed or owner-wide paths affect every selected constructor.

engine:inferenceStateWithOpaqueProvenanc.label: Inference state with opaque provenance
engine:inferenceStateWithOpaqueProvenanc.description: Replace only the opaque-provenance record (field types read through an opaque pure view; nominal owners unfolded) in an immutable solver state.

engine:inferenceStateWithProjections.label: Inference state with projections
engine:inferenceStateWithProjections.description: Replace only the pending record-projection obligations in an immutable solver state.

engine:inferenceSubstLookup.label: Inference substitution lookup
engine:inferenceSubstLookup.description: Look up a metavariable in the immutable substitution list.

engine:inferenceSurfaceReferences.label: Inference surface references
engine:inferenceSurfaceReferences.description: Public descriptor-boundary helper returning the lexical-scope-aware external spellings needed from an authoring resolver.

engine:inferenceSyntaxFieldBySortKey.label: Inference Syntax field by sort key
engine:inferenceSyntaxFieldBySortKey.description: Lookup one unique Syntax record field by its canonical sort key.

engine:inferenceSyntaxFieldKeysUnique.label: Inference Syntax field keys unique
engine:inferenceSyntaxFieldKeysUnique.description: Reject duplicate anonymous spellings or duplicate semantic identities rather than silently collapsing them during canonical ordering.

engine:inferenceSyntaxFieldSortKey.label: Inference Syntax field sort key
engine:inferenceSyntaxFieldSortKey.description: Canonicalize registered fields by semantic FieldKey and anonymous surface-record fields by their unique wire spelling before assigning local positional identities.

engine:inferenceSyntaxFieldsFromSortKeys.label: Inference Syntax fields from sort keys
engine:inferenceSyntaxFieldsFromSortKeys.description: Rebuild the Syntax field list in canonical key order.

engine:inferenceSystemGroundBuiltin.label: Inference system ground builtin
engine:inferenceSystemGroundBuiltin.description: Build an exact system-owned scalar nominal for literal and Boolean-obligation synthesis. Callers supply only String, Number, or Boolean.

engine:inferenceSystemNominalIdentity.label: Inference system nominal identity
engine:inferenceSystemNominalIdentity.description: Construct the stable semantic owner identity for a system-owned nominal. Scalar literal/guard synthesis uses this helper for String, Number, and Boolean instead of publishing an unowned public spelling.

engine:inferenceTake.label: Inference take types
engine:inferenceTake.description: Take n entries from a list.

engine:inferenceTopLevelExactRows.label: Inference top-level exact rows
engine:inferenceTopLevelExactRows.description: Flatten candidate-local exact routing projections for one atomic fence join.

engine:inferenceTopLevelMatchScrutinee.label: Inference top-level match scrutinee
engine:inferenceTopLevelMatchScrutinee.description: Expose only a top-level match scrutinee Syntax node so the descriptor boundary can ask the Fenel solver for its exact nominal owner before resolving colliding arm constructors.

engine:inferenceTopLevelSccPartition.label: Inference top-level SCC partition
engine:inferenceTopLevelSccPartition.description: Partition the exact cached surface-call graph through indexed frontier reachability and the same candidate-order mutual-reachability grouping law.

engine:inferenceTotalityCallHead.label: Inference totality call head
engine:inferenceTotalityCallHead.description: Resolve one source ECall head or EVar spelling through the candidate's exact routing rows, stripping a var-head call's `$dyn:` marker exactly as the surface dependency walk does (inferenceCollectResolvedReference). A spelling resolved to a current-SCC member becomes the member's canonical id (a graph call, or a value escape for checkMutualTotality); one resolved to a trusted std primitive (totIsTrustedPrimitive: std:gt, std:sub, …) becomes that canonical id, the only form the size-change oracle reads facts off (2026-10-03: a user function named `gt` or `sub` must yield none); one resolved elsewhere keeps its source spelling minus `$dyn:` (an outside callee). An unresolved or ambiguous spelling stays unchanged, so the checker's unresolved-dynamic-call rule still sees it.

engine:inferenceTotalityGroup.label: Inference totality group
engine:inferenceTotalityGroup.description: Project inference candidates to the existing checkMutualTotality member shape.
