Each body's source spellings are first rewritten through that candidate's exact registry resolution rows, so the core totality checker sees the same canonical ids as the SCC planner.

engine:inferenceTotalityGroupGo.label: Inference totality group fold
engine:inferenceTotalityGroupGo.description: Internal member projection with a shared canonical SCC-id set.

engine:inferenceTotalityGroupIds.label: Inference totality group ids
engine:inferenceTotalityGroupIds.description: Collect the canonical member ids of one current inference SCC.

engine:inferenceTotalityResolveArms.label: Inference totality resolve match arms
engine:inferenceTotalityResolveArms.description: Resolve exact SCC call heads in match guards and bodies while retaining the optional guard shape.

engine:inferenceTotalityResolveExpr.label: Inference totality resolve core calls
engine:inferenceTotalityResolveExpr.description: Canonicalize exact call heads and value references into the current SCC before the totality walk (inferenceTotalityCallHead, `$dyn:` stripped as the dependency walk strips it). A member reached as a value (EVar) is canonicalized too, so checkMutualTotality refuses it as an escape instead of ignoring it. Unmatched and ambiguous spellings and constructor heads remain unchanged.

engine:inferenceTotalityResolveFields.label: Inference totality resolve Expr fields
engine:inferenceTotalityResolveFields.description: Resolve exact SCC call heads in record field values.

engine:inferenceTotalityResolveList.label: Inference totality resolve Expr list
engine:inferenceTotalityResolveList.description: Resolve exact SCC call heads recursively in a core Expr list.

engine:inferenceTypeContainsUnion.label: Inference type contains union
engine:inferenceTypeContainsUnion.description: Recursively recognize output-only unions before a value reaches any consumer or elimination boundary. Callers apply the current substitution first.

engine:inferenceTypeKind.label: Inference type kind
engine:inferenceTypeKind.description: Read the kind carried by a solver leaf/application; every ground FenelType constructor has KType.

engine:inferenceTypeListContainsUnion.label: Inference type list contains union
engine:inferenceTypeListContainsUnion.description: Detect an output-only union anywhere below a type-list consumer boundary.

engine:inferenceTypesFromTraversal.label: Inference types from traversal
engine:inferenceTypesFromTraversal.description: Convert a list of TraversalType children.

engine:inferenceUnify.label: Inference unify
engine:inferenceUnify.description: Syntactic rank-1 unification with substitution composition, occurs check, nominal constructor congruence, flattened arrows, and FieldKey-exact products.

engine:inferenceUnifyCallArgs.label: Inference unify call arguments
engine:inferenceUnifyCallArgs.description: Unify call arguments with the matching positional parameter prefix, recursively fencing union consumers and preserving lexical provenance for higher-rank diagnostics.

engine:inferenceUnifyCanonicalContainerA.label: Inference unify canonical container arguments
engine:inferenceUnifyCanonicalContainerA.description: Unify arguments extracted by an already-established exact standard container pair without changing either published representation.

engine:inferenceUnifyCases.label: Inference unify cases
engine:inferenceUnifyCases.description: Width-exact variant unification by constructor identity, then semantic FieldKey.

engine:inferenceUnifyCasesGo.label: Inference unify cases walk
engine:inferenceUnifyCasesGo.description: Walk the left constructor set after one width check; right remains the complete constructor index.

engine:inferenceUnifyFields.label: Inference unify fields
engine:inferenceUnifyFields.description: Width-exact field unification by semantic FieldKey token, independent of declaration/insertion order.

engine:inferenceUnifyFieldsGo.label: Inference unify fields walk
engine:inferenceUnifyFieldsGo.description: Walk the left field set after the wrapper has checked width once; right remains the complete semantic-key index.

engine:inferenceUnifyLists.label: Inference unify type lists
engine:inferenceUnifyLists.description: Unify two equal-width ordered type lists, threading substitution state.

engine:inferenceUnifyNormalized.label: Inference unify normalized
engine:inferenceUnifyNormalized.description: Unify two already checked arrow-normal-form roots. Recursive equations re-enter inferenceUnify and therefore repeat checked normalization at every nested arrow.

engine:inferenceUnifyRefined.label: Inference unify refined types
engine:inferenceUnifyRefined.description: Unify refinement bases and retain the directional inferred-to-declared subset obligation for post-solve discharge.

engine:inferenceUnionBranchesFromKeys.label: Inference union branches from keys
engine:inferenceUnionBranchesFromKeys.description: Rebuild canonical branches from their sorted structural keys.

engine:inferenceUnionFlatten.label: Inference flatten union branches
engine:inferenceUnionFlatten.description: Flatten nested ItUnion values into one branch list before canonicalization.

engine:inferenceUnionRowByKey.label: Inference union row by key
engine:inferenceUnionRowByKey.description: Recover the unique branch paired with a canonical structural key.

engine:inferenceUniqueUnionRows.label: Inference unique union rows
engine:inferenceUniqueUnionRows.description: Deduplicate structurally identical internal types by a stable JSON key emitted from Fenel-owned solver values.

engine:inferenceUnownedNominal.label: Inference unowned nominal
engine:inferenceUnownedNominal.description: First nominal in a projected declaration field that carries no owner identity (its name is its bare spelling), other than String, Number and Boolean, which the unifier already equates with their system owners. A declaration row carries no nominal resolution, so any other bare spelling has no owner proof and the projection fences rather than publish an unowned name.

engine:inferenceUnownedNominalCases.label: Inference unowned nominal in cases
engine:inferenceUnownedNominalCases.description: First unowned nominal spelling below a variant's payloads.

engine:inferenceUnownedNominalFields.label: Inference unowned nominal in fields
engine:inferenceUnownedNominalFields.description: First unowned nominal spelling below a field list.

engine:inferenceUnownedNominalList.label: Inference unowned nominal in type list
engine:inferenceUnownedNominalList.description: First unowned nominal spelling in a list of inference types.

engine:inferenceUnpreparedMemberRow.label: Inference unprepared member row
engine:inferenceUnpreparedMemberRow.description: modules-as-values Phase 5a — a member's declared type that rank-1 inference cannot represent (e.g. `Monoid List`: Fenel keys instances on a bare constructor at a Type-kinded binder, so the argument's kind differs from the binder's) says nothing about the expression mentioning it. The member fences (`inference.host-scheme-sidecar`), only where it is read, with the preparation diagnostic quoted; it never becomes a definite Invalid and never fails the other rows.

engine:inferenceValidateArrowCases.label: Inference validate arrow cases
engine:inferenceValidateArrowCases.description: Reject an invalid flattened arrow container in any variant payload type.

engine:inferenceValidateArrowFields.label: Inference validate arrow fields
engine:inferenceValidateArrowFields.description: Reject an invalid flattened arrow container in any semantic field type.

engine:inferenceValidateArrowList.label: Inference validate arrow list
engine:inferenceValidateArrowList.description: Reject an invalid flattened arrow container anywhere in an ordered child-type list.

engine:inferenceValidateSchemeArrows.label: Inference validate scheme arrows
engine:inferenceValidateSchemeArrows.description: Return a scheme only when every arrow occurrence has an identity-total flattened parameter container.

engine:inferenceValidateTopLevelCandidat.label: Inference validate top-level candidates
engine:inferenceValidateTopLevelCandidat.description: Reject every missing-slot candidate whose active implementation cannot lawfully be inferred, before SCC planning publishes anything.

engine:inferenceValidateTypeArrows.label: Inference validate type arrows
engine:inferenceValidateTypeArrows.description: Walk a complete inference type and apply checked flattening to every arrow occurrence before a scheme may enter an environment or cross a publication boundary.

engine:inferenceVariantConstructorCallab.label: Inference variant constructor callables
engine:inferenceVariantConstructorCallab.description: Build trusted callable schemes only for exact registry-selected cases of one registered variant entity.

engine:inferenceVerifyRecursiveReturnEqu.label: Inference verify recursive return equations
engine:inferenceVerifyRecursiveReturnEqu.description: Re-check every deferred equation after closure with current substitutions and canonical top-level union normalization.

engine:inferenceWhere.label: Inference where bindings
engine:inferenceWhere.description: Infer SWhere bindings with the same sequential scoped-let semantics as desugaring: each value sees earlier bindings only and is generalized before the next binding.

engine:inhabit.label: Inhabit
engine:inhabit.description: The constructive dual of comprehend: extract a witness inhabitant from a canonical `Se*` SetExpr ⇒ Maybe a. The THIN dispatcher over the DecidableMembership family (decide-substrate Phase 3) — routes by the shape `$tag` (seTag) to each theory's OWN per-shape witness face: SeEnum ⇒ seWitnessEnum (first value); SeInterval ⇒ seWitnessInterval (an INCLUSIVE bound — hi preferred, then lo; both-exclusive / unbounded-open ⇒ Nothing, the ℝ honesty fence); SeIntersect ⇒ seWitnessIntersect (fold the interval branches, witness the combined interval; a non-interval branch ⇒ Nothing, v1); SeUnion ⇒ seWitnessUnion (the first child's Just); everything else ⇒ seWitnessFallback, which routes SeRef to seWitnessRef (signature-substrate slice 3jw — the ten definitionally-inhabited names witness to their canonical inhabitant, membership-re-checked) and delegates the rest to seWitnessNone (Nothing — the remaining documented no-witness fences: SeAll has no canonical pick, SeNone is empty, SeComplement / SePattern / SeWhere are out-of-fragment v1, SeRigid is the validation-only rigid atom). `solve = inhabit ∘ comprehend` LITERALLY; the DecidableMembership `witness` method dispatches to the SAME per-shape faces. Replaces witnessOfSet (Ws markers) + the Inh* type-marker inhabit. decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage B; per-shape faces Phase 3.

engine:inhabitSet.label: Inhabit set
engine:inhabitSet.description: solver-extension Phase 6 — the `FenelType → Maybe {base, set}` marshal-result unwrapper for refined-type inhabitant enumeration. Consumes the dispatch-marshalled type marker (a plain record; the `$`-key read happens in the dispatch wrapper): `{ tag = InhRefined, base, set }` (a `$refined {base, set}` type) ⇒ Just { base, set } (the base type NAME + the set as the canonical `Se*` SetExpr — Stage B). anything else ⇒ Nothing. The exact-inhabitant law: ⟦$refined base S⟧ = ⟦base⟧ ∩ S, so the inhabitants = enumerableSet base S (enumerableInhabit). solver-extension Phase 6.

engine:intListToNumberArray.label: enumerable: intListToNumberArray
engine:intListToNumberArray.description: solver-extension Phase 1 — fold a pure cons-spine `List Int` (the Enumerable Int stepper's output) into the native array of Numbers the SetExpr readers expect: Nil ⇒ []; Cons h t ⇒ concat [intToNumber h] (recurse). Mirrors listToArray exactly (the array-repr witness convention, the appendItem note). Internal helper.

engine:intersectAnyDisjoint.label: empty: intersectAnyDisjoint
engine:intersectAnyDisjoint.description: Phase 2 Step 1b — the pairwise-disjoint arm of emptyIntersect: Just true if SOME pair of branches is provably disjoint (via ttDisjoint → decideDisjoint over refined leaves), else Nothing. Two disjoint branches ⇒ the intersection is empty. Internal helper.

engine:intersectAnyEmpty.label: empty: intersectAnyEmpty
engine:intersectAnyEmpty.description: Phase 2 Step 1b — the any-branch-empty arm of emptyIntersect: Just true if SOME branch is provably empty, else Nothing (emTrueOnly drops each branch's Just false — all-branches-non-empty does NOT prove the intersection inhabited). Internal helper.

engine:intersectDisjointAgainst.label: empty: intersectDisjointAgainst
engine:intersectDisjointAgainst.description: Phase 2 Step 1b — is the branch `b` provably disjoint from any LATER branch? mOr-fold of emTrueOnly(ttDisjoint b o) over the rest (each Just false dropped — proven-non-disjoint is not a positive emptiness proof). Internal helper to intersectAnyDisjoint.

engine:intersectIntervals.label: set-algebra: intersectIntervals
engine:intersectIntervals.description: Phase 7b-continuation — n-ary intersect with Maybe<Interval> output.

engine:intersectToNegUnion.label: Intersect to neg-union
engine:intersectToNegUnion.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the De Morgan derivation witness (fwd): rewrite `SeIntersect bs` to the `{¬, ∪}`-basis form `SeComplement (SeUnion [¬b …])` (§2.1 — the Boolean collapse, DATA-FRAGMENT-scoped: above the data fragment ∩ is independent because ¬ fences). The equality claim is lawDeMorganIntersect. Non-intersect input passes through unchanged.

engine:intersectToRecord.label: Intersect to record
engine:intersectToRecord.description: ISO-4 bwd witness (partial inverse, design-lock §1.2): defined on a `TtIntersect` whose branches are each single-field-presence records over distinct semantic field keys — merges them into one `$record`. `Nothing` on a cross-base `∩` (`Int & String` — no field structure, no record preimage). Field-key disjointness is the side-condition that makes the `∩` a product; wire names are presentation only.

engine:intersectToRecordFold.label: iso: intersectToRecordFold
engine:intersectToRecordFold.description: ISO-4 helper: fold a TtIntersect's branches, accumulating each single-field-presence record's field into one record's field list; `Nothing` the moment a branch is not a single-field record (a cross-base intersect ⇒ no record preimage). Internal helper.

engine:intervalDiff.label: set-algebra: intervalDiff
engine:intervalDiff.description: Phase 7b-continuation — A minus B for two intervals. Returns IntervalDiffResult marker.

engine:intervalIsNumeric.label: set-algebra: intervalIsNumeric
engine:intervalIsNumeric.description: Phase 7b-continuation — are both bounds (if present) numeric?

engine:intervalIsValid.label: set-algebra: intervalIsValid
engine:intervalIsValid.description: Phase 7b-continuation — does this interval describe a non-empty set?

engine:intervalMember.label: Interval member
engine:intervalMember.description: Decide membership in a WsInterval `lo`/`hi` (each a `Maybe { value, inclusive }`): a Nothing bound is unbounded that side; an inclusive bound uses gte/lte, exclusive uses gt/lt. Internal helper.

engine:intervalMinusEnum.label: set-algebra: intervalMinusEnum
engine:intervalMinusEnum.description: Phase 7b-continuation — A minus enum-values. Returns IntervalDiffResult marker.

engine:intervalSubset.label: set-algebra: intervalSubset
engine:intervalSubset.description: Phase 7b-continuation — a subset b for two intervals; expression bounds use string-key structural equality.

engine:intervalsTouch.label: set-algebra: intervalsTouch
engine:intervalsTouch.description: Phase 7b-continuation — do two intervals overlap or touch at an inclusive edge?

engine:invert.label: Invert
engine:invert.description: Backward type propagation (abstract interpretation): given `output = inputs[0] op inputs[1]` with all but `inputs[unknownIdx]` known, compute the constraint on the unknown input over the canonical SetExpr lattice — equation solving. Binary only (inputs.length != 2 ⇒ SeAll); invertible for + - * / on intervals/enums (with the unknownIdx left/right asymmetry for - and /); % and every non-arith op ⇒ SeAll. Consumes and authors the registered Se* ADT directly; the TS delegate only canonicalizes boundary inputs and applies the final normalize. The port of fenel-check's invert onto the Fenel set-algebra substrate, reusing propagate.fenel's interval/enum helpers. unified-static-analysis Phase 3b-2 / floor-kernel Phase 4.

engine:invertBadArity.label: invert: bad arity?
engine:invertBadArity.description: True when the inputs are not exactly a binary pair, or the unknownIdx is neither 0 nor 1 — the uninvertible-arity guard (⇒ SeAll). Internal helper.

engine:invertConfIvEnum.label: invert: confidence (interval/enum known)
engine:invertConfIvEnum.description: An arithmetic op (+ - * /, % already excluded upstream) over an interval/enum known ⇒ exact, unless * / / with a zero in the denominator ⇒ unavailable; a non-arith op ⇒ unavailable. Internal helper.

engine:invertConfOf.label: invert: confidence of known
engine:invertConfOf.description: Classify by the known marker: $all ⇒ unavailable; interval/enum ⇒ exact when the op is arithmetic (+ - * /) and there is no zero in the denominator for * / /, else unavailable; $union ⇒ approximate; otherwise unavailable. Internal helper.

engine:invertConfidence.label: Invert confidence
engine:invertConfidence.description: Classify a backward-propagation step: `exact` (invertible op + non-$all known + no zero in the denominator), `approximate` ($union known — sound but possibly wide), or `unavailable` (uninvertible — bad arity, % / cat, $all known, zero-in-denominator for * / /, or a non-interval/enum/union known). The companion classifier to invert. unified-static-analysis Phase 3b-2.

engine:invertCore.label: invert: core fold
engine:invertCore.description: The backward-transfer marker fold over (output, known, unknownIdx): $none in either ⇒ $none; $all output ⇒ $all; distribute over a $union in output OR in known; interval×interval ⇒ the interval inverse; enum×enum ⇒ the pointwise inverse; enum-output×interval-known ⇒ $all (approximate); interval-output×enum-known ⇒ distribute the known enum as point intervals; otherwise $all. Internal helper.

engine:invertDivCorner.label: invert: division corner
engine:invertDivCorner.description: One division corner oBound / kBound: an unbounded output bound ⇒ Nothing (∞/x non-finite, excluded); a present output bound over an unbounded known bound ⇒ Just{ 0, exclusive } (finite/±∞ = ±0; the Fenel runtime canonicalizes to the single +0 — signed zero is a JS-repr artifact, `num x = Number x || 0` collapses −0, so the legacy IEEE −0 becomes +0 here, semantically identical since −0 === 0; the parity test canonicalizes ±0); over a zero known value ⇒ Nothing (finite/0 = ∞, excluded — Fenel `div` returns 0 on a zero divisor, so the zero is caught explicitly); over a present non-zero known value ⇒ Just{ quotient, both inclusive }. Internal helper.

engine:invertDivRight.label: invert: interval div-inverse right (b = a / output)
engine:invertDivRight.description: Invert division `output = a / b` solving b (idx 1): an output interval straddling zero (or with an inclusive-zero endpoint) ⇒ SeAll; otherwise b = a / output via the division corners (invertMul known output — known is the dividend a, output the divisor). Internal helper.

engine:invertEnum.label: invert: enum inverse
engine:invertEnum.description: Pointwise enum inverse: for every numeric (o, k) solve the unknown via invertSolveArith (idx asymmetry), keeping defined + finite results, then dedupe (first-seen). Empty ⇒ SeNone. Internal helper.

engine:invertEnumInner.label: invert: enum inverse inner
engine:invertEnumInner.description: Inner loop of the enum×enum pointwise inverse — over the known values for a fixed output value. Internal helper.

engine:invertEnumOne.label: invert: enum inverse one
engine:invertEnumOne.description: Solve one (o, k) for the unknown, appending the result when defined (not ÷0 / %-undefined) and finite. Internal helper.

engine:invertEnumOuter.label: invert: enum inverse outer
engine:invertEnumOuter.description: Outer loop of the enum×enum pointwise inverse — over the output values. Internal helper.

engine:invertHiNonNeg.label: invert: hi ≥ 0?
engine:invertHiNonNeg.description: True when a hi bound is ≥ 0 (unbounded ⇒ +∞ ⇒ True). Internal helper.

engine:invertIsMulDiv.label: invert: is * or /?
engine:invertIsMulDiv.description: True for the multiplication / division ops (the zero-in-denominator guard applies to these). Internal helper.

engine:invertIv.label: invert: interval inverse
engine:invertIv.description: Dispatch the interval inverse for `output = a op b` solving the unknown (idx 0 = a, idx 1 = b): + ⇒ output - known (symmetric, ≡ propSubIv); - ⇒ a = output + b (idx 0, ≡ propAddIv) / b = a - output (idx 1, ≡ propSubIv known output); * ⇒ output / known (symmetric, the division corners); / ⇒ a = output * b (idx 0, ≡ forward multiply) / b = a / output (idx 1, zero-guard output then divide); any other op ⇒ SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:invertIvEnumKnown.label: invert: interval × enum-known
engine:invertIvEnumKnown.description: Distribute an enum KNOWN over an interval OUTPUT: each numeric known value becomes a point interval, the interval inverse applied, unioned. Empty ⇒ SeAll (matches the legacy `parts.length ? union : $all`). Internal helper.

engine:invertIvEnumParts.label: invert: interval × enum-known parts
engine:invertIvEnumParts.description: Build the union branches of the interval-output × enum-known distribution (the interval inverse applied to each numeric known value as a point interval). Internal helper.

engine:invertKnownOf.label: invert: known of inputs
engine:invertKnownOf.description: The KNOWN input marker: inputs[1] when the unknown is index 0, else inputs[0] (the other side). Assumes a binary pair (the arity guard ran). Internal helper.

engine:invertLoNonPos.label: invert: lo ≤ 0?
engine:invertLoNonPos.description: True when a lo bound is ≤ 0 (unbounded ⇒ −∞ ⇒ True). Internal helper.

engine:invertMul.label: invert: interval mul-inverse (division corners)
engine:invertMul.description: Invert multiplication `output = a * b` for the symmetric unknown = output / known: a known interval straddling zero (or with an inclusive-zero endpoint) ⇒ SeAll (any unknown works); otherwise the four DIVISION corners output/known, keeping the finite ones (output bound present AND known bound unbounded[⇒0] or non-zero), then the min/max fold. No finite corner ⇒ SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:invertMulCorners.label: invert: division corners
engine:invertMulCorners.description: The four division corners of output / known, in the order (oL/kL, oL/kH, oH/kL, oH/kH), keeping only the finite ones. Internal helper.

engine:invertSolveArith.label: invert: scalar solve
engine:invertSolveArith.description: Solve `output = unknown op known` (idx 0) or `output = known op unknown` (idx 1) for the scalar unknown ⇒ Just result, undefined cases ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:invertSolveLeft.label: invert: scalar solve (idx 0)
engine:invertSolveLeft.description: Solve output = unknown op known: + ⇒ output - known; - ⇒ output + known; * ⇒ output / known (known 0 ⇒ Nothing); / ⇒ output * known; % and other ⇒ Nothing (not uniquely invertible). Internal helper.

engine:invertSolveRight.label: invert: scalar solve (idx 1)
engine:invertSolveRight.description: Solve output = known op unknown: + ⇒ output - known; - ⇒ known - output; * ⇒ output / known (known 0 ⇒ Nothing); / ⇒ known / output (output 0 ⇒ Nothing); % and other ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:invertUninvertibleOp.label: invert: uninvertible op?
engine:invertUninvertibleOp.description: True for the ops invert never inverts: % (not uniquely invertible) and cat (string concat). Internal helper.

engine:invertZeroDenom.label: invert: zero in denominator?
engine:invertZeroDenom.description: True when the known operand admits zero: an interval whose lo ≤ 0 and hi ≥ 0 (unbounded counts as ∓∞), or an enum containing 0. Internal helper.

engine:isAllK.label: Is-all key
engine:isAllK.description: Does the predicate keyed `k` accept every element (the $all flag, pre-computed TS-side)? Reads the name->info index. Internal helper.

engine:isAstral.label: Is astral char
engine:isAstral.description: True when a single code-point char `c` is an astral (supplementary-plane) char — i.e. it occupies 2 UTF-16 code units, not 1. Decided WITHOUT a code-access native via the observation that `slice c 0 1` of an astral char is a lone high surrogate (one code unit) ≠ `c`, whereas a BMP char's `slice c 0 1` equals `c`. Internal lexer helper — feeds `unitLen`. parser-substrate Phase 7k.

engine:isBinDigit.label: Is binary digit char
engine:isBinDigit.description: True for binary digits (0–1) — the `0b` radix run. Internal lexer helper.

engine:isBinaryConstructor.label: Is binary constructor
engine:isBinaryConstructor.description: Well-kindedness predicate (kind `* -> * -> *`): True for a named type constructor of declared arity EXACTLY 2 (Either / Result / Map). The Bifunctor / Profunctor class kind. Reads the constructor arity surfaced on the marshalled KindType at the category-B kind-marshal seam. Advisory; modelled on engine:isRecordType. unified-static-analysis Phase 5a.

engine:isBottomMu.label: subset: isBottomMu
engine:isBottomMu.description: Phase 5 / type-substrate P1(a.6) — recognize the syntactic μX.X shortcut. Picker mode preserves its legacy Just true; sound mode returns Nothing because validation and matchesShape do not establish this syntax as a live-face bottom.

engine:isCharEnumerable.label: enumerable: isCharEnumerable
engine:isCharEnumerable.description: solver-extension Phase 2 — true when a base type NAME is `Char` — the gate for codepoint-stepping a Char-typed SeInterval (Char is the first NON-numeric Enumerable base: a discrete order over the Unicode codespace). Internal helper.

engine:isConcreteDomain.label: Is concrete domain
engine:isConcreteDomain.description: Phase 5b13 helper for refineCeIfBranches. True iff the domain carries representation info (DomBool / DomNum); False for DomUnknown / DomRef (which are 'don't-know' boundaries).

engine:isCtorName.label: Is constructor name
engine:isCtorName.description: True for an uppercase-initial name with no dot: what the application lift turns into a constructor. A dotted uppercase name is a qualified method or a dotted path, never a constructor tag. modules-as-values Phase 5c-1a.

engine:isDigit.label: Is digit char
engine:isDigit.description: True for ASCII decimal digits 0–9. Internal lexer helper.

engine:isDirectiveChunk.label: Is directive chunk
engine:isDirectiveChunk.description: True when a decl-LINE chunk is a `@directive` line — its first token is `@`. Internal parse-file helper. parser-substrate Phase 5b1.

engine:isEffectFnId.label: symbolize: isEffectFnId
engine:isEffectFnId.description: Phase 14a — recognise an effect-call head: true iff `fnId` is in the supplied `effectFnIds` set (option (c), the registry `requires`-walk the TS wrapper supplies) OR `parseEffectFnId fnId` is Just (option (a), the `$effect:` sentinel). The D-A hybrid recogniser. Internal helper.

engine:isFenelTypeKeysMatch.label: Is FenelType (keys match)
engine:isFenelTypeKeysMatch.description: Phase 7a — pure list-membership predicate: does at least one of the input keys appear in the known-Fenel-type-keys list? Boundary adapter for `isFenelType`; dispatched via `dispatchedIsFenelType` in engine-bodies-dispatch.ts which handles the null / non-object / array / empty-object short-circuits TS-side. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/dependent-types.ts:isFenelType. Fifth (and final) port of the type-algebra arc.

engine:isFirstFieldNamed.label: Is first field named
engine:isFirstFieldNamed.description: Head's name equals the given string. Helper for isSingleLetObject.

engine:isGeneratorShape.label: search: isGeneratorShape
engine:isGeneratorShape.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — true when a branch can act as a candidate generator: SeEnum (its values), SeInterval (its ≤2 inclusive endpoints / typed stepping), or a nested SeUnion / SeIntersect (its own enumeration / a single-witness search fallback). Every other shape (SeAll / SeComplement / SeRef / SePattern / SeWhere / SeDiff) is filter-only. Internal helper.

engine:isHexDigit.label: Is hex digit char
engine:isHexDigit.description: True for hex digits (0–9 a–f A–F) — the `0x` radix run. Internal lexer helper.

engine:isIdentCont.label: Is ident-continue char
engine:isIdentCont.description: True for chars that may CONTINUE an identifier (a–z A–Z 0–9 _). Mirrors the TS `[\p{L}\p{N}_]` continue class. Internal lexer helper.

engine:isIdentStart.label: Is ident-start char
engine:isIdentStart.description: True for chars that may BEGIN an identifier (a–z A–Z _). Mirrors the TS `[\p{L}_]` start class restricted to the ASCII the corpus uses. Internal lexer helper.

engine:isIntEnumerable.label: enumerable: isIntEnumerable
engine:isIntEnumerable.description: solver-extension Phase 1 — true when a base type NAME is integer-`Enumerable` (Int or Nat) — the gate that decides whether a SeInterval is steppable over ℤ. The base is the var's type-context name (the Codeable projection of its type ref). Rational / Real are NOT integer-enumerable (dense/uncountable — no successor). Internal helper.

engine:isJustVal.label: Is Just
engine:isJustVal.description: True when a Maybe value is `Just _`. Internal helper (parseNull convergence presence test).

engine:isLowerInitName.label: Is lower-initial name
engine:isLowerInitName.description: True when the first char of `n` is a–z OR underscore (the isLowerInitial parity, fenel-parser.ts:2432 — the qualified-method method-segment test). Internal expr-grammar helper. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 6.

engine:isNumLit.label: narrow: is numeric literal marker?
engine:isNumLit.description: True when an ExprMarker is a Lit whose value is a number (the legacy `typeof lit === 'number'` guard). Internal helper.

engine:isOctDigit.label: Is octal digit char
engine:isOctDigit.description: True for octal digits (0–7) — the `0o` radix run. Internal lexer helper.

engine:isOpChar.label: Is operator char
engine:isOpChar.description: True for the operator-symbol char set (`OP_CHAR` in parser-keywords.ts: `!#$%&*+./<=>?@\^|-~:` + the Unicode set-theory operators ∈∪∩¬∅∞). The longest run of these forms a generic `op` token unless it's a reserved-multi / named-singleton. Internal lexer helper.

engine:isPEmpty.label: Is PEmpty
engine:isPEmpty.description: True when a Pat is the empty-language PEmpty. Internal helper (regex-containment).

engine:isPEps.label: Is PEps
engine:isPEps.description: True when a Pat is the empty-string PEps. Internal helper (regex-containment).

engine:isProperType.label: Is proper type
engine:isProperType.description: Well-kindedness predicate (kind `*`): True for a fully-saturated type — a nullary type constructor (declared arity 0, e.g. Int / String) or a fully-applied / structural proper type (KtProper — Maybe Int, a $record, a $variant, an $arrow). A unary / binary type constructor (Maybe / Either) is NOT proper. Reads the declared constructor arity surfaced on the marshalled KindType by marshalKindType (engine-bodies-dispatch.ts, category-B seam — the 3b-6 return-table precedent). Advisory; modelled on engine:isRecordType. unified-static-analysis Phase 5a.

engine:isRelOrRule.label: Is relation or rule
engine:isRelOrRule.description: True when a head name is a relation OR a rule in the facts env. Internal helper for the residual safety check (a residual may not hide a relation/rule head).

engine:isRepresentational.label: representations: isRepresentational
engine:isRepresentational.description: Phase 10b sub-step 3 — predicate over representationalClassNames. Returns Bool. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedIsRepresentational`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/representations.ts:isRepresentational.

engine:isScalarV.label: Is scalar value
engine:isScalarV.description: True when a value is a solver scalar leaf — null / String / Number / Bool (Char's repr is a 1-char String). Such a value has no `entries` to recurse, so deepEqValue bottoms out in the std `eq` leaf. Internal helper for Phase-5 deep matching.

engine:isSelfCall.label: Is self call
engine:isSelfCall.description: True when a JsAst callee is `$fenel.<name>` (JsMember over JsVar `$fenel` with property = the enclosing fn's own name). Phase 6b2 self-tail-call detection.

engine:isSingleLetObject.label: Is single-let object
engine:isSingleLetObject.description: Recognise a JsonLogic node that is `{let: <something>}` with exactly one field.

engine:isStringTypedEq.label: Is string-typed eq
engine:isStringTypedEq.description: Phase 21.5.2 polymorphic-eq detection. True iff fnId is 'eq' or 'neq' AND at least one arg is structurally string-typed (CeLit string / dotted CeVar / DomRef-returning CeCall). Short-circuits on fnId first so non-comparison fnIds skip the args walk.

engine:isTtNamed.label: subset: isTtNamed
engine:isTtNamed.description: Phase 5 (E-named) — is the leaf a bare name-handle (TtNamed, NOT an opaque)? Gates ssNominalBridge so it fires ONLY when ≥1 side is a name-handle — reproducing isSubtype's `$named↔$named` hierarchy + `$named↔$opaque` bridge WITHOUT short-circuiting opaque↔opaque (where the name alone is insufficient — `List Int ⊄ List Nat` despite both being the opaque `List`; those must PEEL to their pure form and compare element-wise). Internal helper.

engine:isUnaryConstructor.label: Is unary constructor
engine:isUnaryConstructor.description: Well-kindedness predicate (kind `* -> *`): True for a named type constructor of declared arity EXACTLY 1 (Maybe / List). Int (arity 0) / Either (arity 2) / an applied `Maybe Int` (KtProper) ⇒ False. The Functor / Monad class kind — checking `Functor f` is checking the `isUnaryConstructor f` predicate-bound. Reads the constructor arity surfaced on the marshalled KindType at the category-B kind-marshal seam. Advisory (the resolver wire is Phase 5b); modelled on engine:isRecordType. unified-static-analysis Phase 5a.

engine:isUnitLit.label: Is unit literal
engine:isUnitLit.description: True when `a` is the unit primary `SLit { value = nullValue }` (what `()` lowers to). parser-substrate Phase 4h.

engine:isUnknownDomain.label: Is unknown domain
engine:isUnknownDomain.description: Predicate: is the WasmDomain DomUnknown? Helper to coerceDomain's short-circuit and inferBranchDom's then/else picking.

engine:isUpperName.label: Is uppercase name
engine:isUpperName.description: True when the first char of `n` is A–Z (the parseApp uppercase-head ⇒ construct test, `isUpperCase`). Internal expr-grammar helper. parser-substrate Phase 3b.

engine:isValueOnlyPredicate.label: set-algebra: isValueOnlyPredicate
engine:isValueOnlyPredicate.description: set-algebra-to-fenel 3b-3 Step 1 — does this SetExpr's membership only depend on the value itself (vs. an outer context)? Reads the registered `$tag` SetExpr ADT directly: every leaf except `SeWhere` is value-only; structural compound arms recurse via mEvery semantics; a non-SetExpr point value is false. Used by setEnumDecideDisjoint to gate the per-value test path. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:isValueOnlyPredicate.

engine:isVarM.label: narrow: is var marker?
engine:isVarM.description: True when an ExprMarker is a Var. Internal helper.

engine:isWildcardPat.label: Is wildcard pattern
engine:isWildcardPat.description: True when a match-arm pattern is the `_` catch-all (`PatLit { value = "_" }`) — the trailing such arm drops its pattern to match TS-parse. parser-substrate Phase 4h.

engine:isWsChar.label: Is whitespace char
engine:isWsChar.description: True for the lexer's inline-whitespace chars (space, tab, carriage-return) — all SKIPPED with no token (`fenel-parser.ts:90`). CR is `charFromCode 13` because the Fenel string escape has no `\r` (it would decode to the letter `r`); CRLF corpora rely on this. Newline is handled separately (it emits a `nl`). Internal lexer helper.

engine:jlsAndOrOp.label: JLS and/or op
engine:jlsAndOrOp.description: `{and: [...]}` / `{or: [...]}` ⇒ `SCall { fnId, args }` (never SOp). desugar lowers to ECall; the per-target emitter decides ternary vs operator form downstream.

engine:jlsAnn.label: JLS annotation op
engine:jlsAnn.description: `{ann: [e, T]}` ⇒ `SAnn { expr, type }` (a type annotation `(e : T)`): e lowers via jsonLogicToSyntax; the `$`-keyed FenelType T rides OPAQUELY as its JsonLogic image. Exactly two args (Err otherwise). desugar is transparent except over SMethod (rejected by jsonLogicToExpr). modules-as-values Phase 2d.

engine:jlsArrayItems.label: JLS array items
engine:jlsArrayItems.description: Lower a JlArray to a nested `appendItem`-chain of SCalls over a `SLit {value = []}` base (decision 4). Left-fold acc preserves source order; mirrors lowerJlArrayItems' snoc semantics but targets Syntax (no list case).

engine:jlsArrayItemsAcc.label: JLS array items (accumulator)
engine:jlsArrayItemsAcc.description: Accumulator-threaded inner loop for jlsArrayItems. Each item wraps the acc with `SCall appendItem [item, acc]`, mirroring appendItem's `(item, arr)` order.

engine:jlsBuildNamedRecordResult.label: JLS build named-record result
engine:jlsBuildNamedRecordResult.description: Iterate ctorDef order, looking up each field in recFields and lowering the value to Syntax. Assembles the named-field SConstruct.

engine:jlsCallOp.label: JLS call op
engine:jlsCallOp.description: `{call: [callee, ...args]}` ⇒ `SCall { fnId, args }`. Callee resolved via the reused resolveCallee (direct string or `{var: name}` ⇒ `$dyn:name`).

engine:jlsCatchAllArm.label: JLS catch-all arm
engine:jlsCatchAllArm.description: An unpaired trailing match arg is the `_`-dropped catch-all body: lower it via jsonLogicToSyntax and append `{ pattern = PatLit "_", body }` (the canonical `_` pattern jlsPattern/buildConPat produce). fenel-surface-extensions Phase 1 Step 2.

engine:jlsCollectLeadingLets.label: JLS collect leading lets
engine:jlsCollectLeadingLets.description: Walk from the head of a `do` arg list, accumulating consecutive `{let: …}` forms into a Syntax bindings list. Returns `{bindings, rest}`. Mirrors collectLeadingLets via the reused isSingleLetObject/extractLetFields.

engine:jlsConstructOp.label: JLS construct op
engine:jlsConstructOp.description: `{construct: [Tag, ...]}` ⇒ `SConstruct { ctor, args, fields? }`. Unambiguous named-record metadata preserves identity-bearing slots in `fields`; ambiguous unscoped constructor metadata returns structured CompileError.Unsupported; positional and unknown shapes omit `fields`.

engine:jlsDoOp.label: JLS do op
engine:jlsDoOp.description: `{do: [...]}` ⇒ re-nested SLet/SDo: leading consecutive `{let:…}` items merge into SLet bindings scoping over the rest (JSON Logic's flat statement encoding re-nested as source-format structure, mirroring lowerDoSequence); mid-stream lets nest recursively; pure expr segments ⇒ SDo with NO singleton-unwrap (that lowering stays in desugar). Errors on empty/lets-empty do.

engine:jlsExprList.label: JLS expr list
engine:jlsExprList.description: Lower a list of JsonLogic nodes to Syntax, accumulating into a list. Used by SDo exprs, SCall args, and and/or.

engine:jlsFnFlat.label: JLS fn (flat form)
engine:jlsFnFlat.description: Flat `{fn: ["p1", "p2", ..., body]}` shape. Last element is the body; everything before is a string param name.

engine:jlsFnOp.label: JLS fn op
engine:jlsFnOp.description: `{fn: [["p1","p2"], body]}` OR `{fn: ["p1","p2",body]}` ⇒ `SLambda`. Handles both paren-list and flat param shapes.

engine:jlsGuardParts.label: JLS guard parts
engine:jlsGuardParts.description: Recognise a guarded match arm's `{$guard:[pat,cond]}` pattern-position element (a JlObject single `$guard` field over a 2-elem JlArray) ⇒ Just {pat, cond} (raw JsonLogic nodes), else Nothing. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 3.

engine:jlsIfChain.label: JLS if chain
engine:jlsIfChain.description: Fold a multi-arm `if` arg list into a right-associated nested SIf chain (surface frame preserved). 2-arg: implicit `else null` (SLit nullValue); 3-arg: standard SIf; 5+: right-fold. desugar owns the SIf → ECall "if" lowering.

engine:jlsIfThree.label: JLS if (3-arg form)
engine:jlsIfThree.description: Handle the 2-arg and 3-arg if forms. useImplicitElse=true ⇒ else = SLit { value = nullArg }; otherwise the third arg is lowered.

engine:jlsLetBindings.label: JLS let bindings
engine:jlsLetBindings.description: Walk a JlObject's field list as let bindings, lowering each value to Syntax and accumulating `{name, value}` records.

engine:jlsLetOp.label: JLS let op
engine:jlsLetOp.description: `{let: {x: 1, y: 2}}` ⇒ `SLet { bindings, body = SVar lastName }`. Implicit-body-as-last-binding mirrors JSON-Logic let; desugar owns the let → applied-ELambda lowering.

engine:jlsMatchArms.label: JLS match arms
engine:jlsMatchArms.description: Walk a list of (pattern, body) pairs accumulating `{pattern, body}` records. An odd, UNPAIRED trailing arg is the `_`-dropped catch-all body (the TS parser drops a bare `_ -> body` arm to `{match:[scrut, …, body]}`): the adapter synthesises the canonical `_` pattern `PatLit "_"` (the jlsPattern/buildConPat shape) so the Syntax/compile IR accepts it — the interpreter already does. Pattern via jlsPattern, body via jsonLogicToSyntax. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 1 Step 2.

engine:jlsMatchOp.label: JLS match op
engine:jlsMatchOp.description: `{match: [scrutinee, p1, b1, p2, b2, ...]}` ⇒ `SMatch { scrutinee, arms }`. Walks args pair-wise after the scrutinee; patterns via jlsPattern target the std Pattern ADT.

engine:jlsMethod.label: JLS method op
engine:jlsMethod.description: `{method: [cls, method, …args]}` ⇒ `SMethod { cls, method, args }` (a module-qualified-method head). cls+method are the first two JlString args (Err otherwise); the rest lower via jlsExprList. desugar lowers SMethod to a dotted-fnId ECall. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 6.

engine:jlsObjectExpr.label: JLS object expression
engine:jlsObjectExpr.description: Handle a JlObject at expression position: empty ⇒ SRecord []; single-key ⇒ jlsSingleKey; multi-key ⇒ reject `$`-prefixed keys then SRecord.

engine:jlsObjectPattern.label: JLS object pattern
engine:jlsObjectPattern.description: Dispatch on the structural pattern shape of a JlObject: `{var: name}` or `{$bind: name}` ⇒ PatVar; otherwise error.

engine:jlsOperatorOrFnId.label: JLS operator or fnId
engine:jlsOperatorOrFnId.description: Default raw-IR fall-through: tries the operator-notation map first (`+` ⇒ add, …); on miss rejects `$`-prefixed markers; then retains legacy compatibility by value shape — a non-empty-array value ⇒ key-as-fnId SCall, any other value ⇒ single-field SRecord. Explicit source records preserve record intent separately in buildRecord.

engine:jlsPattern.label: JLS pattern
engine:jlsPattern.description: Lower a JSON-Logic-shaped pattern AST to the std Pattern ADT. PatLit / PatVar / PatConstruct shapes (Pat* tags shared with CorePattern by design). Array patterns are not lowerable (Err).

engine:jlsRecordFields.label: JLS record fields
engine:jlsRecordFields.description: Walk a list of JlField, lowering each value to Syntax and accumulating `{name, value}` records into an SRecord.

engine:jlsSingleKey.label: JLS single-key op
engine:jlsSingleKey.description: Single-key JlObject dispatcher mirroring lowerSingleKey's cascade but emitting Syntax frames (SIf/SLet/SDo preserved; SCall for call/and/or/operator/fnId — never SOp). Inherits the unsupported-op Err arm.

engine:jlsTagged.label: JLS tagged value
engine:jlsTagged.description: A pre-evaluated tagged value (`{$tag: "Just", value: 5}`) ⇒ SConstruct with identity-bearing constructor slots when metadata is unambiguous. Ambiguous unscoped constructor metadata returns structured CompileError.Unsupported; unknown or positional shapes omit `fields`.

engine:jlsTaggedFields.label: JLS tagged fields
engine:jlsTaggedFields.description: Walk a JlTagged's field list, lowering each value to Syntax while accumulating positional args + field names. Returns `{args, fields}` wrapped in Result.

engine:jlsTaggedPattern.label: JLS tagged pattern
engine:jlsTaggedPattern.description: Constructor pattern from a `{$tag: "Just", value: <subpat>}` shape. Unambiguous registered metadata preserves identity-bearing PatConstruct.fields; ambiguous unscoped constructor metadata returns structured CompileError.Unsupported; unknown or positional shapes omit fields.

engine:jlsTaggedPatternFields.label: JLS tagged pattern fields
engine:jlsTaggedPatternFields.description: Walk a JlTagged pattern's field list, recursively lowering each value to a sub-pattern. Accumulates (args, fields).

engine:jlsTailExprs.label: JLS tail exprs
engine:jlsTailExprs.description: Walk the post-leading-let tail of a `do` arg list, lowering each expr to Syntax. Mid-stream `{let: …}` triggers a recursive jlsDoOp on the remaining items (nested SLet scope). Mirrors lowerTailExprs.

engine:jlsTryNamedRecordLiteral.label: JLS try named-record literal
engine:jlsTryNamedRecordLiteral.description: When construct's only arg is a JlObject matching a registered ctorDef's declared fields, lower it as a named-field SConstruct (args in ctorDef order). Returns Just (Ok|Err) on success, Nothing to fall through to positional.

engine:jlsWalkCtorDef.label: JLS walk ctor def
engine:jlsWalkCtorDef.description: Iterate a ctorDef's field names. For each present in recFields, lower the value to Syntax and accumulate (args, fields). Absent names are skipped.

engine:jlsWhere.label: JLS where op
engine:jlsWhere.description: `{where: [body, {x: 1, …}]}` ⇒ `SWhere { body, bindings = [{name, value}] }`. The bindings-object → list conversion reuses jlsLetBindings (the SLet binding walk); desugar lowers SWhere to the let-equivalent Expr. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 4.

engine:joinAll.label: Join all
engine:joinAll.description: Fold the grounding atoms left-to-right via joinStep, starting from the unit tuple-set (vars = [], rows = [[]]). Internal helper.

engine:joinChunks.label: Join chunks
engine:joinChunks.description: Flatten a list of decl-LINE chunks into one token run, inserting a synthesized `vsemi` token between consecutive chunks (the layout-virtual the Decls production expects between decl-lines). parser-substrate Phase 5b1.

engine:joinChunksGo.label: Join chunks (go)
engine:joinChunksGo.description: joinChunks' walk: prepend-accumulated run; each further chunk is appended after a synthesized `vsemi` token. Internal parse-file helper. parser-substrate Phase 5b1.

engine:joinExisting.label: Join existing
engine:joinExisting.description: For each existing tuple, build its var→value bindings and accumulate the extended rows that match the atom against any fact row. Internal helper.

engine:joinFactRows.label: Join fact rows
engine:joinFactRows.description: For one existing binding, try each fact row: matchArgs ⇒ Just final-bindings ⇒ append the extended row (the newVars projected from the bindings); Nothing ⇒ skip. Internal helper.

engine:joinStep.label: Join step
engine:joinStep.description: Join one atom against the running tuple-set: extend the var list with the atom's new EVar args (first-appearance order), then re-derive the rows by matching every existing tuple against every fact row. Internal helper.

engine:joinVerdict.label: Join verdict
engine:joinVerdict.description: The Phase 3h totality-gate JOIN: fold a list of subject totality verdict tags (each the shipped `subjectTotalityVerdict` of one method fnId the law's property names) through the conservative meet — any Unknown ⇒ Unknown, else any Partial ⇒ Partial, else Total. An EMPTY list (the law names no method-var subject — its genuine subjects are trusted natives) folds to Total (the meet identity), so the gate proceeds. The TS seam (engine/src/law-discharge.ts) threads the result into `verify(prop, proof, { verdict })`; the kernel's `vpSample` rule rejects a SampleTestResult over an Unknown/Partial subject (Err NonTotal).

engine:jopDisjoint.label: judgment of proposition: disjoint
engine:jopDisjoint.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 — the PropDisjoint arm of the iso: JEmpty (s ∩ t), the composed set built via SeIntersect. Presentation only (the re-decide is pre-computed by isDisjoint). Internal helper.

engine:jopSubset.label: judgment of proposition: subset
engine:jopSubset.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 — the PropSubset arm of the iso: JEmpty (s ∩ ¬t), the composed set built via SeComplement + SeIntersect. Presentation only (the re-decide is pre-computed by isSubset). Internal helper.

engine:jsMemberPropertySafe.label: JS member property safe
engine:jsMemberPropertySafe.description: True when a property is a non-empty ASCII JavaScript identifier accepted by dotted member syntax. Other keys, including full module:function ids, serialize through bracket notation.

engine:jsonLogicToExpr.label: JSON Logic to Expr
engine:jsonLogicToExpr.description: Composition `desugar ∘ jsonLogicToSyntax` — lifts raw JSON Logic straight to the irreducible core Expr ADT. Threads the adapter's Err through (Result-at-boundary); rejects an annotation over a qualified method call (Err Unsupported via desugarAnnotationError — its written type selects the instance, modules-as-values Phase 2d); applies the total desugar on the Ok path. The seam 4b's compiler-entry re-layer and P3's reify consume. expr-substrate Phase 4a.

engine:jsonLogicToSyntax.label: JSON Logic to Syntax
engine:jsonLogicToSyntax.description: The JSON-Logic source-format adapter (form-map). Maps each JSON-Logic form 1:1 to a Syntax case — surface frames PRESERVED (`{if}` ⇒ SIf, `{let}` ⇒ SLet, `{do}` ⇒ SDo verbatim, operators/and/or ⇒ SCall — never SOp). Mirrors normalise-to-core's recognition cascade but targets Syntax instead of CoreExpr, reusing the target-agnostic structural helpers. Result-wrapped (inherits the Unsupported error arms). Input is the existing JsonLogic ADT (marshalled by the dispatch wrapper). `jsonLogicToExpr` composes this with the total `desugar`. expr-substrate Phase 4a; gives desugar its first real caller. NOTHING in the live pipeline calls it until 4b.

engine:jsonSchemaForwardPlan.label: JSON Schema forward semantic plan
engine:jsonSchemaForwardPlan.description: Field-identity Phase 3 repair — audit the shared identity-total TraversalType, elaborate schema-mode validation semantics in Fenel, then recursively select record, variant, map, list, Maybe, tagged and atomic JSON Schema semantics. TypeScript only marshals the `$` barrier and serialises current-wire JSON keys.

engine:jsonSchemaIdentityIntents.label: JSON Schema field identity authoring plan
engine:jsonSchemaIdentityIntents.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — turn JSON Schema property rows into explicit MintField/ReuseField intents. No entropy is created; an explicit reuse key is accepted only after the shared FieldKey validator succeeds.

engine:jsonSchemaReverseFormFields.label: JSON Schema reverse form-field plan
engine:jsonSchemaReverseFormFields.description: Return top-level property authoring plans for the public jsonSchemaToFormFields surface. Property presence and object classification are decided in Fenel; identity intents are entropy-free.

engine:jsonSchemaReverseFormReuseRequest.label: JSON Schema reverse form reuse requests
engine:jsonSchemaReverseFormReuseRequest.description: Reuse-callback requests for jsonSchemaToFormFields, including its property-bearing schema compatibility surface and recursively selected child types.

engine:jsonSchemaReversePlan.label: JSON Schema reverse authoring plan
engine:jsonSchemaReversePlan.description: Plan recursive JSON Schema scalar/list/record/discriminated-variant imports over a single own-property marker. Fenel owns constraint folding, required membership, Mint/Reuse sibling validation, and every structural choice; the host only serialises and applies the plan.

engine:jsonSchemaReverseReuseRequests.label: JSON Schema reverse reuse requests
engine:jsonSchemaReverseReuseRequests.description: Return callback requests at the semantic authoring paths selected by the reverse planner. Discriminated cases retain the public case:<tag> path; no host-side case selection is needed.

engine:jsonSchemaReverseSet.label: JSON Schema reverse SetExpr plan
engine:jsonSchemaReverseSet.description: Fold enum/const/pattern/format/integer/interval/multipleOf/not/anyOf/oneOf/allOf JSON Schema constraints into canonical Se* constructors. The input is the own-property marker; regex parsing uses the existing std regexSet leaf.

engine:judgmentOfProposition.label: Judgment of proposition
engine:judgmentOfProposition.description: The Proposition → Judgment half of the decomposition iso (decide-substrate Phase 2). PropSubset s t → JEmpty (s ∩ ¬t); PropDisjoint s t → JEmpty (s ∩ t); PropEmpty s → JEmpty s; PropInhabited s → JInhabited s. The composed set is the SEMANTIC meaning of the claim — the actual re-decide is pre-computed by the delegate keyed on the claim shape (tri-precision dispatch), so this set is presentation, not the thing decided on the ReDecide path. Internal helper.

engine:kindArityIs.label: kinds: arity is
engine:kindArityIs.description: Shared core for the constructor-arity predicates: True iff the marshalled KindType is a named constructor (tag KtCon) whose declared arity equals n. A proper / variable / unknown kind is not a constructor of any arity ⇒ False. The arity read is guarded behind the KtCon tag test. Internal helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:labelOfValue.label: identifiable: labelOfValue
engine:labelOfValue.description: Phase 10b sub-step 2 — display label for a specific value, falling back to its type's Labelable instance. Resolution order: (1) value-side override field (`__name` / `name` / `title` / `label`); (2) `getLabel typeName` lifted to String via `canonical`; (3) Nothing. The wrapper pre-extracts the candidate strings from the value; the body falls through to the type-level helper on miss. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:labelOfValue.

engine:lastBindingName.label: Last binding name
engine:lastBindingName.description: Read the last binding's name from a non-empty bindings list. Used to synthesise let's implicit body.

engine:lastOf.label: infer: last of list
engine:lastOf.description: The last element of a list as a Maybe (Nothing for an empty list). Internal helper used by inferPipe to read the final pipe stage.

engine:lawAbsorbIntersect.label: Law: absorption (intersect)
engine:lawAbsorbIntersect.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — lattice housekeeping: `A ∩ (A ∪ B) ≅ A` (§3.2 absorption).

engine:lawAbsorbUnion.label: Law: absorption (union)
engine:lawAbsorbUnion.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — lattice housekeeping: `A ∪ (A ∩ B) ≅ A` (§3.2 absorption).

engine:lawCommutativeIntersect.label: Law: commutative intersect
engine:lawCommutativeIntersect.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — lattice housekeeping: `A ∩ B ≅ B ∩ A` (§3.2 comm of ∩).

engine:lawCommutativeUnion.label: Law: commutative union
engine:lawCommutativeUnion.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — lattice housekeeping: `A ∪ B ≅ B ∪ A` (§3.2 comm of ∪).

engine:lawDeMorganIntersect.label: Law: De Morgan (intersect)
engine:lawDeMorganIntersect.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the De Morgan axiom instance over operands a, b: `SeIntersect [a,b] ≅ intersectToNegUnion (SeIntersect [a,b])` = `¬(¬a ∪ ¬b)` (§3.2; §2.1 data-fragment scope).

engine:lawDiffDef.label: Law: diff definition
engine:lawDiffDef.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the `∖ = ∩ ∘ ¬` axiom instance over operands a, b: `SeDiff a b ≅ diffToFloor (SeDiff a b)` = `SeIntersect [a, ¬b]` (§3.2).

engine:lawDoubleComplement.label: Law: double complement
engine:lawDoubleComplement.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the `¬¬A = A` axiom instance over operand a: `SeComplement (SeComplement a) ≅ a` (§3.2 classical involution).

engine:lawEnumDecomposition.label: Law: enum decomposition
engine:lawEnumDecomposition.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the enum-decomposition axiom instance over an enum e: `e ≅ enumToSingletonUnion e` (the finite ∪ of singletons — §1 Layer-1).

engine:lawEvalSafe.label: synthesize: law safety
engine:lawEvalSafe.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.6 — Option A's EXHAUSTIVE seven-case `Expr` classifier: `EVar` is safe; `ECall`/`ELambda`/`EConstruct`/`ERecord` recurse over every expression child; `EMatch` is ALWAYS unsafe; `ELit` is safe only for a null/Boolean/Number/String value. An unknown or malformed future case is unsafe — the wildcard arm returns the UNSAFE code, so a new `Expr` constructor fails closed instead of falling through to a permissive host null. Internal helper.

engine:lawEvalSafeFields.label: synthesize: law safety (fields)
engine:lawEvalSafeFields.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.6 — the worst law-safety code across a named-field list. Internal helper.

engine:lawEvalSafeList.label: synthesize: law safety (list)
engine:lawEvalSafeList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.6 — the worst law-safety code across a list of expression children. Internal helper.

engine:lawExcludedMiddle.label: Law: excluded middle
engine:lawExcludedMiddle.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the `A ∪ ¬A = ⊤` axiom instance over operand a (§3.2; the classical seam — expected to FENCE pre-Phase-3: ⊤ ⊆ A∪¬A needs classical ¬).

engine:lawIdempotentIntersect.label: Law: idempotent intersect
engine:lawIdempotentIntersect.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — lattice housekeeping: `A ∩ A ≅ A` (§3.2 idem of ∩).

engine:lawIdempotentUnion.label: Law: idempotent union
engine:lawIdempotentUnion.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — lattice housekeeping: `A ∪ A ≅ A` (§3.2 idem of ∪).

engine:lawNonContradiction.label: Law: non-contradiction
engine:lawNonContradiction.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the `A ∩ ¬A = ⊥` axiom instance over operand a (§3.2).

engine:lawNullaryIntersect.label: Law: nullary intersect
engine:lawNullaryIntersect.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the `∩∅ = ⊤` axiom instance: `SeIntersect [] ≅ SeAll` (§3.2; the Layer-1 ⊤ derivation).

engine:lawNullaryUnion.label: Law: nullary union
engine:lawNullaryUnion.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the `∪∅ = ⊥` axiom instance: `SeUnion [] ≅ SeNone` (§3.2; the Layer-1 ⊥ derivation).

engine:lawProposition.label: Law proposition
engine:lawProposition.description: Classify a representation-presence / enum-membership law FIELD (labelNonEmpty / iconNonEmpty / emojiNonEmpty / structureValid / geometryTypeValid) into a decidable law claim built from the instance's sibling method values, JUDGMENT-NATIVE since decide-substrate Phase 2 (K2): non-empty laws ⇒ `JEmpty (SeIntersect [{value}, {""}])` (value ≠ "", via jopDisjoint); enum-membership laws ⇒ `JEmpty (SeIntersect [{value}, ¬allowed])` (value ∈ allowed, via jopSubset). Out-of-table fields ⇒ `{ tag = "None" }` (the sample-arm sentinel). The producer now emits the one lattice judgment, not the closed PropDisjoint/PropSubset marker; the TS audit-side hook (unmarshalProposition) shape-recognizes the judgment back to the still-Prop* proposer (byte-identical), peels the SeEnum payloads, and runs the existing propose+verify round-trip. expr-substrate Phase 6a / decide-substrate Phase 2.

engine:lawSafeWorse.label: synthesize: law safety (worse of two)
engine:lawSafeWorse.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.6 — combine two law-safety codes by taking the WORSE: safe < match-excluded < otherwise-excluded. A candidate carrying both a match and a non-scalar literal is therefore NOT a pure match exclusion. Internal helper.

engine:layoutGo.label: Layout fold
engine:layoutGo.description: The layout fold over the token stream: drop `nl` tokens, close all contexts before `eof`, and route every other token through `stepLayout` (threading the context stack, the forward-order token accumulator, the `pendingOpen` arm, and the previous real token's line for new-line detection). Internal helper for `layoutTokens`.

engine:layoutTokens.label: Layout tokens
engine:layoutTokens.description: The layout pass: rewrite the lexer's token stream (`nl`-separated) into a virtual-delimited block stream — `nl` consumed, `{t="vopen"/"vsemi"/"vclose"}` virtuals inserted by column-anchored offside discipline (the whole program is one block, opened at the first token; openers `= -> then else do of where` open nested blocks; dedents cascade-close; brackets suspend). The Phase-3 grammar's input contract (decision 8). parser-substrate Phase 2.

engine:lblBoundRepr.label: validation-hints: lblBoundRepr
engine:lblBoundRepr.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — render a raw interval-bound value for a label (toString / null→"null"; no `expr(…)` carve-out — that is the formatter's). Was the TS lblBoundReprStr. Internal helper.

engine:lblEnumReprs.label: validation-hints: lblEnumReprs
engine:lblEnumReprs.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — map each raw enum value to its label repr (toString / null→"null"; no JSON-quoting — the label DSL is human-prose). In original order. Was the TS lblEnumValueRepr. Internal helper.

engine:lblPattern.label: validation-hints: lblPattern
engine:lblPattern.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — LblPatternKind → human-readable label. `lblClassifyPattern` (rxhPatternToRegex∘rxhReadPat + lblClassifyRegex) produces the kind; this dispatches on it and emits the matching string ("exactly N characters", "contains uppercase letter", "URL-safe slug", etc.). Internal helper.

engine:lblWhere.label: validation-hints: lblWhere
engine:lblWhere.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — render a $where JSON-Logic predicate to a human label (was the TS labelWhere). Tries the comparison ops (≥/>/≤/<), ==/===, in, and, or in order; "custom constraint" fallback. Internal helper.

engine:lcgNext.label: enumerate: lcgNext
engine:lcgNext.description: Phase 15 — one MINSTD (Park–Miller) step: `mod (mul 48271 seed) 2147483647`. Double-precision-SAFE: 48271·(2³¹−2) ≈ 1.04e14 < 2⁵³, so NO float overflow (a 1103515245-class multiplier would silently lose precision in JS doubles — the classic trap, fenced by construction). Internal helper.

engine:lcgSeed.label: enumerate: lcgSeed
engine:lcgSeed.description: Phase 15 — normalise an arbitrary seed into [1, 2147483646], guarding the 0 fixed-point. Double-mod because std `mod` keeps the dividend's sign (Step-0 probe), so a negative seed re-normalises back into range: `add (mod (add (mod s m') m') m') 1` with m' = 2147483646. Internal helper.

engine:lexAll.label: Lex all
engine:lexAll.description: Tokenize a Fenel source string into the `{ t, v, ln, col }` token stream (mirroring `fenel-parser.ts`'s `tokenize`, the parity oracle): run the driver loop over the source (line 1, col 0), accumulating tokens in forward source order. Emits `nl` tokens (consumed by the layout pass) and a trailing `eof`. The no-locale path (locale word-op projection is Phase 5). parser-substrate Phase 2.

engine:lexBacktick.label: Lex backtick
engine:lexBacktick.description: Lex a backtick at `i`: backtick-INFIX (`` x `add` y ``) when the previous token closes an expression AND a single whitespace-wrapped ident is bracketed by a closing backtick — emits THREE tokens `` ` `` ident `` ` `` (`fenel-parser.ts:118–145`); otherwise a TEMPLATE string (`lexTemplate`). Internal lexer helper.

engine:lexGo.label: Lex loop
engine:lexGo.description: The main lexer dispatch loop over the source string `cs` from index `i`, threading line/col + the forward-order token accumulator `out`: skip whitespace/`--`-comments, emit `nl` per newline, and dispatch strings/backticks/numbers/identifiers/operators to their sub-lexers. Appends the `eof` token at the end. Internal helper for `lexAll`.

engine:lexIdent.label: Lex identifier
engine:lexIdent.description: Lex an identifier run from `i` (greedy ident-continue chars + whitespace-free dotted `.IDENT` joins, `fenel-parser.ts:229–238`), reclassify via `classifyTT` (bool / keyword / ident) and emit the token (the raw text as `v`). Internal lexer helper.

engine:lexMaxLoop.label: Lex maximal loop
engine:lexMaxLoop.description: The maximal-munch step loop: at each step record the best (longest, ≥1-char) nullable position + its parseNull value, advance one char through `stepGrammar`, stop on `PEmpty` (dead) or EOF. Internal helper for `lexMaximal`.

engine:lexMaximal.label: Lex maximal
engine:lexMaximal.description: Maximal-munch over a ref-free token pattern `root` (a `Pat`): step the chars of `cs` from `pos` (bounded by `n`) through the strict whole-grammar derivative, tracking the LAST position where the root was nullable (+ its `parseNullG` value = the winning class); on a dead (`PEmpty`) residual or EOF, return `{ len, val }` for the best match (len `-1` / val `Nothing` if none). A SIBLING of `runSteps`/`recognizeG`/`parseG` (those stay byte-untouched); the env starts empty (`[]`) — token patterns are ref-free so the fixpoints degenerate to plain recursion (decision 6, the hot path stays cheap). parser-substrate Phase 2.

engine:lexNumber.label: Lex number literal
engine:lexNumber.description: Lex a numeric literal from `i` (radix 0x/0o/0b, decimal with optional fractional `.`-not-`..` part and scientific exponent), emitting a `num` token whose `v` is the RAW source slice (`fenel-parser.ts:179–223`). Internal lexer helper.

engine:lexOperator.label: Lex operator
engine:lexOperator.description: Lex an operator/punctuation token at `i`, replicating the TS hand priority (`fenel-parser.ts:261–294`): 2-char reserved-multi first, then punctuation singletons, then `=`/`:` (non-doubled) and `.`, then the longest op-char run (via the maximal-munch driver `lexMaximal`) named by `opTT`. An unexpected char emits an `error` token (TS throws; the differential never feeds lex errors — the corpus is valid). Internal lexer helper.

engine:lexString.label: Lex string literal
engine:lexString.description: Lex a double-quoted string from the opening quote at `i`: scan to the closing quote resolving `\`-escapes into the DECODED `v`, emit a `str` token (`fenel-parser.ts:98–110`). `ln` is NOT incremented on an embedded newline (the TS string branch doesn't). Internal lexer helper.

engine:lexTemplate.label: Lex template string
engine:lexTemplate.description: Lex a backtick template from the opening backtick at `i`: emit `str` (no interpolation) or `str_begin`/`str_mid`/`str_end` around `${}` holes, each hole RE-TOKENIZED (via `lexAll`) and its tokens spliced FLAT into the stream carrying the backtick's ln/col (`fenel-parser.ts:148–176`). Internal lexer helper.

engine:liftCtorArg.label: Lift a nullary-ctor arg
engine:liftCtorArg.description: An argument lifts like the head: a qualified-method SVar (`Monad.bind`) is a 0-arg SMethod, an undotted uppercase SVar a 0-arg SConstruct (the Fenel convention); a dotted uppercase name stays a dotted-path SVar. Anything else passes through. Internal expr-grammar helper. parser-substrate; SMethod and dotted arms modules-as-values Phase 5c-1a.

engine:liftCtorArgs.label: Lift nullary-ctor args
engine:liftCtorArgs.description: Map liftCtorArg over an argument list (uppercase SVar args ⇒ 0-arg SConstruct). Internal expr-grammar helper. parser-substrate.

engine:liftEnvelope.label: type-former: liftEnvelope
engine:liftEnvelope.description: P7-5 — the two refinement-envelope lifts: $refined{base, SeNone} ⇒ $void (refined-by-∅ = ⊥); $refined{base, SeAll} ⇒ base (refined-by-⊤ = base); else ⇒ $refined{base, set'} (canonical). Emits the $-free outcome marker the TS boundary re-authors. Sound by construction (setAlgebraNormalize only emits SeNone/SeAll when proven). Internal helper.

engine:listIndex.label: listIndex
engine:listIndex.description: Return Just element when 0 <= i < length, else Nothing. Local helper not yet in std; lifted into engine to keep the CeConstruct + CeRecord arms self-contained.

engine:listIndexLoop.label: listIndexLoop
engine:listIndexLoop.description: listIndex sub-helper: walk xs with a counter; emit Just element on match, Nothing on exhaustion.

engine:litEqFuncType.label: litEq func type
engine:litEqFuncType.description: Build the (externref, externref) -> i32 WasmFuncType for the $fenel.litEq runtime helper used by the Phase 21.5.2 string-typed eq path.

engine:litStringFuncType.label: litString func type
engine:litStringFuncType.description: Build the (i32) -> externref WasmFuncType for the $fenel.litString runtime helper. Pure constant; takes an emptyList sentinel for the params/results list construction in pure-FP style.

engine:loBound.label: Lower boundary
engine:loBound.description: The membership-transition point a WsInterval lower bound induces: an inclusive `lo` enters AT `lo.value`, an exclusive `lo` enters at `lo.value + 1` (integer domain); a Nothing (unbounded) bound induces no boundary. Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:loBoundChar.label: enumerable: loBoundChar
engine:loBoundChar.description: solver-extension Phase 2 — the INCLUSIVE Char lower endpoint of an interval bound { value, inclusive }: inclusive ⇒ value (the Char); exclusive (c > value) ⇒ the NEXT codepoint (charFromCode (add (charCode value) 1)). Internal helper.

engine:loBoundInt.label: enumerable: loBoundInt
engine:loBoundInt.description: solver-extension Phase 1 — the INCLUSIVE integer lower endpoint of an interval bound { value, inclusive }: inclusive ⇒ numberToInt value; exclusive (x > value) ⇒ value + 1 over ℤ (intAdd (numberToInt value) (numberToInt 1)). The step unit is built via numberToInt 1 (the bridge path — the numeric-tower §0.2 stack hazard). Internal helper.

engine:loOf.label: propagate: loOf
engine:loOf.description: The LO bound of a full SeInterval marker, cleaned through numBound (encapsulates the SeInterval `interval` nesting + the marshalBound guard). Nothing for a non-interval (defensive). Internal helper.

engine:lookupBool.label: Lookup bool
engine:lookupBool.description: The Bool value bound to `name` in a name→Bool INDEX (a `fromEntries`-built record; default false — an unbound PRef is conservatively non-nullable). 7h S2: O(1) `mapGet` read replacing the O(|g|) `findEntry` scan (the env-lookup de-superlinearization — the assoc-list stays the source of truth, this reads its opaque-map index). Internal helper.

engine:lookupCtorDef.label: Lookup ctor def
engine:lookupCtorDef.description: Find a ctor name in the marshalled ctorDefs list. Returns `Just fields` or `Nothing`.

engine:lookupCtorDefAmbiguous.label: Lookup ctor def ambiguity
engine:lookupCtorDefAmbiguous.description: Report whether the requested source constructor spelling was omitted because multiple semantic owners define it.

engine:lookupCtorWireName.label: Lookup ctor wire name
engine:lookupCtorWireName.description: Project an exact semantic constructor target to its runtime ADT wire tag after constructor metadata selection; unknown spellings remain unchanged.

engine:lookupFieldInList.label: Lookup field in list
engine:lookupFieldInList.description: Find a JlField by name in a List<JlField>. Returns `Just value` or `Nothing`.

engine:lookupRelation.label: Lookup relation
engine:lookupRelation.description: Find a relation entry `{ name, arity, rows }` by name in the facts env. Internal helper.

engine:lookupReturn.label: infer: lookup return-type
engine:lookupReturn.description: Look a fnId up in the return-table and, when the application is saturated, project its return TraversalType through typeToSetProjection; a miss, under-applied call, or degraded projection yields SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:lookupRule.label: Lookup rule
engine:lookupRule.description: Find a rule entry `{ name, params, body }` by name in the facts env. Internal helper.

engine:lookupVal.label: Lookup val
engine:lookupVal.description: The Maybe-value bound to `name` in a name→(Maybe a) INDEX (a `fromEntries`-built record; default Nothing). 7h S2: O(1) `mapGet` read replacing the O(|g|) `findEntry` scan. The stored value is itself a Maybe (the parseNull lattice), so a present key returns that Maybe directly. Internal helper.

engine:lowerAndOrPath.label: Lower and/or path
engine:lowerAndOrPath.description: lowerCall sub-helper for and / or: arity-check (>= 2) then delegate to lowerBoolFold with I32And / I32Or. Error message carries the specific fnId.

engine:lowerArgsAt.label: Lower args at target
engine:lowerArgsAt.description: Fold over args lowering each at the supplied target domain and concatenating the resulting instrs onto acc. Shared by lowerCmpPath (DomNum) / lowerLitEqPath / lowerDynPath / lowerEffectPath / lowerDefaultPath (DomRef) / lowerNotPath (DomBool) / lowerNegatePath (DomNum). Returns Result<List<WasmInstr>>.

engine:lowerBoolFold.label: Lower boolean fold
engine:lowerBoolFold.description: Left-fold over args at DomBool emitting I32And / I32Or between each pair. Used by the 'and' / 'or' paths in lowerCall. Eager evaluation matching the Phase 13 TS oracle (source-level short-circuit `if c then x else y` lives in CeIf).

engine:lowerBoolFoldRest.label: Lower boolean fold (rest)
engine:lowerBoolFoldRest.description: lowerBoolFold sub-helper: per-iteration emit arg instrs + I32And/I32Or. Recurses through the args list.

engine:lowerCall.label: Lower CeCall
engine:lowerCall.description: Central CeCall dispatch. Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:1395 (lines 1395-1604). Seven dispatch paths over (fnId, args): direct numeric (add/sub/mul/div), string-typed eq via litEq (Phase 21.5.2), direct comparison (lt/lte/gt/gte/eq/neq), and/or (I32And/I32Or eager fold), not (I32Eqz), negate (F64Neg), $dyn:<varName> (indirect closure call via callClosure_<N>), $effect:<Class>:<method> (effect-dispatch via internImportInModule), default ($fenel.<fnId> runtime helper).

engine:lowerCallDispatch.label: Lower call dispatch (post-numeric)
engine:lowerCallDispatch.description: lowerCall sub-helper: routes to lowerLitEqPath when isStringTypedEq fires, else to lowerCallNonStringEq.

engine:lowerCallEffectOrDefault.label: Lower effect-or-default path
engine:lowerCallEffectOrDefault.description: lowerCall sub-helper: calls parseEffectFnId and routes to lowerEffectPath on Just, lowerDefaultPath on Nothing. This is the Fenel-body-calling-Fenel-body case (parseEffectFnId is Phase 21.0-ported).

engine:lowerCallNonCmp.label: Lower call non-cmp
engine:lowerCallNonCmp.description: lowerCall sub-helper: chain over fnId for the remaining paths (and/or via lowerAndOrPath → lowerBoolFold, not, negate, $dyn:, then $effect: / default via lowerCallEffectOrDefault).

engine:lowerCallNonStringEq.label: Lower call non-string-eq
engine:lowerCallNonStringEq.description: lowerCall sub-helper: checks directComparisonOp and routes to lowerDirectCmpPath when matched, else to lowerCallNonCmp.

engine:lowerClosure.label: Lower Wasm CeClosure
engine:lowerClosure.description: CeClosure arm entry. Allocates a fresh closure id + name; resolves captures in the CALLER's scope; enterClosureBody installs a fresh frame with [$env, ...params]; emits the capture-load prologue; lowers the body at DomRef; exitClosureBody restores the caller's frame; assembles + registers the body WasmFunc + WasmExport; emits the closure-construction sequence (envAlloc + per-capture envSet + makeClosure → externref handle) into the caller's out. Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:lowerClosure (872-985).

engine:lowerCmpPath.label: Lower direct comparison path
engine:lowerCmpPath.description: Both args at DomNum, then append the cmp op (F64Lt / F64Le / F64Gt / F64Ge / F64Eq / F64Ne). Result domain DomBool.

engine:lowerCtorVal.label: Lower value-expr (data ctor)
engine:lowerCtorVal.description: Lower value-expr type-args inside one `data` constructor: its full `type` sig marker (the dependent RETURN index, `Vec a (n + 1)`) AND each decomposed `fields[].type`. A normal (non-data) ctor has no `type` key (left unchanged); fields without value-args round-trip deep-equal. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 8 (D-G follow-up).

engine:lowerDefaultPath.label: Lower default path
engine:lowerDefaultPath.description: Default fallback: $fenel.<fnId> runtime helper. Lower each arg at DomRef, then Call (import "$fenel" "<fnId>" (externref^N) -> externref) via internImport. Result DomRef.

engine:lowerDirectCmpPath.label: Lower direct cmp path
engine:lowerDirectCmpPath.description: lowerCall sub-helper: arity-check (== 2) for direct comparison ops, then lowerCmpPath.

engine:lowerDynPath.label: Lower $dyn: path
engine:lowerDynPath.description: Indirect closure call via $dyn:<varName>. LocalGet the closure handle, coerce to DomRef, lower each arg at DomRef, then Call $fenel.callClosure_<N>(externref^(N+1)) -> externref. Result domain DomRef. Out-of-scope varName → Err Unsupported.

engine:lowerEffectPath.label: Lower $effect: path
engine:lowerEffectPath.description: Effect-dispatch sentinel ($effect:<Class>:<method>). Lower each arg at DomRef, then Call (import "$effect.<Class>" "<method>" (externref^N) -> externref) via internImportInModule (the module name differs from the default $fenel). Result DomRef.

engine:lowerExprWithTarget.label: Lower expression with target
engine:lowerExprWithTarget.description: Wrapper around lowerWasmExpr that applies coerceDomain to bring the produced domain into alignment with the caller's target. Used internally by CeIf / CeLet / CeDo / dotted CeVar / (future) CeCall arms for each recursive descent so coerceDomain inserts box/unbox helpers wherever sub-expression domains don't line up. Named with the WithTarget suffix because normalise-to-core's `lowerExpr` already occupies the bare codeName.

engine:lowerFieldVal.label: Lower value-expr (record/ctor field)
engine:lowerFieldVal.description: Lower value-expr type-args inside one record-/ctor-field marker's `type` slot. fenel-surface-extensions Phase 8 (D-G follow-up).

engine:lowerLet.label: Lower let
engine:lowerLet.description: Fold a JsLet's bindings into the current block's statement spine. Fresh name ⇒ `const name = value` (declared += name). Name already declared in this block ⇒ temp+block fallback (`const $l<i> = value` in outer scope, then a JsSBlock re-binding name = $l<i> with the remainder nested). Body lowered via lowerSpine. Phase 6b2.

engine:lowerLitEqPath.label: Lower string-typed eq path
engine:lowerLitEqPath.description: Phase 21.5.2 string-typed eq / neq. Both args lower at DomRef, then Call $fenel.litEq(externref, externref) -> i32. For neq, append I32Eqz to flip the result. Arity must be exactly 2; else Err Unsupported.

engine:lowerMatch.label: Lower Wasm CeMatch
engine:lowerMatch.description: CeMatch arm entry. Lower scrutinee at DomRef, stash in a fresh local via allocLocal, then delegate to emitWasmMatchArms. Result domain: DomRef (match always produces externref). Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:lowerMatch.

engine:lowerNamedField.label: Lower named field
engine:lowerNamedField.description: Per-field named mode (Phase 21.1): push interned name + Call litString, lower fieldExpr at DomRef, then Call $fenel.setFieldNamed. Used for every CeRecord field and for CeConstruct fields when fieldNames metadata is present.

engine:lowerNegatePath.label: Lower negate path
engine:lowerNegatePath.description: Exactly-1-arg at DomNum, then append F64Neg. Result DomNum.

engine:lowerNotPath.label: Lower not path
engine:lowerNotPath.description: Exactly-1-arg at DomBool, then append I32Eqz. Result DomBool.

engine:lowerNumericFold.label: Lower numeric fold
engine:lowerNumericFold.description: Left-fold over args emitting arg0 instrs then for each subsequent arg its instrs + the binop. Used by direct-numeric paths (add/sub/mul/div). Each arg lowers at DomNum.
