engine:partitionGen.label: search: partitionGen
engine:partitionGen.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — scan an intersect's branches for the FIRST generator-capable shape (isGeneratorShape); return { gen, rest } with rest = the other branches (order-preserved) that become membership filters. No generator-capable branch ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:partitionReps.label: Partition representatives
engine:partitionReps.description: The representative values to derive under, from the boundary points: one per cell `[b_i, b_{i+1})` (its left endpoint `b_i`, a boundary value) PLUS one below-everything representative `min(bounds) - 1` (witnessing the leftmost / complement / WsAll cell). Empty boundaries (all-WsAll/None markers) ⇒ a single arbitrary representative (every value is equivalent). One deriv per representative ⇒ LINEAR in the boundary count. Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:patForkable.label: fork: pat-forkable
engine:patForkable.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — a pattern is fork-safe iff it is PatWildcard / PatVar / PatLit / a PatConstruct whose args are ALL simple (PatVar/PatWildcard/PatLit — no nested constructor or record patterns). Internal helper.

engine:peAllConcrete.label: PE: all concrete
engine:peAllConcrete.description: True iff every PEResult in the list is concrete (done). Used by the strict EConstruct fold. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peAllFoldReady.label: PE: all fold-ready
engine:peAllFoldReady.description: True iff every PEResult in the list is fold-ready: concrete (done), or a residual ELambda (higher-order fold readiness — the egressed lambda becomes a host closure). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peAndOr.label: PE: and/or prune
engine:peAndOr.description: Short-circuit-aware and/or pruning (walkAndOr): `and` short-circuits on a concrete falsy (returns it) and prunes a truthy identity; `or` short-circuits on a concrete truthy and prunes a falsy identity; surviving residuals collect — empty ⇒ the operator identity (and→true, or→false), a single survivor returns bare, else a residual `ECall op`. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peAndOrFinish.label: PE: and/or finish
engine:peAndOrFinish.description: Finish the and/or prune: empty survivors ⇒ the operator identity (and→true, or→false); a single survivor returns bare; else a residual `ECall op survivors`. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peApplyLambda.label: PE: apply lambda (let/do recovery)
engine:peApplyLambda.description: β-reduce an applied single-param ELambda directly: bind the param to the PE'd value (concrete or residual — residuals substitute at use sites) and walk the body under the EXTENDED bindings (lexical scope). No budget decrement (structural consumption, not recursive inlining). The desugared walkLet/walkDo recovery; dead frames drop — divergence class D-let vs the TS oracle (tier-2 equal). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peAt.label: PE: index arg
engine:peAt.description: Index into an Expr list via std:at (which returns the raw element, not a Maybe). peIf's `lt i n` / `lt (i+1) n` guards keep every access in range. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peBetaReduce.label: PE: beta-reduce (user-fn inline)
engine:peBetaReduce.description: Inline a pure user fn: on-demand spec via peFnSpec (Nothing / bodyless / lift-Err ⇒ residual call — D-inline), FRESH param scope (registry fns capture nothing; unsupplied params stay unbound), body walked at budget-1 (0 ⇒ residual call). args ≥ params ⇒ body result (extras dropped, TS mirror); under-application ⇒ residual body, or the residual-call sentinel when the body reduced concrete. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peBindParams.label: PE: bind params
engine:peBindParams.description: Zip declared param names with PE'd args into a fresh bindings map; unsupplied params stay unbound, extra args drop (TS mirror). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peBindingsFromKnowns.label: PE: bindings from knowns
engine:peBindingsFromKnowns.description: Fold the {name, value} known-inputs list into the opaque bindings map (name ⇒ concrete PEResult). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peCall.label: PE: call
engine:peCall.description: The ECall dispatcher: `if`/`?:` ⇒ dead-branch prune, `and`/`or` ⇒ short-circuit / identity-prune, `$dyn:<name>` heads ⇒ binding-resolved dynamic call, applied single-param ELambda via `$` ⇒ direct β-reduce (the desugared let/do recovery), everything else ⇒ fold / β-reduce / residual. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peConcrete.label: PE: concrete result
engine:peConcrete.description: Build a concrete PEResult `{ done = true, value }` — a fully-reduced value. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peConstruct.label: PE: construct
engine:peConstruct.description: The ADT constructor arm (walkConstruct + walkTaggedRecord): PE every arg; all concrete ⇒ fold via the peEval host re-entry (egressing the rebuilt EConstruct); else a residual EConstruct with the named-field `fields` metadata preserved (dual-arm) so a nested tagged-record residual round-trips byte-faithfully. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peDynCall.label: PE: dynamic call
engine:peDynCall.description: Resolve a `$dyn:<name>` dynamic callee through the bindings (the TS walkCall var-callee path): a concrete string re-dispatches as a named call (inline/fold apply); another concrete value (closure) folds via the `$` application vehicle when all args are fold-ready; unbound/residual keeps the residual `$dyn:` call (egress renders `{call: ["$", {var: name}, …]}`). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peExtendBinds.label: PE: extend bindings
engine:peExtendBinds.description: Fold a capture-binds list `[{name, value}]` into the bindings map as concrete PEResults. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peFoldReady.label: PE: fold-ready
engine:peFoldReady.description: A single PEResult is fold-ready iff concrete or a residual ELambda. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peGeneralCall.label: PE: general call (fold / residual)
engine:peGeneralCall.description: Fold a foldable ECall whose args are all fold-ready (concrete-or-ELambda) via the peEval host re-entry (egressing the rebuilt call tree through exprToJsonLogic); the gate is the positive `elem fnId foldableFnIds` (every registered pure fn — excludes both effectful and unknown fnIds, matching the TS oracle). Otherwise a residual call with PE'd args. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peIf.label: PE: if-prune
engine:peIf.description: Dead-branch pruning over the chained `if` arg list (walkIf): pairs (cond, then) walk left-to-right; a concrete truthy cond with no accumulated residual collapses to the then; a concrete falsy cond is skipped (dead branch); an unknown cond appends a residual (cond, then) pair; the trailing else closes the chain. An empty `out` with no live branch ⇒ concrete nullValue. Rebuilds the smallest residual `ECall "if"`. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peIsAppliedLambda.label: PE: is applied lambda
engine:peIsAppliedLambda.description: Recognise the desugared let/do applied-lambda shape `ECall "$" [ELambda <exactly 1 param>, value]` — the only shape desugar mints (single-binding chains). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peIsELambda.label: PE: is ELambda
engine:peIsELambda.description: Recognise a residual ELambda Expr (the fold-ready lambda-value case). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peIsLazyOp.label: PE: is lazy op
engine:peIsLazyOp.description: Recognise a lazy control-flow op head (`if` / `?:` / `and` / `or`) — the ops that must egress as the op-KEY form (`{if:[…]}`) rather than the strict call form, to preserve lazy / short-circuit re-evaluation semantics. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peMatch.label: PE: match
engine:peMatch.description: The EMatch arm (walkMatch): concrete scrutinee ⇒ first-match arm-select (3-way verdict: match/no/unknown — unknown = guarded arm or lost-names constructor pattern ⇒ SOUND residual bail); captures extend bindings concretely and only the selected body is PE'd; exhausted ⇒ nullValue. Residual scrutinee ⇒ every arm body PE'd under pattern-var shadows, patterns + guards verbatim. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peMatchArmsResidual.label: PE: match arms (residual walk)
engine:peMatchArmsResidual.description: Walk EMatch arms for the residual rebuild: shadow the arm's pattern vars, PE the body, preserve pattern + guard verbatim. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peMatchConcrete.label: PE: match (concrete scrutinee)
engine:peMatchConcrete.description: Walk arms in order against a concrete scrutinee: guarded arm ⇒ residual bail (the D-guard sound fence); pattern verdict match ⇒ extend bindings with the concrete captures and PE that body only; no ⇒ next arm; unknown ⇒ residual bail; exhausted ⇒ concrete nullValue. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peMatchCtor.label: PE: match constructor
engine:peMatchCtor.description: Constructor-pattern match: Bool-opaque True/False against a JS-boolean scrutinee (type-gated first — loose eq would coerce); otherwise mapGet the scrutinee's $tag (a non-record scrutinee reads Nothing ⇒ no), compare to the ctor, then per-field sub-match. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peMatchCtorFields.label: PE: match constructor fields
engine:peMatchCtorFields.description: Per-field sub-pattern walk of a tag-matched constructor: fields-present walks resolved CompileFieldSlot metadata in parallel and projects slot.wireName only for mapGet; an invalid/missing semantic slot is UNKNOWN. Fields-absent uses positional `_i` (a missing key there is UNKNOWN, the lost-names sound bail; a missing resolved wire projection is a genuine no). Sub-verdicts propagate; binds accumulate. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peMatchPattern.label: PE: match pattern
engine:peMatchPattern.description: 3-way pure pattern matcher (Pattern ADT vs concrete value): {kind: match|no|unknown, binds}. Wildcard/PatLit "_" ⇒ match; PatVar ⇒ bind; PatLit ⇒ eq (loose-across-types caveat documented); PatConstruct ⇒ Bool-opaque + $tag compare + per-field recurse (fields-present = resolved CompileFieldSlot metadata projected to wireName only at the concrete-object read; fields-absent = positional _i with missing-key ⇒ unknown — the lost-names sound bail). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peMatchResidual.label: PE: match (residual rebuild)
engine:peMatchResidual.description: Rebuild a residual EMatch: every arm body PE'd under pattern-var shadows (PatVar names rebound to residual self-EVars so outer knowns don't substitute into runtime-rebound positions), patterns + guards preserved VERBATIM (guards are not PE'd — the TS mirror). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:pePatternShadows.label: PE: pattern shadows
engine:pePatternShadows.description: Collect every name a pattern would bind and rebind each to a residual self-EVar in the bindings map (the addPatternVarBindings port) — shadows outer knowns inside a residual match arm's body. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:pePatternShadowsList.label: PE: pattern shadows (list)
engine:pePatternShadowsList.description: pePatternShadows over a sub-pattern list. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:pePositionalFields.label: PE: positional fields
engine:pePositionalFields.description: True iff a resolved fields metadata list is the PositionalField-key prefix 0, 1, … (or empty) — the case where positional construct emission stays aligned. Current wire spelling is irrelevant to structural positional identity. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peProject.label: PE: project path
engine:peProject.description: Project remaining dotted-path segments into a concrete value via mapGet; a missing field / non-record intermediate ⇒ concrete nullValue (walkVar's fallback-less miss). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peRecord.label: PE: record
engine:peRecord.description: The user-record arm (walkUserRecord): PE every field value; all concrete ⇒ a concrete raw record (built via mapSet); else a residual ERecord with PE'd field exprs. One pass threads both the residual field list and the concrete record. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peResidual.label: PE: residual result
engine:peResidual.description: Build a residual PEResult `{ done = false, value }` — an unreduced residual Expr. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peResultsToExprs.label: PE: results to Exprs
engine:peResultsToExprs.description: Map resultToExpr over a PEResult list — the residual-rebuild / fold-egress arg list. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peTruthy.label: PE: truthy (walkIf semantics)
engine:peTruthy.description: The PE's own truthiness ported exactly from truthyJs (strict): nullValue / false / 0 / "" / "0" / the empty array are falsy; everything else truthy. Type-discriminated (isBoolean/isNumber/isString/isArray) because std:eq is JS-loose (" " == false) — within one type loose eq is exact. Deliberately NOT std:truthy. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peVar.label: PE: var
engine:peVar.description: Variable substitution + dot-path projection (walkVar). Look up the head segment of the dotted name; a concrete head is projected into (record field access via mapGet, a miss ⇒ nullValue); a residual single-segment head returns its residual; anything else stays a residual EVar. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peWalk.label: PE: walk
engine:peWalk.description: The core partial-evaluation recursion, structural over the 7 Expr cases. ELit ⇒ concrete; EVar ⇒ substitute-if-known (dot-path project) / residual; ECall ⇒ if-prune / and-or short-circuit / fold-if-concrete (via peEval) / residual; EConstruct ⇒ fold-if-concrete / residual (fields preserved); ERecord ⇒ field-wise; ELambda / EMatch ⇒ SOUND residual pass-through (β-reduce + arm-select are Steps 3-5). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peWalkArgs.label: PE: walk args
engine:peWalkArgs.description: PE a list of Expr children in order, accumulating PEResults (appendItem appends to the end). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peZipFields.label: PE: zip construct fields
engine:peZipFields.description: Zip an EConstruct's resolved named-field metadata with its args into SRecord `{name, value}` fields, projecting each semantic slot's current wireName only at this source/property egress boundary. partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:peelArrow.label: Peel arrow layer
engine:peelArrow.description: signature-substrate Phase A — peel ONE arrow layer: `Just { params, returns }` with the param TYPES projected out of the TtArrowParams (identity metadata dropped — this is the type-spine read), or Nothing for a non-arrow value. One layer only; use uncurryType/paramTypes/finalReturn for the flattened spine.

engine:peelList.label: set-algebra: peelList
engine:peelList.description: Phase 7c / repr-retire 5a — recognise the canonical List encoding STRUCTURALLY ($opaque with Phase-2.5 self-reference or legacy $mu pure, or bare $mu with Cons/Nil variant). Returns Just { value = head-raw } when matched; Nothing otherwise. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedPeelList`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:peelList.

engine:peelListCons.label: subset: peelListCons
engine:peelListCons.description: Phase 5 / field-identity Phase 3 — given a variant's case list, validate the Nil/Cons List shape and return the Cons payload field with the canonical List-head FieldKey. Else Nothing. Internal helper to peelListElem.

engine:peelListConsHead.label: subset: peelListConsHead
engine:peelListConsHead.description: Phase 5 / field-identity Phase 3 — having found the Cons case, require a sibling Nil case and return the canonical List-head FieldKey component's marshalled type. The recognizer consults neither current wire spelling nor declaration order. Internal helper to peelListCons.

engine:peelListElem.label: subset: peelListElem
engine:peelListElem.description: Phase 5 / type-substrate P1(a.6) — legacy permissive List-element peel retained for picker identity and classifier barrier detection. It crosses refined/opaque/mu wrappers and accepts a loose Nil/Cons structural shape by canonical head FieldKey. Sound LiveList recognition instead uses validationListInnerVariant's exact terminal grammar.

engine:peelListForAuthoring.label: List element for authoring
engine:peelListForAuthoring.description: Project the declared List element without inventing field identities. Identity-total inputs use the canonical List-head key, including renamed projections; incomplete declarations admit only an originally unkeyed head field. Membership and containment continue to use strict peelList.

engine:peelListVariant.label: set-algebra: peelListVariant
engine:peelListVariant.description: Phase 7c / field-identity Phase 3 — given a TtVariantCase list, validate Nil/Cons shape (Nil nullary, Cons with exactly two fields including the canonical List-head FieldKey); return Just { value = head.raw }. Current wire spelling is never identity. Internal helper to peelList.

engine:peelMaybe.label: set-algebra: peelMaybe
engine:peelMaybe.description: Phase 7c — recognise the canonical `Nothing | Just { _0: T }` variant shape (through outer $refined). Returns Just T-raw when matched; Nothing otherwise. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedPeelMaybe`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:peelMaybe.

engine:peelResult.label: set-algebra: peelResult
engine:peelResult.description: Phase 7c — recognise the canonical `Err { _0: E } | Ok { _0: A }` shape (through outer $refined). Returns Just { err = E-raw, ok = A-raw } when matched. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedPeelResult`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:peelResult.

engine:peelToRefined.label: subset: peelToRefined
engine:peelToRefined.description: Phase 5 — peel a type through its opaque layers to a refined form: TtRefined ⇒ Just it; TtOpaque ⇒ recurse its pure view; else Nothing. The `while opaque bp = bp.pure` copy-peel isSubtype's refined-a arm does to test whether b reveals a refinement. Internal helper.

engine:peelToVariant.label: set-algebra: peelToVariant
engine:peelToVariant.description: Phase 7c — walk through outer $refined / $opaque.pure wrappers to find an inner $variant; returns the matched type's raw (TtVariant.raw). Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedPeelToVariant` in engine-bodies-dispatch.ts which extracts `.$variant` from the result. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:peelToVariant (now a thin shim).

engine:phantomEntityName.label: field-meta: phantomEntityName
engine:phantomEntityName.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — extract the entity-name string from an optional shared TraversalType. Fenel owns TtTagged phantom selection, refined SeEnum-first recognition, and the string leaf check; TS supplies only descriptor-safe canonical boundary data. Dispatched via `dispatchedPhantomEntityName`.

engine:phantomGeoLevelOf.label: field-meta: phantomGeoLevelOf
engine:phantomGeoLevelOf.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — extract the first refined phantom enum member only for a TtTagged whose value is named GeoPath. Fenel owns both the type gate and enum-first policy over the shared descriptor-safe TraversalType. Dispatched via `dispatchedPhantomGeoLevelOf`.

engine:phantomUnitOf.label: field-meta: phantomUnitOf
engine:phantomUnitOf.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — extract the first refined phantom enum member from an optional shared TraversalType. Fenel owns enum-first policy and preserves any UnitExpr payload; TS supplies no unit classifier. Dispatched via `dispatchedPhantomUnitOf`.

engine:pickConstructKey.label: Pick construct key
engine:pickConstructKey.description: Choose the key name for position idx: fields[idx] when present, else `_<idx>`. Mirrors the TS oracle's fieldNames-or-positional dispatch.

engine:pickType.label: Pick type
engine:pickType.description: Identity-total record pick. Paths are non-empty lists of FieldKey; recursive matching never reads wireName.

engine:planAuthoredTopLevelSignatures.label: Plan authored top-level signatures
engine:planAuthoredTopLevelSignatures.description: Validate complete authored schemes, fence parser binding diagnostics, and plan their active-implementation trust without a host-side default.

engine:planFieldPersistenceKernel.label: Plan field persistence
engine:planFieldPersistenceKernel.description: Diff complete normalized account owner/Field/facet snapshots. The returned plan explicitly chooses owner writes/deletes, durable Field live/tombstone operations, Codeable reservations, optional facet upserts/deletes, and the committed snapshot for one account transaction.

engine:positionalFieldsForCtor.label: Positional fields for ctor
engine:positionalFieldsForCtor.description: When ctorDef is registered AND arg count matches the declared field count, return the field list. Otherwise Nothing.

engine:prefixParamContains.label: set-algebra: prefixParamContains
engine:prefixParamContains.description: named-membership Phase 1 — the prefix-parameterized named-set families: multiple:N (mod), list:maxdiff:N, list:span:N, format:path:max-depth:N, format:path:max-length:N, format:path:ext:NAME. Returns Just verdict on a prefix match, Nothing otherwise. Parses the param via Fenel string ops. Mirrors the `name.startsWith(...)` branches of implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:containsNamed.

engine:prepareFieldAuthoringInventory.label: Prepare field authoring inventory
engine:prepareFieldAuthoringInventory.description: Classify live normalization inputs, account tombstone reservations, repository identities, and UUID kinds before the host invokes the field-identity B3 bridge. Liveness/realm/kind policy is entirely Fenel-owned.

engine:prependAll.label: Append all
engine:prependAll.description: Append each token of `items` onto the accumulator `out` in order (the spliced interpolation-hole tokens). Internal lexer helper.

engine:primaryPat.label: Primary pattern
engine:primaryPat.description: Build the Primary production's alternation (a Pat VALUE, not a named production): num / str / bool / var / unit `()` / `(op)` section / parens (with the `( Expr : Type )` annotation arm ⇒ SAnn, modules-as-values Phase 2d) / List / Record refs. Called TWICE by exprGrammar — once with the full ident vocabulary (the HEAD Primary: `and a b` parses as application) and once with the and/or-excluded vocabulary (ArgPrimary: `f and g` stops the juxtaposition, the WORD_INFIX mirror). The section arm sits BEFORE the paren arm (the `(and)` tiebreak — TS opOf fires before parseExpr). parser-substrate Phase 3b (T2).

engine:printDecl.label: fenel-printer: printDecl
engine:printDecl.description: printer-substrate Phase 2 — the declaration renderer (pxDecl's non-type arms): a `$`-free decl marker (declToMarker, engine-bodies-dispatch.ts) → .fenel text. Four forms: def → `name params = body` (`(op)` LHS for operator names, params space-joined) / type_sig → `name : type` (type marshalled, rendered via printType) / fixity → `infixl|infixr|infix prec op` (the assoc l/r/n → infixl/infixr/infix map is this body's pure if-cascade) / where → `body where k = v, …` (kw.where localized; bindings comma-joined). EXPRESSION slots (def.body, where body + binding values) carried RAW → printExpr; the type_sig type → printType. isOp (the operator-name regex) precomputed at the marshal boundary. Mirrors fenel-printer.ts:pxDecl; the TS pxDecl def/type_sig/fixity/where arms are now thin marshal+dispatch shims.

engine:printExpr.label: fenel-printer: printExpr
engine:printExpr.description: Phase 3b-3f — the Fenel EXPRESSION pretty-printer (px's expression arms): JSON-Logic Expression → .fenel text syntax. Discriminates JS shapes via isNull/isNumber/isBoolean/isString/isArray (number/bool → toString, string → jsLit, null → "null", array → `[a, …]`), dispatches single-key op objects on the key (var/let/if/match/do/cat/fn/call/apply/tuple/construct/method + operators or/and/!/==/…/in/|>/+/-/*/%/ann). Infix/prefix rendering sources notation/prec/assoc from defaultFixityTable (§B). Precedence-threaded; `ctx`-driven parenthesisation. Keyword table `kw` threaded by the TS router (§D). Declaration/program/type arms + the type-printer stay TS (router); the three type-printer boundaries (object-type ann / type-shaped-in-expr / read+schema) are router-intercepted or deferred. Self-recursive: one dispatch renders a whole expression subtree. Mirrors fenel-printer.ts:px; the TS px is now a thin router.

engine:printLegacyTypeExpr.label: fenel-printer: printLegacyTypeExpr
engine:printLegacyTypeExpr.description: printer-substrate Phase 1 — the read(T)-with-schema legacy type-expr renderer (pLegacyTypeExpr): a `$`-free Ls marker (printerLegacySchemaToMarker, engine-bodies-dispatch.ts) → the legacy type-expr surface. A record schema → `{ name: <T>, … }` (recursive); a scalar → `Name` / `Name{fmt}` (named format set, `format:` stripped) / `Name[lo..hi]` (interval). Leaf display names (TYPE_NAMES) + the fmt/interval discrimination are precomputed at the marshal boundary; the body assembles the surface. Mirrors fenel-printer.ts:pLegacyTypeExpr; the TS pCallRead read-call arm dispatches this body for the inner type string.

engine:printProgram.label: fenel-printer: printProgram
engine:printProgram.description: printer-substrate Phase 2 — the top-level program fold (pxDecl's program arm): a list of pre-classified item markers (programItemsToMarkers, engine-bodies-dispatch.ts) → the `\n\n`-joined surface. The px router's 4-way item classification (single-key DECL_KEYS → PiDecl/PiTypeDef/PiProgram, read-schema call → PiLegacy, looksLikeType → PiType, else → PiExpr) is a $-key read done TS-side; the body dispatches per tag: PiDecl → printDecl / PiTypeDef → printTypeDef / PiProgram → printProgram (nested) / PiLegacy → `read(<printLegacyTypeExpr>[ at "src"])` / PiType → printType / PiExpr → printExpr at prec None. Mirrors fenel-printer.ts:pxDecl's program arm; the TS program arm is a thin marshal+dispatch shim.

engine:printReadItem.label: fenel-printer: printReadItem
engine:printReadItem.description: printer-substrate Phase 3 — the `read(T)` / `read(T at "src")` legacy-call wrapper (the Fenel-first capstone): a PiLegacy marker (`{schema, hasSource, source}` via printerReadCallToMarker, engine-bodies-dispatch.ts) → `read(<printLegacyTypeExpr schema>)` / `read(… at "src")`. Promotes the ppReadWrap helper (shared with the program-item PiLegacy arm) to a public dispatchable entry so the former TS pCallRead rendering line is now Fenel-authored — zero rendering logic remains in fenel-printer.ts; the TS read arm only marshals the read-schema call + dispatches this body.

engine:printSetExpr.label: fenel-printer: printSetExpr
engine:printSetExpr.description: Phase 3b-3f — render a canonical 14-case SetExpr to its refinement-predicate surface string (the harvest's LAST structural reader). 11 refinement-surface arms: SeAll → "true" / SeNone → "false" / SeWhere → printExpr pred None (THE blocker, now rides the Fenel expression printer) / SeRef → handle / SeEnum → `value in [v, …]` (jsLit values) / SeInterval → `lo <op> value` / `value <op> hi` AND-joined (jsLit bounds) / SeIntersect → comma-join (refinement AND) / SeUnion → `(…) or (…)` / SeDiff → `(…) and not (…)` / SeComplement → `not (…)` / SePattern → `matches <pattern>` (constant). SeCtor / SeMu / SeArrow use the conservative fallback until ux-parity defines their authoring syntax. Boundary legacy input is canonicalized before dispatch. Output is a plain STRING. Mirrors fenel-printer.ts:printSetExpr; dispatched from the TS wrapper; consumed by printType's $refined arm + printRefinementPredicate.

engine:printType.label: fenel-printer: printType
engine:printType.description: printer-substrate Phase 1 — the FenelType pretty-printer (the parser's type-grammar inverse): a `$`-free TtMarker tree → .fenel type surface. The TS marshal arm (printerTypeToMarker, engine-bodies-dispatch.ts) precomputes the hard recognitions (refHandle / peelList / peelMaybe / peelResult / peelEntityRef) and carries raw `$refined.set` (→ printSetExpr) + `$el` value args (→ printExpr); the body folds marker → string over the 17 constructors (TtRef/TtVar/TtVoid/TtUnit/TtList→[T]/TtMaybe→Maybe T/TtResult→Result E A/TtTuple/TtRecord/TtArrow/TtRefined→base where <set>/TtEntityRef→EntityRef<"X">/TtTagged→Tagged v p/TtMap→Map K V/TtVariant+TtLiteral+TtOther→precomputed JSON/TtOpaque→name/TtFunction→Fn<name>/TtEl→juxtaposition/TtType→Type/TtRaw→verbatim). Container applications print as juxtaposition with every compound argument parenthesised (ppTypeArg) and an arrow's arrow/refined parameter and refined result parenthesised, so every printed type re-parses (no `>>`; modules-as-values Phase 2d). Mirrors fenel-printer.ts:printType; the TS printType is now a thin marshal+dispatch shim.

engine:printTypeDef.label: fenel-printer: printTypeDef
engine:printTypeDef.description: printer-substrate Phase 1 — the type-def renderer (pTypeDef): a `$`-free Td marker (printerTypeDefToMarker, engine-bodies-dispatch.ts) → .fenel type-def surface. The form is precomputed (refined `Name = base | pred` / alias `Name = <type>` / Idris `data Name : kind where <ctors>` / variant `Name = Ctor f: T | …`); the body assembles the string (params join, `opaque "<repr>" ` + `@discriminator "<name>"` prefixes, positional-vs-named ctor fields, Phase-7d ` = <default>` via printExpr). Cross-calls printType (field/base/kindSig types) + printExpr (field defaults / `$where` preds). Mirrors fenel-printer.ts:pTypeDef; the TS px router's type_def arm is now a thin marshal+dispatch shim.

engine:processDoExprs.label: Process do exprs
engine:processDoExprs.description: Fold over a CeDo's exprs emitting per-expr instrs with target=DomUnknown for all but the last (with a Drop after when produced != DomUnknown to clear the stack), and target=outer-target for the last (whose produced domain becomes the CeDo's result domain). Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:802-822.

engine:processDoInter.label: Process do interior expr
engine:processDoInter.description: processDoExprs sub-helper for non-last exprs. Lowers e at DomUnknown, concats its instrs, appends Drop when produced != DomUnknown, and recurses on the remaining exprs.

engine:processDoLast.label: Process do last expr
engine:processDoLast.description: processDoExprs sub-helper for the last (target-domain) expr in a CeDo. Lowers e with target, concats its instrs onto acc, returns the result with the produced domain.

engine:processLetBindings.label: Process let bindings
engine:processLetBindings.description: Fold over a CeLet's bindings list emitting per-binding (value instrs, LocalSet idx) pairs and allocating a fresh local per binding via HasWasmBuilder.allocLocal. Mirrors the for-loop at compile-wasm.ts:786-799.

engine:productDisjoint.label: disjoint: productDisjoint
engine:productDisjoint.description: Phase 2.4 / floor-kernel Phase 3c / type-substrate P1(a.6) — require both complete products to pass the embedded/effective-coordinate, plan, reserved-wire, and occurrence-policy fence. Then require equal arity and mOr-fold disjointness over semantic-FieldKey-aligned factors. Both empty yields Just false; every failed preflight/alignment yields Nothing.

engine:productDisjointByKey.label: disjoint: productDisjointByKey
engine:productDisjointByKey.description: FieldKey-aligned product-disjoint fold after equal-arity and semantic-slot validation. Internal helper.

engine:programToFrames.label: Program to frames
engine:programToFrames.description: Map the Fenel parser's program output `[{frame, directives}]` into the loader's frame list (the flattenProgram(parse src) shape): {type_sig|def|type_def|module_decl: …}. Bodies lowered via syntaxToJsonLogic; type slots kept as `{mk}` markers for the TS marshal; @discriminator lifted to the type_def slot; directives/params omitted when empty (TS-parse byte-parity). parser-substrate Phase 5a.

engine:projectCommittedAccountFieldRegis.label: Project committed account registry inputs
engine:projectCommittedAccountFieldRegis.description: Classify the live external Field roster, tombstone-inclusive UUID reservations, and live-target account facets for registry hydration. This is the sole liveness policy for committed snapshots; host adapters only marshal the result.

engine:projectFieldFacets.label: Project repository field facets
engine:projectFieldFacets.description: Project exactly one Codeable per live named FieldEntity and UUID-keyed optional source facets. Positional fields never enter the entity input and therefore cannot emit facets.

engine:projectFields.label: Project fields
engine:projectFields.description: The fold behind projectInstanceRow: walk a fieldOrder name list, `std:lookup` each on the instance, appending its value to the row; the first missing key short-circuits to Nothing (the total-row requirement). Empty / exhausted names ⇒ Just acc. Internal helper.

engine:projectInstanceRow.label: Project instance row
engine:projectInstanceRow.description: Project one flat merged-envelope instance row onto a fieldOrder column list ⇒ Maybe row (a positional scalar list in column order). `std:lookup` each name in order; ANY missing field ⇒ Nothing — the row is dropped upstream (a fact must be TOTAL; partial rows can't join honestly — the proven-rows spirit: only facts we fully read are asserted). Envelope fields (id / accountId / createdAt / updatedAt) project exactly like data fields — fieldOrder decides what projects. A variant-valued cell rides verbatim under Just (decision 4 — it projects but never matches a constant, by std eq's reference-shallowness). expr-substrate Phase 16.

engine:projectRows.label: Project rows
engine:projectRows.description: Project each row of a tuple-set onto the requested vars (via zipBindings + extendRow). Internal helper.

engine:projectTupleSet.label: Project tuple set
engine:projectTupleSet.description: Project a tuple-set onto the requested var list (dropping unfold-introduced join vars), deduping the resulting rows. Internal helper.

engine:propAddBounds.label: propagate: add bounds
engine:propAddBounds.description: Add two bounds (Just{value,inclusive}): present ⟺ both present; value = sum, inclusive = both inclusive; either unbounded ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:propAddIv.label: propagate: add intervals
engine:propAddIv.description: Interval addition [aL,aH]+[bL,bH] = [aL+bL, aH+bH] (an unbounded operand bound makes the result bound unbounded). Internal helper.

engine:propAlNonNeg.label: propagate: dividend lo ≥ 0?
engine:propAlNonNeg.description: True when the dividend interval's lo bound is ≥ 0 (unbounded ⇒ −∞ ⇒ False) — selects the [0,maxB) vs (-maxB,maxB) mod range. Internal helper.

engine:propAllIntervals.label: propagate: all intervals?
engine:propAllIntervals.description: True when every marker in the list is an interval (the min/max numeric-reduce guard). Internal helper.

engine:propAnd.label: propagate: and
engine:propAnd.description: Eager boolean conjunction used throughout the propagate transfer functions (avoids the lazy `and`-operator structural form — the assignable.fenel assignBoth precedent). Returns True only when both operands are True. Internal helper.

engine:propAppendIfJust.label: propagate: append if Just
engine:propAppendIfJust.description: Append a Maybe's payload to the accumulator when Just; leave it unchanged when Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:propArithVal.label: propagate: scalar arith
engine:propArithVal.description: Scalar arithmetic va OP vb ⇒ Just result; ÷0 and %0 ⇒ Nothing (the undefined cases dropped from the enum). Internal helper.

engine:propBinaryArith.label: propagate: binary arith
engine:propBinaryArith.description: Binary arithmetic transfer over two Se* SetExprs: $all/$none absorb; distribute over unions (join) and intersections (meet, a sound approximation); interval×interval ⇒ corner arithmetic; enum×enum ⇒ pointwise; enum×interval ⇒ distribute; named×named ⇒ the tower closure; named×(interval|enum) ⇒ widen to the named set; otherwise SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:propBinaryCompare.label: propagate: binary compare
engine:propBinaryCompare.description: Binary comparison transfer over two Se* SetExprs: $none absorbs; distribute over unions; interval×interval ⇒ bound-ordering decision (proven [true] / [false] / [true,false]); enum×enum ⇒ pointwise (a single distinct result narrows, else [true,false]); otherwise [true,false]. Internal helper.

engine:propBinaryHead.label: propagate: binary head
engine:propBinaryHead.description: Apply the binary transfer to the first two input markers: arithmetic (+ - * / %), comparison (> >= < <= == != === !==), or cat (variadic, folds the whole list); any other op ⇒ SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:propCanonicalOf.label: propagate: canonical tower symbol
engine:propCanonicalOf.description: Canonicalise a tower name to its symbol (Nat→ℕ, Int→ℤ, Rational→ℚ, Real→ℝ; the symbols map to themselves). Internal helper.

engine:propCatFold.label: propagate: cat fold
engine:propCatFold.description: Variadic string concatenation: left-fold the inputs through concatSets (enum×enum string product, else the String set). Internal helper.

engine:propCatFoldGo.label: propagate: cat fold go
engine:propCatFoldGo.description: Accumulator-threaded fold of the remaining cat inputs through concatSets. Internal helper.

engine:propCmpGe.label: propagate: compare >=
engine:propCmpGe.description: a >= b on intervals: proven true when aLo > bHi (or equal with both inclusive); proven false when aHi < bLo; else undecided. Internal helper.

engine:propCmpGt.label: propagate: compare >
engine:propCmpGt.description: a > b on intervals: proven true when aLo > bHi; proven false when aHi < bLo (or equal with an exclusive touch); else undecided. Internal helper.

engine:propCmpLe.label: propagate: compare <=
engine:propCmpLe.description: a <= b on intervals: proven true when aHi < bLo (or equal with both inclusive); proven false when aLo > bHi; else undecided. Internal helper.

engine:propCmpLt.label: propagate: compare <
engine:propCmpLt.description: a < b on intervals: proven true when aHi < bLo; proven false when aLo > bHi (or equal with both inclusive); else undecided. Internal helper.

engine:propCollectJusts.label: propagate: collect Justs
engine:propCollectJusts.description: Collect the Just payloads of a Maybe list, preserving order (drops the Nothing entries — the non-finite corners). Internal helper.

engine:propCompareBool.label: propagate: scalar compare
engine:propCompareBool.description: Scalar comparison va OP vb ⇒ Just bool over > >= < <= == === != !== (== / === and != / !== coincide on numbers); any other op ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:propCompareIv.label: propagate: compare intervals
engine:propCompareIv.description: Decide an interval comparison from the bound ordering: proven [true] / [false] when the intervals are bound-separated, else the undecided [true,false]. Internal helper.

engine:propConcatInner.label: propagate: concat inner
engine:propConcatInner.description: Inner loop of the enum×enum string product — append va++vb for each string vb (non-string operands skipped). Internal helper.

engine:propConcatOuter.label: propagate: concat outer
engine:propConcatOuter.description: Outer loop of the enum×enum string product — over the left values. Internal helper.

engine:propConcatSets.label: propagate: concat sets
engine:propConcatSets.description: String concatenation of two Se* SetExprs: enum×enum ⇒ the cartesian product of string values concatenated (empty ⇒ SeNone), anything else ⇒ the String set (SeRef "String"). Internal helper.

engine:propCorner.label: propagate: corner
engine:propCorner.description: One corner product of two bounds: Just{ value = product, inclusive = both inclusive } when both present, else Nothing (the non-finite corner — excluded by the finite-filter). Internal helper.

engine:propCornerFold.label: propagate: corner fold
engine:propCornerFold.description: Accumulator-threaded fold of the remaining corners into the running { minV, minI, maxV, maxI }. Internal helper.

engine:propCornerMinMax.label: propagate: corner min/max
engine:propCornerMinMax.description: Fold the finite corner list to { minV, minI, maxV, maxI } — the value range with exclusive-on-tie inclusivity (an inclusive corner at the extreme makes the bound inclusive). Seeds from the first corner. Internal helper.

engine:propCornerStep.label: propagate: corner step
engine:propCornerStep.description: Fold one corner into the running min/max accumulator. Internal helper.

engine:propDisjoint.label: Prop: disjoint
engine:propDisjoint.description: The disjointness claim builder (decide-substrate Phase 2 K4 — the retired PropDisjoint constructor's vocabulary as a call): `propDisjoint s t` ⇒ the disjoint judgment `JEmpty (SeIntersect [t, s])` via jopDisjoint — s ∩ t empty. The proposer + kernel shape-recognize it (recheckPlan) back to isDisjoint(s, t).

engine:propDivIv.label: propagate: div intervals
engine:propDivIv.description: Interval division a / b: a divisor straddling zero (or with an inclusive-zero endpoint) ⇒ SeAll (unbounded); otherwise the reciprocal of b (flip + swap bounds, 1/±∞ = 0) multiplied by a. Internal helper.

engine:propDivUnbounded.label: propagate: div unbounded?
engine:propDivUnbounded.description: True when the divisor interval forces an unbounded quotient: it straddles zero (lo < 0 and hi > 0, with an unbounded side counting as ∓∞), or has an inclusive-zero endpoint. Internal helper.

engine:propEmpty.label: Prop: empty
engine:propEmpty.description: The emptiness claim builder (decide-substrate Phase 2 K4 — the retired PropEmpty constructor's vocabulary as a call): `propEmpty s` ⇒ the bare emptiness judgment `JEmpty s`. The proposer + kernel re-decide it via decideEmpty(s).

engine:propEnum1.label: propagate: bool singleton
engine:propEnum1.description: A proven boolean set { v }. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumArith.label: propagate: enum arith
engine:propEnumArith.description: Pointwise arithmetic over two enum value lists: for every numeric (va, vb) compute va OP vb, dropping ÷0 / %0 and non-finite results, then dedupe (first-seen). Empty ⇒ SeNone. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumArithInner.label: propagate: enum arith inner
engine:propEnumArithInner.description: Inner loop of the enum×enum pointwise arithmetic — over the right values for a fixed left value. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumArithOne.label: propagate: enum arith one
engine:propEnumArithOne.description: Compute one va OP vb, appending the result when defined (not ÷0 / %0) and finite. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumArithOuter.label: propagate: enum arith outer
engine:propEnumArithOuter.description: Outer loop of the enum×enum pointwise arithmetic — over the left values. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumCmpInner.label: propagate: enum compare inner
engine:propEnumCmpInner.description: Inner loop of the enum×enum comparison — over the right values for a fixed left value. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumCmpOne.label: propagate: enum compare one
engine:propEnumCmpOne.description: Compare one numeric (va, vb), appending the boolean result; non-numeric operands are skipped. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumCmpOuter.label: propagate: enum compare outer
engine:propEnumCmpOuter.description: Outer loop of the enum×enum comparison — over the left values. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumCompare.label: propagate: enum compare
engine:propEnumCompare.description: Pointwise comparison over two enum value lists: collect the defined boolean results for every numeric (va, vb); exactly one distinct result narrows to { it }, else the undecided { true, false }. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumIvDist.label: propagate: enum × interval
engine:propEnumIvDist.description: Distribute an enum over an interval: each numeric enum value becomes a point interval, transferred through the op, unioned. Empty ⇒ SeNone. Internal helper.

engine:propEnumIvParts.label: propagate: enum × interval parts
engine:propEnumIvParts.description: Build the union branches of the enum×interval distribution (op applied to each numeric enum value as a point interval, on the left). Internal helper.

engine:propEnumTF.label: propagate: bool both
engine:propEnumTF.description: The undecided boolean set { true, false } — the comparison join when neither truth value is proven. Takes an ignored argument (a nullary body resolves to a function ref rather than its value — the bare-reference idiom; pass any in-scope value). Internal helper.

engine:propEqHiLo.label: propagate: aHi == bLo?
engine:propEqHiLo.description: Bound value equality aHi == bLo (both must be present/finite). Internal helper.

engine:propEqLoHi.label: propagate: aLo == bHi?
engine:propEqLoHi.description: Bound value equality aLo == bHi (both must be present/finite). Internal helper.

engine:propFirstOf.label: propagate: first of
engine:propFirstOf.description: The first marker of a list (empty ⇒ SeNone). Internal helper.

engine:propForallSet.label: Prop: forall over a set
engine:propForallSet.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 (Step D) — the ∀-presentation builder: `propForallSet varName domain property` presents `∀ varName ∈ domain. property` as the subset judgment `domain ⊆ ⟦{varName | property}⟧` = `propSubset domain (comprehend varName property)` (the judgment iso's PropForall row made callable — judgment.fenel header). A SeMu domain rides the shipped Park pipeline (proposeSubsetOk mu-induction cert → verifyMuInduction premise re-derivation → the 8μ.3 ctor⊆comprehension arm) to SolverChecked — the first genuine structural-induction proofs. The SAMPLE presentation stays untouched (the μ-shaped-domain alternative, producer-opt-in).

engine:propGeTrue.label: propagate: >= proven-true / < proven-false
engine:propGeTrue.description: aLo > bHi, or aLo == bHi with both bounds inclusive — the shared condition of `>=` proven-true and `<` proven-false. Internal helper.

engine:propGtFalse.label: propagate: > proven-false
engine:propGtFalse.description: aHi < bLo, or aHi == bLo with at least one exclusive touch — the `>` proven-false condition. Internal helper.

engine:propGtHiVal.label: propagate: hi-value >
engine:propGtHiVal.description: value(a) > value(b) for two HI bounds (unbounded ⇒ +∞): max-of-his selector. Internal helper.

engine:propGtLoHi.label: propagate: aLo > bHi?
engine:propGtLoHi.description: Bound ordering aLo > bHi (unbounded lo ⇒ −∞, unbounded hi ⇒ +∞, both make it false). Internal helper.

engine:propGtLoVal.label: propagate: lo-value >
engine:propGtLoVal.description: value(a) > value(b) for two LO bounds (unbounded ⇒ −∞): max-of-los selector. Internal helper.

engine:propHiPos.label: propagate: hi > 0?
engine:propHiPos.description: True when a hi bound is above zero (unbounded ⇒ +∞ ⇒ True). Internal helper.

engine:propInCanonical.label: propagate: in number tower?
engine:propInCanonical.description: True when a name is one of the number-tower sets (ℕ/Nat, ℤ/Int, ℚ/Rational, ℝ/Real). Internal helper.

engine:propIncOf.label: propagate: inclusive of
engine:propIncOf.description: A bound's inclusivity (unbounded ⇒ exclusive). Internal helper.

engine:propInhabited.label: Prop: inhabited
engine:propInhabited.description: The inhabitation claim builder (decide-substrate Phase 2 K4 — the retired PropInhabited constructor's vocabulary as a call): `propInhabited s` ⇒ the inhabited judgment `JInhabited s`. The proposer + kernel re-decide it via the INVERTED decideEmpty(s) (accept on Just false), or a witness proof re-checks {w} ⊆ s (verifyWitnessMembership).

engine:propIsArith.label: propagate: is arith op
engine:propIsArith.description: True for the binary arithmetic operators + - * / %. Internal helper.

engine:propIsCmp.label: propagate: is compare op
engine:propIsCmp.description: True for the binary comparison operators > >= < <= == != === !==. Internal helper.

engine:propIsIvOrEnum.label: propagate: is interval/enum?
engine:propIsIvOrEnum.description: True when a marker is an interval or an enum (the named×other widening guard). Internal helper.

engine:propIsMinMax.label: propagate: is min/max op
engine:propIsMinMax.description: True for the variadic interval-reduce operators min / max. Internal helper.

engine:propIsNeg.label: propagate: is negate op
engine:propIsNeg.description: True for the negation operators - / negate. Internal helper.

engine:propIsNot.label: propagate: is not op
engine:propIsNot.description: True for the boolean-negation operators ! / not. Internal helper.

engine:propIvEnumDist.label: propagate: interval × enum
engine:propIvEnumDist.description: Distribute an interval over an enum: each numeric enum value becomes a point interval on the RIGHT, transferred through the op, unioned. Empty ⇒ SeNone. Internal helper.

engine:propIvEnumParts.label: propagate: interval × enum parts
engine:propIvEnumParts.description: Build the union branches of the interval×enum distribution (op applied to the interval and each numeric enum value as a point interval, on the right). Internal helper.

engine:propIvOp.label: propagate: interval op
engine:propIvOp.description: Dispatch an arithmetic op (+ - * / %) over two interval markers to its transfer function; any other op ⇒ SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:propJustVal.label: propagate: just value
engine:propJustVal.description: Extract a present bound's value (Nothing ⇒ 0 — only called on present bounds). Internal helper.

engine:propLeTrue.label: propagate: <= proven-true
engine:propLeTrue.description: aHi < bLo, or aHi == bLo with both bounds inclusive — the `<=` proven-true condition. Internal helper.

engine:propLoNeg.label: propagate: lo < 0?
engine:propLoNeg.description: True when a lo bound is below zero (unbounded ⇒ −∞ ⇒ True). Internal helper.

engine:propLtHiLo.label: propagate: aHi < bLo?
engine:propLtHiLo.description: Bound ordering aHi < bLo (unbounded hi ⇒ +∞, unbounded lo ⇒ −∞, both make it false). Internal helper.

engine:propLtHiVal.label: propagate: hi-value <
engine:propLtHiVal.description: value(a) < value(b) for two HI bounds (unbounded ⇒ +∞): min-of-his selector. Internal helper.

engine:propLtLoVal.label: propagate: lo-value <
engine:propLtLoVal.description: value(a) < value(b) for two LO bounds (unbounded ⇒ −∞): min-of-los selector. Internal helper.

engine:propMinMax.label: propagate: min/max
engine:propMinMax.description: Variadic min / max: empty ⇒ SeNone; one input ⇒ itself; all-intervals ⇒ the reduced interval (per-bound min-value for min, max-value for max, treating unbounded as ∓∞); a mixed (non-all-interval) input set ⇒ SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:propMinMaxIv.label: propagate: min/max intervals
engine:propMinMaxIv.description: Reduce an all-intervals min/max: min ⇒ the per-bound smaller value, max ⇒ the per-bound larger value (unbounded counts as ∓∞ in the chosen direction). Internal helper.

engine:propModIv.label: propagate: mod intervals
engine:propModIv.description: Interval modulo a % b: an unbounded divisor ⇒ SeAll; otherwise the magnitude maxB = max(|bLo|,|bHi|) bounds the result — [0, maxB) when the dividend lo is ≥ 0, else (-maxB, maxB). Internal helper.

engine:propModMaxB.label: propagate: mod maxB
engine:propModMaxB.description: max(|bLo|, |bHi|) for a bounded divisor interval (both bounds present here). Internal helper.

engine:propModUnbounded.label: propagate: mod unbounded?
engine:propModUnbounded.description: True when either divisor bound is unbounded (⇒ |bound| = ∞ ⇒ maxB non-finite ⇒ SeAll). Internal helper.

engine:propMulCorners.label: propagate: mul corners
engine:propMulCorners.description: The four corner products of two intervals, in the order (aL·bL, aL·bH, aH·bL, aH·bH), keeping only the finite ones (both factor bounds present). Each kept corner carries { value, inclusive }. Internal helper.

engine:propMulIv.label: propagate: mul intervals
engine:propMulIv.description: Interval multiplication via the four corner products [aL,aH]·[bL,bH], keeping only the FINITE corners (a corner is finite ⟺ both factors are present bounds — which also drops the 0·∞ = NaN case), then the min / max of those corners (exclusive-on-tie unless an inclusive corner matches). No finite corner ⇒ SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:propMulIvBounds.label: propagate: mul interval bounds
engine:propMulIvBounds.description: The interval-multiplication kernel over explicit lo/hi bounds (reused by div via the reciprocal). Internal helper.

engine:propN.label: infer: normalize via propagate
engine:propN.description: Apply the binary/variadic propagate transfer then normalize the result (the legacy per-propagate normalize point). Internal helper.

engine:propNamedArith.label: propagate: named arith
engine:propNamedArith.description: The type-level closure: what named set does `a op b` inhabit over the ℕ⊂ℤ⊂ℚ⊂ℝ widening lattice? + * % ⇒ the wider of the two; - ⇒ the wider, widened ℕ→ℤ (subtraction leaves ℕ); / ⇒ the wider, widened ℕ/ℤ→ℚ (division leaves the integers). A non-tower name ⇒ SeAll. Orthogonal to the numeric-tower arc's value-level ops (D-3b-3). Internal helper.

engine:propNamedArithOp.label: propagate: named arith op
engine:propNamedArithOp.description: Map the op + the widened tower symbol to the result named-set ref: + * % ⇒ w; - ⇒ ℤ if w is ℕ else w; / ⇒ ℚ if w is ℕ/ℤ else w. Internal helper.

engine:propNamedSelf.label: propagate: named self-widen
engine:propNamedSelf.description: Conservatively widen a named-tower set against a non-named operand: the tower closure of the name with itself (a non-tower name ⇒ SeAll). Internal helper.

engine:propNegBound.label: propagate: negate bound
engine:propNegBound.description: Negate an interval bound (value ↦ −value, inclusivity preserved; unbounded stays unbounded). Internal helper.

engine:propNegRef.label: propagate: negate named
engine:propNegRef.description: Negate a named-tower set: ℕ widens to ℤ (negatives leave ℕ); the other tower sets keep their name; a non-tower name ⇒ SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:propNegVal.label: propagate: negate value
engine:propNegVal.description: Negate an enum value when numeric, else pass through. Internal helper.

engine:propNegate.label: propagate: negate
engine:propNegate.description: Negate an Se* SetExpr: an interval flips to [-hi, -lo]; an enum maps numbers to their negatives (non-numbers pass through); a named-tower set widens (−ℕ ⊂ ℤ, others keep their name); a non-tower ref / anything else ⇒ SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:propNot.label: propagate: not
engine:propNot.description: Boolean negation of an Se* SetExpr: an enum maps each value to its boolean negation (JS truthiness); anything else ⇒ the undecided { true, false }. Internal helper.

engine:propNotBothInc.label: propagate: not both inclusive
engine:propNotBothInc.description: True when at least one of two inclusivity flags is exclusive (¬(x ∧ y)). Internal helper.

engine:propNotVal.label: propagate: not value
engine:propNotVal.description: Boolean negation of one value (JS truthiness: falsy ↦ True, truthy ↦ False). Internal helper.

engine:propOrderIndex.label: propagate: tower index
engine:propOrderIndex.description: The ℕ⊂ℤ⊂ℚ⊂ℝ ordinal of a tower symbol (ℕ=0, ℤ=1, ℚ=2, ℝ=3). Internal helper.

engine:propOrderName.label: propagate: tower symbol of index
engine:propOrderName.description: The tower symbol for an ordinal (0→ℕ, 1→ℤ, 2→ℚ, else ℝ). Internal helper.

engine:propPointIv.label: propagate: point interval
engine:propPointIv.description: The point interval [v, v] (inclusive both ends) — the enum-value-as-interval lift used by the enum×interval distribution. Internal helper.

engine:propRecipFromHi.label: propagate: reciprocal lo (from hi)
engine:propRecipFromHi.description: The reciprocal interval's LO bound, 1/bHi: an unbounded bHi (+∞) ⇒ 0 exclusive; a zero-valued bHi ⇒ ∞ ⇒ unbounded (Nothing) — matching the legacy 1/0 = ∞ corner-filter (Fenel `div` returns 0, not ∞, on a zero divisor, so the zero is caught explicitly); otherwise 1/value. Internal helper.

engine:propRecipFromLo.label: propagate: reciprocal hi (from lo)
engine:propRecipFromLo.description: The reciprocal interval's HI bound, 1/bLo: an unbounded bLo (−∞) ⇒ 0 exclusive; a zero-valued bLo ⇒ ∞ ⇒ unbounded (Nothing); otherwise 1/value. Internal helper.

engine:propReciprocal.label: propagate: reciprocal bound
engine:propReciprocal.description: 1/value as a bound: a zero value ⇒ ∞ ⇒ Nothing (unbounded — the legacy 1/0 = ∞ corner-filter, since Fenel `div` returns 0 on a zero divisor); otherwise Just{1/value, inclusive} (1/finite-nonzero is always finite). Internal helper.

engine:propReduceBounds.label: propagate: reduce bounds
engine:propReduceBounds.description: Fold a non-empty bound list keeping the bound the comparator prefers (the min/max-value selection, ties to the later element — mirrors the legacy `reduce` with no seed). Internal helper.

engine:propReduceBoundsGo.label: propagate: reduce bounds go
engine:propReduceBoundsGo.description: Accumulator-threaded fold for propReduceBounds: keep `acc` when the comparator prefers it over the next bound, else take the next. Internal helper.

engine:propRefMarker.label: propagate: ref marker
engine:propRefMarker.description: A named-set reference marker (an `SeRef`). Internal helper.

engine:propSubBounds.label: propagate: sub bounds
engine:propSubBounds.description: Subtract two bounds: present ⟺ both present; value = difference, inclusive = both inclusive; either unbounded ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:propSubIv.label: propagate: sub intervals
engine:propSubIv.description: Interval subtraction [aL,aH]-[bL,bH] = [aL-bH, aH-bL] (cross bounds). Internal helper.

engine:propSubset.label: Prop: subset
engine:propSubset.description: The subset claim builder (decide-substrate Phase 2 K4 — the retired PropSubset constructor's vocabulary as a call): `propSubset s t` ⇒ the subset judgment `JEmpty (SeIntersect [SeComplement t, s])` via jopSubset — s ⊆ t ≡ s ∩ ¬t empty. The proposer + kernel shape-recognize it (recheckPlan) back to isSubset(s, t).

engine:propUnary.label: propagate: unary
engine:propUnary.description: Unary transfer over an Se* SetExpr: $none absorbs; distribute over unions; negate (- / negate) ⇒ interval flip / enum map / named-tower widen (−ℕ ⊂ ℤ); not (! / not) ⇒ enum boolean flip, else { true, false }; otherwise SeAll. Internal helper.

engine:propUnaryHead.label: propagate: unary head
engine:propUnaryHead.description: Apply the unary transfer to the single input marker (head of the list). Internal helper.

engine:propUpdMax.label: propagate: update max
engine:propUpdMax.description: Update the running max by one corner: strictly-larger value replaces it (taking that corner's inclusivity); an equal-valued inclusive corner promotes the bound to inclusive. Internal helper.

engine:propUpdMin.label: propagate: update min
engine:propUpdMin.description: Update the running min by one corner: strictly-smaller value replaces it (taking that corner's inclusivity); an equal-valued inclusive corner promotes the bound to inclusive. Internal helper.

engine:propWiderName.label: propagate: wider name
engine:propWiderName.description: The wider of two tower names (the larger ℕ⊂ℤ⊂ℚ⊂ℝ ordinal), as a symbol. Internal helper.

engine:propZeroIncl.label: propagate: inclusive zero?
engine:propZeroIncl.description: True when a bound is exactly zero AND inclusive (the division-by-zero guard). Internal helper.

engine:propagate.label: Propagate
engine:propagate.description: Forward type propagation (abstract interpretation): compute the output SetExpr of an operator from its input SetExprs, over the lattice top=$all / bottom=$none / join=$union / meet=$intersect. Works over the canonical registered `$tag` `Se*` SetExpr directly (the TS delegate passes inputs through `setExprToTag` + runs the final normalize). One input ⇒ unary (negate / not, distributing over unions); op min/max ⇒ a variadic interval reduce; ≥2 inputs ⇒ binary arithmetic (+ - * / %, interval-corner / enum-pointwise / named-tower-closure transfer), comparison (> >= < <= == != === !==, bound-ordering / enum-pointwise), or cat (string-enum product else String). The port of fenel-check's propagate onto the Fenel set-algebra substrate. unified-static-analysis Phase 3b-1.

engine:propagateCeVarDomain.label: Propagate CeVar domain
engine:propagateCeVarDomain.description: Refine a CeVar's binding domain in the env, honouring the dotted-name HEAD special case. For dotted names the HEAD binding refines to DomRef regardless of `expected` (the record/ADT handle MUST be externref so the getFieldNamed chain can dereference it). For undotted names the binding refines to `expected`. Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:263.

engine:propagateLlvmCeVarDomain.label: LLVM inference: propagateLlvmCeVarDomain
engine:propagateLlvmCeVarDomain.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:proposeDecidableSet.label: Propose decidable set
engine:proposeDecidableSet.description: The DecidableSetProver's routing + grading, Fenel-bodied (expr-substrate Phase 6b0; PropInhabited arm 6b; PLAN-DRIVEN decide-substrate Phase 2 K3): the claim — a closed-sum Proposition (compat until K4) or a JUDGMENT (JEmpty/JInhabited, the K2+ producer currency) — resolves through the shared shape recognizer (recheckPlan, judgment.fenel) to the re-check plan {kind, s, t}; kinds subset/disjoint/empty grade the pre-computed tri-state decide outcome ('true' ⇒ Ok with the {left, right?} witness from the plan's ORIGINAL (s, t); 'false' ⇒ Err WitnessError with the refutation counterexample; 'unknown' ⇒ Err Undecided). Kind nonempty INVERTS the decideEmpty outcome ('false' = non-empty ⇒ Ok kind=nonempty; 'true' = empty ⇒ Err WitnessError inhabited-refuted). Non-decidable claims ⇒ OutOfScope (Prop-prefixed ⇒ 'doesn't handle'; anything else ⇒ 'expects a structured Proposition'). Returns a plain-record marker; the TS native maps it to the Ok ProofTerm / Err UnprovedReason shapes. The decide itself (isSubset/isDisjoint/decideEmpty) is the justified TS re-entry bridge, keyed on the SAME plan.

engine:proposeMonotonic.label: Propose monotonic
engine:proposeMonotonic.description: The MonotonicityProver's decision ladder, Fenel-bodied (expr-substrate Phase 6b0): requires the PropMonotonic shape (shapeOk — the `$tag`/typeof extraction is the TS boundary), a registered Aggregable instance (isAgg — registry bridge), resolvable methods (hasMethods), a well-formed monotonicity value (monoShapeOk); a Monotone tag ⇒ the SampleTestResult claim `Monotonic.<agg>` (1 sample); any other tag ⇒ Err WitnessError { kind = monotonicity-refuted, agg, monotonicity }. Returns a plain-record marker; the TS native maps it.

engine:proposeNonemptyViaSearch.label: Propose nonempty via search
engine:proposeNonemptyViaSearch.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 Step E — the nonempty (JInhabited) arm's search widening: when decideEmpty is undecided (decision "unknown"), run the fuel-bounded witness search over the set; SvFound w ⇒ the kind="witness" DecidableSetResult (the K3 witness-membership rule's first producer — the kernel re-checks {w} ⊆ s, so an untrusted or tampered witness is rejected); no witness ⇒ Undecided. Returns a plain-record marker; the TS native maps kind="witness" to the witness ProofTerm. Internal helper.

engine:proposeSampleTest.label: Propose sample test
engine:proposeSampleTest.description: The SampleTestProver's logic, Fenel-bodied (expr-substrate Phase 6b0): guards the structured-Proposition shape, requires PropForall, requires a non-empty inline samples list (count 0 ⇒ Undecided — 'pull from Exemplifiable' is a future version), enforces the 200-sample budget (BudgetExceeded carries the counts), else claims SampleTestResult { propertyId, samplesChecked, allPassed = true }. The kernel re-checks the claim's shape. Returns a plain-record marker; the TS native maps it.

engine:proposeSubsetOk.label: Propose subset ok
engine:proposeSubsetOk.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — the subset arm's Ok-certificate chooser: when the subset LHS `s` is a μ (SeMu), emit the STRONGER Park certificate kind="mu-induction" (the kernel re-derives the premise F[X:=T] via verifyMuInduction — the first new trusted-kernel rule since the witness rule); else the ordinary kind="subset" certificate. Both carry the {left = s, right = t} witness (a convenience — the kernel re-derives from the claim's recognized (s, t), so a tampered witness cannot fool it). Returns a plain-record marker; the TS native maps kind="mu-induction" to the DecidableSetResult ProofTerm (the ledgered $-key marshal). Internal helper.

engine:providerBatchMode.label: Choose provider batch invocation
engine:providerBatchMode.description: Choose getBatch versus scalar fallback from the host-projected capability fact. TypeScript may observe whether the optional IO closure exists, but this Fenel body owns the invocation policy.

engine:providerEntityMergeDecision.label: Select entity provider merge rows
engine:providerEntityMergeDecision.description: Select defined entity-provider rows and reject duplicate current wire projections before the host authors a dynamic wire-keyed object. The decision is computed only after all async leaves have completed, preserving atomic merge.

engine:providerSelectResolvedRows.label: Select provider batch results
engine:providerSelectResolvedRows.description: Return only requested, defined provider rows in requested-key order. Extra keys, absent keys, duplicate requested keys, and explicit undefined/Nothing rows are resolved here, never by host object iteration policy.

engine:publicFieldRootBindingMatches.label: Check public root binding
engine:publicFieldRootBindingMatches.description: Refuse a public type read when its account identity or exact declaration no longer matches the coherent Field graph. Repository roots require the same repository declaration and no new account shadow. This compares captured data versions, not semantic type equivalence.

engine:qualifiedMethodParts.label: Qualified-method parts
engine:qualifiedMethodParts.description: The qualified-method-head discriminant (asQualifiedMethod parity, fenel-parser.ts:2451): split on the FIRST `.`; ⇒ `{found = true, cls, method}` IFF exactly one dot (not first/last char), upper-initial class, lower-initial method, else `{found = false}`. `Foldable.foldr` ✓; `Maybe.Just`/`bot.token`/`std.map`/`A.b.c` ✗. A plain-record sentinel (NOT a Maybe). fenel-surface-extensions Phase 6.

engine:queryFieldResurrectionCandidates.label: Query owner field resurrections
engine:queryFieldResurrectionCandidates.description: List only the account tombstones retained for one exact owner. This is the explicit resurrection catalog; ordinary reuse queries remain live-only.

engine:queryFieldReuseCatalog.label: Query reusable fields
engine:queryFieldReuseCatalog.description: Filter the combined account/repository field catalog by liveness and explicit reuse visibility, then apply deterministic search and cursor pagination. Tombstones and owner-local/internal repository fields never escape.

engine:queryFnRel.label: Query fn relational
engine:queryFnRel.description: The reify-composed findall query entry: materialize relDef markers + rules into the facts env, then solveFnRelAll (reify the marshalled Fn value to its Expr body + captures, the lambda's PARAMS as the ordered unknowns) ⇒ EVERY satisfying binding. The lambda form of queryRel — `\x y -> and (boughtBook x "book-b") (joinedDay y) ...`. reify's Err (bodyless / native) ⇒ Nothing; safe-but-empty ⇒ Just []; unsafe ⇒ Nothing. expr-substrate Phase 16.

engine:queryFnRelOne.label: Query fn relational one
engine:queryFnRelOne.description: The reify-composed first-witness query entry: materialize relDef markers + rules into the facts env, then solveFnRel (reify, the params as the ordered unknowns, the FIRST satisfying binding) ⇒ Maybe (List binding). The lambda form of queryRelOne. reify's Err ⇒ Nothing; no satisfying row ⇒ Nothing. expr-substrate Phase 16.

engine:queryRel.label: Query relational
engine:queryRel.description: queries = solve ∘ materialize (the findall entry): materialize relDef markers + rules into the P13 facts env (factsFromDefs), then enumerate ALL satisfying bindings of a multi-binder predicate `Expr` (solveRelAll over collectFreeVars order) ⇒ Maybe (List bindings). THE engine-side query primitive: a user query ('bought book B ∧ joined < 3 days') = a predicate over materialized entity-instance relations. `Just []` = query SAFE but no satisfying rows; `Nothing` = unsafe / out-of-fragment (the inherited P15 split). The production exposure (a `state:queryRel` orchestration fn calling the live `listInstancesByName → relDef`) rides the engine→SYSTEM_MODULES decision (decision 6). expr-substrate Phase 16.

engine:queryRelOne.label: Query relational one
engine:queryRelOne.description: The first-witness sibling of queryRel: materialize relDef markers + rules into the facts env, then solveRel (the first satisfying binding) ⇒ Maybe (List binding). `Nothing` = unsafe / out-of-fragment / no satisfying row (solveRel folds safe-but-empty back to Nothing via witTuples-on-empty — the P13 first-witness behaviour). expr-substrate Phase 16.

engine:reachableNames.label: Reachable names
engine:reachableNames.description: The transitive closure of production names reachable from `root` via `PRef` over env `g` (the reachability-prune frontier of the strict step — only these productions get derived). 7h S2: builds the name→Pat env INDEX once (`fromEntries`) and threads it to the worklist BFS so each `bodyOf` is an O(1) `mapGet`, not an O(|g|) scan. Internal helper.

engine:readStringField.label: identifiable: readStringField
engine:readStringField.description: Phase 10b sub-step 2 — pure helper: scan a pre-extracted candidate list for the first non-empty trimmed string. Tail-recursive walk over the bounded (2-4 element) list emitted by the *OfValue wrappers. Returns `Just first-non-empty` or `Nothing`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:readStringField.

engine:rebuildAlt.label: Rebuild alt
engine:rebuildAlt.description: Rebuild a right-nested PAlt from a (deduped, non-empty) branch list: [] ⇒ PEmpty; a singleton ⇒ itself; else PAlt head (rebuild tail). Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:recheckPlan.label: Recheck plan
engine:recheckPlan.description: The tri-precision dispatch's SHAPE half (decide-substrate Phase 2 K3): claim (a closed-sum Proposition, compat until K4, or a Judgment) → the re-check plan { kind = subset|disjoint|empty|nonempty|other, s, t? }. Prop* claims read tag+fields (byte-identical to the retired TS tag-ladders); Judgment claims SHAPE-RECOGNIZE the composed set — JEmpty (SeIntersect [¬t, s]) ⇒ subset(s,t), JEmpty (SeIntersect [t, s]) ⇒ disjoint(s,t), bare JEmpty s ⇒ empty(s), JInhabited s ⇒ nonempty(s) — never a naive decideEmpty over the composed intersection (tri-precision, design/deciding.md §3). Returns the ORIGINAL (s, t) out of the composed set for the witness anti-repurpose deepEqual. Shared by the proposer + the kernel + the TS decide seams. Internal helper.

engine:recognizeAggregableComposition.label: set-algebra: recognizeAggregableComposition
engine:recognizeAggregableComposition.description: Phase 2a (set-algebra-to-fenel) — recognise `agg(value) <op> K` / `K <op> agg(value)` / `agg(value) in [...]` inside a $where predicate, where `agg` is a registered Aggregable (membership checked against the fed `aggNames: List String` data table). Lifts to a canonical `Se*` output-space set via compToSet (comparisons) or SeEnum (`in`) — decide-substrate Phase 3 (the Wes*/Cts* marker layer RETIRED). Operates on a pre-marshalled JsonLogicAggExpr (the marshaller surfaces the call(aggFn, var(value)) operand). Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:recognizeAggregableComposition.

engine:recognizeG.label: Recognize G
engine:recognizeG.description: Does the token list `toks` match production `start` of grammar `g`? Folds the strict whole-grammar derivative over `toks` (suffixes start at 1, fixpoints threaded incrementally), then tests nullability of the residual root under the residual env. Single-result; left/mutual recursion terminate. The differential oracle wraps a ref-free root as a singleton grammar. parser-substrate Phase 1.

engine:reconcileNamedFieldOccurrencesKer.label: Reconcile named field occurrences
engine:reconcileNamedFieldOccurrencesKer.description: Classify a code-editor parse using exact Codeable matches first, positional rename fallback second, and explicit mint actions last. The host may materialize entropy only for MintReconciledField actions.

engine:recordFieldDepth.label: subset: recordFieldDepth
engine:recordFieldDepth.description: Phase 5 (E-erasable) — the present-field verdict of recordFieldSub (have HAS the want-field): if the want-field is REQUIRED (not Undefinable) but the have-field is Undefinable (erasable) ⇒ Just false (have may lack the value); else covariant subset on the field types. Reproduces isSubtype's `!bErasable && aErasable ⇒ false` record-depth gate (the Undefinable dispatch via isErasableType over the raw field types). Internal helper.

engine:recordFieldSub.label: subset: recordFieldSub
engine:recordFieldSub.description: Phase 6 Step 2b / type-substrate P1(a.6) — one already-gated want axis. A present semantic FieldKey checks optionality and covariant depth. An absent erasable want key now abstains: omission permission does not constrain an extra property admitted by the open have record. An absent required key retains the witness-graded refutation, with embedded-wire ambiguity conservative and have-inhabitance handled by recordSubGated.

engine:recordSub.label: subset: recordSub
engine:recordSub.description: Phase 6 Step 2b / type-substrate P1(a.6) — record width/depth fold entered only through recordSubGated's complete keyed-product face fence. Matching uses semantic FieldKey and covariant occurrence type; extra have axes remain open-record axes.

engine:recordSubGated.label: subset: recordSubGated
engine:recordSubGated.description: field-identity Phase 4 / type-substrate P1(a.6) — shared record/variant-payload wrapper. Before any width, depth, optionality, or inhabitance verdict, both complete products must pass scoped-effective and embedded coordinate injectivity/alignment, reserved-wire, eager child-plan, and enforcing-widget occurrence checks. A surviving Just false still consults product emptiness so an empty have is vacuously contained.

engine:recordToIntersect.label: Record to intersect
engine:recordToIntersect.description: ISO-4 fwd witness (containment-substrate Phase 2 Step 2): re-read a `$record` (marshalled `TtRecord`) as the `∩` of single-field-presence records (`{x:A,y:B}` ⇒ `{x:A} ∩ {y:B}`) — the OPEN reading, which holds on the nose because Fenel width-subtypes records. The closed reading adds a completeness `$el` predicate. Works at the marshalled `TraversalType` level (the $-key barrier). WITNESS, not rewrite. Non-record input passes through unchanged.

engine:recordToTuple.label: Identified record to tuple
engine:recordToTuple.description: Inverse of tupleToRecord. Validates key/ordinal/wire agreement and rejects any named field.

engine:reenterHave.label: subset: reenterHave
engine:reenterHave.description: Phase 5 (R-resolve) — after resolving the have side: a referent that is ITSELF a TtNamed (a self/chain ref) re-enters resolveHaveSide WITH the accumulated seen (so a cycle is caught); a structural referent recurses the finite subsetW (sound mode, fresh memo — the structural tree terminates on its own). Internal helper.

engine:reenterWant.label: subset: reenterWant
engine:reenterWant.description: Phase 5 (R-resolve) — after resolving the want side: a still-named referent re-enters resolveWantSide with seen (cycle guard); a structural referent recurses the finite subsetW. Internal helper.

engine:refEntityTypeOf.label: field-meta: refEntityTypeOf
engine:refEntityTypeOf.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — derive a FieldDef typed-reference entity name by delegating over its optional shared TraversalType. All phantom-enum and string recognition remains Fenel-owned. Dispatched via `dispatchedRefEntityTypeOf`.

engine:referencesAnyName.label: References any name
engine:referencesAnyName.description: Predicate: does `ast` reference ANY name in the given list? Used by needsNesting to check whether the current binding's value depends on any earlier-binding name. The outer-loop analogue of referencesName for one ast vs many names.

engine:referencesName.label: References name
engine:referencesName.description: Conservative free-variable check used by the serializer to pick between flat-IIFE and nested-IIFE shapes for `let` blocks. 12-arm Bool walker. JsVar uses prefix-with-dot match (`ast.name === name || ast.name.startsWith(name + ".")`) to handle dotted-path references like `scanResult.effects` depending on outer `scanResult` binding. JsArrow / JsLet are shadow-aware: JsArrow.params shadow the outer name; JsLet checks binding values FIRST (outer scope) then shadowing for the body.

engine:referencesNameInBindingValues.label: References name in binding values
engine:referencesNameInBindingValues.description: OR-fold of `referencesName b.value name` over a list of {name, value} bindings. Used by referencesName's JsLet arm to check whether any binding's value (which lives in the OUTER scope) refers to `name`.

engine:referencesNameInFieldValues.label: References name in field values
engine:referencesNameInFieldValues.description: OR-fold of `referencesName f.value name` over a list of {key, value} fields. Used by referencesName's JsObject arm.

engine:referencesNameList.label: References name (list)
engine:referencesNameList.description: OR-fold of `referencesName a name` over a list of JsAst. Used by referencesName's JsCall.args, JsArray.elements, JsSequence.exprs arms.

engine:refineCeIfBranches.label: Refine CeIf branches
engine:refineCeIfBranches.description: Phase 5b13 cross-arm domain refinement for CeIf. When one branch's CeVar is DomUnknown and the other branch has a known concrete domain (DomBool / DomNum), propagate the concrete domain to the CeVar's env entry so a Bool-typed parameter used in a then-arm doesn't default to DomNum at the wrapper boundary. Returns the (possibly updated) {thenDom, elseDom} pair.

engine:refineDomain.label: Refine domain (one-way)
engine:refineDomain.description: One-way env refinement primitive. setDomain iff the current entry is Nothing or DomUnknown — never overwrites a concrete domain. Returns True as a unit-like placeholder. Mirrors the inner guard at compile-wasm.ts:propagateCeVarDomain.

engine:refineHasBound.label: refine: refineHasBound
