engine:refineHasBound.description: Phase 7 — true when at least one of the two interval bounds is a Just (a genuine narrowing); both-Nothing is the universe ⇒ no progress. Internal helper.

engine:refineIntersect.label: refine: refineIntersect
engine:refineIntersect.description: Phase 7 — fold a SeIntersect's branches into one tightened interval via the shared seIntervalFold (tighterLo / tighterHi — inhabit.fenel); on a clean intervals-only fold with at least one present bound ⇒ RfInterval, else RfNoProgress (a non-interval branch or an all-unbounded fold). Internal helper.

engine:refineLadder.label: Refine ladder
engine:refineLadder.description: The LOCKED P7 ladder over the canonical `Se*` (decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage B): SeEnum ⇒ RfEnum (singleton or union-of-singletons); SeInterval ⇒ RfInterval (bounded); SeIntersect ⇒ the tightened interval (via the shared seIntervalFold — inhabit.fenel; a non-interval branch ⇒ RfNoProgress); SeUnion ⇒ merged enum when every branch is SeEnum, else RfNoProgress; SeWhere / SeComplement / SeAll / SeNone / anything else ⇒ RfNoProgress. Out-of-fragment never errs. expr-substrate Phase 7.

engine:refineLlvmDomain.label: LLVM inference: refineLlvmDomain
engine:refineLlvmDomain.description: Phase 21.8.1 — LLVM inference body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:refineType.label: Refine type
engine:refineType.description: The `propose`-returns-a-refined-subtype generalisation (the ladder half). Takes a RefineInput marker (TS-built from a `$`-keyed type): `RiWhere` (a `$refined` whose set is a `$where` predicate, lifted to Expr) routes through `comprehend "value"` (the ONE recognizer) then the LADDER to a RefineOutcome (RfEnum singleton/multi-enum / RfInterval bounded / RfNoProgress); `RiStructural` (already-structural set) and `RiNotRefined` (a non-refined type) ⇒ RfNoProgress; `RiNotType` ⇒ RfOutOfScope. The kernel-round-trip soundness gate runs TS-side after this. decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage B: the ladder reads the canonical `Se*` (the Ws marker hop is gone). expr-substrate Phase 7.

engine:refineUnion.label: refine: refineUnion
engine:refineUnion.description: Phase 7 — merge a SeUnion's branches into one RfEnum when EVERY branch is a SeEnum (union-of-singletons ⇒ multi-enum); any non-SeEnum branch ⇒ RfNoProgress (the v1 fence). Threads a `{ values, ok }` accumulator. Internal helper.

engine:refineUnionFold.label: refine: refineUnionFold
engine:refineUnionFold.description: Phase 7 — accumulator-threaded fold over SeUnion branches, threading `{ values, ok }`: a SeEnum branch appends its values; any other branch sets ok=false. Internal helper.

engine:refineUnionStep.label: refine: refineUnionStep
engine:refineUnionStep.description: Phase 7 — fold one SeUnion branch into the running `{ values, ok }`: a SeEnum branch concatenates its values; any other branch sets ok=false. Internal helper.

engine:refineWherePred.label: Refine where predicate
engine:refineWherePred.description: Classify the canonical refined-set input for the host JSON-Logic lift: SeWhere returns its raw predicate; every other SetExpr returns Nothing. floor-kernel Phase 4 keeps SetExpr semantic recognition in Fenel while the host retains only the outer FenelType and dynamic-key JSON-Logic gateways.

engine:refsOfNames.label: Refs of names
engine:refsOfNames.description: All refs in the bodies of the given production names (concatenated; bodies read from the env INDEX `gidx` via O(1) `bodyOf`). Internal helper for reachability growth.

engine:refsOfNamesInto.label: Refs of names into
engine:refsOfNamesInto.description: refsOfNames' accumulator pass: append each production body's refs (body via the env index `gidx`). Internal helper.

engine:regexHint.label: regex hint: regex cursor hint
engine:regexHint.description: Cursor-aware validation hint for a regex against partially-consumed input. Parses the (pre-tokenized) pattern RAW (anchors stripped, NO `.*` wrapping — the hint surface), walks the consumed tokens by Brzozowski derivative, and reports can-match / can-end / valid-next ranges (+ human label) / the failing position / the enriched named-group segments. Output is `$`-key-free plain data (the TS shim assembles the JS `RegexHint`: `failedAt` + `activeGroup` ride the `hasFailed`/`hasActiveGroup` flag fields). The Fenel port of regex-derivative.ts's `regexHint`. regex-derivative-to-fenel Phase 3 (Slice C).

engine:regexToPatternMarker.label: regex: regex tokens to Pattern marker
engine:regexToPatternMarker.description: Convert a pre-tokenized regex (`[{ ch, code }]`, the TS shim's char + code-point pairs) to a generic-Pattern MARKER tree: normalise anchors (`.*` wrapping, JS RegExp.test semantics), strip the boundary anchors, recursive-descent parse to an RxNode, and lower to a plain-record marker tree the shim authors into a real `Pattern`. The Fenel port of regex-derivative.ts's `regexStringToPattern` front-end (parseRegex + normalizePattern + rNodeToPattern + rangesToSetExpr). regex-derivative-to-fenel Phase 2 (Slice B).

engine:registerConstraintProvider.label: Register constraint provider
engine:registerConstraintProvider.description: Constraint-provider sibling of registerProvider using the same explicit scope/token policy.

engine:registerProvider.label: Register field-value provider
engine:registerProvider.description: Register a field-value provider under an explicit structural registry scope. Duplicate names are deterministic and never overwrite another scope.

engine:reify.label: Reify
engine:reify.description: Runtime introspection of a function value into its irreducible-core body (Expr) + captured environment. Lifts the raw JSON-Logic body via the proven `jsonLogicToExpr` adapter (never re-deriving form recognition); filters the captured lexical scope to the body's free vars via `collectFreeVars` + `reifyFilterCaptures`. Result-typed — bodyless @native fns / partials / non-reifiable values yield Err Unsupported (reusing the CompileError ctor, no new entity). The runtime sibling of quotation `.{ … }`; they compose as `solveFn f = solve (reify f)` (P5). expr-substrate Phase 3a.

engine:reifyFilterCaptures.label: Reify filter captures
engine:reifyFilterCaptures.description: Filter the marshalled env (a list of {name, value} records) to entries whose `.name` is in the body's free-var set, preserving env order. The capture-side analogue of make-closures-explicit's `filterToCaptures` — keeps the {name, value} pairs (with their captured runtime values) rather than just the names. Used by reify to project a closure's whole lexical scope down to its actual captures.

engine:relAddAll.label: rel-solve: relAddAll
engine:relAddAll.description: 13b — fold relAddName over a name list (deduped union of predicate-name sets). Internal helper.

engine:relAddName.label: rel-solve: relAddName
engine:relAddName.description: 13b — append a name to a name set unless already present (structural dedupe for predicate-name accumulators). Internal helper.

engine:relAnyNameInGroups.label: rel-solve: relAnyNameInGroups
engine:relAnyNameInGroups.description: 13b — true when any name of a list is a member of any group (the reach-set vs remaining-groups intersection test for the Kahn scheduler). Internal helper.

engine:relArgsLits.label: rel-solve: relArgsLits
engine:relArgsLits.description: 13b — count the ELit args of one atom (the literal half of the Herbrand constant over-approximation: derived-tuple constants come only from fact cells and atom-arg literals — residuals filter, they never bind). Internal helper.

engine:relAtomsLits.label: rel-solve: relAtomsLits
engine:relAtomsLits.description: 13b — relArgsLits over an atom list. Internal helper.

engine:relBranchDelta.label: rel-solve: relBranchDelta
engine:relBranchDelta.description: 13b — one branch's differential round: build the delta variants and evaluate them all. Internal helper.

engine:relBranchFull.label: rel-solve: relBranchFull
engine:relBranchFull.description: 13b — evaluate one branch with EVERY same-SCC atom reading the full interpretation (the seed round + the naive differential oracle). Internal helper.

engine:relBranchesDelta.label: rel-solve: relBranchesDelta
engine:relBranchesDelta.description: 13b — relBranchDelta over a rule's branches, concatenating (the caller dedupes and subtracts I). Internal helper.

engine:relBranchesFull.label: rel-solve: relBranchesFull
engine:relBranchesFull.description: 13b — relBranchFull over a rule's branches, concatenating the derived rows (the caller dedupes). Internal helper.

engine:relBranchesLits.label: rel-solve: relBranchesLits
engine:relBranchesLits.description: 13b — atom-arg literal count over a rule's branches (positive + negated atoms). Internal helper.

engine:relClassifyBranches.label: rel-solve: relClassifyBranches
engine:relClassifyBranches.description: 13b — classify one rule's DNF branches through the EXISTING expandConjuncts, then apply the per-branch DATALOG SAFETY conditions (every rule param grounded by a positive atom; negated args grounded). Any classification fence or safety failure ⇒ Nothing (a context-safe-only rule cannot be materialized — its finite extension does not exist standalone). Internal helper.

engine:relClassifyEnv.label: rel-solve: relClassifyEnv
engine:relClassifyEnv.description: 13b — the classification env for one SCC's rule bodies: base relations ++ lower-strata materialized extensions ++ same-SCC placeholders, rules unchanged (non-M rules still unfold inline; materialized names are relation-shadowed). Internal helper.

engine:relClassifyRules.label: rel-solve: relClassifyRules
engine:relClassifyRules.description: 13b — classify every SCC predicate's rule ONCE for the fixpoint: dnfBranches over the body (or-in-body = per-branch disjunctive rules, sharing the 64-branch cap) then relClassifyBranches ⇒ { name, params, branches }. Same-SCC atoms carry placeholder rows (re-resolved per round); lower/base atom rows are FINAL. Any fence ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:relDefToRelation.label: Rel def to relation
engine:relDefToRelation.description: Materialize one relDef marker `{ name, fieldOrder, instances }` into a P13 relation entry `{ name, arity, rows }` (relationFromInstances over its three fields). Internal helper.

engine:relDeltaEmpty.label: rel-solve: relDeltaEmpty
engine:relDeltaEmpty.description: 13b — true when every predicate's Δ rows are empty (the fixpoint has been reached). Internal helper.

engine:relDeltaVariants.label: rel-solve: relDeltaVariants
engine:relDeltaVariants.description: 13b — the SEMI-NAIVE differential rewrite of one branch's atom list: one variant per same-SCC atom position, that atom reading Δ while every other atom reads the full interpretation I. A branch with no same-SCC atom yields NO variants (it fired once at the seed round and can never derive new rows). Internal helper.

engine:relEvalAtoms.label: rel-solve: relEvalAtoms
engine:relEvalAtoms.description: 13b — the shared per-branch evaluation pipeline over an already-row-resolved atom list: joinAll from the unit tuple-set → applyResiduals (proven-rows) → applyNegAtoms (antijoin, frozen lower strata) → projectTupleSet onto the rule params ⇒ positional extension rows. Internal helper.

engine:relFixLoop.label: rel-solve: relFixLoop
engine:relFixLoop.description: 13b — the semi-naive least-fixpoint driver: Δ = ∅ ⇒ Just I (the completed extensions — Knaster–Tarski over the finite powerset lattice, rel.fixpoint); fuel exhausted with Δ ≠ ∅ ⇒ Nothing (rel.fuel — NEVER a partial Just); else merge and iterate. Internal helper.

engine:relFixpointFuel.label: rel-solve: relFixpointFuel
engine:relFixpointFuel.description: 13b — the rel.fuel sizing: rounds ≤ 1 + |preds|·|constants|^maxArity (every round adds ≥ 1 tuple; tuples ≤ the Herbrand count), with |constants| over-approximated by fact cells + atom-arg literals, CAPPED at the inline 4096 fence constant (the same inline-cap discipline as the 64-branch DNF guard). Exhaustion at the driver ⇒ Nothing, never a partial Just. Internal helper.

engine:relGroupBlocked.label: rel-solve: relGroupBlocked
engine:relGroupBlocked.description: 13b — a group is BLOCKED when some member's transitive reach hits a predicate of ANOTHER remaining group (its dependencies are not yet materialized — reach crosses non-M rules transitively, so unfolded intermediates are handled). Internal helper.

engine:relGroupSccs.label: rel-solve: relGroupSccs
engine:relGroupSccs.description: 13b — group the materialization set into its SCCs: each not-yet-grouped predicate seeds a group [p] ++ relSccMembers (recursive SCCs arrive whole — every cycle member is recursive hence in M; negation/or-only singletons stay singleton groups). Internal helper.

engine:relInAnyGroup.label: rel-solve: relInAnyGroup
engine:relInAnyGroup.description: 13b — true when a predicate name is a member of ANY group in a group list (SCC grouping dedupe + the Kahn blocked check). Internal helper.

engine:relInitInterp.label: rel-solve: relInitInterp
engine:relInitInterp.description: 13b — the empty interpretation: one { name, rows = [] } per SCC predicate. Internal helper.

engine:relInterpRows.label: rel-solve: relInterpRows
engine:relInterpRows.description: 13b — a predicate's current rows in a { name, rows } interpretation ([] when absent — defensive). Internal helper.

engine:relInterpToRels.label: rel-solve: relInterpToRels
engine:relInterpToRels.description: 13b — project the completed interpretation into relation entries ({ name, arity = |params|, rows }) ready to append to facts.relations. Internal helper.

engine:relIsDerived.label: rel-solve: relIsDerived
engine:relIsDerived.description: 13b — true when a head name denotes a DERIVED predicate: a rule in the facts env NOT shadowed by a same-named relation (expandOne checks relations first; the analysis mirrors that order so verdicts align). Internal helper.

engine:relMatSet.label: rel-solve: relMatSet
engine:relMatSet.description: 13b — filter the reachable predicates down to the materialization set M (relNeedsMat), preserving discovery order for determinism. Internal helper.

engine:relMaterialize.label: rel-solve: relMaterialize
engine:relMaterialize.description: 13b — THE materialization pass (called by relSolveSet before dnfBranches): collect the query's derived refs; when NONE, return the facts env VERBATIM (the byte-identical P13/4T path). Else close reachability, check STRATIFICATION (a negative edge inside an SCC ⇒ Nothing), compute the materialization set M (recursive ∨ negated ∨ rel-bearing-or body), group + Kahn-order the SCCs, materialize bottom-up, and return the facts env with the completed extensions APPENDED as relations (shadowing their rules at expandOne/expandNot — query-level recursion and `not` over derived predicates then ride the unchanged pipeline). M empty ⇒ the facts env verbatim (plain rules keep the top-down unfold). Internal helper.

engine:relMaterializeGroups.label: rel-solve: relMaterializeGroups
engine:relMaterializeGroups.description: 13b — fold relMaterializeScc over the Kahn-ordered SCC groups, accumulating the materialized extensions (later strata classify against earlier ones). Any group's fence ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:relMaterializeScc.label: rel-solve: relMaterializeScc
engine:relMaterializeScc.description: 13b — materialize ONE SCC bottom-up: classify its rules once (relClassifyRules — placeholders for same-SCC atoms, completed extensions for lower strata), seed with a full round against the empty interpretation, then run the SEMI-NAIVE least fixpoint (relFixLoop) under the rel.fuel bound ⇒ the completed { name, arity, rows } extensions. Any classification / safety / fuel fence ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:relMaterializeSccNaive.label: rel-solve: relMaterializeSccNaive
engine:relMaterializeSccNaive.description: 13b — the NAIVE sibling of relMaterializeScc (same classification, same fuel, full re-derivation per round). NOT on the query path — it exists as the executable cross-face pin for the rel.fixpoint / rel.seminaive ledger rows (the naive-vs-semi-naive agreement differential). Internal helper.

engine:relMergeInterp.label: rel-solve: relMergeInterp
engine:relMergeInterp.description: 13b — merge a round's fresh Δ rows into the interpretation (per-predicate concat; Δ is deduped and disjoint from I by construction). Internal helper.

engine:relNaiveLoop.label: rel-solve: relNaiveLoop
engine:relNaiveLoop.description: 13b — the NAIVE fixpoint driver (full re-derivation per round; same fuel fence, same Nothing-on-exhaustion honesty). The executable differential oracle for the rel.seminaive ledger row. Internal helper.

engine:relNaiveRound.label: rel-solve: relNaiveRound
engine:relNaiveRound.description: 13b — one NAIVE round: re-derive every rule fully against the current interpretation and subtract I (the differential ORACLE for rel.seminaive — semi-naive is a presentation of this iteration, pinned by the relMaterializeScc ≡ relMaterializeSccNaive agreement test). Internal helper.

engine:relNeedsMat.label: rel-solve: relNeedsMat
engine:relNeedsMat.description: 13b — the materialization trigger for one reachable predicate: RECURSIVE (p ∈ reach(p)) ∨ NEGATED anywhere (query or reachable rule bodies) ∨ its body carries a rel-bearing `or` (orRel). Everything else keeps the byte-identical top-down unfold path. Internal helper.

engine:relNegRefsAll.label: rel-solve: relNegRefsAll
engine:relNegRefsAll.description: 13b — the deduped union of every reachable rule body's NEGATIVE derived refs (the rule-side half of the materialization trigger; the query's own neg refs are unioned by the caller). Internal helper.

engine:relOrderSccs.label: rel-solve: relOrderSccs
engine:relOrderSccs.description: 13b — Kahn-order the SCC groups dependencies-first (repeatedly relPickScc an unblocked group). The condensation is a DAG so this terminates in |groups| picks; the fuel + the Nothing arm are defensive belts (a failed pick would mean a grouping bug, and the honest answer is Nothing, never a wrong order). Internal helper.

engine:relPickScc.label: rel-solve: relPickScc
engine:relPickScc.description: 13b — pick the first candidate group not blocked by the remaining others (one Kahn step over the SCC condensation — a DAG, so a pick always exists; Nothing is the defensive impossibility arm). Internal helper.

engine:relPlaceholders.label: rel-solve: relPlaceholders
engine:relPlaceholders.description: 13b — the same-SCC placeholder relations for classification: one { name, arity = |params|, rows = [] } per SCC predicate, so expandOne classifies same-SCC atoms as RELATION atoms (arity-checked) whose rows the fixpoint re-resolves per round. Internal helper.

engine:relPowNat.label: rel-solve: relPowNat
engine:relPowNat.description: 13b — natural-number power (b^e by e-fold multiplication; e ≤ 0 ⇒ 1) for the fuel sizing. Internal helper.

engine:relPredRefs.label: rel-solve: relPredRefs
engine:relPredRefs.description: 13b — collect the DERIVED-predicate references of a query / rule-body Expr exactly as classification would see them: `and`/`or` recurse as conjunct trees (a rel-bearing `or` sets orRel — the or-in-body materialization trigger); a derived head ⇒ a POSITIVE ref; `not` routes through relPredRefsNot; relation atoms and everything else collect NOTHING (atom args are not walked — an arg-buried rule call is invisible to expandOne and must stay invisible here so old and new verdicts align). acc = { pos, neg, orRel }. Internal helper.

engine:relPredRefsList.label: rel-solve: relPredRefsList
engine:relPredRefsList.description: 13b — relPredRefs over an and/or operand list, threading the { pos, neg, orRel } accumulator. Internal helper.

engine:relPredRefsNot.label: rel-solve: relPredRefsNot
engine:relPredRefsNot.description: 13b — the `not` arm of relPredRefs: a single-arg `not` over a DERIVED atom records a NEGATIVE ref (the stratification edge + the materialization trigger); every other `not` shape collects nothing (it classifies as a ground antijoin, a residual, or the rel-bearing fence — none of which reference a derived extension). Internal helper.

engine:relPrependAll.label: rel-solve: relPrependAll
engine:relPrependAll.description: 13b — prepend one atom onto every atom list of a variant list (the recursive step of relDeltaVariants). Internal helper.

engine:relReachAllOf.label: rel-solve: relReachAllOf
engine:relReachAllOf.description: 13b — per reachable predicate, its TRANSITIVE reach set (BFS from its body's direct refs — so p ∈ reach(p) iff p is on a dependency cycle, i.e. RECURSIVE). Produces the [{ name, reach }] table the SCC + stratification checks read. Internal helper.

engine:relReachClose.label: rel-solve: relReachClose
engine:relReachClose.description: 13b — BFS closure of the derived-predicate dependency graph: pop a frontier name, skip if seen, else mark seen and push its rule body's pos+neg refs. Returns the reachable derived set (finite: names come from the finite rule env). Internal helper.

engine:relReachOf.label: rel-solve: relReachOf
engine:relReachOf.description: 13b — look a predicate's transitive reach set up in the [{ name, reach }] table ([] when absent — defensive). Internal helper.

engine:relRelsCells.label: rel-solve: relRelsCells
engine:relRelsCells.description: 13b — relRowsCells over every relation of an env (the fact-cell half of the Herbrand constant over-approximation). Internal helper.

engine:relRemoveGroup.label: rel-solve: relRemoveGroup
engine:relRemoveGroup.description: 13b — remove the group whose FIRST member matches the given head name (groups are disjoint and nonempty, so the head identifies a group), preserving the others' order. Internal helper.

engine:relRoundDeltas.label: rel-solve: relRoundDeltas
engine:relRoundDeltas.description: 13b — one semi-naive round: per rule, evaluate the delta variants against (I, Δ), dedupe, subtract I ⇒ the fresh Δ′ rows per predicate. Internal helper.

engine:relRowsCells.label: rel-solve: relRowsCells
engine:relRowsCells.description: 13b — total cell count of a row list (an over-approximation of the distinct constants those rows contribute — sound for fuel sizing, which only needs an UPPER bound). Internal helper.

engine:relRowsNotIn.label: rel-solve: relRowsNotIn
engine:relRowsNotIn.description: 13b — the rows of a candidate list NOT already present in an existing row set (structural rowMember — the Δ = candidates ∖ I subtraction). Internal helper.

engine:relRuleRefs.label: rel-solve: relRuleRefs
engine:relRuleRefs.description: 13b — the { pos, neg, orRel } derived-reference summary of ONE rule's body (empty summary when the name has no rule — defensive). Internal helper.

engine:relRulesLits.label: rel-solve: relRulesLits
engine:relRulesLits.description: 13b — relBranchesLits over the classified SCC rules. Internal helper.

engine:relRulesMaxArity.label: rel-solve: relRulesMaxArity
engine:relRulesMaxArity.description: 13b — the maximum param count across the SCC rules (the exponent of the Herbrand bound). Internal helper.

engine:relSccMembers.label: rel-solve: relSccMembers
engine:relSccMembers.description: 13b — the OTHER members of p's SCC: candidates from reach(p) that reach back to p (q ≠ p). The caller prepends p itself. Internal helper.

engine:relSeedDeltas.label: rel-solve: relSeedDeltas
engine:relSeedDeltas.description: 13b — the fixpoint SEED: one full evaluation of every rule against the EMPTY interpretation (branches without same-SCC atoms contribute their base rows; recursive branches contribute nothing yet), deduped per predicate — Δ⁰. Internal helper.

engine:relSolve.label: Rel solve
engine:relSolve.description: The vars-explicit relational solver core shared by solveRel (free-var order) and solveFnRel (param order). Empty vars ⇒ Nothing. Flattens conjuncts, expands (atom/rule/residual classification with the recursion + or/not + arity fences), safety-checks every requested var is grounded by an atom arg, joins the relation extensions, applies residuals, projects onto `vars`, and witnesses via `inhabit`'s SeEnum arm (the first binding-row). expr-substrate Phase 13; Se* since decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage B.

engine:relSolveBranch.label: rel-solve: relSolveBranch
engine:relSolveBranch.description: decide-substrate Phase 4T Step C — one conjunctive DNF branch through the classic pipeline: expand (atom / rule-unfold / ground-negated-atom / residual classification), the Datalog safety check (every requested var grounded by a POSITIVE atom) + the negation safety check (every negated atom's args grounded vars or literals), join, residual-filter (proven-rows), ANTIJOIN the negated atoms (a row survives iff the instantiated negated atom has NO matching fact — negation-as-failure over the closed finite fact base), project + dedupe ⇒ Just (binding-row list). Any fence ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:relSolveBranches.label: rel-solve: relSolveBranches
engine:relSolveBranches.description: decide-substrate Phase 4T Step C — fold the DNF branches: each conjunct-list runs the classic conjunctive pipeline (relSolveBranch); ANY branch Nothing ⇒ Nothing (the safe-disjunction condition — every disjunct must be in-fragment and ground the requested vars); else the projected binding-row sets UNION (structural dedupe, first-seen order across branches in order). Terminal: Just (SeEnum of the unioned rows). Internal helper.

engine:relSolveSet.label: Rel solve set
engine:relSolveSet.description: The SET-returning relational solver core — `relSolve = relSolveSet >>= inhabit` (expr-substrate Phase 15). Stage-1 Datalog widened by decide-substrate Phase 4T Step C and completed by 13b: relMaterialize FIRST computes the finite extensions of every reachable derived predicate that is recursive, negated, or or-bodied (stratified semi-naive least fixpoint — see the 13b section) and appends them as relations; then the query DNF-distributes rel-bearing `or` conjuncts (dnfBranches — size-bounded at 64 disjunctive branches, over-cap ⇒ the Nothing blowup fence; a REL-FREE `or` stays one residual conjunct, byte-preserving the proven-rows path), and EVERY conjunctive branch runs the classic pipeline (classify/unfold, ground-`not` antijoin, safety-check, join, residual-filter) with the projected binding-row sets UNIONED (structural dedupe). Emits the canonical `SeEnum { values = <binding-row list> }` (each value = one projected row PRE-ZIPPED with the vars into a `[{ name, value }…]` bindings list — the P-1 form). Every fence (empty vars / out-of-fragment / unsafe-var / unsafe-negation / over-cap DNF / any unsafe branch / UNSTRATIFIABLE negation / unmaterializable rule / fixpoint-fuel exhaustion) ⇒ Nothing; a safe-but-empty query ⇒ Just (SeEnum { values = [] }) (the `Just [] ≠ Nothing` split). expr-substrate Phase 15; or/ground-not decide-substrate Phase 4T; recursion/stratified-not/or-in-body decide-substrate 13b.

engine:relStratNegsOk.label: rel-solve: relStratNegsOk
engine:relStratNegsOk.description: 13b — one rule's negative refs against the SCC condition: a negated predicate q that transitively reaches BACK to the negating rule p (q and p share a cycle — includes self-negation) ⇒ false (unstratifiable). Internal helper.

engine:relStratOk.label: rel-solve: relStratOk
engine:relStratOk.description: 13b — the STRATIFICATION gate: true when NO reachable rule carries a negative edge inside its own SCC (relStratNegsOk per rule). A negative edge p →¬ q with q reaching back to p makes the perfect-model semantics undefined ⇒ the caller fences to Nothing (rel.stratified-not's side condition — no locally-stratified / well-founded semantics this phase). Internal helper.

engine:relSwapAtoms.label: rel-solve: relSwapAtoms
engine:relSwapAtoms.description: 13b — relSwapOne over an atom list (row re-resolution for one fixpoint evaluation). Internal helper.

engine:relSwapOne.label: rel-solve: relSwapOne
engine:relSwapOne.description: 13b — re-resolve ONE atom's rows from a { name, rows } env when its head is present (same-SCC atoms read the current interpretation / delta; base and lower atoms keep their classified rows). Internal helper.

engine:relVariantsEval.label: rel-solve: relVariantsEval
engine:relVariantsEval.description: 13b — evaluate every delta variant of one branch (relEvalAtoms per variant atom list; negAtoms/residuals shared), concatenating the derived rows. Internal helper.

engine:relationFromInstances.label: Relation from instances
engine:relationFromInstances.description: Build a P13 relation entry `{ name, arity, rows }` from a name, a fieldOrder, and a flat instance list. `name` = the atom-head spelling the query lambda uses (caller's choice, verbatim); `arity` = length fieldOrder; `rows` = the materialized total-row extension (rowsFromInstances). expr-substrate Phase 16.

engine:relationsFromDefs.label: Relations from defs
engine:relationsFromDefs.description: Map a relDef-marker list onto the P13 relations list (relDefToRelation each), threading the accumulator. Internal helper.

engine:renameType.label: Rename type
engine:renameType.description: Apply an explicit current-wire rename at a FieldKey path while preserving the semantic key.

engine:repeatExternref.label: Repeat externref
engine:repeatExternref.description: Build a list of N Externref WasmValType values by snoc-list accumulation. Used by externrefArgsFuncType and callClosureFuncType to construct variable-arity import signatures.

engine:replicateDomain.label: Replicate domain
engine:replicateDomain.description: Build a List<WasmDomain> of length n filled with d. Helper to callDomainOf when all args share a domain (e.g. add expects N DomNum args).

engine:replicateList.label: Replicate list
engine:replicateList.description: A list of `n` copies of `v` (n ≤ 0 ⇒ empty). Used for a min>0 PRep's null value. Internal helper.

engine:representationalClassNames.label: representations: representationalClassNames
engine:representationalClassNames.description: Phase 10b sub-step 3 — list every class tagged Representational. Walks every Representational marker instance via dispatchListAllInstances + extracts args[0] (the tagged class name). Returns List String. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedRepresentationalClassNames`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/representations.ts:representationalClassNames.

engine:representationalClasses.label: representations: representationalClasses
engine:representationalClasses.description: Phase 10b sub-step 3 — resolve every Representational class name to its full ClassSeed record via dispatchGetType. Names whose class isn't currently registered are dropped (defensive against stale instances). Returns List Value (untyped — the catalog has no ClassSeed entity yet; the wrapper recasts). Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedRepresentationalClasses`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/representations.ts:representationalClasses.

engine:representationsForTarget.label: representations: representationsForTarget
engine:representationsForTarget.description: Phase 10b sub-step 3 — collect every representational instance attached to a target. Nested walk: for each representational class name, look up the target's instance + accumulate. Returns List {typeName, instance} (Fenel doesn't have a first-class Map; the wrapper converts to Map<String, ClassInstance>). Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedRepresentationsForTarget`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/representations.ts:representationsForTarget.

engine:resolveArm.label: subset: resolveArm
engine:resolveArm.description: Phase 5 (R-resolve) / type-substrate P1(a.5) — sound named resolution: resolve a named have or want through resolveRef with the co-induction memo; if neither side is named, enter ttSubsetSortRefute, whose current implementation abstains unconditionally. The blanket different-kind refutation is retired.

engine:resolveAtom.label: input-layer: resolveAtom
engine:resolveAtom.description: Phase 9 sub-step 3 — recursive FenelType-to-atom-name resolver. The TS wrapper pre-walks the FenelType (peelMaybe at every recursion edge + $opaque/$refined/$tagged/$named pre-classification into a nested ResolvedAtomInput ADT). The body's recursion arms (RaiOpaqueInner / RaiRefinedBase) call resolveAtom on already-classified sub-ADTs — no TS callbacks. Internal helper; dispatched via `dispatchedResolveAtom`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/input-layer.ts:resolveAtom.

engine:resolveBound.label: set-algebra: resolveBound
engine:resolveBound.description: Phase 7b-continuation — typed view of a Bound's value as an IntervalValue (IvNumber / IvString / IvOther).

engine:resolveCallee.label: Resolve callee
engine:resolveCallee.description: Turn a call's first arg into a fnId string. Direct → use as-is. Indirect `{var}` → `$dyn:name`. Errors otherwise.

engine:resolveCaptureOperands.label: Resolve closure capture operands
engine:resolveCaptureOperands.description: For each capture name, look it up in the CALLER's locals and build a mini-instr-list: LocalGet + coerce-to-DomRef. Returns Result<List<List<WasmInstr>>>; Err on out-of-scope. MUST run BEFORE enterClosureBody since the capture names live in the caller's scope. Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:885-900.

engine:resolveCaptureOperandsLoop.label: Resolve closure capture operands (loop)
engine:resolveCaptureOperandsLoop.description: Tail-recursive loop body for resolveCaptureOperands. Per-iteration: lookupLocal name → Err if Nothing, else LocalGet + coerce-to-DomRef + append + recurse.

engine:resolveElPayload.label: Resolve $el payload (eager)
engine:resolveElPayload.description: unified-static-analysis Phase 3b-5 — resolve an `$el`-wrapped dependent type's payload Expression by evaluating it under the eager strategy via the shipped `evaluateWith` re-entry (Phase 8). The payload rides OPAQUE (its keys are evaluator ops); the sibling-value context is threaded by the seam through the EvaluateContext `_localData`. An evaluator `Err` collapses to `Nothing` (the TS undefined-on-failure posture). Retires the 7a scope-out that left `resolveEl`/`peelEl`/`containsType` in TS solely because the evaluator re-entry had no Fenel-callable entry. The `isFenelType` gate on the result stays at the marshal seam (the `$`-key barrier).

engine:resolveFieldFacetSelectors.label: Resolve field facet selectors
engine:resolveFieldFacetSelectors.description: Resolve retained typed source selectors against a completed field-identity occurrence roster. Missing, positional, cross-owner, ambiguous, duplicate, and conflicting selectors are structured errors; no dotted runtime target is emitted.

engine:resolveFieldPresentation.label: Resolve field presentation
engine:resolveFieldPresentation.description: Per-slot precedence: contextual override, UUID field facet, then humanized current Codeable. The aggregate source tag reports the highest-precedence authority that contributed.

engine:resolveFrom.label: Resolve from
engine:resolveFrom.description: The functional precedence-climb (Pratt) over a flat `(op operand)` tail: fold tail items into `left` while the operator's `prec ≥ minPrec`, re-entering at `prec` (right-assoc) / `prec + 1` (left + non-assoc) — the `fenel-parser.ts:1543` `next` rule. Each fold emits `SCall { fnId, args = [left, right] }`. A BACKTICK item (`bt = true`, P3b) bypasses the prec test entirely and re-enters at 0 — the TS `parseInfix` handles backticks in a separate unconditional loop AFTER the op-climb breaks (`fenel-parser.ts:1548`): the backtick captures the in-progress left at whatever depth the climb stopped and its rhs swallows the whole rest (`1 + x ``add`` y` ⇒ add(1, add(x, y))); notation IS the emission fnName (no table lookup). Items without a `bt` field (the pre-P3b callers) take the normal arm (absent ⇒ falsy). Returns `{ val, rest }` (value so far + unconsumed tail) so a stopped inner climb hands control back to the outer one. Internal fixity-resolve helper.

engine:resolveHaveSide.label: subset: resolveHaveSide
engine:resolveHaveSide.description: Phase 5 (R-resolve) — resolve the have-side TtNamed: the co-inductive accept (this (have,want) pair already on the resolve stack ⇒ Just true), else resolve the name and recurse with the pair pushed. Internal helper.

engine:resolveHaveStep.label: subset: resolveHaveStep
engine:resolveHaveStep.description: Phase 5 (R-resolve) / type-substrate P1(a.8) — resolve the have name via the resolveRef ctx-native: Nothing (unresolvable) ⇒ NOTHING; Just referent ⇒ reenterHave on the marshalled referent. The old `Just false` was the CLOSED-WORLD refutation and is RETIRED as a false definite (`t.sub.resolve` condition 2). Ground, and it needed no owner ruling: `Just false` asserts ∃v ∈ ⟦have⟧ ∖ ⟦want⟧. Under an OPEN world ⟦unresolvable⟧ is unknown, so no definite follows; under a CLOSED world the name is ill-formed and has no denotation, so again no definite follows. NEITHER documented reading entitles the refutation — standing rule C, design/deciding.md §9.1. MEASURED at entry: `sub({$ref:<unregistered>}, $void)` = `Just false`, and it was the most definite composite path left after P1(a.7) fenced its siblings. ⚠ SEPARATE, UNREPAIRED, and the reason `t.sub.resolve` lands MISSING rather than SIDE-CONDITIONED: the SUCCESS path is unreachable at HEAD. The native marshals the identified referent and then hands that already-marshalled value to a helper that marshals it AGAIN (engine-bodies-dispatch.ts:11345 → :9152), so the own-data boundary rejects it and EVERY resolvable name degrades to a miss — MEASURED `sub({$ref:"Bot"}, record{})` = `Just false` while `getIdentifiedEntityTypeByName("Bot")` returns a type. Repairing that is NOT a monotone rider (it reactivates definite successes and exposes the fresh-memo cycle question), so it is filed, not fixed here. Internal helper.

engine:resolveLlvmCaptureOperands.label: LLVM lowering: resolveLlvmCaptureOperands
engine:resolveLlvmCaptureOperands.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:resolveLlvmCaptureOperandsLoop.label: LLVM lowering: resolveLlvmCaptureOperandsLoop
engine:resolveLlvmCaptureOperandsLoop.description: Phase 21.8 — LLVM lowering body. See fenel/modules/engine/lower-to-llvm-ast.fenel for the per-function comment block.

engine:resolveOpSeq.label: Resolve op sequence
engine:resolveOpSeq.description: Fold a FLAT operator sequence `{ first = Syntax, rest = [{ notation, operand }] }` into the precedence-correct nested `SCall` tree, sourcing prec/assoc/fnId from `table` (the OpSeq production's `PRed` reduction, decision 4). Precedence-climbs from `first` at minPrec 0 via `resolveFrom`; a single-operand sequence (`rest = []`) returns `first` unchanged. Emission is `SCall` per the clean-operator parity (`jsonLogicToSyntax` maps `{call:[codeName,l,r]}` ⇒ SCall); special-emission ops (`|>`/`&`/`in`/`>>=`/`<>`) are fenced from the differential. parser-substrate Phase 3.

engine:resolveTypeFieldPaths.label: Resolve current wire field paths
engine:resolveTypeFieldPaths.description: Explicit readable boundary adapter: resolve current wire-name paths once against a validated owner-local field view and return FieldKey paths. Recursive algebra consumes only the returned keys.

engine:resolveWantSide.label: subset: resolveWantSide
engine:resolveWantSide.description: Phase 5 (R-resolve) — resolve the want-side TtNamed (the symmetric twin of resolveHaveSide): co-inductive accept on a repeated pair, else resolve + recurse with the pair pushed. Internal helper.

engine:resolveWantStep.label: subset: resolveWantStep
engine:resolveWantStep.description: Phase 5 (R-resolve) / type-substrate P1(a.8) — resolve the want name via resolveRef: Nothing ⇒ NOTHING; Just referent ⇒ reenterWant. The SEPARATELY REACHABLE twin of `resolveHaveStep`'s retirement (the have side is structural whenever this fires), retired on the same ground and carrying the same unrepaired success-path note. `t.sub.resolve` condition 2. MEASURED at entry: `sub(record{}, {$ref:<unregistered>})` = `Just false`. Internal helper.

engine:restOf.label: Rest of list
engine:restOf.description: The tail of a list, or [] when empty. Internal helper.

engine:resultToExpr.label: PE: result to Expr
engine:resultToExpr.description: Project a PEResult back to an Expr for residual rebuild / fold egress: concrete ⇒ `ELit value`; residual ⇒ the residual Expr verbatim (mirrors the TS `unwrap` embedding a concrete value or residual node). partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 1. Internal helper.

engine:rleLocals.label: RLE-encode Wasm locals
engine:rleLocals.description: Run-length-encode a flat WasmValType list into Wasm's preferred shape (consecutive locals of the same type are coalesced into one WasmLocalDecl). Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:rleLocals.

engine:rleLocalsLoop.label: RLE-encode Wasm locals (loop)
engine:rleLocalsLoop.description: Tail-recursive loop body for rleLocals. Two-state walker: tracks (curCount, curVt) + an accumulator. On match: bump count. On mismatch: push current, start new. At end of list: push final.

engine:rowEq.label: Row eq
engine:rowEq.description: Element-wise structural equality of two rows (deepEqValue per element — so a variant/record/list cell dedupes structurally, not reference-shallow; both lists must exhaust together). solver-extension Phase 5 swapped the per-element `eq` for `deepEqValue`. Internal helper.

engine:rowMember.label: Row member
engine:rowMember.description: True when a row is structurally equal (rowEq) to some row already in the list. Internal helper for dedupeRows (std `eq` on lists is reference-shallow, so element-wise rowEq is required). Internal helper.

engine:rowsFromInstances.label: Rows from instances
engine:rowsFromInstances.description: Materialize a relation's EXTENSION from a flat merged-envelope instance list: projectInstanceRow each, KEEPING only the total (Just) rows — a partial instance (missing a fieldOrder column) is silently dropped (the proven-rows / total-fact policy). The positional rows feed straight into the P13 facts env. Internal helper.

engine:rowsToBindings.label: rel-solve: rowsToBindings
engine:rowsToBindings.description: Stage B — map each projected tuple-set row onto a bindings list (zipBindings vars row) — the SeEnum values of the P-1 relational set form (rows arrive PRE-DEDUPED from projectTupleSet). The successor of enumerate.fenel's tuplesToBindings, moved to the emit site. Internal helper.

engine:rpEmpty.label: recheck plan: empty
engine:rpEmpty.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 K3 — the JEmpty arm: extract the judgment's set (positional _0) and shape-recognize it (rpEmptySet). Internal helper.

engine:rpEmptySet.label: recheck plan: empty set shape
engine:rpEmptySet.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 K3 — shape-recognize a JEmpty claim's set: SeIntersect ⇒ rpIntersect (subset/disjoint recognition over exactly-2 branches); any other set shape ⇒ { kind = empty, s = the whole set }. Internal helper.

engine:rpInhabited.label: recheck plan: inhabited
engine:rpInhabited.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 K3 — the JInhabited arm: extract the judgment's set (positional _0) ⇒ { kind = nonempty, s }. Internal helper.

engine:rpIntersect.label: recheck plan: intersect arity
engine:rpIntersect.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 K3 — the exactly-2-branch gate over a JEmpty claim's SeIntersect: 2 branches ⇒ rpPair (subset/disjoint recognition); 0/1/3+ branches ⇒ { kind = empty, s = the whole intersection } (decideEmpty handles n-ary intersections internally). Internal helper.

engine:rpPair.label: recheck plan: pair
engine:rpPair.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 K3 — recognize a 2-branch JEmpty intersection: exactly-one-SeComplement ⇒ { kind = subset, s = the other branch, t = the complement's inner }; no complement ⇒ { kind = disjoint, s = branch1, t = branch0 } (the canonical jopDisjoint [t, s] order — s is LAST); two complements ⇒ first-complement-wins (subset), deterministic. Internal helper.

engine:runSteps.label: Run steps
engine:runSteps.description: Fold the strict token step over an input list, threading `{ g, root }`, an incrementing step suffix `k`, AND the OLD env's nullability/parseNull fixpoints (`na`/`pa`) — the 6b INCREMENTAL-FIXPOINT cache: after each step the next env's fixpoints are reseeded from the prior converged maps (kept rows carry forward, fresh `@k` rows default ⊥) and re-converged by early-exit Kleene in a few frontier rounds, instead of recomputed from ⊥ over the deepening chain (O(|g|²) ⇒ O(|g|) per step). Short-circuits once the root is PEmpty (dead). parser-substrate Phase 1 / 6b.

engine:rxBracedMax.label: regex: parse braced max
engine:rxBracedMax.description: The `{n,…}` upper-bound half: a `}` immediately after the comma ⇒ unbounded (-1); else read max digits (defaulting to min when none). Returns `{ max, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxClassAtom.label: regex: read class atom
engine:rxClassAtom.description: Read one char-class element (an escape via `rxEscapeToRanges`, else a literal single-point range from `tok.code`). Returns `{ ranges, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxClassHi.label: regex: read class range hi
engine:rxClassHi.description: Read the upper bound of a char-class `a-z` range — a single code point (`tok.code`, even when escaped: `[a-\d]`'s hi is literal 'd', matching regex-derivative.ts). Returns `{ code, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxClassItems.label: regex: parse class items
engine:rxClassItems.description: The char-class item loop: accumulate ranges until `]` or end. A lo-element followed by `-` and a non-`]` forms a range (`[lo, hi]` when lo is a single point, else the lo-ranges plus a singleton hi); otherwise the lo-ranges append directly. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts's inner `while`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxCloseParen.label: regex: consume close paren
engine:rxCloseParen.description: Drop a leading `)` token if present (the group-close consume). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxComplGo.label: regex: complement ranges go
engine:rxComplGo.description: The complement fold: `prev` is the next uncovered code point, `acc` the emitted gaps. Each range emits the gap `[prev, r.lo-1]` (if any) and advances `prev` to `r.hi+1`; the tail emits `[prev, 0xFFFF]`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxComplementRanges.label: regex: complement ranges
engine:rxComplementRanges.description: Complement code-point ranges within [0, 0xFFFF], mirroring regex-derivative.ts `complementRanges` (sort by lo; emit the gaps before each range; emit the final gap to 0xFFFF). Used by `\D` / `\W` / `\S` inside char classes. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxEndAnchor.label: regex: ends with $ anchor
engine:rxEndAnchor.description: Mirrors regex-derivative.ts's `hasDollar`/`endAnchor`: the last char is `$` and it is not backslash-escaped (length < 2, or the second-last char is not `\`). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxEscapeToNode.label: regex: escape to node
engine:rxEscapeToNode.description: Convert an escaped char (token) in ATOM context to an RxNode: `\d\D\w\W\s\S` → a class node carrying the predefined ranges + the negation flag; any other escape → the literal char (carrying both `tok.ch` and `tok.code`). Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `escapeToNode`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxEscapeToRanges.label: regex: escape to ranges
engine:rxEscapeToRanges.description: Convert an escaped char in CHAR-CLASS context to code-point ranges: `\d\w\s` → the predefined ranges; `\D\W\S` → their complement; any other escape → the literal char's single-point range (`tok.code`). Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `escapeToRanges` (note `\D` PRE-complements here, unlike the atom `escapeToNode` which keeps a neg flag). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxHeadMarker.label: regex: head marker
engine:rxHeadMarker.description: The first marker of a list, or RSNone when empty. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxHeadRange.label: regex: head range
engine:rxHeadRange.description: The first `{ lo, hi }` of a range list, or `{ lo = 0, hi = 0 }` when empty. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxHeadTok.label: regex: head token
engine:rxHeadTok.description: The head token, or a `{ ch = "", code = 0 }` placeholder when empty (defensive — callers guard non-emptiness). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxInit.label: regex: drop last token
engine:rxInit.description: All tokens but the last, or [] when empty. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxIsEmpty.label: regex: token list empty
engine:rxIsEmpty.description: True when a token list has no head. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxIsRxEmpty.label: regex: is empty node
engine:rxIsRxEmpty.description: True when an RxNode is the empty-language RxEmpty. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxIsRxEps.label: regex: is eps node
engine:rxIsRxEps.description: True when an RxNode is the empty-string RxEps. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxLastCh.label: regex: last token char
engine:rxLastCh.description: The `.ch` of the last token, or "" when empty. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxMax.label: regex: numeric max
engine:rxMax.description: Numeric max of two numbers (range-merge upper-bound widening). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxMergeGo.label: regex: merge ranges go
engine:rxMergeGo.description: The merge fold: `cur` is the in-progress range, `acc` the flushed ones; an overlapping/adjacent next range widens `cur`, else `cur` flushes and the next becomes current. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxMergeRanges.label: regex: merge ranges
engine:rxMergeRanges.description: Sort code-point ranges by lo and merge overlapping/adjacent ones (`cur.lo <= last.hi + 1` ⇒ extend), mirroring regex-derivative.ts `mergeRanges`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxMkAlt.label: regex: mkAlt
engine:rxMkAlt.description: Alternation smart constructor: a RxEmpty branch drops out; eps OR eps collapses to eps; else RxAlt. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `mkAlt`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxMkGroup.label: regex: mkGroup
engine:rxMkGroup.description: Group smart constructor: an RxEmpty child annihilates; else a named RxGroup. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `mkGroup`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxMkSeq.label: regex: mkSeq
engine:rxMkSeq.description: Sequencing smart constructor: RxEmpty on either side annihilates; RxEps on the left drops to the right, on the right drops to the left; else RxSeq. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `mkSeq`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxNodeToPattern.label: regex: node to pattern marker
engine:rxNodeToPattern.description: Lower an RxNode to a generic-Pattern MARKER tree (mirrors regex-derivative.ts `rNodeToPattern`): RxChar ⇒ a single-char RSEnum match; RxCls ⇒ the ranges marker (RSComplement-wrapped when negated); RxDot ⇒ RSDot (any-char-except-newline); RxSeq/RxAlt/RxRep map structurally; RxGroup is TRANSPARENT (captures dropped). The TS shim authors the `$`-keys + lifts through pattern.ts's smart constructors. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxNormalize.label: regex: normalize tokens
engine:rxNormalize.description: Wrap an unanchored regex's token list in `.*` to match JS `RegExp.test()` semantics (mirrors regex-derivative.ts `normalizePattern`): both anchors ⇒ unchanged; `^`-only ⇒ append `.*`; `$`-only ⇒ prepend `.*`; neither ⇒ wrap both sides. Anchors are KEPT (rxStripAnchors removes them at parse time). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseAlt.label: regex: parse alternation
engine:rxParseAlt.description: Parse `seq (| seq)*` alternation. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `parseAlternation`. Returns `{ node, rest }`. The recursive-descent entry. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseAltLoop.label: regex: parse alternation loop
engine:rxParseAltLoop.description: The alternation fold: while the next token is `|`, consume it, parse a sequence, and rxMkAlt it on. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseAtom.label: regex: parse atom
engine:rxParseAtom.description: Parse one regex atom (toks non-empty): `(` ⇒ group; `[` ⇒ char class; `.` ⇒ dot; `\x` ⇒ escape; else a literal char. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `parseAtom`. Returns `{ node, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseBraced.label: regex: parse braced quantifier
engine:rxParseBraced.description: Parse a `{n}` / `{n,}` / `{n,m}` quantifier (toks AFTER the `{`): min digits, optional `,` then `}` (unbounded, -1 sentinel) or max digits (defaulting to min when absent), then the closing `}`. Always wraps in RxRep (faithful to regex-derivative.ts, even malformed). Returns `{ node, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseCharClass.label: regex: parse char class
engine:rxParseCharClass.description: Parse a `[...]` char class (toks AFTER the `[`): optional `^` negation, then class items (literals / escapes / `a-z` ranges) until `]`, merged via rxMergeRanges. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `parseCharClass`. Returns `{ node, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseGroup.label: regex: parse group
engine:rxParseGroup.description: Parse a group body (toks AFTER the `(`): `(?:…)` non-capturing, `(?<name>…)` named, else a plain group (the alternation, captures dropped in lowering); consumes the closing `)`. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `parseAtom`'s `(` branch. Returns `{ node, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseQuant.label: regex: parse quantifier
engine:rxParseQuant.description: Parse an atom then an optional postfix quantifier (`* + ? {n,m}`), swallowing a trailing lazy `?`. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `parseQuantifier`. Returns `{ node, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseQuantSuffix.label: regex: parse quantifier suffix
engine:rxParseQuantSuffix.description: Apply a postfix quantifier to `node`: `*` ⇒ rep 0..∞, `+` ⇒ 1..∞, `?` ⇒ 0..1, `{` ⇒ braced; then swallow one trailing lazy `?`. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts. Returns `{ node, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseSeq.label: regex: parse sequence
engine:rxParseSeq.description: Parse a concatenation of quantified atoms until `)`, `|`, or end. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `parseSequence`. Returns `{ node, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxParseSeqLoop.label: regex: parse sequence loop
engine:rxParseSeqLoop.description: The sequence fold: while not at `)`/`|`/end, parse a quantifier and rxMkSeq it on. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxPeek.label: regex: peek char
engine:rxPeek.description: The `.ch` of the head token, or "" past the end (mirrors the RD parser's `peek()` returning "" beyond `end`). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxRangesToMarker.label: regex: ranges to marker
engine:rxRangesToMarker.description: Lower code-point ranges to a SetExpr predicate MARKER (mirrors regex-derivative.ts `rangesToSetExpr`): [] ⇒ RSNone; one range ⇒ a single RSInterval; many ⇒ an RSUnion of RSIntervals (the TS shim authors `$none`/`$interval`/`$union` + `String.fromCodePoint`s the bounds). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxReadDigits.label: regex: read digits
engine:rxReadDigits.description: Read a run of ASCII-digit tokens (code 48..57), accumulating their value `acc*10 + (code-48)` — pure code arithmetic (no string→number native). Returns `{ value, count, rest }` (count distinguishes `parseInt("")||0` from a real 0). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxReadDigitsGo.label: regex: read digits go
engine:rxReadDigitsGo.description: The digit-accumulation fold for rxReadDigits. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxReadName.label: regex: read group name
engine:rxReadName.description: Read a named-group name (`(?<name>…)`) — the chars up to `>` (or end). Returns `{ name, rest }`. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxRest.label: regex: rest of token list
engine:rxRest.description: The tail of a token list, or [] when empty. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxSecondLastCh.label: regex: second-last token char
engine:rxSecondLastCh.description: The `.ch` of the second-to-last token (`pattern.charAt(len-2)`), or "" when too short. Used by the trailing-`$`-anchor escape check. Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxStripAnchors.label: regex: strip anchors
engine:rxStripAnchors.description: Strip the leading `^` and trailing (unescaped) `$` boundary anchors from the normalized token list, leaving the parse body — mirrors regex-derivative.ts `parseRegex`'s `pos`/`end` initialisation (hasDollar computed on the full list). Internal helper (regex-parse).

engine:rxhActiveHas.label: regex hint: active has
engine:rxhActiveHas.description: Is a group name already open in the active assoc-list? Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhAllSingleChar.label: regex hint: all single-char
engine:rxhAllSingleChar.description: Are all strings in a list exactly one char long (the char-class enum validity check)? Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhBuildGo.label: regex hint: build go
engine:rxhBuildGo.description: The per-position segment fold: at each position close inactive groups, then open new ones, threading the active assoc-list + the index; the final empty step closes everything still open. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhBuildSegments.label: regex hint: build segments
engine:rxhBuildSegments.description: Turn a per-position list of active-group lists into `{ name, start, end }` segments tracking each group's consumed span. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `buildSegments` (the mutable Map<name,start> as a threaded ordered assoc-list). Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhCharName.label: regex hint: char name
engine:rxhCharName.description: The display name for a single code point: alphanumerics render as the char itself; CHAR_NAMES entries by name; other printable ASCII (33..126) as the char; everything else as `U+XXXX` (4-digit lowercase hex). Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `charName`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhCharNameLookup.label: regex hint: char-name lookup
engine:rxhCharNameLookup.description: The human name for a code point from the CHAR_NAMES table (tab/newline/space/punctuation), or "" when absent. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `CHAR_NAMES`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhCloseAll.label: regex hint: close all
engine:rxhCloseAll.description: Close all remaining active groups at the final (post-last) index `i` (in active-iteration order). The `i == charGroups.length` terminal step of buildSegments. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhCloseInactive.label: regex hint: close inactive
engine:rxhCloseInactive.description: Close every active group not present in the current position's name set: emit a `{ name, start, end = i }` segment (in active-iteration order) and drop it from the survivors; keep the rest. Returns `{ active = survivors, segs }`. Mirrors the close loop of buildSegments. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhClsHit.label: regex hint: class hit
engine:rxhClsHit.description: Does a code point fall in any `{ lo, hi }` range of a char class? Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `n.ranges.some(r => c >= r.lo && c <= r.hi)`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhDeriv.label: regex hint: deriv
engine:rxhDeriv.description: Brzozowski derivative of an RxNode w.r.t. a consumed `{ ch, code }` token. Char ⇒ eps/empty on `ch` equality; class ⇒ membership (negated by `neg`); dot ⇒ eps unless newline (code 10); seq/alt/rep/group per the standard rules (the rep min/max decrement uses the `-1` infinity sentinel). Reuses regex-parse `rxMkSeq`/`rxMkAlt`/`rxMkGroup`. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `deriv`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhDerivGroups.label: regex hint: deriv groups
engine:rxhDerivGroups.description: The named groups still active after consuming `tok` from an RxNode: group ⇒ [name, …inner] when the inner derivative is non-empty; seq ⇒ derivGroups(a) if a's derivative is live, else derivGroups(b) when a nullable; alt ⇒ derivGroups(a) if live else derivGroups(b); rep ⇒ derivGroups(child) unless max=0; leaves ⇒ []. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `derivGroups`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhDescribeOne.label: regex hint: describe one range
engine:rxhDescribeOne.description: Render one code-point range: lo=hi ⇒ the char name; 0-9/A-Z/a-z get friendly class names; else `lo-hi`. Mirrors the per-range arm of regex-derivative.ts `describeRanges`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhDescribeRanges.label: regex hint: describe ranges
engine:rxhDescribeRanges.description: Human-readable description of a code-point range list: [] ⇒ "end of input"; spanning > 0xfff0 points ⇒ "any character"; a single point ⇒ the char (+ "(name)" when CHAR_NAMES gives a distinct name); else the per-range names joined by ", ". Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `describeRanges`. The Fenel port of the validation-hint range labeller. regex-derivative-to-fenel Phase 3 (Slice C).

engine:rxhDistinct.label: regex hint: distinct names
engine:rxhDistinct.description: Dedup a string list, preserving first-occurrence order (the `new Set(group)` per position in buildSegments). Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhDistinctGo.label: regex hint: distinct go
engine:rxhDistinctGo.description: The dedup fold for rxhDistinct (append on first sight). Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhEnrichGo.label: regex hint: enrich go
engine:rxhEnrichGo.description: Fold rxhEnrichOne over the raw segments, threading the result accumulator. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhEnrichOne.label: regex hint: enrich one
engine:rxhEnrichOne.description: Enrich one raw segment: `scheme` ⇒ depth-0 + (protocol/secure split when it ends in `s` over a TLS base); `host` ⇒ depth-0 + sub/domain/tld; `tld` ⇒ dropped (subsumed by the host split); `query` ⇒ depth-0 + key/value params; anything else ⇒ depth-0 passthrough. Mirrors one iteration of regex-derivative.ts `enrichSegments`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhEnrichSegments.label: regex hint: enrich segments
engine:rxhEnrichSegments.description: Post-process raw group segments into URL/host/query sub-structure (scheme→protocol/secure, host→sub/domain/tld, query→key/value), tagging each with a `depth`. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `enrichSegments`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhEnumSingle.label: regex hint: enum is single literal
engine:rxhEnumSingle.description: Is an enum exactly one single-char string (the literal fast-path of predToRegex)? Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhEnumToCC.label: regex hint: enum to char-class
engine:rxhEnumToCC.description: Render an enum pred as a char-class body `{ ok, body, negated }`: all single chars ⇒ their escaped concatenation; else not-ok (no clean class). Mirrors the `$enum` arm of regex-derivative.ts `predToCharClass`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhEscapeCC.label: regex hint: escape char-class char
engine:rxhEscapeCC.description: Escape a single char inside a `[...]` class — only `] \ ^ -` need it. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `escapeCharClass`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhEscapeLiteral.label: regex hint: escape literal
engine:rxhEscapeLiteral.description: Escape a single char as a regex literal (backslash-prefix metacharacters). Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `escapeRegexLiteral` (single-char path — the only path the enum-literal serializer exercises). Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhFindName.label: regex hint: find char name
engine:rxhFindName.description: Scan a CHAR_NAMES assoc-list for a code-point entry, returning its name or "". Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhFirstSet.label: regex hint: first set
engine:rxhFirstSet.description: Code-point ranges (`[{ lo, hi }]`) that can begin a match of an RxNode: char ⇒ its singleton; class ⇒ the ranges (complemented when negated); dot ⇒ everything but newline; seq ⇒ first(a) (∪ first(b) when a nullable); alt ⇒ both, merged; rep ⇒ first(child) unless max=0; group ⇒ first(child). Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `firstSet`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhHead0.label: regex hint: head-or-empty
engine:rxhHead0.description: The first string of a list, or "" when empty (query key/value split). Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhHostParts.label: regex hint: host parts
engine:rxhHostParts.description: Decompose a dotted host into depth-1 `sub`/`domain`/`tld` segments (leading labels = subs, second-last = domain, last = tld), threading the offset. Mirrors the `host` arm of regex-derivative.ts `enrichSegments`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhHostSubs.label: regex hint: host subdomains
engine:rxhHostSubs.description: Emit a depth-1 `sub` segment for each leading host label, threading the running offset (each label plus its `.` separator). Returns `{ offset, acc }`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhIsAnchored.label: regex hint: is anchored
engine:rxhIsAnchored.description: True when a regex pattern string starts with `^` or ends with `$`. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `isAnchored`. The Fenel port of the anchor predicate. regex-derivative-to-fenel Phase 3 (Slice C).

engine:rxhIsInf.label: regex hint: is unbounded rep
engine:rxhIsInf.description: Is a rep max the `-1` infinity sentinel (TS `Infinity`)? Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhIsMeta.label: regex hint: is regex meta
engine:rxhIsMeta.description: Is a char one of the regex metacharacters that need backslash-escaping outside a class (`\ . ^ $ * + ? ( ) [ ] { } | /`)? Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `REGEX_META`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhIsTlsBase.label: regex hint: is TLS base
engine:rxhIsTlsBase.description: Is a scheme stem one of the TLS-capable bases (http/ws/ftp), so a trailing `s` denotes the secure variant? Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `TLS_BASES`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhLastGroup.label: regex hint: last group
engine:rxhLastGroup.description: The last active group of the most-recent position's group list (the cursor's `activeGroup`), as `{ has, name }`. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `charGroups[i]?.at(-1)`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhNth.label: regex hint: nth-or-empty
engine:rxhNth.description: The k-th string of a list, or "" out of range (host domain/tld access). Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhNullable.label: regex hint: nullable
engine:rxhNullable.description: Does an RxNode match the empty string? eps yes; seq both-nullable; alt either-nullable; rep min=0 or child-nullable; group child-nullable; else no. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `nullable`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhOpenNew.label: regex hint: open new
engine:rxhOpenNew.description: Open every current-position group not already active, recording its start index `i` (in current-iteration order). Mirrors the open loop of buildSegments. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhPatToRegexInner.label: regex hint: pattern to regex inner
engine:rxhPatToRegexInner.description: Render a Pattern MARKER to a regex source fragment `{ ok, value }` in a context (`top`/`seq`/`atom`): empty ⇒ `(?!)`; eps ⇒ ``; match ⇒ the pred atom; seq ⇒ concatenation (parenthesised in atom context); alt ⇒ `a|b` (parenthesised unless top); rep ⇒ child + quantifier; group ⇒ `(?<name>…)`. Not-ok propagates from any child with no clean form. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `patternToRegexInner`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhPatternToRegex.label: regex hint: pattern to regex
engine:rxhPatternToRegex.description: Best-effort inverse of the regex→Pattern conversion: render a Pattern MARKER to an anchored regex source `^…$` as `{ ok, value }`, or `ok = false` when the Pattern carries predicates with no clean regex form (typed `$where`, non-char `$named`, etc. — surfaced as `PrOther` markers). The TS shim reads the `$`-keys into the marker + maps `ok = false` to `null`. The Fenel port of regex-derivative.ts's `patternToRegex`. regex-derivative-to-fenel Phase 3 (Slice C).

engine:rxhPredIsAll.label: regex hint: pred is $all
engine:rxhPredIsAll.description: Is a SetExpr pred the universal set? Dual-reads the canonical $tag SeAll then the legacy $-key {$all}. The SeDiff `left === SeAll` guard for the PrDiffAll (negated-char-class) marker. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `readPred`'s `peelSetExpr(v.left)?.kind === "SeAll"`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhPredToCC.label: regex hint: pred to char-class
engine:rxhPredToCC.description: Render a SetExpr-pred MARKER as a regex char-class `{ ok, body, negated }`, or not-ok when the pred has no clean class form. Enum ⇒ escaped chars; interval ⇒ `lo-hi` (single-char inclusive bounds only); union ⇒ concatenated non-negated children; complement ⇒ flips negation; diff-with-`$all` ⇒ negated inner; anything else ⇒ not-ok. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `predToCharClass`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhPredToRegex.label: regex hint: pred to regex atom
engine:rxhPredToRegex.description: Render a SetExpr-pred MARKER as a regex atom `{ ok, value }`: `$all` ⇒ `.`; a single-char enum ⇒ the escaped literal; else the char-class `[…]` (with `^` when negated); not-ok when no clean form. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `predToRegex`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhQueryOne.label: regex hint: query one
engine:rxhQueryOne.description: Emit the depth-1 `key` (+ `value` when a `=` is present) segments for one query parameter at `offset`. The first-`=` split is reproduced via `split param "="` (key = parts[0]; value = the rest). Mirrors the per-param body of the `query` arm of regex-derivative.ts `enrichSegments`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhQueryParams.label: regex hint: query params
engine:rxhQueryParams.description: Fold over `&`-split query parameters, threading the running offset (each param plus its `&` separator). Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhRangeTotal.label: regex hint: range total
engine:rxhRangeTotal.description: Total number of code points spanned by a range list (Σ (hi - lo + 1)). Used to short-circuit huge ranges to "any character". Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhReadPat.label: regex hint: read pattern
engine:rxhReadPat.description: Read a legacy `.t`-discriminated Pattern (types.ts:196 — empty/eps/match/seq/alt/rep/group) into a `Pt*` marker tree (the input to rxhPatternToRegex). The match-arm pred reads via rxhReadPred (dual-read); the rep max maps the Infinity sentinel to -1 (numberIsFinite guard). The Fenel port of regex-derivative.ts's `readPat` (l.331). set-algebra-to-fenel Phase 3b-3c.

engine:rxhReadPred.label: regex hint: read pred
engine:rxhReadPred.description: Read a SetExpr predicate into a `Pr*` char-class marker (PrAll / PrEnum / PrInterval / PrUnion / PrComplement / PrDiffAll / PrOther) — the input to rxhPredToRegex / rxhPredToCC. Dual-reads the canonical $tag Se* ADT FIRST, then the legacy $-key form (the SetExpr producer `regexStringToPattern.authorPred` emits $-key, so the fallback is the PRIMARY path for fresh patterns). The Fenel port of regex-derivative.ts's `readPred` (l.290). set-algebra-to-fenel Phase 3b-3c.

engine:rxhReadPredDiff.label: regex hint: read diff pred
engine:rxhReadPredDiff.description: Read a SeDiff pred into a `PrDiffAll` marker (negated char-class) when the left side is the universal set `$all`; anything else lowers to `PrOther`. The right side reads recursively via rxhReadPred. Mirrors the SeDiff arm of regex-derivative.ts `readPred`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhReadPredDiffArr.label: regex hint: read diff pred (array)
engine:rxhReadPredDiffArr.description: Read the legacy `$diff: [left, right]` 2-element array form into a diff pred marker, extracting left/right via head/tail. Any short/empty array lowers to `PrOther`. The $-key dual-read sibling of the $tag SeDiff arm. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhReadPredInterval.label: regex hint: read interval pred
engine:rxhReadPredInterval.description: Read a SeInterval pred into a `PrInterval` char-class marker — but ONLY when BOTH bounds are present (Just) AND both bound values are strings (single-char range endpoints); any other shape lowers to `PrOther` (no clean char-class form). Mirrors the SeInterval arm of regex-derivative.ts `readPred`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhReadPredLegacy.label: regex hint: read pred ($-key fallback)
engine:rxhReadPredLegacy.description: The legacy $-key dual-read fallback of rxhReadPred: $all ⇒ PrAll / $enum ⇒ PrEnum / $interval ⇒ PrInterval / $union ⇒ PrUnion / $complement ⇒ PrComplement / $diff ⇒ PrDiffAll-or-PrOther / else ⇒ PrOther. Mirrors the $-key arms of `peelSetExpr` as consumed by regex-derivative.ts `readPred`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhRepSuffix.label: regex hint: rep suffix
engine:rxhRepSuffix.description: Render a repetition bound as a regex quantifier suffix: `0..∞` ⇒ `*`; `1..∞` ⇒ `+`; `0..1` ⇒ `?`; `n..n` ⇒ `{n}`; `n..∞` ⇒ `{n,}`; else `{n,m}`. Mirrors regex-derivative.ts `repToSuffix` (∞ = the `-1` sentinel). Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhSeg.label: regex hint: make segment
engine:rxhSeg.description: Construct an enriched segment record `{ name, start, end, depth }`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhStrOrEmpty.label: regex hint: string-or-empty
engine:rxhStrOrEmpty.description: Lower a SeEnum value to a string: a String value passes through; anything non-string lowers to "" (length 0) so the downstream single-char check rejects it. Mirrors the `typeof x === "string" ? x : ""` map in regex-derivative.ts `readPred`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhUnionToCC.label: regex hint: union to char-class
engine:rxhUnionToCC.description: Fold a `$union` pred's children into a single char-class body, threading the accumulated body; any non-ok or negated child aborts to not-ok. Mirrors the `$union` arm of regex-derivative.ts `predToCharClass`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:rxhWalk.label: regex hint: walk loop
engine:rxhWalk.description: The cursor walk: at each consumed token record the active groups, take the derivative, and either continue or (on a dead derivative) stop with the failing position + the valid-from-here ranges. Returns the terminal state `{ failed, node, matchedI, cgs, … }`. Internal helper (regex-hint).

engine:sCallToJl.label: SCall to JSON Logic
engine:sCallToJl.description: Lower an SCall: `{call: [fnId, …args]}` normally, but a `lit`-marked `appendItem` chain bottoming at `SLit []` (a list-literal desugar) flattens to the array literal it desugared from (collectList). A genuine `appendItem` application is unmarked ⇒ stays a call (parser-substrate Phase 7k Class A). parser-substrate Phase 5a.

engine:sLetToDo.label: SLet to do-list
engine:sLetToDo.description: Lower SLet to the JSON-Logic do-frame list `[{let: bindingsObj}, …bodyExprs]` (inverse of jlsDoOp's leading-let re-nest). Body=SDo spreads its exprs; any other body is a single trailing expr. parser-substrate Phase 5a.

engine:sMatchArgs.label: SMatch args
engine:sMatchArgs.description: Flatten SMatch into the JSON-Logic match arg list `[scrutinee, pattern0, body0, …]`. Patterns are RAW Pattern ADT values (the TS marshal authors their `$tag`/`$bind`); bodies are lowered. parser-substrate Phase 5a.

engine:sRecordToJl.label: SRecord to JSON Logic
engine:sRecordToJl.description: Fold SRecord fields `[{name, value}]` into a plain JSON object via mapSet (empty ⇒ {}). parser-substrate Phase 5a.

engine:sampleLawGrade.label: Sample law grade
engine:sampleLawGrade.description: The Phase 6c sample-iteration grade policy: any failing sample combination refutes (a counterexample is a FINDING — the reason carries the law field, the fail/total counts, and the first counterexample's bindings); any thrown sample is honest non-evidence (a crash is not a counterexample — the law stays missing); zero samples cannot claim (the kernel's samplesChecked > 0 guard); all-pass discharges. Counts arrive pre-stringified for the message (std concat does not coerce numbers — the 6b0 budget-message template).

engine:sampleLawSpec.label: Sample law spec
engine:sampleLawSpec.description: Classify a sample-bearing spec-record law field (expr-substrate Phase 6c) into its owning class + law-decl name: `{ tag = "SampleLaw", typeName, law }` for the seven sample-tested families, `{ tag = "None" }` for out-of-table fields. The TS audit-side bridge resolves the named law decl, iterates its samples through the property expression, and discharges via the kernel's SampleTestResult rule.

engine:sampleSet.label: Sample set
engine:sampleSet.description: Pick ONE element of a SetExpr's finite extension by a deterministic seeded choice ⇒ Maybe a. Enumerates the set (enumerateSet), normalises the seed into [1, m−1] (lcgSeed — guarding the 0 fixed-point AND negative inputs, since std `mod` keeps the dividend's sign), takes one MINSTD step (lcgNext), and selects index `mod stepped n`. SAME seed ⇒ SAME pick (deterministic, pinned). Empty enumeration (SeNone) ⇒ Nothing; a non-enumerable set (interval — i.e. continuous — / out-of-fragment) ⇒ Nothing (honest). PURE only — unseeded / IO sampling is the deferred Random-effect handler variant (no new IO leaves here). expr-substrate Phase 15.

engine:satCombined.label: Sat combined
engine:satCombined.description: decide-substrate Phase 6 (+6D) — the Nelson-Oppen combined satisfiability verdict over mixed atoms { eqs, neqs, ltes, lts }, THREE theories: EUF (congruence + lit-conflict + neq-collapse) ⊕ ORDER (R1 strict cycle / R2 numeric-lit path / R3 nonstrict-cycle ⇒ equalities) ⊕ DATATYPE (ctor distinctness ⇒ conflict / ctor injectivity ⇒ child equalities). Seed EUF with the eqs, close, project the order edges onto roots; any theory's conflict ⇒ Just false; else pool the derived equalities (R3 + injectivity), append the fresh ones and re-close; repeat to a fixpoint (fuel = |universe| + 1). No conflict at fixpoint ⇒ Nothing — NEVER Just true (no combined-sat certificate; the Phase-5 honesty). The textbook `x ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x ∧ f x ≠ f y` ⇒ Just false; `x == Just 1 ∧ x == Nothing` ⇒ Just false (distinctness); `x == Just a ∧ x == Just b ∧ f a ≠ f b` ⇒ Just false (injectivity → congruence).

engine:satSymbolic.label: Sat symbolic
engine:satSymbolic.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 2 (WIDENED decide-substrate Phase 6) — the Nelson-Oppen refutation face over an effectful predicate `Expr`: the LAWFUL GATE (every effect site is a declared read of a Symbolic-in-scope class — no writes, no unknown classes; any violation ⇒ Nothing) then hand the and-spine's MIXED atoms (noWhereAtoms — eq/neq PLUS lte/lt/gte/gt) to `satCombined` with the read sites INTACT as `ECall` application terms (congruence needs the structure). `read(a)==1 ∧ read(b)==2 ∧ a==b` ⇒ Just false (EUF-unsat over the reads-as-applications, zero IO); `read(k)==1 ∧ read(k)==2` ⇒ Just false; `read(a) ≤ read(b) ∧ read(b) ≤ read(a) ∧ f(read a) ≠ f(read b)` ⇒ Just false (the order theory derives read a = read b, EUF refutes); a `write` site anywhere ⇒ Nothing; a class not declared Symbolic ⇒ Nothing. Just false = refuted over EVERY store; else Nothing (never Just true — dropped conjuncts + finite domains). The ambient decideEmpty still fences the same SeWhere to Nothing (the decider has no memory model); this face is its lawful caller. `spec` = List { effectClass, reads }.

engine:satSymbolicPaths.label: Sat symbolic paths
engine:satSymbolicPaths.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 / decide-substrate Phase 7 — the BRANCHING Nelson-Oppen refutation face over an effectful predicate `Expr`. NORMALIZE FIRST (normalizeForDecide — PE const-folds + dead-branch prunes + whole-concrete collapse, gating on the residual).
