The LAWFUL GATE (every effect site is a declared read of a Symbolic-in-scope class — no writes, no unknown classes; any violation ⇒ Nothing) then TYPED-DOMAIN seeding (per value-number group with a domain: inject the numeric BOUNDS ATOMS + the numeric cert into the initial path condition — type-driven refutation, zero IO: `read k : [1,3] ∧ read k > 5` ⇒ Just false; `¬(read k ≤ 5)` under a numeric domain flips to `5 < read k` — the negated-order certificate) then forkPathsSeeded (budget 64, reads kept AS `ECall` terms — congruence needs the structure, NO mint): if the enumeration is COMPLETE and EVERY feasible path's atoms ∪ its residual's atoms refute (satCombined ⇒ Just false), return Just false; else Nothing (never Just true). LIFTS the symbolize.fenel D-B branching fence for refutation — `if (read k == 1) then (read k == 2) else False` refutes (both paths die), where satSymbolic abstains; `case read k of Just v -> read k == Nothing` refutes by datatype distinctness. `spec` = List { effectClass, reads }; `domInsts`/`domTypes` = the scoped SymbolicDomain / method-return-type domains.

engine:scalarExtension.label: enumerate: scalarExtension
engine:scalarExtension.description: Stage B — true when an enumerated extension is non-empty AND its head is an orderable scalar (number or string) — the tier-1 min/max precondition. Empty ⇒ false (no extremum of ∅); a binding-row / record / boolean head ⇒ false (no canonical order — the honest fence that replaced the WsTuples short-circuit). Internal helper.

engine:scanCandidates.label: search: scanCandidates
engine:scanCandidates.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — scan candidate witnesses against the filters (fuel-decremented per test): the first candidate that passes EVERY filter (testFilters ⇒ "pass") ⇒ SvFound; a "reject" (some filter Just false) ⇒ next candidate; a "poison" (some filter Nothing, none false) ⇒ next candidate with the poisoned bit set. Terminal (scanDone): poisoned ⇒ SvUnknown; else exact generator ⇒ SvEmpty (every candidate of the COMPLETE set decidably rejected); else SvUnknown (an inexact generator can't refute). Fuel-out ⇒ SvUnknown. Internal helper.

engine:scanDone.label: search: scanDone
engine:scanDone.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — the candidate-scan terminal (the honest SvEmpty bar): poisoned (a Nothing filter dropped some candidate) ⇒ SvUnknown "filter-poisoned"; else exact (a COMPLETE finite generator, every candidate decidably rejected) ⇒ SvEmpty "intersect-exhausted"; else (an INEXACT generator — endpoints / a search sample) ⇒ SvUnknown "inexact-exhausted". Internal helper.

engine:scanForEffectCalls.label: Scan for effect calls
engine:scanForEffectCalls.description: Recursive walk over a CoreExpr accumulating effect-dispatch sites. Threads the (sites, effects) state forward through the {handlerSites, effects} scan record returned from each recursive call; the 10-arm CoreMatch covers every CoreExpr case. Helper to makeEffectsExplicit — exposed in the registry so the engine evaluator can dispatch the body via getFunction, but tagged `engine-internal` so the editor catalog hides it from the public function picker. Mirrors the TS oracle at implementations/typescript/engine/src/ir/effects-explicit.ts:scanForEffectCalls.

engine:scanHole.label: Scan interpolation hole
engine:scanHole.description: Index of the closing `}` of a `${ }` interpolation hole starting at `i` with brace `depth` (1 after `${`), skipping nested `"`-strings and `` ` ``-templates so their braces don't miscount (`fenel-parser.ts:159–165`). Internal lexer helper.

engine:scanIndexedExprs.label: Scan indexed exprs
engine:scanIndexedExprs.description: Iterate over a list of CoreExpr children with numeric-index paths (`<basePath>.<idx>`). Threading helper used by scanForEffectCalls for CoreCall.args, CoreDo.exprs, CoreConstruct.args.

engine:scanLetBindings.label: Scan let bindings
engine:scanLetBindings.description: Iterate over CoreLet bindings with `let`-prefixed indexed paths (`<basePath>.let.<idx>`). Threading helper used by scanForEffectCalls for CoreLet.bindings.

engine:scanMatchArms.label: Scan match arms
engine:scanMatchArms.description: Iterate over CoreMatch arms with `arm`-prefixed indexed paths (`<basePath>.arm.<idx>`). Threading helper used by scanForEffectCalls for CoreMatch.arms.

engine:scanNamedFields.label: Scan named fields
engine:scanNamedFields.description: Iterate over CoreRecord fields with name-keyed paths (`<basePath>.<fieldname>`). Threading helper used by scanForEffectCalls for CoreRecord.fields.

engine:scanNext.label: search: scanNext
engine:scanNext.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — advance the candidate scan to the tail (scanCandidates) or finish (scanDone) when the candidate list is exhausted. Internal helper.

engine:scanStr.label: Scan string body
engine:scanStr.description: Scan a double-quote string body from `i`, accumulating the DECODED value `acc`; returns `{ endI, v }` where endI is one past the closing quote (or one past EOF — the TS over-advance). Internal lexer helper.

engine:sccPartition.label: analyze: SCC partition
engine:sccPartition.description: Partition a function list into its strongly-connected components (each SCC = one mutually-recursive group; a non-recursive function = a singleton group). Builds the direct call-graph edges (callees ∩ the function ids), takes the exact finite reachability closure using a node-count-derived bound, then groups by mutual reachability. Each group is exactly the checkMutualTotality input shape (its members carry id/params/body). The bridge from `a checker over a given group` (3e) to `a checker over the program` — the gap 3e left (D-3e-4).

engine:seCandidates.label: search: seCandidates
engine:seCandidates.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — materialize a generator branch's candidate set as `Maybe { vals, exact }`. SeEnum ⇒ its values (exact). SeInterval ⇒ `enumerableSet base` (typed exact ℤ/Char stepping) else the ≤2 inclusive endpoints (inexact — the untyped P5 endpoint fence). Nested SeUnion/SeIntersect ⇒ `enumerateSet` (type-erased exact enum-union/enum-intersect) else `enumerableSet base` (typed interval composite) else a single-witness `searchCore` fallback (inexact). `exact` gates the honest SvEmpty (only a complete enumeration can refute). Internal helper.

engine:seCandidatesComposite.label: search: seCandidatesComposite
engine:seCandidatesComposite.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — candidates of a nested SeUnion/SeIntersect generator: try `enumerateSet` (type-erased exact enum-composites), then `enumerableSet base` (typed discrete-base interval composites), then a single-witness `searchCore base (fuel-1)` fallback (INEXACT — one sample witness). Nothing ⇒ the generator produced nothing searchable. Internal helper.

engine:seCandidatesInterval.label: search: seCandidatesInterval
engine:seCandidatesInterval.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — candidates of a SeInterval generator: `enumerableSet base` steps a discrete-base bounded interval EXACTLY (Just xs ⇒ exact); an absent/non-discrete base or unbounded interval falls back to the ≤2 inclusive endpoints (inclusiveEndpoints — INEXACT, the P5 untyped fence). Internal helper.

engine:seCtorCoercing.label: set-algebra: ctorCoercing
engine:seCtorCoercing.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a — true for a constructor name whose `construct` COERCES to a native rep (exactly True/False — the permanent ledger-B5 Bool arm). Mirrors theory-combine.fenel:dtCoercingCtor. A coercing SeCtor cannot ride the $tag-keyed SeCtor rules ⇒ every face degrades it to Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:seCtorFieldReadWire.label: set-algebra: ctorFieldReadWire
engine:seCtorFieldReadWire.description: field-identity Phase 4 (D4) — the host-read projection of one SetCtorField: when the semantic key resolves in the process registry (the fieldKeyCurrentWire ctx-native), the CURRENT wire projection wins over the persisted-frozen `wireName`; an unknown key (draft / cross-registry payload / positional axis) falls back to the embedded wireName as a codec hint. Persisted-SetExpr wire staleness therefore cannot flip membership for registry-known fields — rename-robust without data rewrites (the persisted-row rewrite decision stays with versioning / Phase 5). Internal helper to the membership face.

engine:seCtorFieldValue.label: set-algebra: ctorFieldValue
engine:seCtorFieldValue.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a / field-identity Phase 3 — read one host-object property by the slot's current wireName (Just value / Nothing when absent). The projection is never used as semantic identity. Internal helper to the membership face.

engine:seCtorFieldsFenceOk.label: set-algebra: ctorFieldsFenceOk
engine:seCtorFieldsFenceOk.description: type-substrate P1(a) — the SeCtor faces' JUDGMENT FENCE: the shared identity-total slot validation (fieldSemanticSlotsValid) AND no reserved resolved wire AND resolved-wire injectivity within the operand. Decider-local ON PURPOSE: fieldSemanticSlotsError also serves validate.fenel / type-traversal / type-algebra / normalise-to-core, and this is a judgment fence, not an authoring ban. SCOPE, stated precisely because every looser version is false: it is the precondition of every DIRECT SeCtor tag/product face WHEN THAT FACE IS REACHED — setAlgebraCtorContains / CtorEmpty / CtorDisjoint / SubsetCtorArm / MuSubCtorCtor — which therefore cannot disagree with one another. It is NOT a precondition of every verdict whose operand happens to BE a SeCtor, and not even of every verdict that inspects ctor fields: the connective identities and the outer equality shortcuts decide ABOVE it (b=SeAll ⇒ Just true; b=SeNone ⇒ disjoint Just true; a=SeNone ⇒ Just true; and reflexivity via setSemanticEq, so a fenced R still gives subset(¬R,¬R) = Just true, subset(μX.R,μX.R) = Just true and normalize(R∖R) = SeNone). Every one of those is correct for EVERY set including the empty one, so none of them is a face disagreement. Internal helper.

engine:seCtorFindField.label: set-algebra: ctorFindField
engine:seCtorFindField.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a / field-identity Phase 3 — find a SetCtorField by semantic FieldKey (Just / Nothing), independent of field order and wire spelling. Internal helper.

engine:seCtorNotRecord.label: set-algebra: ctorNotRecord
engine:seCtorNotRecord.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a — true when a value is an array / null / number / string / boolean (a scalar, never a constructed record) ⇒ it inhabits no SeCtor. Guards the dynamic record reads in the membership face. Mirrors dtLitTag's scalar pre-guards. Internal helper.

engine:seCtorValueTag.label: set-algebra: ctorValueTag
engine:seCtorValueTag.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a — a record value's `$tag` string (read through the dynamic-key `mapGet` boundary), or "" when absent / non-string. The membership face's tag-discriminator read. Internal helper.

engine:seCtorWiresOk.label: set-algebra: ctorWiresOk
engine:seCtorWiresOk.description: type-substrate P1(a) — the resolved-wire walk behind seCtorFieldsFenceOk: no field's RESOLVED wire is reserved, and no two fields in the SAME operand resolve to the SAME host property. The shared slot validator dedups the EMBEDDED wireName only, while membership reads the resolved wire (the D4 discipline), so two distinct semantic keys can alias onto one host coordinate and break the independence the product rules assume. Internal helper.

engine:seEnumEnum.label: enumerate: seEnumEnum
engine:seEnumEnum.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 — the SeEnum theory's enumerate face: Just the deduped (shallow std eq, first-seen order) finite extension. The DecidableMembership SetEnum instance's `enumerate` method target; enumerateSet dispatches here. Per-shape face.

engine:seEnumIntersect.label: enumerate: seEnumIntersect
engine:seEnumIntersect.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 — the SeIntersect theory's enumerate face: Just the exact intersection when EVERY branch is a SeEnum (enumIntersect), else Nothing (exactness over progress). The DecidableMembership SetIntersect instance's `enumerate` method target. Per-shape face.

engine:seEnumNone.label: enumerate: seEnumNone
engine:seEnumNone.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 — the SeNone theory's enumerate face: Just [] for SeNone (the empty set's complete finite extension — THE load-bearing `Just [] ≠ Nothing` split: SeNone is decidably-empty, not non-enumerable), Nothing for a set of any other shape (a `Just []` there would claim a complete empty extension it does not have; modules-as-values Phase 2c). The DecidableMembership SetNone instance's `enumerate` method target. Per-shape face.

engine:seEnumOpaque.label: enumerate: seEnumOpaque
engine:seEnumOpaque.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 — the SHARED non-enumerable face: the theories that are NOT finitely enumerable from a bare SetExpr (SetAll — infinite; SetInterval — the type-erased fence, a bare interval carries no base type so integer-stepping is unjustifiable, the typed de-fence is enumerableSet; SetWhere / SetComplement / SetRef / SetDiff / SetPattern — out-of-fragment) all dispatch their `enumerate` here ⇒ Nothing. One honest face (the brief's fewer-honest-faces rule). Per-shape face.

engine:seEnumUnion.label: enumerate: seEnumUnion
engine:seEnumUnion.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 — the SeUnion theory's enumerate face: Just the deduped concatenation of every branch's extension when ALL enumerate, else Nothing (enumUnion). The DecidableMembership SetUnion instance's `enumerate` method target. Per-shape face.

engine:seFreshVar.label: set-algebra: seFreshVar
engine:seFreshVar.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the capture-avoidance freshener: append a prime (') until the name is not in the avoid list. Terminates (avoid is finite; each prime strictly lengthens). Internal helper to substSet's colliding-binder arm.

engine:seHasAll.label: set-algebra: seHasAll
engine:seHasAll.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1-r — does a SetExpr contain an SeAll node ANYWHERE (params / returns / ctor fields / μ body / boolean combinators)? The membership EXACTNESS predicate: a projected signature carrying SeAll is marshal-approximated (free var / $el / $type / open map), not declared-⊤ — arrowSigMembership fences it to Nothing. Leaves (SeEnum/SeInterval/SeRef/SePattern/SeWhere/SeNone) are exact declared sets ⇒ false. Internal helper.

engine:seHasAllFields.label: set-algebra: seHasAllFields
engine:seHasAllFields.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1-r — seHasAll over a SeCtor field list (any field set). Internal helper.

engine:seHasAllList.label: set-algebra: seHasAllList
engine:seHasAllList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1-r — seHasAll over a branch list (any). Internal helper.

engine:seHasAllParams.label: set-algebra: seHasAllParams
engine:seHasAllParams.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1-r — seHasAll over a SeArrow param list (any param set). Internal helper.

engine:seHasWhere.label: comprehend: seHasWhere
engine:seHasWhere.description: Stage A — recursive check: does any SeWhere node occur in the SetExpr tree? (comprehendClosed's fence detector.) Internal helper.

engine:seIntervalFold.label: inhabit: seIntervalFold
engine:seIntervalFold.description: Stage B — accumulator-threaded fold over SeIntersect branches, threading the running { lo, hi, ok } (tighterLo / tighterHi per SeInterval branch; a non-interval branch sets ok=false). The shared Se-interval combiner reused by inhabit / refine / enumerate. Internal helper.

engine:seIntervalStep.label: inhabit: seIntervalStep
engine:seIntervalStep.description: Stage B — tighten the running { lo, hi } by one SeInterval branch (tighterLo / tighterHi over the interval payload's Maybe-bounds); a non-interval branch sets ok=false (the intervals-only fence). Internal helper.

engine:seMgArrowParams.label: set-algebra: seMgArrowParams
engine:seMgArrowParams.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — seMuGuarded over a SeArrow param list (every param set must be guarded). Internal helper to seMuGuarded's SeArrow arm.

engine:seMgList.label: set-algebra: seMgList
engine:seMgList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — seMuGuarded over every branch of a union/intersect. Internal helper.

engine:seMuFaceOk.label: set-algebra: seMuFaceOk
engine:seMuFaceOk.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the shared μ-face gate: positive (Park soundness / well-defined least fixpoint) ∧ supported (substitution reaches every occurrence). Internal helper.

engine:seMuGuarded.label: set-algebra: seMuGuarded
engine:seMuGuarded.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the PRODUCTIVITY (guardedness) condition for μ value-membership: every free occurrence of the μ-var sits inside some SetCtorField.set (a SeCtor node guards everything below it — reaching an occurrence costs one constructor layer of the value ⇒ the unroll-once descent terminates on finite values WITHOUT fuel). A naked occurrence (μX.(X ∪ {1})) is unguarded ⇒ membership degrades to Nothing (termination guard, never a loop). Internal helper.

engine:seMuSupported.label: set-algebra: seMuSupported
engine:seMuSupported.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the substitution-supported check: the μ-var does NOT occur inside any SePattern subtree of the body (substSet cannot rewrite those positions, so a substitution would silently miss occurrences — the leftover SeRef would then leak to the closed-world namedMember and could return a WRONG definite answer). Unsupported ⇒ every μ face returns Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:seNamedEmpty.label: set-algebra: seNamedEmpty
engine:seNamedEmpty.description: decide-substrate 8λ.1-r — the SeRef (named-set) emptiness arm of the decideEmpty core, mirroring containment.fenel's emptyNamed (the Tt* twin): the KNOWN atom tower (ℝ/ℤ/ℕ/String/Char + the raw pre-projection spellings Number/Int/Nat/Boolean/Bool) is inhabited BY CONSTRUCTION ⇒ Just false (decidably NONempty); any other handle (a registered entity name, a format handle, a μ-bound var like "X") ⇒ Nothing (the closed-world abstention — was the unconditional verdict pre-8λ.1-r). The widening that lets setAlgebraArrowEmpty certify param-inhabitance / return-nonemptiness for named-atom arrows, so the subsetArrowArm emptiness gate can certify a nonempty have and the arity refutation keeps firing. Strictly-better: Nothing→Just false only, on definitionally-inhabited names. Internal helper.

engine:seNamedWitnessAtom.label: set-algebra: seNamedWitnessAtom
engine:seNamedWitnessAtom.description: signature-substrate slice 3jw §2 — the non-numeric half of the canonical-witness table dual to seNamedEmpty: "" for String, "a" for Char (live only once Char membership is registered — §2a), False for Boolean/Bool. A PROPOSAL only — seWitnessRef re-checks it through namedMember. Any other handle ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:seNamedWitnessNum.label: set-algebra: seNamedWitnessNum
engine:seNamedWitnessNum.description: signature-substrate slice 3jw §2 — the numeric half of the canonical-witness table dual to seNamedEmpty: 0 inhabits the WHOLE tower (ℝ/ℤ/ℕ and the raw pre-projection spellings Number/Int/Nat), so no per-rung pick is needed. A PROPOSAL only — seWitnessRef re-checks it through namedMember. Any other handle ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:seNamedWitnessPick.label: set-algebra: seNamedWitnessPick
engine:seNamedWitnessPick.description: signature-substrate slice 3jw §2 — the canonical-witness PROPOSAL for a named set: the numeric table first, else the atom table. Split in two because the mirrored single ten-arm cascade measures 136 tokens, over the parser's 120-token PVF_DECL_CAP, which would fence the file. Internal helper.

engine:sePositive.label: set-algebra: sePositive
engine:sePositive.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the POSITIVITY check (design/mu-induction.md §1, the load-bearing Park soundness side-condition): the μ-var `v` occurs in `s` only at EVEN negation-parity. The only negative formers are SeComplement.inner and SeDiff.right (parity flips under each); union/intersect branches and SeCtor field sets preserve parity; an inner same-var SeMu shadows. A SeMu failing this is non-monotone ⇒ every μ face degrades to Nothing (and the 8μ.2 Park rule will REJECT it).

engine:sePositiveAll.label: set-algebra: sePositiveAll
engine:sePositiveAll.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — sePositiveP over every branch of a union/intersect (same parity). Internal helper.

engine:sePositiveArrowParams.label: set-algebra: sePositiveArrowParams
engine:sePositiveArrowParams.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — sePositiveP over every SeArrow param set (the caller passes the ALREADY-FLIPPED parity — param positions are contravariant). Every param must be positive at the flipped parity. Internal helper to sePositiveP's SeArrow arm.

engine:sePositiveFields.label: set-algebra: sePositiveFields
engine:sePositiveFields.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — sePositiveP over every SeCtor field set (same parity — ADT fields are covariant positions). Internal helper.

engine:sePositiveP.label: set-algebra: sePositiveP
engine:sePositiveP.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the parity walk of sePositive (parity true = positive position). SeRef{v} at negative parity ⇒ false. Internal helper.

engine:seRefHandles.label: set-algebra: seRefHandles
engine:seRefHandles.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — collect ALL SeRef handles occurring in a SetExpr (prepended onto acc; includes μ-bound handles — a deliberate over-approximation of the free set, harmless for capture-avoidance where it only forces extra freshening). Internal helper to substSet.

engine:seRefHandlesArrowParams.label: set-algebra: seRefHandlesArrowParams
engine:seRefHandlesArrowParams.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — seRefHandles folded over a SeArrow param list (each param's set). Internal helper to seRefHandles' SeArrow arm.

engine:seRefHandlesFields.label: set-algebra: seRefHandlesFields
engine:seRefHandlesFields.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — seRefHandles folded over a SeCtor field list (each field's set). Internal helper.

engine:seRefHandlesList.label: set-algebra: seRefHandlesList
engine:seRefHandlesList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — seRefHandles folded over a branch list. Internal helper.

engine:seSize.label: set-algebra: seSize
engine:seSize.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — structural node count of a SetExpr (the Kleene-iterate SIZE guard — the rung's depth/fuel discipline bounds BOTH the iterate count AND the iterate size, since each substitution can duplicate the body per occurrence). Internal helper to seWitnessMu.

engine:seSizeArrowParams.label: set-algebra: seSizeArrowParams
engine:seSizeArrowParams.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — seSize summed over a SeArrow param list (each param's set). Internal helper to seSize's SeArrow arm.

engine:seSizeFields.label: set-algebra: seSizeFields
engine:seSizeFields.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — seSize summed over a SeCtor field list (each field's set). Internal helper.

engine:seSizeList.label: set-algebra: seSizeList
engine:seSizeList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — seSize summed over a branch list. Internal helper.

engine:seTag.label: propagate: seTag
engine:seTag.description: The Se* discriminator tag as a String — the port of the old `.tag`-string dispatch to the registered `$tag` Se* ADT (a `.fenel` body reads a constructor tag by pattern match, not `.$tag` access). Internal helper.

engine:seVarInPat.label: set-algebra: seVarInPat
engine:seVarInPat.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — does the μ-var occur inside a SetPattern (SpMatch.pred and SpGroup.type carry SetExprs; SpSeq/SpAlt/SpRep recurse)? Internal helper to seVarOccurs / seVarUnderPattern.

engine:seVarOccurs.label: set-algebra: seVarOccurs
engine:seVarOccurs.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — does the μ-var `v` occur FREE anywhere in `s`, INCLUDING inside SePattern subtrees (SpMatch.pred / SpGroup.type — the deep walk substSet does not rewrite)? Inner same-var SeMu shadows. Internal helper to seMuSupported / seVarInPat.

engine:seVarUnderPattern.label: set-algebra: seVarUnderPattern
engine:seVarUnderPattern.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — does the μ-var occur inside some SePattern SUBTREE of `s` (the positions substSet cannot rewrite)? Structural walk; at a SePattern node the pattern-embedded SetExprs are searched via seVarInPat. Internal helper to seMuSupported.

engine:seVoArrowParams.label: set-algebra: seVoArrowParams
engine:seVoArrowParams.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — seVarOccurs over a SeArrow param list (any param's set). Internal helper to seVarOccurs' SeArrow arm.

engine:seVoFields.label: set-algebra: seVoFields
engine:seVoFields.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — seVarOccurs over a SeCtor field list (any field set). Internal helper.

engine:seVoList.label: set-algebra: seVoList
engine:seVoList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — seVarOccurs over a branch list (any). Internal helper.

engine:seVupArrowParams.label: set-algebra: seVupArrowParams
engine:seVupArrowParams.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — seVarUnderPattern over a SeArrow param list (any param's set — a SePattern nested under an arrow param whose predicate hides the μ-var is a substSet-unreachable position, so seMuSupported must see it). Internal helper to seVarUnderPattern's SeArrow arm.

engine:seVupFields.label: set-algebra: seVupFields
engine:seVupFields.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — seVarUnderPattern over a SeCtor field list (any field set). Internal helper.

engine:seVupList.label: set-algebra: seVupList
engine:seVupList.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — seVarUnderPattern over a branch list (any). Internal helper.

engine:seWireReserved.label: set-algebra: wireReserved
engine:seWireReserved.description: type-substrate P1(a) — the JUDGMENT-side reserved wire set. A field whose RESOLVED wire projection collides with a host axis the faces already read out-of-band ($tag, the membership discriminator) or with the callable-union sentinels the SeArrow face classifies on ($ref / __fenelPartial / __fenelFn, json-logic.ts isCallableValue) is REFUSED by the SeCtor faces: such a field would make the ctor's field product and the tag/sort axis the same coordinate, and every product rule here assumes they are independent. Internal helper.

engine:seWitIntersect.label: inhabit: seWitIntersect
engine:seWitIntersect.description: Stage B — witness of a SeIntersect: fold the branches into one combined interval (seIntervalFold — tighter lo / tighter hi), then witInterval it. A non-interval branch marks the fold un-decidable (ok=false ⇒ Nothing — the v1 fence). Internal helper.

engine:seWitUnion.label: inhabit: seWitUnion
engine:seWitUnion.description: Stage B — witness of a SeUnion: the first child whose inhabit is Just; Nothing when no child witnesses. Internal helper.

engine:seWitnessAdjudicate.label: inhabit: seWitnessAdjudicate
engine:seWitnessAdjudicate.description: signature-substrate slice 3jw §2 — the three-verdict witness decision, given a proposed witness and the two independent oracle verdicts (membership of the proposal, emptiness of the set). `mem = Just True` and `emp = Just True` CONTRADICT — the set is claimed both to contain the witness and to be empty — so the answer is WContradiction, never a witness. `mem = Just True` alone ⇒ WAccept. Anything else (Just False, or the undecided Nothing) ⇒ WAbstain: the Tri discipline, where an undecided oracle is never read as agreement. Internal helper.

engine:seWitnessArrow.label: inhabit: seWitnessArrow
engine:seWitnessArrow.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 / 8λ.3 / 8λ.6 — the SeArrow theory's witness face. Valid semantic slots ⇒ the whole goal goes to `synthesizeArrow`'s preference-ordered candidate search; there is no const-first or vacuity-first probe left here, because either one masked the ordering fixes by returning a constant before the search ran. The search itself owns root vacuity (offered first, at every fuel and budget), the admitted batch sorted base-free before point-dependent, and the ONE uncharged bare point reserve offered last. The witness is a closure `{__fenelFn, params, body, closure}` (the Ref substrate's callable rep) whose own kernel re-certification DECIDES (the 8λ.2 CHECK face; every returned TvFound is self-re-checked BY CONSTRUCTION, so it is kernel-CERTIFIABLE — not necessarily kernel-certified, since this face does not itself take the kernel round-trip). Per-shape face; inhabit dispatches here for SeArrow.

engine:seWitnessArrowConst.label: inhabit: seWitnessArrowConst
engine:seWitnessArrowConst.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.6 — the arity-3 thin delegate. Its const-first `inhabit returns` probe is DELETED: the whole arrow goal goes to `synthesizeArrow`, whose ordered search offers the root vacuous candidate first, then the preference-sorted admitted batch, then the one uncharged bare point reserve — so a constant is still reachable, but only after every admitted base-free candidate. Projected via tvToMaybe. Internal helper to seWitnessArrowGo.

engine:seWitnessArrowGo.label: inhabit: seWitnessArrowGo
engine:seWitnessArrowGo.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 / 8λ.3 / 8λ.6 — the SeArrow witness dispatch. After slot validation it keeps NO vacuity branch and NO arrow-return branch: EVERY valid SeArrow goal routes through the ordered candidate search, which owns root vacuity, the admitted window and the one bare reserve. Leaving either fast path here would mask every preference fix behind a constant. Internal helper to seWitnessArrow.

engine:seWitnessCtor.label: inhabit: seWitnessCtor
engine:seWitnessCtor.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the SeCtor theory's witness face: build the canonical inhabitant `{$tag: c, field: witness(set), …}` from each field's own inhabit witness (any field Nothing ⇒ Nothing; a nullary ctor ⇒ just the tag record; the synthetic record ctor "" ⇒ no $tag). Assembled via the mapSet dynamic-key native (a record literal cannot author a $-prefixed key; the string "$tag" as an argument is data — the dtLitTag read-side precedent). Coercing ctors (True/False) ⇒ Nothing (ledger-B5). Per-shape face; inhabit dispatches here for SeCtor.

engine:seWitnessDiff.label: inhabit: seWitnessDiff
engine:seWitnessDiff.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 Step B — the SeDiff theory's witness face (NEW — search-backed): `a \ b` witnesses via the search core as `a ∩ ¬b` (a generator from `a`, the negative filter `¬b`). The old SetDiff instance pointed `witness` at seWitnessNone (always Nothing); this is a pure Nothing→Just widening (the old fence had no decidable fast path). The DecidableMembership SetDiff instance's `witness` method target. Per-shape face.

engine:seWitnessEnum.label: inhabit: seWitnessEnum
engine:seWitnessEnum.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 — the SeEnum theory's witness face: the first enum value (empty ⇒ Nothing). The DecidableMembership SetEnum instance's `witness` method target; inhabit dispatches here for enum shapes. Per-shape face.

engine:seWitnessFallback.label: inhabit: seWitnessFallback
engine:seWitnessFallback.description: signature-substrate slice 3jw §2 — inhabit's fall-through, one level of indirection over the old trailing `else seWitnessNone s`: a SeRef routes to the new seWitnessRef face, EVERY other shape (SeAll / SeNone / SePattern / SeWhere / SeComplement / SeRigid) delegates to seWitnessNone unchanged. Swapping one identifier for another in inhabit's dispatcher is token-NEUTRAL, so the 119-of-120 PVF_DECL_CAP budget is untouched; adding a ninth arm instead would push it to 132 and fence the file. Internal helper.

engine:seWitnessIntersect.label: inhabit: seWitnessIntersect
engine:seWitnessIntersect.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 / Phase 4 Step B — the SeIntersect theory's witness face: the interval-fold FAST PATH first (seWitIntersect — fold the interval branches into one combined interval, tighter lo / tighter hi, then witness it; byte-preserved), and on Nothing the fuel-bounded search widens (enum∩enum, generator+¬filter, mixed intersects). The DecidableMembership SetIntersect instance's `witness` method target. Per-shape face.

engine:seWitnessInterval.label: inhabit: seWitnessInterval
engine:seWitnessInterval.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 — the SeInterval theory's witness face: an INCLUSIVE bound (hi preferred, then lo; both-exclusive / unbounded-open ⇒ Nothing — the ℝ honesty fence). The DecidableMembership SetInterval instance's `witness` method target. Per-shape face.

engine:seWitnessMu.label: inhabit: seWitnessMu
engine:seWitnessMu.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the SeMu theory's witness face: fuel-bounded Kleene iteration `inhabit(Fⁿ(∅))` (design/mu-induction.md §0.3) — S₀=∅, Sᵢ₊₁=substSet v Sᵢ F, first Just wins; fixed fuel 8 iterations + a seSize>512 iterate-size guard (the depth/fuel discipline bounds both axes). Gated on positive ∧ supported (Fⁿ(∅) ⊆ LFP needs monotone F). `inhabit ⟦List a⟧ = Just {$tag:"Nil"}` at the first iterate. Per-shape face; inhabit dispatches here for SeMu.

engine:seWitnessNone.label: inhabit: seWitnessNone
engine:seWitnessNone.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 — the SHARED no-witness face: the theories with no canonical witness synthesis all dispatch their `witness` here ⇒ Nothing. One honest face over several forced-inert ones (the brief's fewer-honest-faces rule). The live set is SIX — SetAll (no canonical pick), SetNone (empty), SetPattern / SetWhere / SetComplement (out-of-fragment v1) and SetRigid (a ground witness would not survive κ := ∅). It was seven at Phase 3; SetDiff left at Phase 4 Step B (seWitnessDiff) and SetNamed at signature-substrate slice 3jw (seWitnessRef). Per-shape face.

engine:seWitnessRef.label: inhabit: seWitnessRef
engine:seWitnessRef.description: signature-substrate slice 3jw §2 — the SeRef theory's witness face (NEW): the constructive dual of seNamedEmpty. A named set among the ten definitionally-inhabited names witnesses to its canonical inhabitant (0 / "" / 'a' / False), membership-re-checked through namedMember; every other handle — an unknown name, a registered entity name, a μ-bound var — stays fenced at Nothing. Replaces seWitnessNone as the DecidableMembership SetNamed instance's witness target. Per-shape face.

engine:seWitnessRefPick.label: inhabit: seWitnessRefPick
engine:seWitnessRefPick.description: signature-substrate slice 3jw §2 — the INTERNAL witness face for a named set: propose a canonical inhabitant (seNamedWitnessPick), RE-CHECK it through the namedMember membership seam, and hand both verdicts plus the emptiness verdict to seWitnessAdjudicate VERBATIM (a tail call — there is no room here to inspect, launder or override the adjudicator's result). A name outside the ten proposes nothing ⇒ WAbstain, the honest fence. Internal helper.

engine:seWitnessUnion.label: inhabit: seWitnessUnion
engine:seWitnessUnion.description: decide-substrate Phase 3 / Phase 4 Step B — the SeUnion theory's witness face: the first-child FAST PATH first (seWitUnion — the first child whose inhabit is Just; byte-preserved order + value), and on Nothing the fuel-bounded search widens (a union whose every child needs composite search — empty-branch pruned). The DecidableMembership SetUnion instance's `witness` method target. Per-shape face.

engine:search.label: Search
engine:search.description: The fuel-bounded, emptiness-pruned witness search over a canonical `Se*` composite (decide-substrate Phase 4). `search fuel s` explores ∪ branches (DPLL case-split, empty-branch prune), generates + filters ∩/diff (the first generator-capable branch feeds candidates; the rest are membership filters via setAlgebraContains), and delegates leaves to `inhabit`. Verdict: `SvFound w` (a witness the kernel re-checks via {w} ⊆ s), `SvEmpty` (a decidably-empty refutation — the honest bar), or `SvUnknown` (fuel-out / a Nothing filter / an inexact generator / a bare complement). The untyped entry steps type-erased intervals by their inclusive endpoints only (the P5 rule); `searchTyped` threads a base for exact interval stepping.

engine:searchCore.label: search: searchCore
engine:searchCore.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — the fuel-guarded driver core: `lte fuel 0` ⇒ SvUnknown "fuel"; else dispatch by seTag — SeUnion ⇒ svUnion (ordered branch exploration + empty-prune); SeIntersect ⇒ svIntersect (generator + filters); SeDiff ⇒ svDiff (a ∩ ¬b); a bare SeComplement ⇒ SvUnknown (no generator — ¬x is only searchable inside an intersect that provides one); every leaf ⇒ svLeaf (inhabit ∘ decideEmpty). The base threads the typed interval stepping. Internal helper.

engine:searchDefault.label: Search default
engine:searchDefault.description: decide-substrate Phase 4 — `search` at the named default fuel budget `256` (the constant the composite witness faces widen onto in Step B). 256 bounds branch-descent depth + candidate tests; comfortably covers comprehend-emitted composites (depth ≤ ~10, a handful of candidates) with large headroom. Calls `searchCore` directly (untyped, base "") — NOT bare `search`, which is an AMBIGUOUS bare name (engine:search vs notion:search); every internal entry routes through the unambiguous searchCore.

engine:searchTyped.label: Search typed
engine:searchTyped.description: The typed sibling of `search` (decide-substrate Phase 4 — the P5 rule): given the free var's base type (Int / Nat / Char — CALLER-provided, never invented), a bounded SeInterval generator steps EXACTLY via `enumerableSet base` (the solver-extension de-fence) instead of only its ≤2 inclusive endpoints, so the emptiness/witness search over discrete-base interval composites is complete. Every other shape behaves as `search`. A non-discrete / absent base falls back to the endpoint sampling (inexact — SvEmpty is then withheld, honest).

engine:seedBool.label: Seed bool map
engine:seedBool.description: Build the seed Bool assumption map for env `g` from a PRIOR step's converged nullability map: an ORIGINAL name (no `@` — an un-derived production whose body NEVER changes) carries forward its prior value (identical body ⇒ identical fixpoint); a DERIVATIVE name (`@`) defaults false (⊥). The seed MUST be ≤ the least fixpoint pointwise (the Kleene iteration only moves UP, so a too-high seed would NOT be corrected). Under bounded `base@birth` naming (7h) a derivative KEEPS its name across steps while its body is RE-DERIVED each step, so carrying its prior value forward would seed the OLD body's fixpoint — generally > the new body's least fixpoint ⇒ UNSOUND (it silently mis-captured a nullable kept-tail's null value — an empty-record argument dropped a trailing arg). Seeding derivatives ⊥ recomputes them from scratch, exactly as the pre-7h cumulative naming did implicitly (a fresh per-step name always looked up ⊥). Originals stay the 6b incremental-fixpoint cache. Internal helper.

engine:seedClosureCapturesAt.label: Refine each closure capture to DomRef
engine:seedClosureCapturesAt.description: Phase 5b23 — walk the closure's captures list refining each name in the outer-scope inference env to DomRef via refineDomain (one-way). Closes the boxNum-on-record-capture bug at the closure-construction step for picture:solid / circle / checkerboard.

engine:seedClosureParamsAt.label: Zip closure params with table domains; refine each
engine:seedClosureParamsAt.description: Phase 5b23 — zip a closure's param-name list with the table-declared domain list; refine each name to the matched domain via refineDomain. Extras (params beyond the domain list) default to DomNum, mirroring inferCallArgsWithDomains' argDomains[i] fallback shape. Today's table is arity-1 across all entries so the extras path is unexercised.

engine:seedCtorArgMaybe.label: Per-arg dispatch for ctor-wrapped closure seeding
engine:seedCtorArgMaybe.description: Phase 5b23 — pattern-match a single CeConstruct arg. CeClosure shape → seedClosureParamsAt + seedClosureCapturesAt; other shapes → no-op. Split into a top-level helper so the CeClosure arm's two-statement body uses let-sequencing without nesting inside a let-binding's value (the layout rule treats that as a single expression).

engine:seedCtorArgsLoop.label: Loop over ctor args dispatching seedCtorArgMaybe
engine:seedCtorArgsLoop.description: Phase 5b23 — iterate over a CeConstruct's args list, calling seedCtorArgMaybe per arg with the table-declared domain list. Forward-recursive walk via head / tail.

engine:seedCtorClosureParams.label: Seed ctor-wrapped closure param + capture domains
engine:seedCtorClosureParams.description: Phase 5b23 — for ctors with a CTOR_CLOSURE_PARAM_DOMAINS entry, walk the CeConstruct's args looking for CeClosure values and seed each closure's param + capture names with DomRef in the inference env (via refineDomain). Param seeding ensures non-dotted body references infer DomRef; capture seeding ensures the OUTER-scope binding for each capture name doesn't boxNum a record into NaN at the caller-side capture-loading step. Side-effecting; returns True as a unit-like placeholder.

engine:seedVal.label: Seed value map
engine:seedVal.description: Build the seed Maybe-value assumption map for env `g` from a PRIOR step's converged parseNull map: ORIGINAL names (no `@`, stable body) carry forward; DERIVATIVE names (`@`) default Nothing (⊥). Same 7h soundness reason as `seedBool` — under bounded `base@birth` naming a derivative keeps its name while its body is re-derived, so carrying its prior parseNull value forward seeds the OLD body's (too-high) value and the monotone Kleene iteration can't lower it ⇒ a nullable kept-tail captures the wrong null value (the empty-record-arg trailing-arg drop). Seeding derivatives ⊥ recomputes them, as cumulative naming did implicitly. Originals stay the 6b incremental-fixpoint cache. Internal helper.

engine:seenPair.label: subset: seenPair
engine:seenPair.description: Phase 5 (R-resolve) — is the (have, want) pair already on the resolve stack? Structural deep-equality (deepEqValue) of both components against each memo entry — the co-inductive accept that makes cyclic-entity subtyping decidable. Internal helper.

engine:selectDesiredAccountFields.label: Select desired account fields
engine:selectDesiredAccountFields.description: Remove immutable repository identities from a normalized desired field collection and project the durable account Field rows.

engine:selectFieldResurrections.label: Select explicit field resurrections
engine:selectFieldResurrections.description: Resolve an explicit resurrection request against the account reservation set. Only tombstoned account Fields are admitted; ordinary field refs never call this authority.

engine:selectMigratedAccountFields.label: Select migrated account field entities
engine:selectMigratedAccountFields.description: Project normalized non-repository field entities into the durable live account catalog used by the migration plan.

engine:sepIndex.label: Separator index
engine:sepIndex.description: Index of the FIRST SEP (charFromCode 0) in an encoded token string, or the string length when absent (so the value slice is total). Internal expr-grammar helper. parser-substrate Phase 3b.

engine:serializeAst.label: Serialize JsAst
engine:serializeAst.description: 12-arm JsAst walker producing a JS source string. JsLit / JsObject keys use std:jsLit (wraps JSON.stringify) for JS-source-valid string-literal encoding. JsLet picks between flat IIFE `((p1, p2) => body)(v1, v2)` and nested IIFE `((p1) => ((p2) => body)(v2))(v1)` based on needsNesting (any later binding refs an earlier name) OR bindings.length === 1. Mirrors the TS oracle at compile-js.ts:serializeAst.

engine:serializeAstList.label: Serialize JsAst list
engine:serializeAstList.description: Map serializeAst over a list of JsAst into a List<String>. Used by JsCall.args, JsArray.elements, JsSequence.exprs serialization.

engine:serializeJsModuleEntry.label: Serialize JsModule (entry)
engine:serializeJsModuleEntry.description: Top-level entry. Walks `input.entry` (a JsArrow whose params + body capture the source function's signature + lowered body) via serializeAst. The Result wrap mirrors the TS oracle's `Codec<JsAst, String>` encode shape: `{$tag: "Ok", value: string} | {$tag: "Err", value: string}`. The body always returns Ok — the TS oracle's Err path catches malformed-input rejection (the dispatcher's typed-ADT input rules this out) and runtime exceptions (Fenel evaluator surfaces those as crashes, not Err values). Mirrors the TS oracle at implementations/typescript/engine/src/modules/compile-js.ts:serializeJsModuleNative. Phase 21.6.1 — closes the JS pipeline end-to-end; every step from raw source to JS source text has a Fenel body when FENEL_DISPATCH_FENEL_PASSES=1.

engine:serializeLoopFn.label: Serialize JsLoopFn
engine:serializeLoopFn.description: Print a JsLoopFn entry as a block-bodied arrow `((p1, p2) => { while (true) { <stmts> } })`. Outer parens match the JsArrow convention. Phase 6b2 lever B.

engine:serializeObjectFields.label: Serialize object fields
engine:serializeObjectFields.description: Build a `[<jsLit key>]: <serialized value>` string for each {key, value} field, accumulating into a List<String>. Used by the JsObject arm of serializeAst. Every JS-source-encoded key uses computed property syntax so __proto__ remains an own data property; the value is recursively serialized.

engine:serializeStmt.label: Serialize JsStmt
engine:serializeStmt.description: JsStmt walker for the self-tail-call loop spine (Phase 6b2). JsSConst/JsSAssign/JsSExpr/JsSReturn route their expression payload through serializeAst; JsSIf/JsSBlock route their `List JsStmt` bodies through serializeStmts; JsSContinue is the literal `continue;`. One-line text.

engine:serializeStmtList.label: Serialize JsStmt list (loop)
engine:serializeStmtList.description: Map serializeStmt over a list of JsStmt into a List<String>. Recursive worker for serializeStmts.

engine:serializeStmts.label: Serialize JsStmt list
engine:serializeStmts.description: Join a `List JsStmt` with single spaces into one line of source. Used by serializeLoopFn and serializeStmt's JsSIf / JsSBlock arms.

engine:setAlgebraAfterLastAt.label: set-algebra: afterLastAt
engine:setAlgebraAfterLastAt.description: named-membership Phase 3 — the authority after stripping userinfo (the part after the last '@'). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAfterScheme.label: set-algebra: afterScheme
engine:setAlgebraAfterScheme.description: named-membership Phase 3 — everything after the first '://' (joined back when the URL contains more than one). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAllArmDisjoint.label: set-algebra: allArmDisjoint
engine:setAlgebraAllArmDisjoint.description: Phase 2a-2 — the ⊤-arm of isDisjoint (setAllDecideDisjoint ⊤ other): ∅ ⇒ disjoint; ⊤ ⇒ not disjoint; enum ⇒ disjoint iff empty; else undecided. Mirrors set-algebra.ts:setAllDecideDisjoint. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraAllButLastHex.label: set-algebra: allButLastHex
engine:setAlgebraAllButLastHex.description: named-membership Phase 3c — is every element except the last a 1-4 hex group? (The `(hex:)*` token check, skipping the trailing '' from the final colon.) Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAllButLastNonEmpty.label: set-algebra: allButLastNonEmpty
engine:setAlgebraAllButLastNonEmpty.description: named-membership Phase 1 — every element except the last is non-empty (the interior-segment check after dropping the first). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAllChars.label: set-algebra: allChars
engine:setAlgebraAllChars.description: named-membership Phase 3 — do all chars of `s` belong to char-class `cls`? Empty string ⇒ true (callers guard length where non-empty is required). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAllCharsLoop.label: set-algebra: allCharsLoop
engine:setAlgebraAllCharsLoop.description: named-membership Phase 3 — index walk for setAlgebraAllChars. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAllDistinct.label: set-algebra: allDistinct
engine:setAlgebraAllDistinct.description: named-membership Phase 1 — pairwise-distinct list check (O(n²) via setAlgebraEnumContainsLoop). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAllHexGroups.label: set-algebra: allHexGroups
engine:setAlgebraAllHexGroups.description: named-membership Phase 3c — is every list element a 1-4 hex group? Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAllInInterval.label: set-algebra: allInInterval
engine:setAlgebraAllInInterval.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage D — every a-enum value (classifyIntervalValue per raw value) is inside the already-classified b-interval. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraAllOctetParts.label: set-algebra: allOctetParts
engine:setAlgebraAllOctetParts.description: named-membership Phase 3 — are all parts 1-3-digit octet strings? Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAllValuesIn.label: set-algebra: allValuesIn
engine:setAlgebraAllValuesIn.description: Phase 2a-1 — every value of the a-enum is a member of the b-enum value list. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraAltStreamTail.label: set-algebra: altStreamTail
engine:setAlgebraAltStreamTail.description: named-membership Phase 1 — the path tail after a drive prefix (`v.slice(2)` when `/^[A-Za-z]:[\/]/`, else the whole string). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAnyBranchEmpty.label: set-algebra: anyBranchEmpty
engine:setAlgebraAnyBranchEmpty.description: Phase 7b-recursive — does any branch of the intersect provably reduce to ∅? Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraAnyExtMatch.label: set-algebra: anyExtMatch
engine:setAlgebraAnyExtMatch.description: named-membership Phase 1 — does the lowercased last segment end in `.<ext>` for any of the (lowercased) candidate extensions? Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAnyHidden.label: set-algebra: anyHidden
engine:setAlgebraAnyHidden.description: named-membership Phase 1 — does any path segment look hidden? Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAnyNan.label: set-algebra: anyNan
engine:setAlgebraAnyNan.description: Phase 7b-continuation — any-of-4 NaN check over NumericBoundResult.

engine:setAlgebraAnyPairDisjoint.label: set-algebra: anyPairDisjoint
engine:setAlgebraAnyPairDisjoint.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage B — does any unordered pair of intersect branches return `Just true` from setAlgebraIsDisjoint (the direct sibling call; Phase 1c)? The in-Fenel replacement for the TS pairwise-disjoint pre-compute. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraAnyReservedSeg.label: set-algebra: anyReservedSeg
engine:setAlgebraAnyReservedSeg.description: named-membership Phase 3c — is any path segment a Windows reserved device name? Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAnyTrailingSpaceDot.label: set-algebra: anyTrailingSpaceDot
engine:setAlgebraAnyTrailingSpaceDot.description: named-membership Phase 1 — does any non-empty segment end in a space or a dot? Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraAnyValueIn.label: set-algebra: anyValueIn
engine:setAlgebraAnyValueIn.description: Phase 2a-2 — does any value of vs appear in ovs? Internal helper to enum∩enum disjointness.

engine:setAlgebraApplyMember.label: set-algebra: applyMember
engine:setAlgebraApplyMember.description: named-membership Phase 1 — apply a resolved Membership `member` predicate (an fnId handle on the looked-up instance) to a value via bare application. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolActivePositive.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolActivePositives
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolActivePositive.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — flatten positive arrows and drop a constraint with a provably-empty parameter domain (vacuous absorption: it denotes all callables and contributes no restriction). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolAssignedDomain.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolAssignedDomains
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolAssignedDomain.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — zip positive arrows with a dimension-choice list and collect the parameter set for entries assigned to the requested dimension. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolAssignmentDims.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolAssignmentDims
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolAssignmentDims.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — Kleene-OR the component cover query across all parameter dimensions for one rectangle assignment. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolAssignmentTerm.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolAssignmentTerm
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolAssignmentTerm.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — one complement-DNF rectangle term is empty when some parameter component is covered by the domains assigned to that dimension. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolCandidateParam.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolCandidateParamEmpty
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolCandidateParam.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — is any componentwise union of positive domains empty? This is the vacuous half of exact signature realizability. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolClassifyTerm.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolClassifyTerm
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolClassifyTerm.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — split a CORE-undecided DNF term into positive SeArrow atoms and negative complement-of-SeArrow atoms; constants are neutral/absorbing; any other literal fences. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolComponentCover.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolComponentCovered
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolComponentCover.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — target component subset of the union of assigned domains. No assigned domain means target-component emptiness directly; otherwise normalize the union before the shipped subset query (merges interval covers). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnf.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolDnf
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnf.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — bounded DNF over an NNF arrow Boolean expression, represented as a list of conjunction-literal lists. Union concatenates terms; intersection takes a Cartesian product; either expansion exceeding 64 terms returns Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnfCross.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolDnfCross
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnfCross.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — Cartesian product of two DNF term lists; concatenate the literal lists for each pair. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnfCrossOne.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolDnfCrossOne
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnfCrossOne.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — pair one left conjunction with every right conjunction. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnfIntersect.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolDnfIntersect
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnfIntersect.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — Cartesian-product each intersection branch's DNF into the running term list; product >64 fences. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnfUnion.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolDnfUnion
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDnfUnion.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — concatenate each union branch's DNF, fencing once the cumulative term count exceeds 64. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDomainsAt.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolDomainsAt
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolDomainsAt.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — collect every positive arrow's parameter set at one dimension. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolEligible.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolEligible
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolEligible.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — the shared arrow-Boolean fragment gate: ctx-free, arrow/constant Boolean leaves only, and at least one arrow atom. Used by the public emptiness theory arm and by the kernel witness route's enum⊆compound members loop, so verdict and re-check see the identical fragment. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolFinishTerm.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolFinishTerm
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolFinishTerm.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — dispatch a classified conjunction: zero negatives stays owned by CORE; more than one is the Phase-3c multi-negative fence; a negative with no positive arrow is nonempty via a scalar witness; exactly one of each side enters the decomposition. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolHasArrow.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolHasArrow
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolHasArrow.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — true when a Boolean expression contains at least one SeArrow atom. Prevents the theory arm from stealing data-only composites. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolHasArrowAny.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolHasArrowAny
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolHasArrowAny.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — existential arrow-atom scan over Boolean branches. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolLeavesOk.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolLeavesOk
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolLeavesOk.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — arrow-Boolean grammar gate: Boolean connectives may contain arrow atoms and ⊤/∅ only; arrow component sets are checked separately by setAlgebraCtxFree. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolLeavesOkAll.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolLeavesOkAll
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolLeavesOkAll.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — arrowBoolLeavesOk over every union/intersection branch. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolNoActive.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolNoActive
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolNoActive.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — all positive arrow atoms were vacuous constraints. Their conjunction is the callable universe: it is below target only when target's domain is provably empty; an inhabited target domain yields a realizable counter-signature; unknown stays Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolNotEmpty.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolNotEmpty
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolNotEmpty.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — Kleene negation of decideEmpty for the signature-realizability check. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolParamSetAt.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolParamSetAt
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolParamSetAt.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — safe 0-based parameter-set projection from a flattened SeArrow. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolParamSetAtRaw.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolParamSetAtRaw
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolParamSetAtRaw.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — safe 0-based parameter-set projection from a parameter list. Internal helper.

Flatten arrows, drop vacuous positive constraints, require equal residual arity, enforce the 64-state powerset/rectangle caps, then combine the classic partition subset condition with the SC-wit realizability gate. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolSingleNegative.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolSingleNegativeRun

Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolSomeParamEmpty.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolSomeParamEmpty

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolTermExpr.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolTermExpr

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolTermsEmpty.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolTermsEmpty
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolTermsEmpty.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — a DNF union is empty iff every conjunction term is empty (Kleene mAnd; zero terms is bottom). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolUnionOf.label: set-algebra: arrowBoolUnionOf
engine:setAlgebraArrowBoolUnionOf.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — collapse and normalize a list of component sets as a union; empty list is ∅. Used by rectangle coverage and the realizability signature. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowContains.label: set-algebra: arrowContains
engine:setAlgebraArrowContains.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 / 8λ.1-r — the SeArrow membership face: dispatch on the value shape (dynamic-key `mapGet` own-property reads — pure; the callable union is DEFINITIONALLY json-logic.ts:isCallableValue — closure/partial/{$ref}). A bare STRING ⇒ Nothing (not a callable value post typed-fn-refs P5, but legacy persisted data may still carry name-strings in fn slots — the honest compat fence); any OTHER scalar / array / null ⇒ Just false (a number is never callable — the SeCtor scalar-refutation precedent, 8λ.1-r precision); a `{$ref}` ⇒ arrowRefContains (signature subsumption via fnTypeMarker); a `{__fenelPartial}` ⇒ arrowPartialContains (residual signature = drop the collected leading params); a `{__fenelFn}` closure / any other record ⇒ Nothing (the 8λ.2 CHECK face; a future callable rep / opaque Id-handle stays un-refuted). Internal helper to setAlgebraContains.

engine:setAlgebraArrowCtorDisjoint.label: set-algebra: arrowCtorDisjoint
engine:setAlgebraArrowCtorDisjoint.description: type-substrate P1(a) — SeArrow ⊥ SeCtor decides ONLY through emptiness (∅ ⊥ X): either operand decidably empty via setAlgebraDecideEmptyCore ⇒ Just true; else Nothing, for the ""-ctor and named ctors alike. The 8λ.1 value-sort axiom is retired as false — open ctor membership plus presence-dispatched arrow membership admit values inhabiting both sorts, and the old unconditional Just true made JEmpty and JInhabited simultaneously kernel-certifiable. Soundness is delegated wholly to the emp rows (emp.ctor under the P1(a) judgment fence; emp.arrow the exponential law). Internal helper to setAlgebraDisjointArm.

engine:setAlgebraArrowEmpty.label: set-algebra: arrowEmpty
engine:setAlgebraArrowEmpty.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — the SeArrow emptiness face (the exponential law, mirror containment.fenel:emptyArrow): `empty(P1→…→Pn→R) ⟺ empty(R) ∧ every param inhabited` — a param decidably EMPTY ⇒ the vacuous fn inhabits ⇒ NOT empty; R inhabited ⇒ constant fns inhabit ⇒ NOT empty. mAnd (decideEmpty R) (all-params-inhabited). Sound both directions. Internal helper to setAlgebraDecideEmptyCore.

engine:setAlgebraArrowParamsSub.label: set-algebra: arrowParamsSub
engine:setAlgebraArrowParamsSub.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — the contravariant pairwise param fold for setAlgebraArrowSub: zip the two param lists, subset (want-param-set) ⊆ (have-param-set) at each position (callers pass want-params first ⇒ contravariant); arity mismatch ⇒ Just false; both exhausted ⇒ Just true (emptyList — containment.fenel's arity-exhaustion check, bare-name same-module reuse). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowSub.label: set-algebra: arrowSub
engine:setAlgebraArrowSub.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 — the UNGATED variance core: (aps→ar) ⊆ (bps→br) iff params CONTRAVARIANT (want-params bps ⊆ have-params aps, pairwise) AND return COVARIANT (have-return ar ⊆ want-return br). Arity mismatch ⇒ Just false (mirror containment.fenel:arrowSub/paramsSub — the agreement gate). NOTE the Just-false here is the raw variance verdict — the SUBSET consumer (setAlgebraSubsetArrowArm) must emptiness-gate it (∅ ⊆ b regardless of variance); the MEMBERSHIP consumer (arrowSigMembership) needs NO gate (for a specific value's signature the conjunction is the literal membership condition). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraArrowSubAligned.label: set-algebra: arrowSubAligned
engine:setAlgebraArrowSubAligned.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.2-r — the subset verdict over two FLATTENED arrows: EQUAL arities ⇒ the variance core (contravariant params / covariant return — a flat-vs-curried pair that aligns after flattening now decides variance instead of falsely refuting on written arity: ⟦(A,B)→C⟧ = ⟦(A)→((B)→C)⟧ under the currying calling convention); arities STILL mismatched after flattening ⇒ the callable-tail refutation: a longer-have (na>nb) member applied to nb args is a PARTIAL — a callable — so a provably CALLABLE-FREE b-codomain refutes; a shorter-have (na<nb) member's value after na args lies in the have-codomain — provably CALLABLE-FREE ⇒ it cannot absorb b's remaining args (over-application onto a non-callable is declared-semantics UB; the runtime's silent arg-drop is a fenced quirk, not semantics) ⇒ refutes; both gated on b's params decidably NONEMPTY (else the ∀ may be vacuous — the gate the b-vacuous Just-true above makes near-complete) — else Nothing. NOTE the raw refutation here still rides the caller's have-NONEMPTY gate (setAlgebraSubsetArrowArm). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraClassifyBound.label: set-algebra: classifyBound

Mirrors marshalBound; the BoundExpr arm's exprKey is unused by inInterval / intervalIsValid / intersectIntervals (which treat an expression bound as a type-mismatch → false). NOTE: `intervalSubset` DOES compare exprKeys (interval⊆interval over expression bounds) — but a Fenel-stringify of the raw `$expr` value would EVALUATE its `var` directive (collapsing to undefined), so the subset interval arm re-homes the TS `marshalInterval` (string exprKeys) via `tagInterval` rather than using this Fenel classify. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraClassifyInterval.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage A — raw interval (untagged {value, inclusive} bounds, the canonical SeInterval payload) → the marshalled Interval ADT (tagged Bounds) inInterval consumes. Pure-Fenel replacement for the TS marshalInterval. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraClassifyMaybeBound.label: set-algebra: classifyMaybeBound
engine:setAlgebraClassifyMaybeBound.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage A — Maybe raw-bound → Maybe (tagged Bound). Internal helper to setAlgebraClassifyInterval.

Was the CtsEnum/CtsDiffEnum/CtsAll marker arm. Internal helper to compToSet.

Emits the live-wire SeInterval shape (Maybe-wrapped {value, inclusive} bounds). Was the CtsIntervalLo/CtsIntervalHi/CtsAll marker arm. Internal helper to compToSet.

engine:setAlgebraContains.label: set-algebra: contains (recursive)

Structural arms recurse; SeEnum / SeInterval keep their pure-Fenel leaf logic (setEnumContains / inInterval ∘ classifyInterval ∘ classifyIntervalValue); the three opaque leaves ride body-reachable seams — SeWhere → whereContainsEval (evaluateWith), SeRef → the namedMember ctx-native, SePattern → the patternMember ctx-native. engine:setAlgebraCountNonEmpty.label: set-algebra: countNonEmpty
engine:setAlgebraCountNonEmpty.description: named-membership Phase 1 — count of non-empty segments (the depth measure). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraCtorContains.label: set-algebra: ctorContains
engine:setAlgebraCtorContains.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a — the SeCtor membership face: a host array against a constructor set an array could represent (the names Nil and Cons, and the anonymous record former "") ⇒ Nothing (the List host carrier is outside the canonical domain this face is sound over: runtime pattern matching never reads an array as Nil or Cons, so a verdict here could contradict execution — tcb-ledger row mem.ctor); against any other constructor name ⇒ Just false; any other scalar value ⇒ Just false; a coercing ctor ⇒ Nothing; a synthetic record ctor ("") skips the tag check; else the value's `$tag` must equal `c` (mismatch / absent ⇒ Just false); then every field value must be ∈ its field set (mEvery via setAlgebraContains; a missing field ⇒ Just false). The §0.4 structural-descent leaf, set-side. Internal helper to setAlgebraContains.

engine:setAlgebraCtorDisjoint.label: set-algebra: ctorDisjoint
engine:setAlgebraCtorDisjoint.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a / field-identity Phase 3 / type-substrate P1(a) — the SeCtor∩SeCtor disjointness face (dtConflict distinctness set-side): either side outside the judgment fence (seCtorFieldsFenceOk) or a coercing ctor ⇒ Nothing; BOTH ctors NAMED and distinct ⇒ Just true (distinct $tags never structurally equal); otherwise — equal ctors, OR either ctor the anonymous-record former "" — fieldwise. The ""-vs-named leg was Just true and was FALSE: membership is ""-agnostic, so a named-tag value satisfying the fields inhabits both. The datatype theory already had this right (dtConflict/dtTaggedEntries drop empty tags before the distinctness scan, theory-combine.fenel:520); this face was the sloppy copy. The fieldwise call SEEDS sawNothing with the width-asymmetry bit — an asymmetric pair can never claim overlap. Internal helper to setAlgebraDisjointArm.

engine:setAlgebraCtorEmpty.label: set-algebra: ctorEmpty
engine:setAlgebraCtorEmpty.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a — the SeCtor emptiness face: a coercing ctor ⇒ Nothing; else empty iff SOME field set is empty (a product with an empty factor is empty). Nullary (fs==[]) ⇒ Just false (a point). Fold via setAlgebraCtorEmptyLoop. Internal helper to setAlgebraDecideEmptyCore.

engine:setAlgebraCtorEmptyLoop.label: set-algebra: ctorEmptyLoop
engine:setAlgebraCtorEmptyLoop.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a — the emptiness fold over a SeCtor's field sets (setAlgebraDecideEmpty per field): any Just true ⇒ Just true (empty factor ⇒ empty product); all Just false ⇒ Just false (all factors nonempty ⇒ nonempty, incl. the nullary point); any Nothing (no Just true) ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper to setAlgebraCtorEmpty.

engine:setAlgebraCtorFields.label: set-algebra: ctorFields
engine:setAlgebraCtorFields.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a / field-identity Phase 4 (D4) — mEvery over a SeCtor's fields for membership: for each SetCtorField read the value's field through seCtorFieldReadWire (key→CURRENT wire when the registry knows the key; embedded wireName fallback; missing ⇒ Just false — shape mismatch) then setAlgebraContains its set; any Just false ⇒ Just false; all Just true ⇒ Just true; any Nothing (no Just false) ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper to setAlgebraCtorContains.

engine:setAlgebraCtorFieldwiseDisjoint.label: set-algebra: ctorFieldwiseDisjoint
engine:setAlgebraCtorFieldwiseDisjoint.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a / field-identity Phase 3 / type-substrate P1(a) — fieldwise disjointness: disjoint iff SOME FieldKey-aligned pair is disjoint. Any Just true ⇒ Just true; all-overlap ⇒ Just false ONLY when nothing was tracked AND the widths agreed (the caller seeds sawNothing with the width-asymmetry bit) — the old unconditional terminal never saw b-only keys, so a b-only ∅ field (which makes b EMPTY, hence genuinely disjoint) was answered Just false; a semantic key absent on b, or an aligned pair whose RESOLVED wires disagree, ⇒ track (the ∃ leg must not fire on a divergent pair either: two fields that read DIFFERENT host properties are not competing for one coordinate, so `SeCtor("P",[K@x:{1}])` vs `SeCtor("P",[KU@y:{2}])` is NOT disjoint — `{$tag:"P", x:1, y:2}` inhabits both). PRICED PRECISION LOSS, named rather than hidden: the guard is SYMMETRIC, so a divergent pair also blocks the all-overlap `Just false`, which was CORRECT on that pair for exactly the same reason (independent coordinates are jointly satisfiable). Recovering it would need a per-divergent-pair emptiness check — an empty set on either side makes its operand empty and the ctors genuinely disjoint — which is not worth the rule. Abstaining is the conservative side of the Tri. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraCtorFieldwiseSubset.label: set-algebra: ctorFieldwiseSubset
engine:setAlgebraCtorFieldwiseSubset.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a / field-identity Phase 3 / type-substrate P1(a) — fieldwise ⊆, iterated over the WANT side: for every b-field find the a-field carrying the same semantic key and decide af.set ⊆ bf.set. The loop ran over the HAVE side before, so want-only fields were never examined and a tag-only have vacuously proved (`Pt{} ⊆ Pt{x:{1}}` ⇒ Just true, FALSE). Now: a want key ABSENT on the have side ⇒ track (never decide — the Se face has no "members lack this key" fact, so Nothing is the only honest absence verdict, which subsumes the Tt missing-key ambiguity discipline a fortiori); an aligned pair whose RESOLVED wires disagree ⇒ track; Just false ⇒ Just false (the caller's a-nonempty gate realizes the refutation); all Just true ⇒ Just true. Have-only keys are never inspected — under open membership an extra have constraint only shrinks a (resolved-wire injectivity, enforced by the fence, is what makes the coordinates independent). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraCtorSubsetCtor.label: set-algebra: ctorSubsetCtor
engine:setAlgebraCtorSubsetCtor.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a / type-substrate P1(a) — SeCtor a ⊆ SeCtor b: a decidably empty ⇒ Just true (∅ ⊆ b); a NAMED want-ctor distinct from ac ⇒ Just false when a is decidably NONEMPTY (a's field product is tag-independent under the judgment fence, so an inhabited a admits a member with any tag ∉ {bc}), else Nothing; a want-ctor of "" — the anonymous-record former — SKIPS the tag leg entirely and goes fieldwise (a "" want constrains fields only; the old distinct-tag refutation was FALSE here, and "" is the CANONICAL $record projection, not a fringe operand); same ctor ⇒ fieldwise. Just false ⇒ Just false only when a is decidably nonempty (else Nothing — a maybe-empty a is still ⊆). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraCtorSubsetWhere.label: set-algebra: ctorSubsetWhere
engine:setAlgebraCtorSubsetWhere.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.3 — the ∀-INTRO arm: SeCtor c fs ⊆ SeWhere{pred} by symbolic validity over the ctor's field domains (all-pure — kernel-premise-safe under any dispatch ctx). Fences: coercing ctor / synthetic record ctor / non-Expr (JsonLogic) pred / non-EMatch pred ⇒ Nothing (falls through to the whereExtract tail). ∅ ⊆ b ⇒ Just true. Decides via static arm-selection + per-conjunct validity (negation + satCombined over the field-domain bounds atoms) with a per-field ground witness refutation. Internal helper to setAlgebraSubsetCtorArm.

engine:setAlgebraCtxFree.label: set-algebra: ctxFree
engine:setAlgebraCtxFree.description: floor-kernel Phase 3a — TRUE iff the SetExpr has NO ctx-native-riding leaf (SeWhere/SeRef/SePattern) anywhere, walking SeCtor fields / SeMu bodies / SeArrow params+returns / Boolean combinators; μ-bound SeRef occurrences are admitted (substituted away before any name lookup). The shape-permissive sibling of setAlgebraSearchable (whose SeCtor/SeMu/SeArrow exclusions are search-capability limits, not ctx concerns). Gates the 3a rewrite arms per the D′ ctx discipline. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraCtxFreeAll.label: set-algebra: ctxFreeAll
engine:setAlgebraCtxFreeAll.description: floor-kernel Phase 3a — setAlgebraCtxFreeW over every branch of a union/intersect. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraCtxFreeFields.label: set-algebra: ctxFreeFields
engine:setAlgebraCtxFreeFields.description: floor-kernel Phase 3a — setAlgebraCtxFreeW over every SeCtor field set. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraCtxFreeParams.label: set-algebra: ctxFreeParams
engine:setAlgebraCtxFreeParams.description: floor-kernel Phase 3a — setAlgebraCtxFreeW over every SeArrow param set. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraCtxFreeW.label: set-algebra: ctxFreeW

engine:setAlgebraDecideEmpty.label: set-algebra: decideEmpty (recursive)
engine:setAlgebraDecideEmpty.description: The PUBLIC decideEmpty — connective-algebra CORE first, then the fixed-fuel D′ search arm, then the Nelson-Oppen SeWhere arm, then floor-kernel Phase 3b's ctx-free arrow-Boolean theory arm. The final arm NNF/DNF-normalizes an arrow-bearing ∩/∖/¬ composite (64-term cap) and applies the single-negative signature-space decomposition; every recursive component verdict is Kleene-combined verbatim, so an undecided premise remains Nothing. CORE stays the cycle-break used by search and by the per-DNF-term pre-check.

engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyArrowBoolArm.label: set-algebra: decideEmptyArrowBoolArm
engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyArrowBoolArm.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — public-top arrow-Boolean emptiness arm (ledger emp.arrow-bool). For a ctx-free ∩/∖/¬ composite with at least one arrow atom and no non-arrow Boolean leaf, compute NNF then bounded DNF (≤64 terms); CORE gets first refusal on every term; a still-undecided term with exactly one negative arrow uses the classic finite partition condition over flattened equal-arity arrows. Component subset/emptiness verdicts are Kleene-combined without synthesis; multi-negative terms and over-cap products return Nothing.

engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyComplement.label: set-algebra: decideEmptyComplement
engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyComplement.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage B / floor-kernel Phase 3b — ¬A empty iff A covers ⊤. The direct SeAll/SeNone cases stay first; the ctx-free else arm computes setAlgebraNnf A and asks setAlgebraTopCover, whose minimal complete slice is excluded-middle/pairing plus enum/interval leaf covers. Tri passthrough only. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyCore.label: set-algebra: decideEmpty (core)
engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyCore.description: set-algebra-to-fenel Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage B / decide-substrate Phase 4T Step D′ — the recursive CONNECTIVE-ALGEBRA decideEmpty core over the CANONICAL registered `$tag` `Se*` SetExpr ADT (byte-identical to the pre-D′ `setAlgebraDecideEmpty`; the public entry now widens on top of it via ONE bounded search fall-through, and search's own prune/leaf sites call THIS core — the cycle-break). Structural arms recurse; SeEnum / SeInterval keep their pure-Fenel leaf logic (setEnumDecideEmpty / intervalIsValid ∘ classifyInterval); named / pattern are trivially undecided (Nothing). The cross-query pre-computes ride body-reachable seams — SeWhere → the whereEmpty ctx-native (recognizeAggregableComposition lift), SeIntersect → the in-Fenel pairwise-disjoint LOOP over direct setAlgebraIsDisjoint sibling calls (Phase 1c), SeDiff → the direct setAlgebraIsSubset sibling call (Phase 1c).

engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyDiff.label: set-algebra: decideEmptyDiff
engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyDiff.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage B — A minus B empty iff A empty or A ⊆ B (direct setAlgebraIsSubset sibling call; Phase 1c). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyEufArm.label: set-algebra: decideEmptyEufArm
engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyEufArm.description: decide-substrate Phase 5 / WIDENED Phase 6 — the decider's Nelson-Oppen fall-through: a still-undecided SeWhere leaf ⇒ noDecideWhere over its predicate Expr (EUF congruence + the order theory over the shared universe; unsat ⇒ Just true empty, else Nothing); every other tag ⇒ Nothing. The headline gains: `decideEmpty ⟦{v | f v == 1 ∧ f v == 2}⟧` and `⟦{v | v ≥ 5 ∧ v ≤ 5 ∧ f v ≠ f 5}⟧` both flip Nothing ⇒ Just true. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraDecideEmptyIntersect.label: set-algebra: decideEmptyIntersect
