engine:setAlgebraIsSubset.label: set-algebra: isSubset (recursive)
engine:setAlgebraIsSubset.description: set-algebra-to-fenel Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage D / floor-kernel Phase 4 — recursive isSubset over the CANONICAL registered `$tag` `Se*` SetExpr ADT (TWO args; the per-query marshalled `SisMarshalled` is RETIRED; `marshalSetExprForIsSubset` + `marshalSubsetA`/`marshalSubsetB` + the `Sis*`/`Sisa*`/`Sisb*` types delete). a=∅ ⇒ Just true; b=⊤ ⇒ Just true (checked before the a-dispatch, at every depth); a-Union folds mEvery, a-Intersect folds mSome (sound shortcut) falling to the Fenel `intersectSubsetTail` normalize-retry; an a-leaf self-reasons via the leaf math (intervalSubset / setAlgebraAllValuesIn / inInterval ∘ classifyInterval). The per-direction fed data the marshaller pre-computed now self-reasons in-body: enum⊆named/pattern LOOPS `setAlgebraContains b v` (the b-side membership kill-2-birds), named⊆named the `namedSubsetCheck` ctx-native, and a-SeWhere owns its complete branch order here: `whereExtract` is terminal when applicable, same-Aggregable predicates compare their marshalled facts and prove only through output-set subset, then `setAlgebraWhereSubsetTailRules` preserves the conservative fallback. The host `whereAggregable` seam only marshals recognizer facts; it does not select branches, compare aggregators, recurse, or gate a verdict. a-$pattern⊆pattern uses the `patternSubsetArm` ctx-native (raw patterns, the patternDisjoint twin — Phase 1c dropped its setExprToDollarKey round-trip; a-SePattern⊆non-pattern falls to `setAlgebraSubsetTailRules`), b-$where uses the `whereExtract` ctx-native, and the structural-eq tail is the Fenel `deepEqValue` over canonical `$tag` Se*. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:isSubset.

engine:setAlgebraMuContains.label: set-algebra: muContains
engine:setAlgebraMuContains.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the μ value-membership face: `{w} ⊆ μv.F` by UNROLL-ONCE + structural descent (design/mu-induction.md §0.4) — contains(F[v := μv.F], w); the recursion re-enters this arm only through a SeCtor field (GUARDEDNESS) with a strictly smaller sub-value ⇒ terminates on finite values without fuel. Gated on positive ∧ supported ∧ guarded (an unguarded body like μX.(X ∪ {1}) ⇒ Nothing — the termination guard). Internal helper to setAlgebraContains.

engine:setAlgebraMuEmpty.label: set-algebra: muEmpty
engine:setAlgebraMuEmpty.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1b — the μ emptiness face: `empty(μv.F) ⟺ empty(F[v:=∅])` (design/mu-induction.md §0.2 — one substitution, then the ordinary judgment; NO kernel change). Soundness needs F monotone ⇒ gated on positive ∧ supported (else Nothing). Terminates: μ-nesting depth strictly decreases per unwrap (substituting ∅ introduces no SeMu). `empty(μX.X) = Just true`; `empty(⟦List a⟧) = Just false` (the nullary Nil — the 8μ.1a SeCtor arm composes); `empty(μX.Cons{tail:X}) = Just true` (no base case). Internal helper to setAlgebraDecideEmptyCore.

engine:setAlgebraMuParkLeft.label: set-algebra: muParkLeft
engine:setAlgebraMuParkLeft.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — THE a-side Park rule: subset(μv.F, T). Gate seMuFaceOk (positivity ⇒ monotone ⇒ Park sound) and fuel > 0; RE-DERIVE the premise F[v:=T] via substSet (never trusts a supplied premise); re-check isSubset (F[v:=T]) T with fuel-1 through the fuel entry. Just true ⇒ Just true; anything else ⇒ Nothing (ONLY proves — a failed premise does not refute). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuSubAll.label: set-algebra: muSubAll
engine:setAlgebraMuSubAll.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — a ⊆ (b1 ∩ b2 …): a ⊆ EVERY branch (fuel threaded). All Just true ⇒ Just true; any non-true ⇒ Nothing (only proves). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuSubCtorA.label: set-algebra: muSubCtorA
engine:setAlgebraMuSubCtorA.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — a-SeCtor ⊆ b: b a SeCtor ⇒ fuel-threaded fieldwise (muSubCtorCtor, so a μ TAIL field threads fuel); b a SeMu ⇒ the b-side unroll (the Nil/Cons ⊆ μ premise decomposition — muUnrollRight); b a SeUnion ⇒ a ⊆ some branch (the unrolled `Nil | Cons` split); b a SeIntersect ⇒ a ⊆ every branch; else the ordinary μ-free leaf decision. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuSubCtorCtor.label: set-algebra: muSubCtorCtor
engine:setAlgebraMuSubCtorCtor.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 / type-substrate P1(a) — SeCtor a ⊆ SeCtor b under Park: either side outside the judgment fence (seCtorFieldsFenceOk — added for FACE AGREEMENT, so a reserved/aliased-wire operand cannot get a definite ⊆ from the μ face while mem/emp/dis/sub all answer Nothing) ⇒ Nothing; a coercing ctor (True/False) ⇒ Nothing (Bool stays the enum); DISTINCT ctors ⇒ Nothing (ONLY proves — a Park-context ctor mismatch abstains, it never refutes, so the union `some` moves on to the matching ctor); SAME ctor ⇒ fuel-threaded fieldwise ⊆ (the covariant injectivity rule, muSubCtorFields). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuSubCtorFields.label: set-algebra: muSubCtorFields
engine:setAlgebraMuSubCtorFields.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 / field-identity Phase 3 / type-substrate P1(a) — fieldwise ⊆ under Park, iterated over the WANT side (the μ twin of the ordinary loop's width repair; fuel threaded so a μ tail field re-enters the fuel entry): for every b-field find the a-field carrying the same semantic key and decide via setAlgebraMuSubset (SAME fuel — the μ step inside decrements). All Just true ⇒ Just true; a want key absent on the have side, an aligned pair whose RESOLVED wires disagree, or any non-true ⇒ Nothing (only-proves posture preserved). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuSubEvery.label: set-algebra: muSubEvery
engine:setAlgebraMuSubEvery.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — a-Union ⊆ b: every branch ⊆ b (fuel threaded, same fuel per branch — union is finite/structural, the μ step inside decrements). Just false ⇒ Just false (a branch decidably out); all Just true ⇒ Just true; any Nothing (no Just false) ⇒ Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuSubIntersect.label: set-algebra: muSubIntersect
engine:setAlgebraMuSubIntersect.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — a-Intersect ⊆ b: a SOUND shortcut — if SOME branch is ⊆ b, the whole intersection is ⊆ b. Any Just true ⇒ Just true; else Nothing (only proves). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuSubRight.label: set-algebra: muSubRight
engine:setAlgebraMuSubRight.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — the b-dispatch for a PLAIN-leaf a (interval / ref / pattern / where): SeMu ⇒ the b-side bounded unroll (muUnrollRight); SeUnion ⇒ a ⊆ some branch (muSubSome); SeIntersect ⇒ a ⊆ every branch (muSubAll); else the ordinary μ-free leaf decision (setAlgebraIsSubset — a, b both non-μ leaves, terminates). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuSubSome.label: set-algebra: muSubSome
engine:setAlgebraMuSubSome.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — a ⊆ (b1 ∪ b2 …): a ⊆ SOME branch (fuel threaded). Any Just true ⇒ Just true; else Nothing (only proves — never refutes on all-fail). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuSubset.label: set-algebra: muSubset
engine:setAlgebraMuSubset.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — the fuel-carrying Park/unroll subset entry: ⟦a⟧ ⊆ ⟦b⟧ with a fuel budget for μ-unrolling. deepEq reflexivity first (bottoms recursive `T ⊆ T` tails), then ∅ ⊆ b / a ⊆ ⊤ shortcuts, then dispatch on a (muSubsetA). ONLY proves — every non-Just-true collapses to Nothing at the Park/unroll boundaries (a failed premise never refutes). Internal helper (seeded fuel 4 from the public subset arms; the a-SeMu route in setAlgebraDecideLeafSubset + the b-SeMu arm in setAlgebraSubsetTailRules).

engine:setAlgebraMuSubsetA.label: set-algebra: muSubsetA
engine:setAlgebraMuSubsetA.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — the a-dispatch of the Park subset entry (after reflexivity / ∅ / ⊤ shortcuts): SeMu ⇒ the a-side Park rule (muParkLeft); SeUnion ⇒ every branch ⊆ b (muSubEvery); SeIntersect ⇒ some branch ⊆ b (sound shortcut, muSubIntersect); SeCtor ⇒ fieldwise/unroll/split (muSubCtorA); SeEnum ⇒ per-value membership loop (setAlgebraEnumSubsetMembers — μ value-membership terminates on finite values, no fuel); a plain leaf ⇒ dispatch on b (muSubRight). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraMuUnrollRight.label: set-algebra: muUnrollRight
engine:setAlgebraMuUnrollRight.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.2 — the b-side bounded unroll: subset(S, μw.G). The equi-recursive identity μw.G = G[w := μw.G] exposed ONLY here (arms-only, NOT a normalize rewrite — design §3.3). Gate seMuFaceOk (w positive in G) and fuel > 0; re-check isSubset S (G[w := μw.G]) with fuel-1. Just true ⇒ Just true; else Nothing (same only-prove posture). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraNnf.label: set-algebra: nnf
engine:setAlgebraNnf.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — convert a canonical SetExpr to negation normal form. De Morgan swaps union/intersect under odd parity, double complement flips parity back, diff expands as A∩¬B (and ¬(A∖B) as ¬A∪B), and ¬⊤/¬∅ swap the constants. Complements remain only directly above leaves. Each rewrite is an existing floor-law theorem; the new norm.nnf ledger row classifies their terminating composition.

engine:setAlgebraNnfDiff.label: set-algebra: nnfDiff
engine:setAlgebraNnfDiff.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — the diff arm of NNF: A∖B becomes A∩¬B; under odd parity it becomes ¬A∪B. Named-field branch values are let-bound to avoid the parser's application-valued-field ambiguity. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraNnfPolarity.label: set-algebra: nnfPolarity

engine:setAlgebraNormMinusVoFold.description: decide-substrate (normalize enum-filter honesty) — the { kept, exact } fold for normEnumMinusValueOnly (tri on setAlgebraContains b v). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraNormNodeHandle.label: set-algebra: normNodeHandle
engine:setAlgebraNormNodeHandle.description: Phase 1b — the name-handle of an SeRef node (Maybe String). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraNormNumericInsiders.label: set-algebra: normNumericInsiders
engine:setAlgebraNormNumericInsiders.description: Phase 3b-3 — keep only the numeric insiders (isNumber). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraNormUnionDedupEnum.label: set-algebra: normUnionDedupEnum
engine:setAlgebraNormUnionDedupEnum.description: Phase 2c — dedup union enum values (seen-list fold) + drop values covered by a merged interval; Maybe (List value). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraNormUnionDedupFold.label: set-algebra: normUnionDedupFold
engine:setAlgebraNormUnionDedupFold.description: Phase 2c — the dedup-drop-covered fold (threads seen + acc). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraNormValueOnlyClass.label: set-algebra: normValueOnlyClass
engine:setAlgebraNormValueOnlyClass.description: decide-substrate (normalize enum-filter honesty) — one value's membership class over ALL value-only predicates: any Just false ⇒ "out" (short-circuit); all Just true ⇒ "in"; else (≥1 Nothing, no Just false) ⇒ "unknown". Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraNormVoClassFold.label: set-algebra: normVoClassFold
engine:setAlgebraNormVoClassFold.description: decide-substrate (normalize enum-filter honesty) — the tri-class fold (allTrue threads whether every decided predicate so far was Just true). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraNormalize.label: set-algebra: normalize
engine:setAlgebraNormalize.description: containment-substrate Phase 1b — the structural SetExpr simplifier over the canonical $tag Se* ADT (flatten nested unions/intersects, eliminate ∅/⊤, DNF-distribute, dedup, minimize, splay diffs). Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:normalize; calls the sibling deciders / interval bodies directly under the merged ctx.

engine:setAlgebraNormalizePort.label: set-algebra: normalizePort
engine:setAlgebraNormalizePort.description: named-membership Phase 3 — drop a port equal to the scheme's default (http/ws 80, https/wss 443, ftp 21), mirroring new URL()'s default-port elision. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraOctetCheck.label: set-algebra: octetCheck
engine:setAlgebraOctetCheck.description: named-membership Phase 3 — the first-two-octet private/reserved IPv4 test (true = NOT private). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraOctetsAllLe255.label: set-algebra: octetsAllLe255
engine:setAlgebraOctetsAllLe255.description: named-membership Phase 3c — are all dotted-quad parts numerically <= 255? Mirrors `v.split('.').every(n => parseInt(n) <= 255)`. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraOrderPairOk.label: set-algebra: orderPairOk
engine:setAlgebraOrderPairOk.description: named-membership Phase 1 — the adjacent-pair relation for each list-order mode (ascending → b > a; descending → b < a; nondecreasing → b ≥ a; nonincreasing → b ≤ a). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraOrderedChain.label: set-algebra: orderedChain
engine:setAlgebraOrderedChain.description: named-membership Phase 1 — pairwise-adjacent ordering walk for the list:* order constraints. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraPairDisjointWithAny.label: set-algebra: pairDisjointWithAny
engine:setAlgebraPairDisjointWithAny.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage B — is `x` PROVABLY disjoint (setAlgebraIsDisjoint ⇒ Just true; Phase 1c direct sibling call) from ANY element of `ys`? Inner scan of setAlgebraAnyPairDisjoint. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraParamAfter.label: set-algebra: paramAfter
engine:setAlgebraParamAfter.description: named-membership Phase 1 — slice the param substring after a known prefix. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraPathExt.label: set-algebra: pathExt
engine:setAlgebraPathExt.description: named-membership Phase 1 — format:path:ext:NAME: the last path segment ends in `.<ext>` (case-insensitive); the param lists alternatives via `|`. Non-string → false. Mirrors the `format:path:ext:` branch. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraPathMaxDepth.label: set-algebra: pathMaxDepth
engine:setAlgebraPathMaxDepth.description: named-membership Phase 1 — format:path:max-depth:N: at most N non-empty path segments. Non-string / non-finite N → false. Mirrors the `format:path:max-depth:` branch. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraPathMaxLength.label: set-algebra: pathMaxLength
engine:setAlgebraPathMaxLength.description: named-membership Phase 1 — format:path:max-length:N: string length ≤ N. Non-string / non-finite N → false (code-point count; non-BMP divergence noted in the file header). Mirrors the `format:path:max-length:` branch. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraPathSegments.label: set-algebra: pathSegments
engine:setAlgebraPathSegments.description: named-membership Phase 1 — split a path on both separators (backslash normalised to slash, then split on slash) = TS `v.split(/[\/]/)`. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraPeelListFromMuBody.label: set-algebra: peelListFromMuBody
engine:setAlgebraPeelListFromMuBody.description: Phase 7c — inside a TtMu.body, recognise a TtVariant with Cons/Nil cases. Internal helper to peelList.

engine:setAlgebraPeelListFromOpaquePure.label: set-algebra: peelListFromOpaquePure
engine:setAlgebraPeelListFromOpaquePure.description: Phase 7c — inside a TtOpaque.pure, recognise either a direct TtVariant (Phase 2.5) or a TtMu wrapping a TtVariant (legacy μ); else Nothing (e.g. String's nested List-opaque pure). Internal helper to peelList.

engine:setAlgebraPeelMaybeFromCases.label: set-algebra: peelMaybeFromCases
engine:setAlgebraPeelMaybeFromCases.description: Phase 7c / field-identity Phase 3 — given a TtVariantCase list, validate Nothing/Just shape (Nothing nullary, Just with exactly one positional field at ordinal 0); return the field.raw wrapped in Just when matched. Current wire spelling is never identity. Internal helper to peelMaybe.

engine:setAlgebraPeelResultFromCases.label: set-algebra: peelResultFromCases
engine:setAlgebraPeelResultFromCases.description: Phase 7c — given a TtVariantCase list of length 2, find Err and Ok cases and delegate to setAlgebraExtractResultFields. Internal helper to peelResult.

engine:setAlgebraPhoneShape.label: set-algebra: phoneShape
engine:setAlgebraPhoneShape.description: named-membership Phase 3c — `^\+?[0-9]\d{6,14}$` shape over the stripped string (optional '+', then 7-15 digits). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraPlainHostPort.label: set-algebra: plainHostPort
engine:setAlgebraPlainHostPort.description: named-membership Phase 3 — host/port split for a non-bracketed authority (host(':'port)?). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraPostalShape.label: set-algebra: postalShape
engine:setAlgebraPostalShape.description: named-membership Phase 3c — the postal-code shape over the lowercased value. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraPostalWithSep.label: set-algebra: postalWithSep
engine:setAlgebraPostalWithSep.description: named-membership Phase 3c — postal-code with a single `[\s-]` separator: 2-5 alnum left, separator, 2-5 alnum right (no further non-alnum). Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraSameShape.label: set-algebra: sameShape
engine:setAlgebraSameShape.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage C — do a and b share their canonical SetExpr constructor (the marshaller's setShape(a)===setShape(b) swap gate)? Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraSchemeOfNormalized.label: set-algebra: schemeOfNormalized
engine:setAlgebraSchemeOfNormalized.description: named-membership Phase 3 — the raw scheme token (before the first '://') of the normalized URL. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraSearchable.label: set-algebra: searchable
engine:setAlgebraSearchable.description: decide-substrate Phase 4T Step D′ — true when a SetExpr is PURE-STRUCTURAL (no SeWhere / SeRef / SePattern leaf anywhere): the fragment the decider's search fall-through can decide under ANY dispatch ctx (those three leaves ride ctx-native membership seams that bare-name callers may not carry). SeUnion/SeIntersect branches, SeDiff sides, SeComplement inner recurse; SeEnum/SeInterval/SeAll/SeNone are structural. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraSearchableAll.label: set-algebra: searchableAll
engine:setAlgebraSearchableAll.description: decide-substrate Phase 4T Step D′ — setAlgebraSearchable over every branch of a union/intersect. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraSegTrailingSpaceDot.label: set-algebra: segTrailingSpaceDot
engine:setAlgebraSegTrailingSpaceDot.description: named-membership Phase 1 — a non-empty segment ending in a space or a dot. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraShapeTag.label: set-algebra: shapeTag
engine:setAlgebraShapeTag.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage C — the canonical SetExpr constructor as a tag string (1:1 with decidable-membership.ts:SHAPE_KEY). Internal helper to setAlgebraSameShape.

engine:setAlgebraSortIntervalsFold.label: set-algebra: sortIntervalsFold
engine:setAlgebraSortIntervalsFold.description: Phase 3b-3 — insert each interval into the sorted accumulator. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraSortNumbersFold.label: set-algebra: sortNumbersFold
engine:setAlgebraSortNumbersFold.description: Phase 3b-3 — insert each number into the sorted accumulator. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraStripComma.label: set-algebra: stripComma
engine:setAlgebraStripComma.description: named-membership Phase 3 — drop a single trailing comma. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraStripFraction.label: set-algebra: stripFraction
engine:setAlgebraStripFraction.description: named-membership Phase 3 — drop trailing fractional seconds ('.fff'): the part before the first '.'. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraStripPhone.label: set-algebra: stripPhone
engine:setAlgebraStripPhone.description: named-membership Phase 3c — strip the `[\s\-().]` chars (realistic `\s` members: space, tab, LF, CR, FF, VT) plus `- . ( )`. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraStripZone.label: set-algebra: stripZone
engine:setAlgebraStripZone.description: named-membership Phase 3 — drop a trailing 'Z' or a ±HH:MM offset. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetAllArm.label: set-algebra: subsetAllArm
engine:setAlgebraSubsetAllArm.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage D / floor-kernel Phase 1 soundness fix — ⊤ ⊆ b leaf decision: b=$where ⇒ Nothing; b=∩ ⇒ the exact ∀-rule (mEvery over branches, vacuous Just true on the nullary meet ∩[]); b=∪/∖/¬ ⇒ Nothing (a Boolean compound can denote ⊤ — the old blanket Just false falsely refuted ⊤ ⊆ A∪¬A); leaf shapes ⇒ Just false (domain-bounded, provably ≠ ⊤); b=⊤ handled by the leading SeAll shortcut. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetAllCompound.label: set-algebra: subsetAllCompound
engine:setAlgebraSubsetAllCompound.description: floor-kernel Phase 3c — close missing.sub.top-compound: for a ctx-free union/diff/complement RHS, decide top⊆b by NNF + the shared exact top-cover engine. Both decided polarities pass through; an ungated or out-of-slice compound remains Nothing. Internal helper to setAlgebraSubsetAllArm.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetArrowArm.label: set-algebra: subsetArrowArm
engine:setAlgebraSubsetArrowArm.description: decide-substrate Phase 8λ.1 / 8λ.1-r / 8λ.2-r — the SeArrow ⊆ b face, EMPTINESS-GATED on BOTH SIDES: (1) 8λ.2-r — a b-arrow with SOME param domain decidably EMPTY ⇒ Just true UNCONDITIONALLY (the WANT-side vacuous dual of the 8λ.1-r have-side gate: ∀x∈∅ holds for every callable, so an empty-domain arrow set contains ALL callables ⊇ any arrow set's members — mirrored on the Tt* arrowSub); (2) a decidably-EMPTY have-arrow ⇒ Just true (∅ ⊆ b — the exponential law; refuting on arity was the 8λ.1-r find); else the variance verdict, with a Just-false REFUTATION gated on the have-arrow being decidably NONEMPTY (a maybe-empty have is still ⊆ — honest Nothing). b a non-SeArrow ⇒ Nothing (the leaf-subset dispatch falls to the tail rules). Internal helper to setAlgebraDecideLeafSubset.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetComplementArm.label: set-algebra: subsetComplementArm
engine:setAlgebraSubsetComplementArm.description: floor-kernel Phase 3c — the a-SeComplement subset arm (tcb-ledger missing.sub.lhs-complement → THEOREM): ¬A⊆B iff A∪B covers top. Ctx-free operands are NNF-normalized and routed to setAlgebraTopCover; decided polarities pass through, while misses preserve the old tail rules. NNF makes every pairing inner complement-free, which is the termination measure for the top-cover↔subset composition. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetCtorArm.label: set-algebra: subsetCtorArm
engine:setAlgebraSubsetCtorArm.description: decide-substrate Phase 8μ.1a / 8μ.3 — the SeCtor ⊆ b face (dtDerive injectivity set-side). b a SeCtor ⇒ setAlgebraCtorSubsetCtor; b a SeWhere ⇒ the 8μ.3 ∀-INTRO arm (setAlgebraCtorSubsetWhere — symbolic validity over the ctor's field domains; Nothing falls through to the tail rules so the whereExtract path is preserved); b anything else (SeUnion of SeCtors / eq fallback) ⇒ setAlgebraSubsetTailRules (a ⊆ some branch). Internal helper to setAlgebraDecideLeafSubset.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetDiffArm.label: set-algebra: subsetDiffArm
engine:setAlgebraSubsetDiffArm.description: floor-kernel Phase 3a — the a-SeDiff subset arm (tcb-ledger missing.sub.lhs-diff → THEOREM sub.diff.arm): A∖B ⊆ C decided as A ⊆ B∪C via the sibling setAlgebraIsSubset (∖-def + De Morgan + the subset iso), tri passthrough both polarities (the rewrite's refutation is witness-grade for the original). Gated setAlgebraCtxFree on both operands (D′ ctx discipline); ungated/undecided falls to setAlgebraSubsetTailRules (pre-3a behavior preserved). Internal helper to setAlgebraDecideLeafSubset.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetEnumArm.label: set-algebra: subsetEnumArm
engine:setAlgebraSubsetEnumArm.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage D — {x,y} ⊆ b leaf decision. enum⊆enum (membership), enum⊆interval (inInterval ∘ classifyIntervalValue per value), enum⊆named/pattern (setAlgebraContains LOOP, mEvery), enum⊆$where (whereExtract+recurse), else tail rules. Mirrors set-algebra.ts:setEnumDecideSubset. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetEnumCompound.label: set-algebra: subsetEnumCompound
engine:setAlgebraSubsetEnumCompound.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 soundness fix / Phase 3b kernel face — enum ⊆ ∪/∩/∖/¬ via the exact per-value membership loop. The original setAlgebraSearchable gate remains; Phase 3b admits the same ctx-free arrow-Boolean fragment as decideEmpty so a realized closure witness can re-certify through {w}⊆s. Other non-searchable compounds keep the old tail rules. Internal helper to setAlgebraSubsetEnumArm.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetEvery.label: set-algebra: subsetEvery
engine:setAlgebraSubsetEvery.description: Phase 2a-1 — mEvery semantics over b's $intersect branches for the A ⊆ B∩C tail rule. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetRigidArm.label: set-algebra: subsetRigidArm
engine:setAlgebraSubsetRigidArm.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — κ ⊆ b for a validation rigid a: syntactic self-identity (same scopeToken + ordinal + kind) ⇒ Just true; every other b ⇒ Nothing. `∅ ⊆ κ` and `κ ⊆ ⊤` are decided by the ⊥/⊤ shortcuts above this arm; `⊤ ⊆ κ` is fenced in setAlgebraSubsetAllArm. Never refutes — a Just false at a rigid fails under some ground instantiation. Internal helper to setAlgebraDecideLeafSubset.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetSome.label: set-algebra: subsetSome
engine:setAlgebraSubsetSome.description: Phase 2a-1 / floor-kernel Phase 1 soundness fix — mSome semantics over b's $union branches for the A ⊆ B∪C tail rule: any Just true ⇒ Just true, else Nothing (the old all-Just-false ⇒ Just false collapse falsely refuted an A splitting across branches — the ∃-rule can prove, never refute). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraSubsetTailRules.label: set-algebra: subsetTailRules
engine:setAlgebraSubsetTailRules.description: Phase 3b-3 Step 3 Stage D — ported _subsetTailRules: A ⊆ b's $union (mSome) / $intersect (mEvery) / extracted-$where (whereExtract+recurse) / structural-eq fallback (the Fenel `deepEqValue` structural deep-eq over canonical `$tag` Se*; Phase 1c — the subsetStructEq ctx-native + its `$`-key JSON.stringify round-trip are deleted; deepEqValue mirrors the evaluator's deepEqual, byte-identical over the canonical form — shallow `eq` is reference-shallow on records, so it is NOT a valid fold). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraTakeUntil.label: set-algebra: takeUntil
engine:setAlgebraTakeUntil.description: named-membership Phase 3 — the authority prefix: chars before the first '/', '?', or '#'. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraTakeUntilLoop.label: set-algebra: takeUntilLoop
engine:setAlgebraTakeUntilLoop.description: named-membership Phase 3 — index walk for setAlgebraTakeUntil. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraTopArmDisjoint.label: set-algebra: topArmDisjoint
engine:setAlgebraTopArmDisjoint.description: floor-kernel Phase 3a — the ⊤-arm disjoint driver (tcb-ledger missing.dis.all-completion → THEOREM dis.all — the identity law ⊤∩x = x): the classified fast arm (∅/⊤/enum) byte-preserved, then SaoOther routes to setAlgebraDecideEmpty x under the setAlgebraCtxFree gate (D′ ctx discipline), tri passthrough both polarities. Closes the interval/ctor/μ/arrow/compound ⊤-gaps. Internal helper to setAlgebraIsDisjointLeaf.

engine:setAlgebraTopCover.label: set-algebra: topCover
engine:setAlgebraTopCover.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — decide whether an NNF SetExpr covers ⊤. Exact first slice: constants; enum/interval leaves (provably bounded, hence not ⊤); complement leaves via inner emptiness; intersections by Kleene-every; unions by a branch already covering ⊤ or the pairing equivalence P∪¬N=⊤ iff N⊆P. Anything outside that slice is Nothing. Internal helper to decideEmptyComplement.

engine:setAlgebraTopCoverAnyBranch.label: set-algebra: topCoverAnyBranch
engine:setAlgebraTopCoverAnyBranch.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — does any union branch independently cover ⊤? Only a Just-true counts; false/unknown cannot refute the whole union. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraTopCoverBoundedLeaves.label: set-algebra: topCoverBoundedLeaves
engine:setAlgebraTopCoverBoundedLeaves.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — true iff every branch is an enum/interval/bottom leaf; any such finite union misses other host-domain sorts and cannot be ⊤. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraTopCoverEvery.label: set-algebra: topCoverEvery
engine:setAlgebraTopCoverEvery.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — ⊤ is below an intersection iff it is below every branch (Kleene mAnd; empty intersection is ⊤). Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraTopCoverPair.label: set-algebra: topCoverPair
engine:setAlgebraTopCoverPair.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — decide N⊆P for one P∪¬N pairing. Empty P uses empty(N) directly (avoids the known enum-empty-vs-SeNone subset precision gap); otherwise normalize P before the subset query. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraTopCoverUnion.label: set-algebra: topCoverUnion
engine:setAlgebraTopCoverUnion.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — NNF-union top cover: a branch already equal to ⊤ wins; otherwise try the exact complement pairing scan; with no complement pair, an enum/interval-only union is provably bounded and therefore not ⊤. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraTopCoverUnionOf.label: set-algebra: topCoverUnionOf
engine:setAlgebraTopCoverUnionOf.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — collapse a branch list to bottom/singleton/union for the pairing subset query. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraTopCoverUnionPairs.label: set-algebra: topCoverUnionPairs
engine:setAlgebraTopCoverUnionPairs.description: floor-kernel Phase 3b — scan an NNF union for a complement literal ¬N. For U=P∪¬N, U=⊤ iff N⊆P; build P from the prefix+suffix, normalize it (merging enum/interval covers), and route to the shipped subset face. A decided polarity is exact; an undecided candidate continues the scan. Internal helper.

engine:setAlgebraUrlScheme.label: set-algebra: urlScheme
engine:setAlgebraUrlScheme.description: named-membership Phase 3 — the lowercased URL scheme (part before the first ':' when a valid scheme token), or '' when there is none. Mirrors `/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:/i`. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraWhereSubsetEvery.label: set-algebra: where subset every
engine:setAlgebraWhereSubsetEvery.description: mEvery fold for a SeWhere left operand over right-intersection branches, recursively invoking the top-level subset judgment. Any Just false refutes; all Just true proves; otherwise Nothing.

engine:setAlgebraWhereSubsetSome.label: set-algebra: where subset some
engine:setAlgebraWhereSubsetSome.description: Sound mSome fold for a SeWhere left operand over right-union branches, recursively invoking the top-level subset judgment. Any Just true proves; no positive branch yields Nothing because a set may split across union branches.

engine:setAlgebraWhereSubsetTailRules.label: set-algebra: where subset tail rules
engine:setAlgebraWhereSubsetTailRules.description: The SeWhere-specific subset tail: right union uses a sound proof-only mSome fold through top-level setAlgebraIsSubset, right intersect uses mEvery through that same judgment, right SeWhere extracts and retries, and the terminal is structural equality. Ported from the last live TS _subsetTailRules call in floor-kernel Phase 4.

engine:setAlgebraWiderHi.label: set-algebra: widerHi
engine:setAlgebraWiderHi.description: Phase 7b-continuation — pick the wider hi bound; prefer inclusive on tie.

engine:setAlgebraWiderLo.label: set-algebra: widerLo
engine:setAlgebraWiderLo.description: Phase 7b-continuation — pick the wider lo bound; prefer inclusive on tie.

engine:setAlgebraWinBodyOk.label: set-algebra: winBodyOk
engine:setAlgebraWinBodyOk.description: named-membership Phase 3c — the path body contains none of `<>:"|?*`. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setAlgebraWinUnc.label: set-algebra: winUnc
engine:setAlgebraWinUnc.description: named-membership Phase 3c — the UNC `\\server\share[\rest]` parse: 1+-char server (none of `\/?*:|"<>`), a backslash delimiter, 1+-char share, then optional `[\/]` + rest. Returns the final body forbidden-char check. Helper; tagged engine-internal.

engine:setBodySpan.label: SetExpr body span
engine:setBodySpan.description: Walk a `value ∈`-body token run tracking bracket depth (`()[]{}`), returning `{endOff, rest}`: endOff = the last non-newline body token's `off + length v` (the TS `parseSetForm` endOffset arithmetic), rest = the token list from the depth-0 `nl`/`;`/`eof` terminator onward. Interior (depth>0) newlines are skipped without advancing endOff; brackets are depth-tracked exactly as TS (fenel-parser.ts:945-963). Internal decl-grammar helper. parser-substrate Phase 4i.

engine:setEnumContains.label: set-algebra: setEnumContains
engine:setEnumContains.description: Phase 7b proof-of-pattern — value ∈ {v1, v2, …} pure list-membership test. Returns MaybeBool (Just true / Just false). Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:setEnumContains.

engine:setEnumDecideEmpty.label: set-algebra: setEnumDecideEmpty
engine:setEnumDecideEmpty.description: Phase 7b proof-of-pattern — is the enum set empty? Pure length check returning MaybeBool. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-algebra.ts:setEnumDecideEmpty.

engine:setExprAtom.label: input-layer: setExprAtom
engine:setExprAtom.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — extract the atom name from a name-ref SetExpr. Walks the canonical `$tag` Se* ADT (SeRef handle) directly; the dispatch normalises legacy `$`-key forms to `$tag` upstream via setExprToTag. Strips a "format:" prefix when present (e.g. "format:email" → "email"); Nothing for non-name-ref shapes. Internal helper; dispatched via `dispatchedSetExprAtom` (which now feeds the canonical SetExpr — the TS marshaller marshalSetExprForAtom is deleted).

engine:setExprToConstraints.label: json-schema: setExprToConstraints
engine:setExprToConstraints.description: Phase 3b-3c / floor-kernel Phase 4 — render a canonical 14-case SetExpr to a partial JSON-schema constraint fragment (the cheap-structural reader behind fenelTypeToJsonSchema → forms / FieldRenderer). 11 JSON-Schema-representable arms: SeAll → {} / SeNone → {not:{}} / SeEnum → {enum} / SeRef → format-or-integer / SePattern → {pattern} via rxhPatternToRegex∘rxhReadPat / SeInterval → numeric bounds / SeIntersect → merged branches / SeUnion → {anyOf} / SeComplement → {not} / SeDiff → {allOf} / SeWhere → {} (skip). baseType ("string"|"number") threads into the union/complement/diff arms. Single-key records build via fromEntries (the function-name-key call hazard). SeCtor / SeMu / SeArrow conservatively contribute no JSON-Schema constraint. Boundary legacy input is canonicalized before dispatch. Mirrors json-schema.ts:setExprToConstraints; dispatched from the TS wrapper.

engine:setExprToSqlFragment.label: set-expr-sql: setExprToSqlFragment
engine:setExprToSqlFragment.description: Phase 3b-3e / floor-kernel Phase 4 — render a canonical 14-case SetExpr to a pure SQL-fragment marker tree (the col-on-a-row reader behind db setExprToSQL → entity-query / permission-policy filtering). 11 SQL-representable arms: SeAll → SqlRaw TRUE / SeNone → SqlRaw FALSE / SeEnum → SqlRaw FALSE | SqlCmp = | SqlIn / SeInterval → AND-combined SqlCmp >=/>/<=/< (staticBound skips {$expr}) / SeRef → SqlNamed (leaf NAMED_SQL) / SePattern → SqlMatch via rxhPatternToRegex∘rxhReadPat else SqlRaw TRUE / SeWhere → SqlWhere (carry the raw pred through to the leaf expressionToSQL) / SeUnion → SqlRaw FALSE | rec | SqlOr / SeIntersect → SqlRaw TRUE | rec | SqlAnd / SeComplement → SqlNot / SeDiff → SqlAnd [left, SqlNot right]. SeCtor / SeMu / SeArrow use the conservative fallback. col is NOT a param (constant + position-only; the leaf substitutes it). Boundary legacy input is canonicalized before dispatch. The db sqlFragToSql leaf reconstitutes the Drizzle sql object. Mirrors set-expr-sql.ts:setExprToSQL; dispatched from the TS wrapper.

engine:setFieldFuncType.label: setField func type
engine:setFieldFuncType.description: Build the (externref, i32, externref) -> () WasmFuncType for the $fenel.setField runtime helper. Positional field mutation: writes fieldValue into the AdtHandle's slot at index. Used when fieldNames metadata is absent (legacy / unregistered ctors).

engine:setFieldNamedFuncType.label: setFieldNamed func type
engine:setFieldNamedFuncType.description: Build the (externref, i32, externref, externref) -> () WasmFuncType for the $fenel.setFieldNamed runtime helper. Phase 21.1 named-field path: writes (fieldValue, name) into the AdtHandle's slot at index. Used when CeConstruct.fields supplies a name list or for every CeRecord field.

engine:setRepresentation.label: representations: setRepresentation
engine:setRepresentation.description: Phase 10b sub-step 3 — add or replace a representational instance for a target via dispatchRegister (sync native). Wraps args = [targetId]; preserves the TS surface's overwrite-via-higher-priority idiom (the native sets priority=Date.now()). Returns a confirmation echo record ({typeName, args, methods, scope}); the registry-side priority lives in the registry, not in the echo (consumers treat the return as a confirmation, not a queryable). In-memory only — caller is responsible for persisting to typeclass_instances. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedSetRepresentation`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/representations.ts:setRepresentation.

engine:setSemanticEq.label: SetExpr semantic equality
engine:setSemanticEq.description: Identity-aware semantic equality for canonical SetExpr values. SeCtor fields align by FieldKey and must ALSO agree on their RESOLVED wire projection (type-substrate P1(a): the fields walk ignored wireName entirely, so two ctors reading DIFFERENT host properties compared equal and the μ entry's reflexivity shortcut — which sits ABOVE the fieldwise loops — proved ⊆ between them; setAlgebraNormDiffMain collapsed their difference to SeNone by the same predicate). SeArrow params align by list position and ignore key/wire metadata — deliberately: an arrow param's wire/key is retained reflection metadata, never host-read. This predicate is only ever a proof SHORTCUT or a collapse trigger, never a refuter, so a stricter answer can only degrade to the fallback; reflexivity on identical operands is preserved (identical fields resolve identically). Runtime value equality remains unchanged.

engine:setSyntaxAdjustDepth.label: set-syntax: adjustDepth
engine:setSyntaxAdjustDepth.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — `[`/`(` increment depth; `]`/`)` decrement; else unchanged. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxAdvance.label: set-syntax: advance
engine:setSyntaxAdvance.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — return a new ParseState with pos += n. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxBuildIntersect.label: set-syntax: buildIntersect
engine:setSyntaxBuildIntersect.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — 1-child → single child as-is (no PseIntersect wrap); ≥2 → PseIntersect { branches }. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxBuildUnion.label: set-syntax: buildUnion
engine:setSyntaxBuildUnion.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — 1-child → return single child as-is (no PseUnion wrap); ≥2 → PseUnion { branches }. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxCh.label: set-syntax: ch
engine:setSyntaxCh.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — read the char at current pos; returns "" if past end. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxChAt.label: set-syntax: chAt
engine:setSyntaxChAt.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — read the char at pos+offset with bounds check; "" if out of range. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxClassifyBareWord.label: set-syntax: classifyBareWord
engine:setSyntaxClassifyBareWord.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — true / false / null → typed PsValue markers; else PsvString of the accumulated word. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxConsumeDecimalDigits.label: set-syntax: consumeDecimalDigits
engine:setSyntaxConsumeDecimalDigits.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — advance past `[0-9]+`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxConsumeExponentBody.label: set-syntax: consumeExponentBody
engine:setSyntaxConsumeExponentBody.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — after `e`/`E`, optionally consume `+`/`-` then digits. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxConsumeNameBody.label: set-syntax: consumeNameBody
engine:setSyntaxConsumeNameBody.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — advance past name-body chars. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxConsumeOptionalExponent.label: set-syntax: consumeOptionalExponent
engine:setSyntaxConsumeOptionalExponent.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — if current char is `e`/`E`, consume + optional sign + digits. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxConsumeOptionalFraction.label: set-syntax: consumeOptionalFraction
engine:setSyntaxConsumeOptionalFraction.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — if current char is `.` AND next is NOT `.` (range separator), consume `.` + digits. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxConsumePatternBody.label: set-syntax: consumePatternBody
engine:setSyntaxConsumePatternBody.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — consume regex chars with `\`-escape until closing `/`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxConsumeQuoted.label: set-syntax: consumeQuoted
engine:setSyntaxConsumeQuoted.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — recursive char consumer inside parseQuotedString. `acc` is the partial string built so far. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxConsumeRadixDigits.label: set-syntax: consumeRadixDigits
engine:setSyntaxConsumeRadixDigits.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — advance while current char matches the radix's digit predicate. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxConsumeSign.label: set-syntax: consumeSign
engine:setSyntaxConsumeSign.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — optionally consume `+` or `-`. Returns `{ newState, value: ±1 }`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxDisplayName.label: set-syntax: displayName
engine:setSyntaxDisplayName.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — named-set display aliases (the DISPLAY_NAMES table: Nat→ℕ / Int→ℤ / Rational→ℚ / Real→ℝ; everything else verbatim). Internal helper (was the TS resolveDisplayName).

engine:setSyntaxEmitInterval.label: set-syntax: emitInterval
engine:setSyntaxEmitInterval.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — assemble the PseInterval markers from the lo/hi Maybe-bounds + their inclusive flags. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxEnumReprs.label: set-syntax: enumReprs
engine:setSyntaxEnumReprs.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — map each raw enum value to its repr (jsLit for strings / toString otherwise), in original order. Was the TS fmtEnumValueRepr. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxExpectChar.label: set-syntax: expectChar
engine:setSyntaxExpectChar.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — skipWs + assert that current char equals `expected` + advance. Returns Err with the TS oracle's exact format if mismatched. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxExpectDoubleDot.label: set-syntax: expectDoubleDot
engine:setSyntaxExpectDoubleDot.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — assert `..` at current pos + advance 2. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFinishInterval.label: set-syntax: finishInterval
engine:setSyntaxFinishInterval.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — consume closing bracket + assemble PseInterval with Maybe-wrapped bounds. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundClose.label: set-syntax: fmtBoundClose
engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundClose.description: Phase 7d sub-step 1 — closing bracket for the hi side: Nothing → `)`; Just inclusive → `]`; Just exclusive → `)`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundOpen.label: set-syntax: fmtBoundOpen
engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundOpen.description: Phase 7d sub-step 1 — opening bracket for the lo side: Nothing → `(`; Just inclusive → `[`; Just exclusive → `(`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundRepr.label: set-syntax: fmtBoundRepr
engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundRepr.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — render a raw interval-bound value: `$expr`-typed (object with the `$expr` key, via `lookup`) → `expr(…)`; string → jsLit; else → toString. Was the TS fmtBoundReprStr. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundValueHi.label: set-syntax: fmtBoundValueHi
engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundValueHi.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — rendered hi-value repr or `∞` sentinel for unbounded hi. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundValueLo.label: set-syntax: fmtBoundValueLo
engine:setSyntaxFmtBoundValueLo.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — rendered lo-value repr or `-∞` sentinel for unbounded lo. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtBranches.label: set-syntax: fmtBranches
engine:setSyntaxFmtBranches.description: Phase 7d sub-step 1 — map setSyntaxFmtExpr over a list of branches with a fixed ctx. Equivalent to `branches.map(b => fmtExpr(b, ctx))` in TS; the recursion threads an accumulator since Fenel doesn't have a closure-friendly `map` here. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtEnumReprs.label: set-syntax: fmtEnumReprs
engine:setSyntaxFmtEnumReprs.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — assemble `{r0, r1, ...}` from the rendered value reprs (List String). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtExpr.label: set-syntax: fmtExpr
engine:setSyntaxFmtExpr.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — recursive formatter dispatcher over the canonical Se* ADT. `ctx` is the enclosing operator context ("top" | "union" | "intersect" | "unary") used to decide whether SeUnion arms need surrounding parens (precedence: union < intersect < complement). The `_` arm is the unknown-shape JSON fallback. Internal helper to formatSetExpr.

engine:setSyntaxFmtIntersect.label: set-syntax: fmtIntersect
engine:setSyntaxFmtIntersect.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — render the named-range short-form `Name[lo..hi]` (a 2-branch SeIntersect of a SeRef + a SeInterval, either order) when it applies, else the n-ary general case `a ∩ b ∩ c`. The named-range detection was the TS `tryNamedRange`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtInterval.label: set-syntax: fmtInterval
engine:setSyntaxFmtInterval.description: Phase 7d sub-step 1 — assemble `[lo..hi]` / `(lo..hi)` (or `-∞`/`∞` for unbounded sides) from a pre-marshalled FmtIntervalAdt. Brackets resolved by bound's `inclusive` Bool. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtPatternRepr.label: set-syntax: fmtPatternRepr
engine:setSyntaxFmtPatternRepr.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — render `/regex/` via `rxhPatternToRegex (rxhReadPat p)` (the already-Fenel regex serialiser, ok ⇒ the anchored regex); `$pattern(…)` placeholder when ok = false. Takes the raw legacy `.t`-Pattern. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxFmtUnion.label: set-syntax: fmtUnion
engine:setSyntaxFmtUnion.description: Phase 7d sub-step 1 — render `a ∪ b ∪ c`. Wraps in parens when the enclosing ctx is `intersect` or `unary` (precedence: union < intersect < complement). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsAlnum.label: set-syntax: isAlnum
engine:setSyntaxIsAlnum.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — char-class predicate: `[a-zA-Z0-9]`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsAlpha.label: set-syntax: isAlpha
engine:setSyntaxIsAlpha.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — char-class predicate: `[a-zA-Z]`. Implemented via std:elem over the alphabet lookup string. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsBinaryDigit.label: set-syntax: isBinaryDigit
engine:setSyntaxIsBinaryDigit.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — char-class predicate: `[01]`. Used by parseRadixMagnitude for `0b…` literals. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsDigit.label: set-syntax: isDigit
engine:setSyntaxIsDigit.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — char-class predicate: `[0-9]`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsHexDigit.label: set-syntax: isHexDigit
engine:setSyntaxIsHexDigit.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — char-class predicate: `[0-9a-fA-F]`. Used by parseRadixMagnitude for `0x…` literals. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsIntervalStart.label: set-syntax: isIntervalStart
engine:setSyntaxIsIntervalStart.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — depth-tracked lookahead for `..` at depth 0 to disambiguate `[lo..hi]` (interval) from `(expr) ∪ ...` (grouped expr). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsMathLetter.label: set-syntax: isMathLetter
engine:setSyntaxIsMathLetter.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — char-class predicate: `[ℕℤℚℝ]` (the named-set math letters used for hierarchy atom names). All four are BMP code points; string equality suffices. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsNameBodyChar.label: set-syntax: isNameBodyChar
engine:setSyntaxIsNameBodyChar.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — char-class predicate for NAME continuation chars: `[a-zA-Z0-9:_-]`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsNameHeadChar.label: set-syntax: isNameHeadChar
engine:setSyntaxIsNameHeadChar.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — char-class predicate for the first char of a NAME: `[a-zA-Zℕℤℚℝ]`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsOctalDigit.label: set-syntax: isOctalDigit
engine:setSyntaxIsOctalDigit.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — char-class predicate: `[0-7]`. Used by parseRadixMagnitude for `0o…` literals. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsRadixDigit.label: set-syntax: isRadixDigit
engine:setSyntaxIsRadixDigit.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — dispatch on radix to the right digit predicate (hex/octal/binary). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsRadixPrefix.label: set-syntax: isRadixPrefix
engine:setSyntaxIsRadixPrefix.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — `0[xob]`-style prefix detection. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsUFollower.label: set-syntax: isUFollower
engine:setSyntaxIsUFollower.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — `U` followed by alphanum / `:` / `_` / `-` is the start of a NAME (e.g. `UnicodeString`), NOT the universal-set shorthand. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxIsWs.label: set-syntax: isWs
engine:setSyntaxIsWs.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — whitespace predicate: space / tab / newline / CR. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxMatchIntersectOp.label: set-syntax: matchIntersectOp
engine:setSyntaxMatchIntersectOp.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — recognise `∩` / `n` (not followed by alnum) / `&` (not followed by `&`). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxMatchIntersectOpAscii.label: set-syntax: matchIntersectOpAscii
engine:setSyntaxMatchIntersectOpAscii.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — ASCII alternatives for matchIntersectOp. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxMatchLiteral.label: set-syntax: matchLiteral
engine:setSyntaxMatchLiteral.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — skipWs + check if `lit` starts at the current pos. On match, advance past the literal and return Just newState; on no match, return Nothing. Mirrors the TS oracle's `match(s)`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxMatchUnionOp.label: set-syntax: matchUnionOp
engine:setSyntaxMatchUnionOp.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — recognise `∪` / `u` (not followed by alnum) / `|` (not followed by `|`). Returns Just newState if matched (with the operator consumed), Nothing otherwise. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxMatchUnionOpAscii.label: set-syntax: matchUnionOpAscii
engine:setSyntaxMatchUnionOpAscii.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — ASCII alternatives for matchUnionOp: `u` followed by non-alnum; `|` followed by non-`|`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxNamedRange.label: set-syntax: namedRange
engine:setSyntaxNamedRange.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — detect a 2-branch SeIntersect that is a SeRef + a SeInterval (either order) → Just "Name[lo..hi]"; Nothing otherwise. Was the TS tryNamedRange. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxNamedRangeOf.label: set-syntax: namedRangeOf
engine:setSyntaxNamedRangeOf.description: containment-substrate Phase 1a — `Just "Name[lo..hi]"` when x is a SeRef and y is a SeInterval (display name ++ interval body); Nothing otherwise. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxOrEofChar.label: set-syntax: orEofChar
engine:setSyntaxOrEofChar.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — render "" as "EOF" for error messages. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseAtom.label: set-syntax: parseAtom
engine:setSyntaxParseAtom.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — leading-char dispatcher over `∅`/`U`/`(`/`[`/`{`/`/`/NAME. Returns Result String ParseSuccess with value = ParsedSetExpr. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseAtomAfterEmpty.label: set-syntax: parseAtomAfterEmpty
engine:setSyntaxParseAtomAfterEmpty.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — `∅` ruled out; check for `U` (standalone universal set). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseAtomAfterU.label: set-syntax: parseAtomAfterU
engine:setSyntaxParseAtomAfterU.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — `∅`/`U` ruled out; dispatch on the leading char for `(`/`[`/`{`/`/`/NAME. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseAtomNamed.label: set-syntax: parseAtomNamed
engine:setSyntaxParseAtomNamed.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — consume a NAME + check for named-range shape (`Name[lo..hi]` or `Name(lo..hi]`). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseAtomNamedAfterName.label: set-syntax: parseAtomNamedAfterName
engine:setSyntaxParseAtomNamedAfterName.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — name parsed; check if a named-range bracket follows. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseAtomParen.label: set-syntax: parseAtomParen
engine:setSyntaxParseAtomParen.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — `(` could be either an interval lo-exclusive or a grouped expression. Use isIntervalStart to disambiguate. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseBareWord.label: set-syntax: parseBareWord
engine:setSyntaxParseBareWord.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — consume non-comma / non-`}` / non-whitespace chars into a word. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseBound.label: set-syntax: parseBound
engine:setSyntaxParseBound.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — number / quoted-string / -∞ / ∞ / empty. Returns `Result String ParseSuccess` with value = `Maybe scalar` (Nothing for unbounded, Just for present). Internal helper to parseInterval (sub-step 3).

engine:setSyntaxParseBoundNumber.label: set-syntax: parseBoundNumber
engine:setSyntaxParseBoundNumber.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — call parseNumber + wrap result's value in Just. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseBoundPositive.label: set-syntax: parseBoundPositive
engine:setSyntaxParseBoundPositive.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — sub-branch after negative-infinity literals ruled out. Match positive-infinity literals or dispatch to bound-value-or-empty. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseBoundString.label: set-syntax: parseBoundString
engine:setSyntaxParseBoundString.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — call parseQuotedString + wrap result's value in Just. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseBoundValueOrEmpty.label: set-syntax: parseBoundValueOrEmpty
engine:setSyntaxParseBoundValueOrEmpty.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — leading char selects: `.`/`]`/`)`/EOF → unbounded; `"`/`'` → quoted-string; otherwise → number. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseDecimal.label: set-syntax: parseDecimal
engine:setSyntaxParseDecimal.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — consume decimal digits + optional fraction + optional exponent, convert via std:toNumber, apply sign. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseEnumSet.label: set-syntax: parseEnumSet
engine:setSyntaxParseEnumSet.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — `{ v0, v1, ... }`. Returns Result String ParseSuccess where value is PseEnum { reprs }. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseEnumValueStep.label: set-syntax: parseEnumValueStep
engine:setSyntaxParseEnumValueStep.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — parse one value + recurse with the appended accumulator. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseEnumValuesLoop.label: set-syntax: parseEnumValuesLoop
engine:setSyntaxParseEnumValuesLoop.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — fold values into the accumulator until `}` is reached. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseExpr.label: set-syntax: parseExpr
engine:setSyntaxParseExpr.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — top of the grammar; delegates to parseUnion. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseGroupedExpr.label: set-syntax: parseGroupedExpr
engine:setSyntaxParseGroupedExpr.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — consume `(` + setSyntaxParseExpr (forward-ref to sub-step 4) + consume `)`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseIntersect.label: set-syntax: parseIntersect
engine:setSyntaxParseIntersect.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — `unary ( intersect-op unary )*`. Same fold pattern as parseUnion. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseIntersectTail.label: set-syntax: parseIntersectTail
engine:setSyntaxParseIntersectTail.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — consume `intersect-op unary` pairs. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseInterval.label: set-syntax: parseInterval
engine:setSyntaxParseInterval.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — `[` or `(` + parseBound + `..` + parseBound + `]` or `)`. Returns Result String ParseSuccess where value is PseInterval. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseIntervalAfterOpen.label: set-syntax: parseIntervalAfterOpen
engine:setSyntaxParseIntervalAfterOpen.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — bracket consumed; parse the lo bound, then `..` separator, then the hi bound, then closing bracket. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseName.label: set-syntax: parseName
engine:setSyntaxParseName.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — `[a-zA-Zℕℤℚℝ][a-zA-Z0-9:_-]*` identifier. Optional match — returns `Maybe ParseSuccess`. Internal helper to parseAtom (sub-step 3).

engine:setSyntaxParseNumber.label: set-syntax: parseNumber
engine:setSyntaxParseNumber.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — decimal / hex / octal / binary with optional sign + decimal point + exponent. Admits whitespace between sign and magnitude (per parseSetForm re-emission convention). Returns `Result String ParseSuccess`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseNumberWithSign.label: set-syntax: parseNumberWithSign
engine:setSyntaxParseNumberWithSign.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — delegate to parseRadixMagnitude + apply sign. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParsePattern.label: set-syntax: parsePattern
engine:setSyntaxParsePattern.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — `/regex/` with `\`-escape. Emits PsePattern { regexStr } intent marker; the wrapper calls regexStringToPattern at unmarshal time. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseQuotedString.label: set-syntax: parseQuotedString
engine:setSyntaxParseQuotedString.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — consume a quoted string (`"foo"` or `'bar'`) with `\`-escape. Pre-condition: `state` points at the opening quote. Returns `Result String ParseSuccess` (Err on unterminated). Internal helper to parseValue / parseBound (sub-step 3).

engine:setSyntaxParseRadixDigits.label: set-syntax: parseRadixDigits
engine:setSyntaxParseRadixDigits.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — fold a digit string into a number via `acc * radix + digitValue(c)`. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseRadixMagnitude.label: set-syntax: parseRadixMagnitude
engine:setSyntaxParseRadixMagnitude.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — unsigned magnitude in given radix (16/8/2). State points AT the leading `0` of the prefix; returns Err on empty-digits. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseSetExpr.label: set-syntax: parseSetExpr
engine:setSyntaxParseSetExpr.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — public entry. Parses an expression, then verifies all input was consumed (mirroring the TS oracle's `if (p.pos < p.src.length) throw new SyntaxError`). Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedParseSetExpr` in engine-bodies-dispatch.ts which marshals the input string into ParseState + unmarshals ParsedSetExpr → raw SetExpr. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/set-syntax.ts:parseSetExpr (now a thin shim).

engine:setSyntaxParseUnary.label: set-syntax: parseUnary
engine:setSyntaxParseUnary.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — `!` atom | `¬` atom | atom. Emits PseComplement when the negation prefix is consumed. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseUnaryComplement.label: set-syntax: parseUnaryComplement
engine:setSyntaxParseUnaryComplement.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — atom consumed after negation prefix; wrap in PseComplement. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseUnion.label: set-syntax: parseUnion
engine:setSyntaxParseUnion.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — `intersect ( union-op intersect )*`. Folds branches; 1-child → single child as-is; ≥2 → PseUnion. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseUnionTail.label: set-syntax: parseUnionTail
engine:setSyntaxParseUnionTail.description: Phase 7d sub-step 4 — consume `union-op intersect` pairs while the operator matches. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseValue.label: set-syntax: parseValue
engine:setSyntaxParseValue.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — enum value dispatch: quoted-string / signed-number / bare-word. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseValueNumOrWord.label: set-syntax: parseValueNumOrWord
engine:setSyntaxParseValueNumOrWord.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — try parseNumber; on Err, fall through to parseBareWord at the original position (mirrors the TS oracle's `try/catch + this.pos = start` rollback). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxParseValueQuoted.label: set-syntax: parseValueQuoted
engine:setSyntaxParseValueQuoted.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — call parseQuotedString + wrap as PsvString. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxPeek.label: set-syntax: peek
engine:setSyntaxPeek.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — skipWs + return current char. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxRadixDigitValue.label: set-syntax: radixDigitValue
engine:setSyntaxRadixDigitValue.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — numeric value of a hex / oct / bin digit char (a-f / A-F → 10-15; 0-9 → 0-9). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxScanContinue.label: set-syntax: scanContinue
engine:setSyntaxScanContinue.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — advance one char + adjust depth + recurse. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxScanDepthZero.label: set-syntax: scanDepthZero
engine:setSyntaxScanDepthZero.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — at depth 0, check for `..` / closing-bracket / grouped-expr-marker; otherwise track bracket depth. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxScanForDoubleDot.label: set-syntax: scanForDoubleDot
engine:setSyntaxScanForDoubleDot.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — char-by-char lookahead. At depth 0: check for `..`/closing-bracket/grouped-expr-marker. Otherwise track depth. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxScanWithDepth.label: set-syntax: scanWithDepth
engine:setSyntaxScanWithDepth.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — at depth > 0, track bracket depth via continue. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxSkipWs.label: set-syntax: skipWs
engine:setSyntaxSkipWs.description: Phase 7d sub-step 2 — advance past whitespace; returns the new ParseState. Recursive char-by-char loop. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxSpacedSymbol.label: set-syntax: spacedSymbol
engine:setSyntaxSpacedSymbol.description: containment-substrate Phase 2 Step 3 — a former glyph wrapped in single spaces (` ∪ ` / ` \ `), the infix separator the union/intersect/diff arms emit. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxSymbol.label: set-syntax: symbol
engine:setSyntaxSymbol.description: containment-substrate Phase 2 Step 3 — resolve a former's display glyph via the Symbolable projection (`getSymbol former`); the Nothing arm degrades to "" (never re-inlines a parallel glyph). Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxTryNamedRange.label: set-syntax: tryNamedRange
engine:setSyntaxTryNamedRange.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — the bracket might be a range OR the start of a grouped expression operator on a named set; use isIntervalStart. Emits PseNamedRange or PseNamed. Internal helper.

engine:setSyntaxWrapBound.label: set-syntax: wrapBound
engine:setSyntaxWrapBound.description: Phase 7d sub-step 3 — `Maybe scalar` → `Maybe PsBound`. Nothing stays Nothing; Just x becomes Just (PsBound { boundVal = x, inclusive }). Internal helper.

engine:shortIdOf.label: identifiable: shortIdOf
engine:shortIdOf.description: Phase 10c sub-step 2 PARTIAL — last-resort short-id helper for values lacking any other label. The TS wrapper classifies `value` into ShortIdInput (SidString s / SidObject id / SidNone — non-empty string, object with non-empty string `id`, or none); the body dispatches on the variant + truncates inline (`slice s 0 8 ++ "…"` when its UTF-16 code-unit length is greater than 8, else passthrough). The shared lexer `unitLen` helper preserves JavaScript `.length` semantics for astral characters, while `slice` already uses UTF-16 indexes. Ellipsis is U+2026 HORIZONTAL ELLIPSIS, byte-equivalent to the TS oracle. Boundary adapter; dispatched via `dispatchedShortIdOf`. Mirrors implementations/typescript/engine/src/identifiable.ts:shortIdOf.

engine:shouldUseNamedFields.label: Should use named fields
engine:shouldUseNamedFields.description: Decide whether a pattern's field-name list should attach to PatConstruct. True when ctorDef is registered, list is non-empty, AND every name is in ctorDef.

engine:showPat.label: Show pattern
engine:showPat.description: A total, deterministic structural string rendering of a Pat (PMatch carries an opaque pred key) — the coinductive memo key. Distinct Brzozowski states render to distinct strings. Internal helper.

engine:sigFrame.label: Sig frame
engine:sigFrame.description: Assemble a `{type_sig: {name, type, directives?}}` frame; type kept as the `{mk}` marker for the TS walkType marshal. parser-substrate Phase 5a.

engine:simplePatArgs.label: fork: simple-pat-args
engine:simplePatArgs.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 — true when every ctor-argument pattern is simple (PatVar / PatWildcard / PatLit); a nested PatConstruct (or anything else) makes the enclosing ctor pattern non-forkable. Internal helper.

engine:simplifyEmpty.label: Simplify empty
engine:simplifyEmpty.description: Rewrite a body PROPAGATING emptiness through references: a `PRef n` whose production is in the empty INDEX `empt` (name→true) becomes `PEmpty`, and the smart constructors re-fire bottom-up so `∅` factors annihilate (`mkSeq ∅ = ∅`) and `∅` branches drop (`mkAlt ∅ x = x`, preserving first-Just-wins since a `∅` branch never yields a Just). `PRep` just recurses into its child (NO `mx==0` collapse — that would wrongly empty a nullable exhausted rep; a genuinely-`∅` rep, `mn>0` over a `∅` child, is caught by `bodyEmptyUnder` at the production level + the row-drop). Only called in the elimination's empty-present branch (the common empty-free step keeps the OLD reachability prune verbatim). Language-and-value preserving. Internal helper. parser-substrate Phase 8.

engine:singleParamLambda.label: Single-param lambda peel
engine:singleParamLambda.description: If `lam` is an ELambda of exactly one param, returns Just { param, value, body }; otherwise Nothing. Helper to applyDollarPair.

engine:singletonUnionToEnum.label: Singleton union to enum
engine:singletonUnionToEnum.description: floor-kernel Phase 1 — the enum-decomposition derivation witness (bwd, partial): a `SeUnion` whose branches are ALL enums merges their value lists back into one `SeEnum` (order-preserving concat); any non-enum branch ⇒ Nothing (no enum preimage — the union genuinely mixes formers). Left-inverse of enumToSingletonUnion.

engine:skipBT.label: Skip backtick template (depth scan)
engine:skipBT.description: Index just past a `` ` ``-template (handling `\`-escapes) — the naive skip the interpolation-hole brace scan uses (`fenel-parser.ts:162`). `i` is just past the opening backtick. Internal lexer helper.

engine:skipDQ.label: Skip double-quote string (depth scan)
engine:skipDQ.description: Index just past a `"`-string (handling `\`-escapes) — the naive skip the interpolation-hole brace scan uses so a `}` inside a nested string doesn't close the hole (`fenel-parser.ts:161`). `i` is just past the opening quote. Internal lexer helper.

engine:skipSpaces.label: Skip spaces
engine:skipSpaces.description: Index after skipping inline spaces/tabs from `i` (the backtick-infix whitespace tolerance `` ` add ` ``). Does NOT skip newlines. Internal lexer helper.

engine:skipToNl.label: Skip to newline
engine:skipToNl.description: Index of the first `\n` at or after `i` (or `n` at EOF) — the body of a `--` line comment. Internal lexer helper.

engine:soEvidence.label: law-validate: soEvidence
engine:soEvidence.description: Phase 6b0 — grade a well-formed Verified value's evidence via gradeEvidence; a 'fail' status emits the error (with the graded reason), 'pass' and 'uncheckable' emit nothing (the permissive policy — KernelProven's reserved uncheckable is accepted at construction time). Internal helper.

engine:soEvidenceMalformed.label: law-validate: soEvidenceMalformed
engine:soEvidenceMalformed.description: Phase 6b0 — the malformed-evidence predicate over the marshalled facts: absent OR not typeof-object OR `$tag` not a string. Internal helper.

engine:soField.label: law-validate: soField
engine:soField.description: Phase 6b0 — one field's classification: skip non-Verified; invalid value ⇒ prove-candidate (hook present + strictly undefined) or the missing-value error; malformed evidence ⇒ its error; else grade the evidence. Internal helper.

engine:soMissingMsg.label: law-validate: soMissingMsg
engine:soMissingMsg.description: Phase 6b0 — build the verbatim missing-Verified-value message embedding the marshalled typeof string. Internal helper.

engine:soValueInvalid.label: law-validate: soValueInvalid
engine:soValueInvalid.description: Phase 6b0 — the invalid-value predicate over the marshalled typeof facts: falsy OR array OR not typeof-object. Internal helper.

engine:soWalk.label: law-validate: soWalk
engine:soWalk.description: Phase 6b0 — accumulator-threaded recursion over the marshalled field-fact list, appending each field's outcome entries in field order. Internal helper.

engine:solve.label: Solve
engine:solve.description: Find a witness value satisfying a predicate `Expr` over a SINGLE free variable — LITERALLY `inhabit ∘ comprehend` (the decide-substrate one-judgment composition): `comprehend` lowers the body to the canonical `Se*` SetExpr, `inhabit` extracts a witness from it. Discovers the free var via `collectFreeVars`; 0 or ≥2 free vars ⇒ Nothing (the documented v1 fence). The decidable fragment (eq / comparisons / and / or / not / the P12 affine inversion) yields enum/interval witnesses; out-of-fragment shapes ⇒ Nothing (the SeWhere fence). expr-substrate Phase 5; representation collapsed decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage B; `solveFn f = solve (reify f)` is the ergonomic surface.

engine:solveAll.label: Solve all
engine:solveAll.description: The findall sibling of `solve`: enumerate ALL witnesses of a single-free-var predicate `Expr` ⇒ Maybe (List a) — LITERALLY `enumerateSet ∘ comprehend`. Discovers the free var via collectFreeVars; 0 or ≥2 free vars ⇒ Nothing (solve's documented fence). `solveAll (x == 5 or x == 7)` ⇒ Just [5, 7]. `Just []` = decidable-but-empty (e.g. SeNone); `Nothing` = the free-var fence or a non-enumerable set (interval / out-of-fragment). solve stays byte-untouched. expr-substrate Phase 15; Se* since decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage B.

engine:solveFn.label: Solve fn
engine:solveFn.description: The locked composition `solveFn f = solve (reify f)`: reify the marshalled Fn value to its `Expr` body + captures, substitute the captured values into the body (substituteCaptures), then solve for a witness. reify's Err (bodyless / native / non-reifiable) ⇒ Nothing (solveFn is Maybe-typed; the Result lives on reify). The captures path is the reify payoff: `y = 5; \x -> x == y` ⇒ Just 5. expr-substrate Phase 5.

engine:solveFnAll.label: Solve fn all
engine:solveFnAll.description: The findall composition `solveFnAll f = solveAll (reify f)`: reify the marshalled Fn value to its `Expr` body + captures, substitute the captures, then enumerate all witnesses. reify's Err (bodyless / native / non-reifiable) ⇒ Nothing. The list-valued sibling of solveFn. expr-substrate Phase 15.

engine:solveFnRel.label: Solve fn relational
engine:solveFnRel.description: The relational composition `solveFnRel f facts = solveRel (reify f) facts` (with the lambda's PARAMS as the ordered unknowns): reify the marshalled Fn value to its `Expr` body + captures, substitute the captures, then relational-solve over the param order against the threaded fact base. reify's Err (bodyless / native / non-reifiable) ⇒ Nothing. The headline grandparent query `\x y -> and (parentOf x y) (parentOf y "eleonora")` rides this. expr-substrate Phase 13.

engine:solveFnRelAll.label: Solve fn relational all
engine:solveFnRelAll.description: The findall relational composition `solveFnRelAll f facts = solveRelAll (reify f) facts` (with the lambda's PARAMS as the ordered unknowns): reify, substitute the captures, run relSolveSet over the param order against the threaded fact base, then enumerate the tuple set ⇒ EVERY satisfying binding. reify's Err ⇒ Nothing; safe-but-empty ⇒ Just []; unsafe ⇒ Nothing. expr-substrate Phase 15.

engine:solveFnSymbolic.label: Solve fn symbolic
engine:solveFnSymbolic.description: The lambda symbolic-solve composition: reify the marshalled Fn value to its `Expr` body + captures, substitute the captures, symbolizeEffects the effect sites, then solve — finding the effect READ that satisfies the lambda-as-predicate WITHOUT performing the IO. reify's Err (bodyless / native / non-reifiable) ⇒ Nothing. The natural shape is `\_ -> <effectful predicate>` (the only unknown is the read; a lambda that also references its own param yields 2 free vars ⇒ Nothing, solve's single-unknown fence). expr-substrate Phase 14a.

engine:solveRel.label: Solve relational
engine:solveRel.description: Multi-binder relational solve (stage-1 conjunctive Datalog): find bindings for ALL the free vars of a predicate `Expr` against a THREADED finite fact base. Discovers the unknowns via `collectFreeVars` (first-appearance order). Flattens the top-level `and` tree, classifies each conjunct (relation atom ⇒ join / rule atom ⇒ unfold / residual ⇒ closed-term filter), runs select-project-join over the relations' extensions, applies residuals (proven-rows), projects onto the free vars, and witnesses the first surviving row as `Just [{ name, value }…]`. Unsafe (a var ungrounded by any atom) / out-of-fragment (or/not over atoms, recursion, arity mismatch) ⇒ Nothing. The sibling of P5's single-var `solve` (which stays byte-untouched). expr-substrate Phase 13.

engine:solveRelAll.label: Solve relational all
engine:solveRelAll.description: The findall sibling of `solveRel`: enumerate ALL satisfying bindings of a multi-binder predicate `Expr` against a threaded fact base ⇒ Maybe (List bindings). THE P13 payoff — `solveRelAll (and (parentOf x y) (parentOf y "eleonora"))` returns EVERY grandparent pair, not just the first. Discovers the unknowns via collectFreeVars (first-appearance order), runs relSolveSet (which emits the SeEnum-of-binding-rows tuple set), then enumerates it. `Just []` = query SAFE but no satisfying rows; `Nothing` = unsafe / out-of-fragment (the new semantic split — relSolveSet's fences ⇒ Nothing, safe-but-empty ⇒ Just []). expr-substrate Phase 15.

engine:solveSymbolic.label: Solve symbolic
engine:solveSymbolic.description: Find a witness READ that satisfies an effectful predicate `Expr` WITHOUT performing the IO: `solve (symbolizeEffects effectFnIds expr)`. Rewrites every effect-call site (per the supplied effect-fnId set or the `$effect:` sentinel) to a fresh unknown, then hands the residual single-free-var predicate to the shipped solver. The headline `eq (state:getInstance "counter") 42` ⇒ Just 42, no state read. expr-substrate Phase 14a.

engine:solveSymbolicPaths.label: Solve symbolic paths
engine:solveSymbolicPaths.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 3 / decide-substrate Phase 7 — the BRANCHING witness face: NORMALIZE FIRST (normalizeForDecide) → the LAWFUL GATE (declared-reads-only; any write/unknown class ⇒ Nothing) → symbolizeSharedDetailed (mint FIRST — path conditions range over the shared `?sym:` vars; the mint table drives TYPED-DOMAIN seeding: each minted var's numeric bounds atoms + cert seed the path condition, and its domain joins the witness domMap) → forkPathsSeeded (budget 64) → for each WITNESS-SAFE (non-shadowable) feasible path IN ORDER, rebuild `and(pathAtoms ∧ opaque ∧ residual)`; a minted var WITH a domain solves DOMAIN-AWARE (`inhabit (SeIntersect [domain, comprehend v we])`, enum-first — an interval-only pred becomes witnessable under an enum domain: `read k > 2` @ `SeEnum [1,2,3]` ⇒ Just 3); else plain solve. The first Just w wins, all-Nothing ⇒ Nothing. Inherits solve's single-unknown fence honestly. Lifts the symbolize.fenel D-B witness half: `if (read k > 40) then (read k == 42) else False` ⇒ Just 42. `spec` = List { effectClass, reads }; `domInsts`/`domTypes` = the domains.

engine:solveSymbolicShared.label: Solve symbolic shared
engine:solveSymbolicShared.description: partial-evaluator-substrate Phase 2 — `solve (symbolizeShared spec effectFnIds expr)`: the value-numbered symbolic solve. The memory model collapses same-key reads to ONE unknown, so `(read k) == 42 ∧ (read k) > 40` witnesses `Just 42` (enum∩interval over the shared var) where the per-site 14a mint returns Nothing (two vars). `spec` = List { effectClass, reads }.

engine:some.label: Some
engine:some.description: Quantifier builder: `some varName pred baseSet` ⇒ the inhabited JUDGMENT `JInhabited (baseSet ∩ the predicate's set)` ("the intersection is non-empty" = some element satisfies pred). Judgment-native since decide-substrate Phase 2 (K2). DELEGATES to `exists` (the body carrier): `some` collides with `std:some` (the list predicate, which owns the bare name — live bare callers, JS-conventional), so a bare `some` call is a resolution-substrate Phase-1b hard ambiguousModule error; the intra-module delegation therefore runs exists-ward (bare `exists` is unambiguous). Callers by fnId (`engine:some`) are unaffected. expr-substrate Phase 5 / 6b; delegation flipped decide-substrate Phase 1 Stage A.

engine:someParamEmptyW.label: subset: someParamEmptyW
engine:someParamEmptyW.description: decide-substrate 8λ.2-r — does SOME arrow param have a decidably-EMPTY type (emptyW = Just true)? The want-side vacuous gate for arrowSub: a want-arrow with an uninhabitable param domain is never invocable, so EVERY function value is vacuously a member (∀x∈∅) — the Tt* twin of the judgment's arrowSomeParamEmpty. ⚠ NOT INFORMATION-MONOTONE, and a successor must know this before re-reaching `arrowSub` (type-substrate P1(a.8), found by post-commit adversarial review). This returns a BOOLEAN, so it reads `Nothing` as "keep going" rather than as "stop, unknown": when a leaf loses a definite the short-circuit stops firing and a DIFFERENT rule decides, which can FLIP the polarity rather than soften it. Derived at P1(a.8) entry vs measured after: `arrowSub(TRUE, (Number)→Number, (tagged{value=void})→String)` was `Just true` via this gate and is `Just false` via variance — PICKER mode specifically; `arrowSub(false, …)` returns `Nothing` post-repair, so the flip is not a sound-mode one, because the tagged emptiness peel was retired. Nothing ships from that — `arrowSub` has been UNREACHED from sound dispatch since P1(a.7) and the P1(a.8) differential measures ZERO non-monotone movements across 8757 public columns — but the arrow-recovery slice may NOT simply re-point `ssCompositeSound` here: this gate must first propagate `Nothing` as `Nothing`. Ledger `t.emp.arrow`. Internal helper.

engine:sortIntervals.label: set-algebra: sortIntervals
engine:sortIntervals.description: Phase 3b-3 — stable insertion sort of intervals by numeric lo bound (mirrors dispatchedMergeIntervals' pre-sort: -∞ first, numeric ascending, non-numeric los keep input order).

engine:sortNumbersAsc.label: set-algebra: sortNumbersAsc
