engine:vlgNamedish.label: Ledger namedish args
engine:vlgNamedish.description: True when an argument list is exactly one non-empty plain record with no `$`-prefixed key and no single-key expression shape — the runtime's precondition for expanding named arguments to positional.

engine:vlgProvenanceDivergent.label: Ledger provenance divergent
engine:vlgProvenanceDivergent.description: True when a body's parser provenance is not the authoritative representation (unknown parser or unknown AST ABI). Fences the ledger before any row is minted.

engine:vlgRawRuleForm.label: Ledger raw-rule form
engine:vlgRawRuleForm.description: The KNOWN_OPS that evaluate their rule argument per element in a DERIVED data context (map/filter/reduce/all/some/none). They do NOT enter a callable; they fence because a bare variable inside the rule may bind to an item field rather than a lexical binder or registered name. The rule slot comes from the shared form's ruleIndex, so it is never confused with an ordinary evaluated argument.

engine:vlgResolvedRow.label: Ledger resolved row
engine:vlgResolvedRow.description: Build one ledger row by resolving a spelling through the frozen source frame only. Missing, ambiguous, and fenced are complete negative results and are never retried through another resolver.

engine:vlgRootClaimClass.label: Primitive root claim class
engine:vlgRootClaimClass.description: The claim half of the classifier: negative authority FIRST (any refuted clause fences before any positive claim is read), then ground-scheme, attestation presence, and the three positive claims, each fencing with its exact reason.

engine:vlgRootInventory.label: Primitive root inventory
engine:vlgRootInventory.description: Classify each SUPPLIED HostNative / active-native NativeWithFallback / ExternalHandler row as ConvertToFenel | RootRequired(policy) | Fenced(reason), independently of certificate presence. A declared handler with no installed implementation is Fenced MissingActiveHandler. A positive claim requires an attestation row on the input — `requires` absence never proves purity. It classifies the rows it is given: it enumerates nothing, asserts no coverage, and holds no register of its own.

engine:vlgRouteRow.label: Ledger route row
engine:vlgRouteRow.description: Project a frozen route into a ledger row: resolved/fenced/missing/ambiguous status, with saturation and enters-target computed from the target's declared arity (an underapplication never enters the target).

engine:vlgRouteStatus.label: Ledger route status
engine:vlgRouteStatus.description: Project a frozen route's status string into the closed UseLedgerStatus, retaining a fenced row's exact target and diagnostics and an ambiguous row's complete sorted candidates.

engine:vlgSaturation.label: Ledger saturation
engine:vlgSaturation.description: Classify an application's saturation against the target's declared arity (exact / under / over). A non-application reference is exact by construction.

engine:vlgSlotNodes.label: Ledger slot nodes
engine:vlgSlotNodes.description: The raw argument nodes of an evaluated slot list, in order — the input the named-argument recognizer needs. Internal helper.

engine:vlgVarUse.label: Ledger var use
engine:vlgVarUse.description: `{var: name}` — a lexically bound name is a Lexical row; an unbound name resolving through the frozen frame to a registered target is a Reference row (an arrow value consumed without application); otherwise a negative row.

engine:vlgWalk.label: Ledger walk node
engine:vlgWalk.description: The faithful node walk, DELEGATING its form recognition to the shared `fdcNodePlan`: an inert plan contributes nothing, a sequence plan walks elementwise at VpsSeq, a record plan walks fields at VpsField, an op plan carries the runtime's own child schedule, and a keyed plan is the resolution-decided call form with its unresolved fallback attached.

engine:vlgWalkArgs.label: Ledger walk args
engine:vlgWalkArgs.description: Walk a positional JsonLogic argument list, each argument at its VpsArg index.

engine:vlgWalkCalleeNode.label: Ledger walk callee node
engine:vlgWalkCalleeNode.description: Walk a non-name call callee as an ordinary expression at VpsCallee so nested uses are not lost. The `$` vehicle callee is such a position, at raw slot 1.

engine:vlgWalkFields.label: Ledger walk fields
engine:vlgWalkFields.description: Walk a record-literal field list, each value at its VpsField key segment.

engine:vlgWalkGuard.label: Ledger walk guard
engine:vlgWalkGuard.description: Walk a guarded arm condition at VpsArmGuard in the pattern-extended scope; an unguarded arm contributes nothing.

engine:vlgWalkSeq.label: Ledger walk sequence
engine:vlgWalkSeq.description: Walk a positional JsonLogic item list, each item at its VpsSeq index.

engine:vlgWalkSlots.label: Ledger walk slots
engine:vlgWalkSlots.description: Walk exactly the argument slots the runtime evaluates, at their VpsArg index. Replaces the blanket every-argument walk, which minted rows for guaranteed-dead trailing children of the eager intrinsics.

engine:vlgWhereBindings.label: Ledger where bindings
engine:vlgWhereBindings.description: Walk a where-clause binding entry list at VpsWhereBinding, threading each binder forward.

engine:vlgWhereOp.label: Ledger where op
engine:vlgWhereOp.description: `{where: [body, bindingsObject]}` - bindings first at VpsWhereBinding, then the body at VpsArg 0 with all binders in scope (the runtime order). A bindings carrier the shared layout reports NOT TOTAL fences.

engine:vobAbstain.label: observe: abstain reason
engine:vobAbstain.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the RsnCheckerAbstained row for a deliberate abstention that is not itself a reflection. Internal helper.

engine:vobAddName.label: observe: add name
engine:vobAddName.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — add a spelling to a set of spellings (idempotent). Internal helper.

engine:vobAddOrdinal.label: observe: addOrdinal
engine:vobAddOrdinal.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — add one quantifier ordinal to a set (idempotent). Internal helper.

engine:vobAllArgOrdinals.label: observe: all arg ordinals
engine:vobAllArgOrdinals.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — every ordinal contributing anywhere in an argument list. Used when a summary names an output-derivation index the analysed argument list does not have: the conservative answer is the whole argument taint, never nothing. Internal helper.

engine:vobAmbientGate.label: observe: ambient gate
engine:vobAmbientGate.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the channel the explicit argument list does not cover: a ctx-native receives the whole EvaluateContext (json-logic.ts:2370-2377), in which evaluator strategies park caller data, so ground explicit arguments do not prove it cannot see a κ-typed value. It fences whenever any rigid is live in scope. The named-argument hazard is NOT gated here — the arity gate subsumes it; see the note above vobNamedish.

engine:vobAnalyze.label: Validation observation fence
engine:vobAnalyze.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the public entry of the quantified-observation fence. Takes ONE FROZEN REQUEST carrying the raw body, the DECLARED parameter types, the quantifier vector, the frozen call targets, the execution mode and the invalidation identity; ORIGINATES every parameter's provenance and the scope's ordinal set itself; and reports either the accumulated fence set (not guaranteed exhaustive: two call-gate rules return early, which is fail-closed) or the body's result provenance with the profile set the verdict covers. 3b took prebuilt provenance, which made the shell-completeness invariant a contract on the caller — a shell omitting a tainted payload read as ground and admitted every deep observation of it. Still ATTESTED and not authenticated here: the declared types, the quantifier vector, the frozen targets and the identity hashes. INERT: no checker, decider, kernel, or dispatch path consumes this.

engine:vobAnalyzeFromProvenance.label: observe: analyze from provenance
engine:vobAnalyzeFromProvenance.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — ANALYSIS-INTERNAL entry taking PRE-ORIGINATED parameter provenance and a caller-stated ordinal set, which is exactly what the public entry stopped accepting. It exists so the algebra battery can drive shell and opaque scrutinees through the walker directly, since the public entry cannot produce a shell by design. It carries NO judgment authority, and what keeps that true is the phase-4 static reachability gate, not the name: a consumer wired here instead of vobAnalyze would reopen the caller-supplied provenance hole in full.

engine:vobAnnOp.label: observe: ann op
engine:vobAnnOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the annotation form evaluates only argument 0; the trailing type is never evaluated and contributes nothing. Internal helper.

engine:vobArityGate.label: observe: arity gate
engine:vobArityGate.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — arity is a gate in BOTH directions. Over-application creates a SECOND ungated call: the runtime tests whether a returned value is callable and applies the leftover arguments to it (json-logic.ts:2204-2211, 2404-2410). Under-application produces a partial carrying the collected argument values, whose later application prepends them somewhere this analysis never sees. So a call is gateable only at exact arity.

engine:vobBindAll.label: observe: bind all
engine:vobBindAll.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — extend a scope with a WINNER-FIRST list of bindings by CONCATENATION. vobBindLookup takes the first match, so add's head is its winner and must stay in front. 3b folded through the prepending vobBindWith, which reverses add — and since the structural, array and arm-installation sites all call this, two same-spelling binders resolved to the runtime's LOSER by a double reversal. The runtime's winner is the LAST occurrence in a successful depth-first pattern-key walk, because defineDataContextBinding redefines a configurable, writable property (json-logic.ts:34-41).

engine:vobBindArm.label: observe: bind arm
engine:vobBindArm.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the $bind pattern arm, shared by the tagged and plain object arms because matchPattern reads $bind off ANY object and returns before every structural arm (json-logic.ts:1818-1821). A literal name binds the whole scrutinee and observes nothing; a NON-literal one binds a synthetic spelling AND abstains, because the runtime names the binder String(value) and this analysis does not reproduce that coercion (rendering a boxed host number is the recorded landmine), so a later read of the real name would find no binder.

engine:vobBindLookup.label: observe: bind lookup
engine:vobBindLookup.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the provenance of a lexical binding, if bound. Internal helper.

engine:vobBindParams.label: observe: bind params
engine:vobBindParams.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — bind a list of parameter spellings to one provenance. Internal helper.

engine:vobBindWith.label: observe: bind with
engine:vobBindWith.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — extend a scope with one binding, PREPENDED so it shadows an existing same-named binder (matching the runtime's copied data context). Internal helper.

engine:vobBindingForm.label: observe: binding form
engine:vobBindingForm.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3e - dispatch the three sequentially-scoped binding forms. Internal helper.

engine:vobBindings.label: observe: bindings
engine:vobBindings.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b - fold a binding entry list into the scope at VpsBinding, each value seeing the preceding binders, returning the extended scope and the LAST binding's provenance. Internal helper.

engine:vobBoolOp.label: observe: bool op
engine:vobBoolOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the lazy boolean operators. They return the OPERAND VALUE rather than a Boolean, and truthy is applied to every operand, so each operand is both a deep TEST and a possible result. The form's provenance is the join of the operands.

engine:vobBranchGate.label: observe: branch gate
engine:vobBranchGate.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — gate rules 3 to 5: a host-active branch receiving a NON-GROUND argument fences (the criterion is the active BRANCH, never a hand-written list of reflective callees); a Fenel-bodied callee is admissible only against a provenance summary, which this slice never has; an unrecognized origin is an unresolved use.

engine:vobBranchIsHostActive.label: observe: host-active branch
engine:vobBranchIsHostActive.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — is this the ACTIVE non-Fenel implementation branch? HostNative / NativeWithFallback / ExternalHandler are the ImplementationOrigin tags, plus BuiltinOpNative — the fifth branch ImplementationOrigin does not model (json-logic.ts:2348-2351), reachable only for a raw key with no registration and no native, yet still an active host implementation.

engine:vobBranchIsNativeMapped.label: observe: branch is native-mapped
engine:vobBranchIsNativeMapped.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — is this branch reached THROUGH one of the two native maps? A strictly narrower question than vobBranchIsHostActive: HostNative and NativeWithFallback are, while ExternalHandler (a declaration with no installed implementation) and BuiltinOpNative (reached only for a key with no registration at all) are host-active but carry NO native-map coordinate. Conflating the two false-fenced correct records. Internal helper.

engine:vobCallOp.label: observe: call op
engine:vobCallOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the explicit application form. Only a LITERAL name head reaches the call gate; the $ application head and an expression or {var} callee are dynamic applications whose target is a VALUE, so no frozen target record can describe them.

engine:vobCallOutput.label: observe: call output
engine:vobCallOutput.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the provenance of a call's RESULT: tainted when the instantiated result type mentions a caller rigid (which happens with NO tainted actual — a return-position typeclass operation) or when the callee summary says the output derives from a tainted input.

engine:vobCaptureFrom.label: observe: capture from
engine:vobCaptureFrom.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — fold the join over a scope's binding provenances. Internal helper.

engine:vobCaptureProv.label: observe: capture prov
engine:vobCaptureProv.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the provenance of a lambda's CAPTURED environment: the join over every binding in scope, since fnOp copies the whole data context (json-logic.ts:2556). This is what makes handing a taint-capturing closure to a native fence. Internal helper.

engine:vobClassifyForm.label: observe: classify form
engine:vobClassifyForm.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the raw-form transfer classifier. Total over strings: an unrecognized form answers VfcFence, so a new evaluator op fences rather than inheriting an existing form's semantics.

engine:vobConstructOp.label: observe: construct op
engine:vobConstructOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the primary shell producer: a constructed value's outer former is fixed and its payload slots carry the arguments' provenances. True/False at arity one are the opaque-repr fast path to JS booleans and are wholly literal. The named-versus-positional payload reading needs the constructor table a pure body lacks, so a single plain-object payload contributes BOTH readings' slots — a SUPERSET, so any real key resolves to a provenance at least as tainted as the truth.

engine:vobConstructPayload.label: observe: construct payload
engine:vobConstructPayload.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — walk a constructor's payload into shell slots: positional keys always, plus the named-record reading's own field keys when the payload is a single plain object (the ambiguity a pure body cannot resolve). Internal helper.

engine:vobCoversOrdinals.label: observe: covers ordinals
engine:vobCoversOrdinals.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — does a provenance's own ordinal set cover every ordinal the scope says this parameter carries? The FLOOR on an originated shell (3d: a floor, explicitly not a proof): a shell descriptor is an attestation the ADT cannot verify, so a witnessed shape whose slots declare FEWER rigids than the scope has must degrade to the opaque atom rather than be taken at its word. It does NOT establish slot completeness — a shell with a clean real payload and a bogus extra slot still passes — and for a `Maybe a` under `forall a b.` it demands `b` too, which over-fences. Internal helper.

engine:vobDeriveRepr.label: observe: derive repr
engine:vobDeriveRepr.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — derive one parameter's CLOSED representation descriptor from its DECLARED TYPE. Answers RprGround or RprOpaque and never a shell, because a declared type is not a representation proof. Degrades to opaque over EVERY ordinal in scope on a $el node (the compatibility spelling of a higher-kinded application, whose head identity lives in the TypeScheme.applications sidecar this traversal does not consult — so a $var scan alone answers GROUND for `f Number`, a false admission), on a $var naming no quantifier, and on fuel exhaustion.

engine:vobDispatchGate.label: observe: dispatch reflection gate
engine:vobDispatchGate.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — gate rule 2, the deepest channel: an in-range RDispatch route reflects its dispatch argument to select the instance, so a non-ground argument there makes WHICH CODE RUNS instantiation-dependent. Keyed on the SITE argument count, not on declared arity. An under-applied dispatch eta-defers into a closure that re-dispatches later, and a return-position route resolves no instance at all; both abstain.

engine:vobDoItems.label: observe: do items
engine:vobDoItems.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — fold do statements at VpsSeq, threading the scope so an inline let item's binders reach the following statements. Internal helper.

engine:vobDoOp.label: observe: do op
engine:vobDoOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — a statement sequence whose inline let items bind into the ENCLOSING scope (which is why the fold threads the scope, not the reasons alone); the form's value is the last statement's.

engine:vobDollarCall.label: observe: dollar call
engine:vobDollarCall.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the $ application head, whose layout differs from the ordinary call form: the callee is at index 1 and the actuals begin at index 2 (json-logic.ts:2436-2439). The form fences because the callee is a VALUE, but the callee is walked at VpsCallee and the actuals at VpsArg so no nested observation is lost or misattributed.

engine:vobDotFrom.label: observe: dot scan
engine:vobDotFrom.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — scan a spelling for a dot separator, terminating on an exhausted slice rather than a code-point length (slice indexes UTF-16 units while length counts code points, so a length bound misses a dot past an astral character). Internal helper.

engine:vobDropObserved.label: observe: drop observed
engine:vobDropObserved.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the summary with its first observed-parameter index consumed. Internal helper.

engine:vobDropTwo.label: observe: dropTwo
engine:vobDropTwo.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the list without its first two elements (an if/match pair, or the method form's class and method names). Internal helper.

engine:vobDynamicCall.label: observe: dynamic call
engine:vobDynamicCall.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — a dynamic application: the arguments are still walked so no nested observation is lost, and the form fences because the callee identity is a value rather than an exact target. Internal helper.

engine:vobEnvPathCarrier.label: observe: env path carrier
engine:vobEnvPathCarrier.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3e - the missing_some key carrier at raw slot 1. Slot 0 is the numeric threshold, not a path, and the wrapper flatten is already consumed by the inner missing call, so the carrier's items are the paths with no flatten remaining. Internal helper.

engine:vobEnvPathName.label: observe: env path name
engine:vobEnvPathName.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — deep-observe the value one raw path name resolves to in the abstract environment. Internal helper.

engine:vobEnvPathOp.label: observe: env-path op
engine:vobEnvPathOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the missing / missing_some transfer. Their arguments are raw PATH NAMES, not values: the runtime resolves each name in the DATA CONTEXT and compares the resulting VALUE against null, undefined and the empty string (json-logic.ts:1628-1633), so a clean literal argument can still observe a κ-typed binding. Every literal path is resolved through the abstract environment and deep-observed; a computed or nested path abstains.

engine:vobEnvPaths.label: observe: env paths
engine:vobEnvPaths.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — resolve each raw path-name argument through the abstract environment and deep-observe the value it names; a non-literal path abstains. Internal helper.

engine:vobEnvWith.label: observe: env with
engine:vobEnvWith.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — a copy of the analysis environment carrying an extended lexical scope. Internal helper.

engine:vobFnOp.label: observe: fn op
engine:vobFnOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — a lambda CAPTURES the whole surrounding data context, so the closure value carries the capture's taint at a «capture» slot (handing a taint-capturing closure to a host implementation fences), and its PARAMETERS bind OPAQUELY over every ordinal in scope, so any observation of a parameter fences at the abstraction rather than at an application site. With no ordinals in scope the parameters are clean.

engine:vobFormNames.label: observe: form names
engine:vobFormNames.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the COMPLETE raw evaluator form set: evaluate's non-op dispatch tiers plus all forty KNOWN_OPS. The exhaustiveness meta-test asserts a two-way match against json-logic.ts, so neither a missing row nor a stale row can pass.

engine:vobFormOp.label: observe: form op
engine:vobFormOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3e - dispatch one KNOWN_OP on the SHARED closed form classification. The structural half (which form, which child slots) comes from the shared decomposition; the semantic half (which observation each form performs) stays in this analysis's transfer table.

engine:vobFormTable.label: observe: form table
engine:vobFormTable.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the raw-form transfer table as DATA, projected from the form enumeration through the classifier so the two cannot drift.

engine:vobGateCall.label: observe: gate call
engine:vobGateCall.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — resolve a raw call key to its frozen call-target record and run the gate. A key with NO frozen record is an unresolved use, never an assumption.

engine:vobGateTarget.label: observe: gate target
engine:vobGateTarget.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the call gate over one frozen target: rule 1 fences a source-frame-versus-flat-runtime target disagreement (the ledger's recorded P4-D0a seam, where both answers are positive and differ), then the profile check, the dispatch-argument reflection rule, the active-branch rules, and finally the result provenance.

engine:vobHarvestFields.label: observe: harvest fields
engine:vobHarvestFields.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the raw-key harvest over a marshalled field list: the field NAME, then any literal callee head inside a call or method argument list, then the field value. Internal helper.

engine:vobHarvestHeadItems.label: observe: harvest head items
engine:vobHarvestHeadItems.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — accumulate the literal string items of an argument list. Internal helper.

engine:vobHarvestHeads.label: observe: harvest heads
engine:vobHarvestHeads.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the literal string items of a call or method argument list, which is where those two forms carry their callee head. Internal helper.

engine:vobHarvestItems.label: observe: harvest items
engine:vobHarvestItems.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the raw-key harvest over a marshalled item list. Internal helper.

engine:vobHarvestRawKeys.label: observe: harvest raw keys
engine:vobHarvestRawKeys.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — every object key and call head reachable in a marshalled raw body. Syntactic by design: a key with no registry resolution has no frozen call-target record, which the gate reports as an unresolved use rather than as an assumption. The call and method forms carry their heads as literal strings inside the argument list rather than as object keys, so those lists are scanned for string items too. Ported out of the census's TypeScript copy so origination and harvesting have ONE authority.

engine:vobHasOrdinal.label: observe: hasOrdinal
engine:vobHasOrdinal.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — is this quantifier ordinal already in the set? Internal helper.

engine:vobIfOp.label: observe: if op
engine:vobIfOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the lazy conditional: each condition is a DEEP truthy TEST (truthy inspects primitive values — zero, empty string, "0", false and an empty array are falsy), so a non-ground condition makes branch selection instantiation-dependent. The form's provenance is the JOIN of every reachable branch; a lone trailing argument is the else branch.

engine:vobIfPairs.label: observe: if pairs
engine:vobIfPairs.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — walk conditional argument PAIRS in raw index order, testing each condition and joining each branch. A lone trailing argument is the else branch. Internal helper.

engine:vobIndicesInRange.label: observe: indices in range
engine:vobIndicesInRange.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — are every one of these parameter indices below the declared bound? Internal helper.

engine:vobIsCallHeadKey.label: observe: is call head key
engine:vobIsCallHeadKey.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — is this field name one whose ARGUMENT LIST carries a callee head as a literal string rather than as an object key (call, method)? Internal helper.

engine:vobIsCtxTier.label: observe: isCtxTier
engine:vobIsCtxTier.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — does the frozen POST-FLATTEN native-map coordinate name the ctx-aware map (the one whose implementations receive the whole EvaluateContext)? Internal helper.

engine:vobIsDotted.label: observe: isDotted
engine:vobIsDotted.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — does this spelling carry a dot field-projection separator? Internal helper.

engine:vobIsGround.label: observe: isGround
engine:vobIsGround.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — is this provenance rigid-free at every depth? The admissibility test for a DEEP observer (one that reads into the payload), strictly stronger than 'the outer former is fixed'. An opaque atom answers false UNCONDITIONALLY, including one carrying an empty ordinal set: vobOpaqueOf normalizes that away, but the ADT is PUBLIC, so a malformed atom is constructible from outside the module's own producers — and it would otherwise read as ground and admit every deep observation. Slice 3d removed the parameter-seed channel from the public entry; the ADT stays public, so this arm stays unconditional.

engine:vobIsKnownOp.label: observe: is known op
engine:vobIsKnownOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — is this raw key one of the evaluator's KNOWN_OPS (as opposed to a key-as-fnId call head)? Internal helper.

engine:vobJoin.label: observe: join
engine:vobJoin.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the provenance join (least upper bound). Same-shape shells join slotwise; differing shapes collapse to the opaque union. PvClean joined with a shell collapses to the shell's taint, because PvClean carries no shape and the join cannot verify the formers agree — sound, deliberately imprecise, documented.

engine:vobJoinList.label: observe: joinList
engine:vobJoinList.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the provenance join over a branch list. An empty list is PvClean: a form with no branches evaluates to host-null, which is instantiation-independent.

engine:vobJoinListFrom.label: observe: joinListFrom
engine:vobJoinListFrom.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — fold vobJoin over a branch list from a seed. Internal helper.

engine:vobJoinSlots.label: observe: joinSlots
engine:vobJoinSlots.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — slotwise join over the UNION of two shells' key sets. A key present on only one side keeps that side's provenance (the other branch's value lacks it, so a pattern requiring it fails there and observes nothing). Internal helper.

engine:vobJoinSlotsLeft.label: observe: joinSlotsLeft
engine:vobJoinSlotsLeft.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the left half of the slotwise join: every key of la, joined with lb's slot at that key when present. Internal helper.

engine:vobJoinSlotsRight.label: observe: joinSlotsRight
engine:vobJoinSlotsRight.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the right half of the slotwise join: append lb's slots whose key la does not carry. Internal helper.

engine:vobKeyAsFnId.label: observe: key as fnId
engine:vobKeyAsFnId.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the key-as-fnId call form, the universal call shape and the only route to BUILTIN_OP_NATIVES. The runtime decides call-versus-record by RESOLUTION rather than value shape, so a key with no frozen target record is an unresolved use, never silently a record literal.

engine:vobKnownEvaluators.label: observe: known evaluators
engine:vobKnownEvaluators.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the evaluator-ENTRY axis of the execution mode: the direct call, a scoped Evaluator strategy frame (Eager / Lazy / Partial / Jit / a user-registered one), or an explicit evaluateWith. A scoped strategy calls the ctx-natives map directly after parking caller data in ctx._localData, so it never passes through invokeFunction's selection order — which is why the ambient gate needs this axis. Strategies are registry-OPEN, so this list is a scope declaration, not a survey of the runtime universe.

engine:vobKnownLowerings.label: observe: known lowerings
engine:vobKnownLowerings.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the lowering axis of the execution mode. Interpreted versus a compiled target is a DIFFERENT question from which evaluator entry runs; 3b's single profile string conflated them.

engine:vobKnownTiers.label: observe: known tiers
engine:vobKnownTiers.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the closed native-map coordinate set: the empty string (no native map — a Fenel body or an external handler), the two real maps, and `both` for a key registered in each. Anything else is malformed.

engine:vobLastItem.label: observe: lastItem
engine:vobLastItem.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the final element of a JsonLogic item list, treating an empty tail remainder as the end (tail of a singleton is Just of the empty list, not Nothing). Internal helper.

engine:vobLazyForm.label: observe: lazy form
engine:vobLazyForm.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3e - the short-circuit structural ops. The conditional and the boolean operators differ in what they RETURN (a branch versus the operand value), so they keep separate transfers. Internal helper.

engine:vobLetOp.label: observe: let op
engine:vobLetOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — sequential bindings folded into a copied context, so binding i sees binders 0..i-1; the form's value is the LAST binding (there is no separate body at rest).

engine:vobMatchArms.label: observe: match arms
engine:vobMatchArms.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b - fold the shared layout's arms: the pattern against the scrutinee's provenance, then the guard at VpsArmGuard as a deep TEST in the arm-extended scope, then the body at VpsArmBody. Internal helper.

engine:vobMatchOp.label: observe: match op
engine:vobMatchOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the match form: walk the scrutinee, then each arm's pattern against the scrutinee's provenance, its guard as a deep TEST in the arm-extended scope, and its body. A lone trailing element is the default arm body, evaluated in the OUTER scope. The form's provenance is the join of the arm bodies.

engine:vobMergeSlots.label: observe: merge slots
engine:vobMergeSlots.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — merge two slot lists by JOINING colliding keys rather than letting the first hit win. Load-bearing for the constructor dual reading: a named payload carrying a `_0` field collides with the positional reading's own `_0`, and first-hit lookup would answer with the whole-record shell while the runtime's named branch stores the payload directly — masking that payload's provenance. Internal helper.

engine:vobMethodKey.label: observe: method key
engine:vobMethodKey.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the qualified key for a method form, built the way the resolver's own position index is (Class.name, dispatch.fenel:334-336). The method form is not uniformly qualified dispatch — it also has a module-member direct branch, directly-invoked projected host methods, and oracle-fallback paths — so the frozen record's dispatchRoute decides whether the call reflects a dispatch argument, not this walker.

engine:vobMethodOp.label: observe: method op
engine:vobMethodOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — use-site qualified dispatch. The dispatch argument is reflected to select the instance, so the gate is entered with the method's raw key and the frozen record's RDispatch route carries the position.

engine:vobModeGate.label: observe: mode gate
engine:vobModeGate.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the top-level execution-mode fence. Strict v1 admits ONLY the interpreted lowering under the DIRECT evaluator entry; every compiled lowering, every scoped strategy (a scoped Eager frame included, since its context still carries the frame) and explicit evaluateWith abstain, and an UNRECOGNIZED mode abstains rather than defaulting — the half that matters, because a whitelist can otherwise only reject a typo.

engine:vobNameIn.label: observe: nameIn
engine:vobNameIn.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — is a spelling present in a string list? Internal helper.

engine:vobNamedFieldSlots.label: observe: named field slots
engine:vobNamedFieldSlots.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the payload slots for a named-record constructor payload, keyed by field name. Internal helper.

engine:vobNamedPayloadSlots.label: observe: named payload slots
engine:vobNamedPayloadSlots.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3e — the named-record reading's payload slots, over the field list the SHARED constructor layout publishes. The shape test lives there, and it admits any single-object payload — a $tag-bearing and a $-keyed one included — because applyOp's named test is any non-null non-array object. Internal helper.

engine:vobNamedish.label: observe: namedish
engine:vobNamedish.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — is this argument list the NAMEDISH shape maybeReorderNamedArgs may read as named fields: exactly one argument that is a plain object with no $-prefixed key (a $-keyed record is a wire value and is never named args, json-logic.ts:2069-2091)? DETECTOR ONLY — the arity gate subsumes the hazard, and this AST-shaped test reports true for a raw {var} whose evaluated value is not a record at all, so it must not gate.

engine:vobNamesDistinct.label: observe: names distinct
engine:vobNamesDistinct.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — are these spellings pairwise distinct and all non-empty? Internal helper.

engine:vobNthProv.label: observe: nth prov
engine:vobNthProv.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the provenance at one position of a positional list. Internal helper.

engine:vobObserveDeep.label: observe: deep observation
engine:vobObserveDeep.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — record a DEEP observation of one value (an observer that reads into the payload). Admissible only when the value is rigid-free at every depth; otherwise a RsnQuantifiedReflection row naming the channel.

engine:vobObserveDeepAll.label: observe: deep observation over a list
engine:vobObserveDeepAll.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — vobObserveDeep over every provenance in a positional list. Internal helper.

engine:vobObserveShape.label: observe: shape observation
engine:vobObserveShape.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — record an OUTER-SHAPE observation of one value (extent, discriminator, key set). Admissible on PvClean and on every PvShell (a shell asserts its former is instantiation-independent); fences on PvOpaque.

engine:vobObserveShapeAll.label: observe: shape observation over a list
engine:vobObserveShapeAll.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — vobObserveShape over every provenance in a positional list. Internal helper.

engine:vobObservedInputGate.label: observe: observed-input gate
engine:vobObservedInputGate.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the repair for taint laundering through an Any-typed formal. A summary recording only OUTPUT dependency cannot stop it: values cross a call boundary unchanged (json-logic.ts:2394-2399), so a callee that observes a formal it declared as Any observes the κ actual regardless of its own quantifiers. The summary must declare observesFrom — the parameter indices it OBSERVES — and this gate checks the ACTUAL provenance at those positions, so a summary proved in an environment where an Any formal happened to be clean cannot authorize anything.

engine:vobOpNames.label: observe: op names
engine:vobOpNames.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3e - all forty KNOWN_OPS, READ FROM the shared decomposition roster rather than kept as a second copy. Membership is what separates a structural op from a key-as-fnId call head, so it stays apart from the tier pseudo-forms.

engine:vobOpaqueOf.label: observe: opaqueOf
engine:vobOpaqueOf.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — build an opaque provenance over a quantifier-ordinal set, NORMALIZING an empty set to PvClean so an opaque atom over no ordinals is unconstructible. Load-bearing: vobIsGround reads emptiness as ground, so such an atom would fence shape observers while admitting deep observers — an inconsistent value the join could otherwise manufacture.

engine:vobOriginateParams.label: observe: originate params
engine:vobOriginateParams.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — originate the whole parameter scope INSIDE the judgment: each declared parameter's provenance is derived from its declared type through the closed descriptor, in declaration order. This is what makes obs.shell.complete an enforced invariant on the public entry rather than a contract on the caller.

engine:vobParamNames.label: observe: param names
engine:vobParamNames.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the binder spellings of a declared parameter list. Internal helper.

engine:vobPatChannel.label: observe: pattern channel
engine:vobPatChannel.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3e - the observation channel for a structural pattern: pattern-tag when the plan carries a WIRE discriminator field (which happens exactly when the carrier was a tagged one), pattern-structural otherwise. Internal helper.

engine:vobPatOf.label: observe: patOf
engine:vobPatOf.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — build a pattern-classification outcome from admissibility, the binders introduced, and the accumulated reasons. Internal helper.

engine:vobPatSteps.label: observe: pattern steps
engine:vobPatSteps.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3e - map the shared pattern plan's ordered matcher steps onto their observations. The wildcard and $bind steps observe nothing; an identity-only plan is a DEEP host-identity comparison against a literal; the field and item steps are a key-presence plus discriminator observation of the OUTER former. Internal helper.

engine:vobPattern.label: observe: pattern
engine:vobPattern.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — classify one RAW pattern against a scrutinee's provenance by matchPattern's own six arms, not by the four-case surface Pattern ADT. The wildcard and a $bind pattern observe nothing; a literal pattern is a DEEP host-identity comparison; a structural object or array pattern is a key-presence plus discriminator observation of the OUTER former, admissible on a clean value or a shell and fencing on an opaque one.

engine:vobPatternItems.label: observe: pattern items
engine:vobPatternItems.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — an array pattern is structural (an array is an object, so matchPattern takes the same arm and iterates index keys); each item is matched against the shell's «element» slot provenance. Internal helper.

engine:vobPatternStructural.label: observe: pattern structural
engine:vobPatternStructural.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the structural pattern arm over a pattern's fields. A WIRE $tag (literal-string pattern value) is a discriminator read already charged as an outer-shape observation and never recursed into; EVERY other key — $guard and a non-string $tag included — is an ordinary payload read at that slot. 3b skipped both keys unconditionally, which was wider than the runtime: matchOp strips only a top-level ARRAY-valued $guard (vobGuardParts already removes exactly that), and a non-string $tag is returned unchanged by constructorPatternWireName and then matched like any other field. Internal helper.

engine:vobPositionalKey.label: observe: positional key
engine:vobPositionalKey.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the positional payload key _0, _1, … for one constructor argument, from a FIXED table rather than by number-to-string conversion (a cloned decider context boxes host numbers, so toString yields the host object rendering). An arity past the table yields an unmodelled slot, which abstains. Internal helper.

engine:vobPositionalSlots.label: observe: positional slots
engine:vobPositionalSlots.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the positional payload slots (_0, _1, …) for a constructor's arguments. Internal helper.

engine:vobProfileGate.label: observe: profile gate
engine:vobProfileGate.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the frozen execution-profile scope. A verdict with no profile qualifier is a latent unsoundness the moment the other lowering runs (eq and lt lower to host === and < in compiled JS while the interpreted path runs type-discriminated structural equality). Strict v1: admissible only when the analysed profile set COVERS every profile the registration can run under.

engine:vobProfileLabelGate.label: observe: profile label gate
engine:vobProfileLabelGate.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — bind the PUBLISHED profile label to the declared execution mode. ObsAdmitted republishes analysedProfiles verbatim and nothing tied that list to the mode, so a request could pass the mode gate on interpreted/Direct while labelling its admission `compiled-js` — a verdict claiming coverage of a lowering nothing analysed. Every analysed and required profile must now BE the declared lowering.

engine:vobProject.label: observe: project
engine:vobProject.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — project one key off a value, mirroring resolveVar's dotted-path read. A clean value projects clean; an opaque value FENCES (projecting a field off a rigid-represented value observes that representation) and propagates its taint; a shell yields the modelled slot, treats `length` as an extent observation, and ABSTAINS on an unmodelled key rather than defaulting.

engine:vobProjectDotted.label: observe: project dotted
engine:vobProjectDotted.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the provenance of a DOTTED variable read off a binder root. A clean root projects clean; an opaque root FENCES (projecting a field off a rigid-represented value observes that representation); a shell root ABSTAINS with its whole taint, because resolving the exact slot needs the path tail that 3c's typed sidecar supplies.

engine:vobProvListOf.label: observe: provListOf
engine:vobProvListOf.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — build a sequence carrier from a positional provenance list and the accumulated reasons. Internal helper.

engine:vobQuantifierIds.label: observe: quantifier ids
engine:vobQuantifierIds.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the GENERATED identities of a quantifier vector (the namespace the authoritative application sidecar resolves against). Internal helper.

engine:vobQuantifierOrdinal.label: observe: quantifier ordinal
engine:vobQuantifierOrdinal.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the ORDINAL (index in the scheme's quantifier vector) of the quantifier with this SOURCE spelling, if any. Matched on sourceName ALONE: the generated id namespace (q0, q1, …) is deliberately not tried, because `collide : a -> q0 -> a` is legal source and matching either slot would resolve {$var: "q0"} to the wrong binder. Internal helper.

engine:vobQuantifierSourceNames.label: observe: quantifier source names
engine:vobQuantifierSourceNames.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the SOURCE spellings of a quantifier vector (the namespace a compatibility $var node resolves against). Internal helper.

engine:vobReflect.label: observe: reflection reason
engine:vobReflect.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the RsnQuantifiedReflection row for an observation of a κ-typed value, naming the channel and the typed path. Internal helper.

engine:vobReprSlots.label: observe: repr slots
engine:vobReprSlots.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — project a descriptor's payload slots into provenance slots, recursively. Internal helper.

engine:vobReprToProv.label: observe: repr to prov
engine:vobReprToProv.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — originate one parameter's provenance from the CLOSED ObsRepr descriptor rather than a type head (3b took an open record). A type constructor's name is not a representation proof: $tagged is an erased phantom wrapper and $refined is transparent, so such a type has its INNER value's runtime representation, and $opaque's representation comes from per-target Reprable instances while dispatch observes the actual JS shape. RprGround yields PvClean; RprOpaque the opaque atom; RprTransparent its INNER's provenance RECURSIVELY (3b returned the opaque atom because no inner was supplied); only RprShell a shell — degraded to opaque on duplicate slot keys or when its own ordinals do not cover the scope's.

engine:vobRequestIssues.label: observe: request issues
engine:vobRequestIssues.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the frozen request's own well-formedness: a duplicate parameter spelling (which hides one provenance behind another), a duplicate or empty quantifier source name or generated id, an empty analysed-profile set, and an empty invalidation-identity field each ABSTAIN. Every one is a channel for making the check scope look smaller than it is. The identity fields are checked for PRESENCE and never recomputed from the body — they BIND the verdict for a consumer to re-establish, they do not authenticate the request.

engine:vobRigidsOf.label: observe: rigidsOf
engine:vobRigidsOf.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — every quantifier ordinal contributing anywhere inside a provenance: the outer atom and every payload slot, recursively.

engine:vobRigidsOfSlots.label: observe: rigidsOfSlots
engine:vobRigidsOfSlots.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — vobRigidsOf accumulated over a shell's payload slots. Internal helper.

engine:vobRootBinder.label: observe: root binder
engine:vobRootBinder.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the lexical binder a spelling reads from: the exact binder, or the binder that is a proper dotted prefix of it (b is the root of b.f). Binder spellings cannot contain a dot, so at most one root matches. Internal helper.

engine:vobScanFieldHead.label: observe: scan field head
engine:vobScanFieldHead.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — classify ONE field name of a marshalled declared type: $el degrades (a higher-kinded application's head identity is in the scheme sidecar, not here), a $var naming a quantifier contributes its ordinal, and a $var naming nothing — or holding a non-literal — degrades. Internal helper.

engine:vobScanFields.label: observe: scan fields
engine:vobScanFields.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the declared-type scan over a marshalled field list: each field's NAME is classified, then its value is walked. Internal helper.

engine:vobScanFieldsWide.label: observe: scan fields wide
engine:vobScanFieldsWide.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the width-bounded field fold of the declared-type scan; each field's NAME is classified, then its value is walked. Exhausting the sibling budget degrades and returns, so a very wide record cannot drive the host stack over. Internal helper.

engine:vobScanItems.label: observe: scan items
engine:vobScanItems.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the declared-type scan over a marshalled item list, bounded in WIDTH as well as depth: depth fuel alone leaves the sibling fold unbounded, and a very wide former drives one interpreter frame per sibling and overflows the host stack. Exhausting the sibling budget degrades and returns. Internal helper.

engine:vobScanItemsWide.label: observe: scan items wide
engine:vobScanItemsWide.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the width-bounded item fold of the declared-type scan. Internal helper.

engine:vobScanSiblingBudget.label: observe: scan items
engine:vobScanSiblingBudget.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the declared-type scan over a marshalled item list. Internal helper.

engine:vobScanType.label: observe: scan type
engine:vobScanType.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — walk a marshalled declared type collecting every quantifier ordinal it mentions, and recording whether the walk must DEGRADE to the whole scope (a $el application head whose quantified identity lives in the scheme sidecar, a $var naming no quantifier, or fuel exhaustion). Internal helper.

engine:vobScopeOf.label: observe: scopeOf
engine:vobScopeOf.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — build a scope-threading carrier from a provenance, the accumulated reasons, and the extended scope. Internal helper.

engine:vobScopeOrdinals.label: observe: scope ordinals
engine:vobScopeOrdinals.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — the check scope's quantifier ordinals, [0 .. n-1] over the scheme's quantifier vector. Derived from the vector rather than accepted from a caller: a caller-supplied ordinal set is a channel for making the scope look emptier than it is, and an empty scope makes every provenance clean. Internal helper.

engine:vobShapeFixed.label: observe: shapeFixed
engine:vobShapeFixed.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — is the value's OUTER former instantiation-independent? True for PvClean and for every PvShell (the shell's own assertion); false for PvOpaque. The admissibility test for a shape observer.

engine:vobShellOf.label: observe: shellOf
engine:vobShellOf.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — build a shell provenance from a shape and its payload slots. Internal helper.

engine:vobSlotKeysDistinct.label: observe: slot keys distinct
engine:vobSlotKeysDistinct.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — are a descriptor's payload slot keys pairwise distinct? Load-bearing rather than tidiness: vobSlotLookup takes the FIRST slot at a key while vobRigidsOf unions ALL of them, so a duplicate pair can pass the ordinal-coverage floor on a tainted slot while every projection reads a clean one in front of it. Internal helper.

engine:vobSlotLookup.label: observe: slotLookup
engine:vobSlotLookup.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the provenance of a shell's payload at one key, if the slot is modelled. Internal helper.

engine:vobSlotOf.label: observe: slotOf
engine:vobSlotOf.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — build one payload slot from a key and its provenance. Internal helper.

engine:vobStateOf.label: observe: stateOf
engine:vobStateOf.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — build a walker state from a provenance and the accumulated reasons. Internal helper.

engine:vobSummaryGate.label: observe: summary gate
engine:vobSummaryGate.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — a provenance summary authorizes a call only when it is a summary OF THIS CALL: same target, same ACTIVE implementation, same execution profile. A summary proved against an interpreted body does not cover the compiled lowering, and one proved before a native was installed does not cover the registration afterwards.

engine:vobSummaryInputTaint.label: observe: summary input taint
engine:vobSummaryInputTaint.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the ordinals a summary's declared input-to-output derivation carries from the actual arguments. Internal helper.

engine:vobTabledOp.label: observe: tabled op
engine:vobTabledOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — dispatch a residual KNOWN_OP by its transfer-table class: a shape observer reads the outer former only, a deep observer requires ground arguments, a fence always fences. A known op whose class is neither is a table-versus-walker disagreement and abstains loudly rather than defaulting to a call.

engine:vobTailList.label: observe: tailList
engine:vobTailList.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the list without its head (the empty list when absent). Internal helper.

engine:vobTaint.label: observe: taint
engine:vobTaint.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — collapse a provenance to its taint content, forgetting the shape: PvClean when rigid-free, otherwise the opaque atom over every contributing ordinal. Used wherever a shape claim can no longer be sustained.

engine:vobTaintFromIndices.label: observe: taint from indices
engine:vobTaintFromIndices.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the union of the argument provenances' ordinals at a list of parameter indices. Internal helper.

engine:vobTargetIssues.label: observe: target issues
engine:vobTargetIssues.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3d — validate a frozen call-target record against the closed coordinate sets and the check scope's ranges: an unrecognized tier, a tier inconsistent with the origin (a Fenel body or external handler naming a native map, or a host native naming none), a resultRigids ordinal outside the scope, and a summary index outside the declared arity all ABSTAIN. 3b read the tier with a predicate that answered false for anything unrecognized, so a misspelled tier silently skipped the ambient fence. This rejects malformation, NOT misstatement: a record calling a genuine ctx-native `nativeImpls` is well-formed and wrong, which is the authenticated producer's obligation.

engine:vobTargetLookup.label: observe: target lookup
engine:vobTargetLookup.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the frozen call-target record for one raw key, if the caller froze one. A missing record is an unresolved use, never an assumption. Internal helper.

engine:vobTierNames.label: observe: tier names
engine:vobTierNames.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — evaluate's NON-OP dispatch tiers as «…»-bracketed pseudo-forms. The brackets cannot collide with a real op key (a JSON-Logic op key is an identifier or an operator notation; the parser emits neither bracket).

engine:vobUnionOrdinals.label: observe: unionOrdinals
engine:vobUnionOrdinals.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — set union of two quantifier-ordinal sets. Internal helper.

engine:vobUnknownProv.label: observe: unknown prov
engine:vobUnknownProv.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the conservatively-unknown provenance for a check scope: opaque over every ordinal in scope, or PvClean when the scope quantifies nothing (with no ordinals nothing can be κ-typed). Never an opaque atom over an EMPTY ordinal set — that reads as GROUND and would admit every observation.

engine:vobUnsupported.label: observe: unsupported-form reason
engine:vobUnsupported.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the RsnUnsupportedSyntax row for a raw form this analysis declines to model. Internal helper.

engine:vobVarNamed.label: observe: var named
engine:vobVarNamed.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — resolve one variable spelling against the lexical scope, distinguishing an exact binder read from a dotted projection off a binder root. Internal helper.

engine:vobVarUse.label: observe: var use
engine:vobVarUse.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — a variable read: an exact binder carries its provenance, a DOTTED read projects off its binder root, and a spelling with no binder is either a registry hit (answered with a {$ref} value) or the fallback — both literal. A dotted spelling with no binder root abstains.

engine:vobWalk.label: observe: walk
engine:vobWalk.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the node walk, mirroring evaluate's dispatch tiers. Scalars are literal; an array literal is a fixed-extent shell carrying the JOIN of its elements; a $tag value and a $-keyed marker are returned untouched and so wholly literal; a record literal is a shell over its evaluated fields. Every arm returns the provenance of the value the node EVALUATES TO.

engine:vobWalkArgs.label: observe: walk args
engine:vobWalkArgs.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — walk a positional argument list at VpsArg, collecting each argument's provenance in order. Internal helper.

engine:vobWalkGuard.label: observe: walk guard
engine:vobWalkGuard.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b - walk a guarded arm's condition at VpsArmGuard in the arm-extended scope; its result is truthy-tested, so it is a DEEP test exactly like a conditional's condition. An unguarded arm contributes nothing. The guard SPLIT comes from the shared decomposition. Internal helper.

engine:vobWalkRecord.label: observe: walk record
engine:vobWalkRecord.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — walk a record literal's fields at VpsField into a shell keyed by field name. Internal helper.

engine:vobWalkSeq.label: observe: walk sequence
engine:vobWalkSeq.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — walk a positional item list at VpsSeq, collecting each item's provenance in order. Internal helper.

engine:vobWalkSlots.label: observe: walk slots
engine:vobWalkSlots.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3e - walk exactly the argument slots the runtime EVALUATES, at their raw index, collecting each provenance in order. The eager intrinsics do not all consume every slot: the bitwise binaries read two, ~ and length one, in two, substr two plus an optional third, and deepEq / withInstance evaluate NOTHING at any arity but two. Observing the residue charged observations against children the runtime never reaches. Internal helper.

engine:vobWhereBindings.label: observe: where bindings
engine:vobWhereBindings.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — fold a where clause's binding fields into the scope at VpsWhereBinding, each value seeing the preceding binders. Internal helper.

engine:vobWhereOp.label: observe: where op
engine:vobWhereOp.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3b — the where form: bindings first at VpsWhereBinding, each seeing the preceding ones, then the body at VpsArg 0 with every binder in scope (the runtime's order).

engine:vocabFor.label: Vocabulary for class
engine:vocabFor.description: The per-input WsEnum vocabulary `values` of a value-bearing token class `cls` — every encoded token of that class present in THIS token list (Design E step 2). Finite + eq-scannable; the value rides in-band. Internal expr-grammar helper. parser-substrate Phase 3b.

engine:vpDecidable.label: kernel: vpDecidable
engine:vpDecidable.description: Phase 6b0 — the DecidableSetResult rule's kind↔proposition agreement guards: kind subset/disjoint/empty/nonempty each requires the matching Prop* tag (nonempty ⇒ PropInhabited, expr-substrate Phase 6b); a non-matching pair ⇒ ShapeMismatch. Past the guards (including the preserved TS quirk: an unrecognised kind falls straight through), routes to the proposition-tag switch. Internal helper.

engine:vpDecidableSwitch.label: kernel: vpDecidableSwitch
engine:vpDecidableSwitch.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 — the DecidableSetResult rule's proposition switch, re-derived onto the one lattice judgment: each decidable-set shape decomposes via judgmentOfProposition (subset/disjoint/empty ⇒ JEmpty, inhabited ⇒ JInhabited) and routes to the single verifyJudgment core (two-sided witness for subset/disjoint; polarity-gated tri-precision decision — JEmpty accepts "true", JInhabited accepts "false"); any other proposition tag ⇒ the 'not a proof of' ShapeMismatch. Subsumes the retired vpDecideTwo/vpDecideOne/vpDecideInhabited cluster. Internal helper.

engine:vpJudgment.label: kernel: vpJudgment
engine:vpJudgment.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 K3 — the judgment-claim ReDecide rule: fetch the shared recheck plan (shape + original (s,t)); kind witness ⇒ the witness-membership rule (JInhabited only — re-checks {w} ⊆ s via verifyWitnessMembership, the K1-landed singleton face now WIRED); kinds subset/disjoint/empty/nonempty ⇒ kind↔recognized-shape agreement then the polarity-gated verifyJudgment re-check; unrecognized kinds fall through to the re-check (the preserved quirk). Internal helper.

engine:vpJudgmentGo.label: kernel: vpJudgmentGo
engine:vpJudgmentGo.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 K3 — the judgment claim's polarity-gated re-check: verifyJudgment over the claim itself (it IS the judgment) with twoSided + witness/recheck messages keyed on the recognized plan kind (subset/disjoint two-sided; empty/nonempty one-sided; the same message strings as the Prop* presentation path). Internal helper.

engine:vpMismatch.label: kernel: vpMismatch
engine:vpMismatch.description: Phase 6b0 — build the ShapeMismatch outcome marker carrying reason + propositionTag + proofTag (the structured fields callers branch on). Internal helper.

engine:vpReDecide.label: kernel: vpReDecide
engine:vpReDecide.description: decide-substrate Phase 2 K3 — the ReDecide evidence dispatcher: JEmpty/JInhabited claims (the judgment-native currency) route to vpJudgment (shape-recognized re-check + the witness-membership arm); closed-sum Prop* claims route to vpDecidable (the compat presentation path, retiring at K4). Internal helper.

engine:vpRefl.label: kernel: vpRefl
engine:vpRefl.description: Phase 6b0 — the Refl rule: requires a PropEq proposition, lhs ≡ rhs, and the proof's carried value ≡ lhs (the pre-computed Fenel value-equality facts). Ok ⇒ Proven. Internal helper.

engine:vpSample.label: kernel: vpSample
engine:vpSample.description: Phase 6b0 + 3g — the SampleTestResult rule: requires a PropForall proposition, matching propertyId, allPassed = true, and at least one sample checked. Phase 3g gates it on the SUBJECT function's totality verdict (the pre-computed `verdict` fact): "Unknown"/"Partial" ⇒ Err NonTotal (a ∀ sample-tested over a non-total function is unsound), checked BEFORE the shape checks; "Total"/"" proceed. Ok ⇒ SampleTested with the sample count (the kernel verifies the claim's SHAPE — it doesn't re-iterate; empirical evidence stays graded SampleTested, not Proven). Internal helper.

engine:vrgBinderFor.label: validation-rigid: binderFor
engine:vrgBinderFor.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — the quantified binder whose source spelling is this handle, if any. Internal helper.

engine:vrgDigestPayload.label: validation-rigid: digestPayload
engine:vrgDigestPayload.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — the fenel.validation.rigid.v1 canonical-byte payload: the domain literal, the alpha-normalized rigid entries (ordinal + kind only — never a scopeToken, never a source spelling), and the semantic scope {validatorVersion, sccId, functionId, schemeHash}. Identical semantic input yields identical bytes; the S2 encoder + SHA-256 leaf turn it into the domain-tagged digest that is the ONLY rigid projection allowed out of a validation frame.

engine:vrgDigestRigids.label: validation-rigid: digestRigids
engine:vrgDigestRigids.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — the alpha-normalized rigid entries for the fenel.validation.rigid.v1 payload: ordinal (the quantifier-order alpha-normal identity) plus kind, in caller-supplied quantifier order. The source spelling and the runtime scopeToken are deliberately absent. Internal helper.

engine:vrgHasRigid.label: validation-rigid: hasRigid
engine:vrgHasRigid.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — does a rigid atom occur anywhere in this SetExpr? The deep non-escape predicate: every published view, evidence payload, cache key, diagnostic, and persisted value must answer false. Descends SeCtor fields, SeMu bodies, SeArrow params/returns, boolean branches, AND SetPattern children (SpMatch predicates and SpGroup types).

engine:vrgHasRigidFields.label: validation-rigid: hasRigidFields
engine:vrgHasRigidFields.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgHasRigid over SeCtor fields (any). Internal helper.

engine:vrgHasRigidLegacyPattern.label: validation-rigid: hasRigidLegacyPattern
engine:vrgHasRigidLegacyPattern.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgHasRigid through the LEGACY `.t`-discriminated host Pattern (the live runtime carrier of SePattern.pattern): match ⇒ pred, seq/alt ⇒ a and b, rep ⇒ child, group ⇒ child plus the optional type slot (read via lookup, since the host form OMITS an absent type rather than carrying Nothing). Internal helper.

engine:vrgHasRigidList.label: validation-rigid: hasRigidList
engine:vrgHasRigidList.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgHasRigid over a branch list (any). Internal helper.

engine:vrgHasRigidParams.label: validation-rigid: hasRigidParams
engine:vrgHasRigidParams.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgHasRigid over SeArrow params (any). Internal helper.

engine:vrgHasRigidPattern.label: validation-rigid: hasRigidPattern
engine:vrgHasRigidPattern.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgHasRigid through a pattern's SetExpr children (match predicates, group types). DUAL-READS the registered Sp* ADT and the legacy `.t`-discriminated host Pattern that is the actual runtime carrier — an Sp*-only match would be blind to every live value. Internal helper.

engine:vrgHasRigidPatternSlot.label: validation-rigid: hasRigidPatternSlot
engine:vrgHasRigidPatternSlot.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgHasRigidPattern on a pattern-valued slot, short-circuiting to an already-computed sibling result. Internal helper.

engine:vrgHasRigidPatternSlotOnly.label: validation-rigid: hasRigidPatternSlotOnly
engine:vrgHasRigidPatternSlotOnly.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgHasRigidPattern on an optional pattern-valued record slot (absent ⇒ false). Internal helper.

engine:vrgHasRigidSlot.label: validation-rigid: hasRigidSlot
engine:vrgHasRigidSlot.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgHasRigid on an optional SetExpr-valued record slot (absent ⇒ false). Internal helper.

engine:vrgIsRigid.label: validation-rigid: isRigid
engine:vrgIsRigid.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — is this node itself a rigid atom? Shallow.

engine:vrgMint.label: validation-rigid: mint
engine:vrgMint.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — mint one rigid atom κ. `scopeToken` must be scope-unique and opaque (two simultaneously live check scopes must not collide even when their source binders share a spelling); `ordinal` is the binder's quantifier-order position; `kind` is its kind. This is the ONLY constructor site for SeRigid outside a test.

engine:vrgNameIn.label: validation-rigid: nameIn
engine:vrgNameIn.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — is a spelling present in the shadowed-binder list? Internal helper.

engine:vrgProject.label: validation-rigid: project
engine:vrgProject.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — the PUBLIC projection entry: rigidify the bound-placeholder projection, then verify the rewrite was TOTAL. Just <term> only when no quantified binder spelling survives as a free SeRef; Nothing otherwise (fail closed — a partially-rigidified term must never reach a decider, because a surviving handle is capturable through the public registerNamedSet). Returns a Se-face SetExpr and nothing else: rigids are prohibited from the raw Tt-face containment API.

engine:vrgResidual.label: validation-rigid: residual
engine:vrgResidual.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — does any quantified binder's spelling SURVIVE as a free SeRef after the rewrite? A surviving handle is exactly the withdrawn bound-SeRef design (capturable through the public registerNamedSet), so a true answer must fence the projection rather than reach a decider. Shadow-aware.

engine:vrgResidualFields.label: validation-rigid: residualFields
engine:vrgResidualFields.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgResidual over SeCtor fields (any). Internal helper.

engine:vrgResidualLegacyPattern.label: validation-rigid: residualLegacyPattern
engine:vrgResidualLegacyPattern.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgResidual through the LEGACY `.t`-discriminated host Pattern (the live carrier): match ⇒ pred, seq/alt ⇒ a and b, rep ⇒ child, group ⇒ child plus the optional type slot. Internal helper.

engine:vrgResidualList.label: validation-rigid: residualList
engine:vrgResidualList.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgResidual over a branch list (any). Internal helper.

engine:vrgResidualParams.label: validation-rigid: residualParams
engine:vrgResidualParams.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgResidual over SeArrow params (any). Internal helper.

engine:vrgResidualPatSlot.label: validation-rigid: residualPatSlot
engine:vrgResidualPatSlot.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgResidualPattern on a pattern-valued slot, short-circuiting to an already-computed sibling result. Internal helper.

engine:vrgResidualPatSlotOnly.label: validation-rigid: residualPatSlotOnly
engine:vrgResidualPatSlotOnly.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgResidualPattern on an optional pattern-valued record slot (absent ⇒ false). Internal helper.

engine:vrgResidualPattern.label: validation-rigid: residualPattern
engine:vrgResidualPattern.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgResidual through a pattern's SetExpr children. DUAL-READS the registered Sp* ADT and the legacy `.t`-discriminated host Pattern that is the live carrier. Since vrgRigidify deliberately does not rewrite patterns, a binder occurrence found here is what makes vrgProject fence. Internal helper.

engine:vrgResidualSlot.label: validation-rigid: residualSlot
engine:vrgResidualSlot.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgResidual on an optional SetExpr-valued record slot (absent ⇒ false). Internal helper.

engine:vrgRigidify.label: validation-rigid: rigidify
engine:vrgRigidify.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — the PURE projection rewrite: replace every FREE occurrence of a quantified binder's spelling (a bound-projection SeRef) with the rigid atom for that binder. Shadow-aware — a SeMu that rebinds the spelling stops the rewrite inside its body, so a recursion variable is never conflated with a rigid. Total over every SetExpr child position INCLUDING SetPattern children. Pure: no decider is consulted, no registry is read.

engine:vrgRigidifyField.label: validation-rigid: rigidifyField
engine:vrgRigidifyField.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgRigidify through one SeCtor field, preserving its identity key and wire projection. Internal helper.

engine:vrgRigidifyParam.label: validation-rigid: rigidifyParam
engine:vrgRigidifyParam.description: signature-substrate Phase 4 slice 3a — vrgRigidify through one SeArrow param, preserving its identity key, wire projection, and list position (arity and variance pair strictly by position). Internal helper.

engine:vteAdmissionDigest.label: Trusted entry admission digest
engine:vteAdmissionDigest.description: The outer digest binding the WHOLE admission: the caller, the snapshot, the eligibility verdict, the certificate set, the registry generation and the entry-digest vector as a table root. It exists because an entry-level digest cannot see that a table with a certificate and a table without one mean opposite things.

engine:vteAdmissionDomain.label: Validation admission domain
engine:vteAdmissionDomain.description: The domain literal for the outer admission digest — caller, snapshot, eligibility and the entry-digest vector as a table root.

engine:vteArityCount.label: Trusted entry arity count
engine:vteArityCount.description: How many arity rows name one target. Internal helper.

engine:vteArityFirst.label: Trusted entry arity first
engine:vteArityFirst.description: The first arity row naming a target, called only after the count is exactly one. Internal helper.

engine:vteArityFor.label: Trusted entry arity for target
engine:vteArityFor.description: The declared formal count for a target id, or Nothing when the arity table names it zero times or more than once. Ambiguity is Nothing rather than the first match: the declared arity is the runtime stage boundary, so an order-dependent answer is not an answer.

engine:vteArityKeys.label: Trusted entry arity keys
engine:vteArityKeys.description: The arity table as an ordered list of structured keys. Internal helper.

engine:vteArrowChainLength.label: Trusted entry arrow chain length
engine:vteArrowChainLength.description: How many parameter slots a projected arrow chain exposes in total, summed layer by layer down the nested unary spine that foldTypes builds. A non-arrow is zero.

engine:vteArrowRefusal.label: Trusted entry arrow refusal
engine:vteArrowRefusal.description: The refusal reason for a declared type that is not an EXACT arrow: one that does not project to a SeArrow, or one whose projection carries SeAll anywhere. The SeAll test is `synthFromSig`'s own exactness rule — a free variable, an $el, a nominal application or an open map all degrade to the top set, and the top set is the marshal saying it does not know.

engine:vteAssemble.label: Trusted entry assemble
engine:vteAssemble.description: Bind the minted table to the carrier and to itself: bijection with the live identities, one shared snapshot, every entry digest re-derived, and every instance re-projected from its target's own published arrow. Internal helper.

engine:vteAuthorityFor.label: Trusted entry authority for
engine:vteAuthorityFor.description: The exact OccurrenceAuthority the certificate set supplies for a target, or the reason there is none. A certificate whose scheme identity disagrees with the published scheme is STALE, not merely different — admitting it would let a certificate verified against an older declaration authorize the current one.

engine:vteAuthorityKey.label: Trusted entry authority key
engine:vteAuthorityKey.description: The structured key of one occurrence authority — its closed tag plus the exact certificate identity it rests on. The certificate hash is IN the key: an entry whose authority came from a different certificate is a different entry.

engine:vteBodyDomain.label: Validation body domain
engine:vteBodyDomain.description: The domain literal for the recomputed body digest. The carrier copies its bodyHash from caller-supplied provenance and the provenance gate only checks non-emptiness, so the entry recomputes it and refuses a mismatch.

engine:vteBuildEntry.label: Trusted entry build entry
engine:vteBuildEntry.description: Assemble one admitted entry and its binding digest. The instance is the target's own published arrow projected through the SAME exactness path the refusal already checked — derived from the scheme row, never proposed. Internal helper.

engine:vteCallerRefusal.label: Trusted entry caller refusal
engine:vteCallerRefusal.description: The refusal reason for a caller whose own effective scheme cannot ground a validation: an unsolved outcome, any authored diagnostic, a quantified scheme, a non-arrow body, an inexact projection, an effectful scheme, or membership in a multi-member SCC. Nothing when the caller is admissible.

engine:vteCertificateCount.label: Trusted entry certificate count
engine:vteCertificateCount.description: How many certificate rows name one target. More than one is an ambiguous certificate set and refuses. Internal helper.

engine:vteCertificateFirst.label: Trusted entry certificate first
engine:vteCertificateFirst.description: The first certificate row naming a target, called only after the count is exactly one. Internal helper.

engine:vteCertificateKeys.label: Trusted entry certificate keys
engine:vteCertificateKeys.description: The certificate set as an ordered list of structured keys. It rides in BOTH the inputs digest and the admission digest: the first binds which certificates were offered, the second binds which admission they produced. Internal helper.

engine:vteCheckedPreflight.label: Trusted entry checked preflight
engine:vteCheckedPreflight.description: The preflight over a carrier already proven to belong to this request, with eligibility RECOMPUTED rather than accepted. Internal helper.

engine:vteClassCountFor.label: Trusted entry class count for identity
engine:vteClassCountFor.description: How many classified rows name one occurrence identity. Internal helper.

engine:vteClassCounts.label: Trusted entry class counts
engine:vteClassCounts.description: Re-derive how many of a carrier's live identities are entry-bearing and how many fall in the Γ and rule classes, from the identities themselves.
