An unclassifiable identity counts in NEITHER bucket, so a carrier carrying one can satisfy no correspondence and refuses. Internal helper.

engine:vteClassKey.label: Trusted entry class key
engine:vteClassKey.description: The structured key of an admission class — the closed tag plus the rule kind for a rule-class row. Digest material. Internal helper.

engine:vteClassKeys.label: Trusted entry class keys
engine:vteClassKeys.description: The classified-identity vector as an ordered list of structured keys — the identity triple plus its re-derived class, so the OUTER admission digest covers every Γ-class and rule-class row. Internal helper.

engine:vteClassOf.label: Trusted entry class of occurrence
engine:vteClassOf.description: The admission class of one occurrence identity, derived from the role/kind PAIR: an entry-bearing function use, a Γ-class lexical read, a rule-class constructor or intrinsic, or Nothing when the pair names no class this slice can carry. Nothing refuses; it never defaults.

engine:vteClassesAgree.label: Trusted entry classes agree
engine:vteClassesAgree.description: Every classified row carries exactly the class its own occurrence identity re-derives to, and none of them re-derives to entry-bearing. This is the forgery check: a supplied classification that disagrees with the derivation is refused rather than believed. Internal helper.

engine:vteClassesGo.label: Trusted entry classes worker
engine:vteClassesGo.description: Enumerate every NON-entry-bearing identity with its re-derived class, refusing at the first identity whose role/kind pair names no class. Entry-bearing identities are omitted here because they are enumerated by their entries. Internal helper.

engine:vteCoverageGo.label: Trusted entry coverage worker
engine:vteCoverageGo.description: Walk the carrier identities, requiring each to be named exactly once by the table its re-derived class assigns and zero times by the other. Internal helper.

engine:vteCoverageOk.label: Trusted entry coverage
engine:vteCoverageOk.description: Every live carrier identity is covered EXACTLY ONCE by the admission — an entry-bearing one by exactly one entry and no classified row, a Γ-class or rule-class one by exactly one classified row and no entry. A count comparison alone cannot see this: two entries naming one identity and none naming another satisfy every length check while dropping an occurrence.

engine:vteCtorFieldKeys.label: Trusted entry constructor field keys
engine:vteCtorFieldKeys.description: The constructor field-layout table as an ordered list of structured keys, carrying each field's semantic-key DIAGNOSTIC projection and its wire name. The diagnostic projection is used because a FieldKey is a constructor value the canonical encoder would render structurally anyway, and the pair (diagnostic, wire) already distinguishes two field vectors that differ. Internal helper.

engine:vteCtorFieldVector.label: Trusted entry constructor field vector
engine:vteCtorFieldVector.description: One constructor's field vector as ordered structured keys. Internal helper.

engine:vteDigestsVerify.label: Trusted entry digests verify
engine:vteDigestsVerify.description: Every minted entry's digest re-derives from the entry's own contents. Re-deriving rather than trusting is the point: this is the check a caller-supplied table could never pass by construction, because a supplied entry would have to carry the digest of material it did not produce.

engine:vteDottedFormal.label: Trusted entry dotted formal
engine:vteDottedFormal.description: The first caller formal whose spelling carries the runtime's path separator, or Nothing when none does. A dotted formal is a binding no variable read can name, because resolveVar splits the spelling before consulting the binder scope.

engine:vteEffectRefusal.label: Trusted entry effect refusal
engine:vteEffectRefusal.description: The SC-eff refusal for a target: any declared `requires` fences, and a non-Fenel-bodied root additionally needs a positive purity/totality/honesty attestation, because `requires` absence never proves purity. Nothing when the target is admissible on the effect axis.

engine:vteEligibilityKey.label: Trusted entry eligibility key
engine:vteEligibilityKey.description: The structured key of an eligibility verdict. Internal helper.

engine:vteEligible.label: Trusted entry eligibility
engine:vteEligible.description: The eligibility verdict for one caller, from inventory facts only — never from a certificate, a verdict or a trust tag. A caller whose own scheme is unsolved, diagnosed, quantified, effectful or inexact is EligUnsupported; a caller whose body carries a use with no published scheme row is EligEvidenceIncomplete; otherwise EligEvidenceComplete.

engine:vteEntriesAreEntryBearing.label: Trusted entry entries are entry-bearing
engine:vteEntriesAreEntryBearing.description: Every minted entry names an identity whose class RE-DERIVES to entry-bearing. Internal helper.

engine:vteEntriesRemint.label: Trusted entry entries re-mint
engine:vteEntriesRemint.description: Every supplied entry RE-MINTS to itself from this request and this rebuilt carrier — the mint is re-run for the entry's own occurrence identity and the resulting binding digest must equal the supplied one. Re-deriving a digest from a supplied entry proves consistency; re-minting proves provenance.

engine:vteEntriesShareProfile.label: Trusted entry entries share profile
engine:vteEntriesShareProfile.description: Every minted entry carries exactly this request's executor profile. Without it an entry minted under one profile could be re-presented inside an admission taken under another, and the per-entry digest would still verify against its own stored field. Internal helper.

engine:vteEntriesShareSnapshot.label: Trusted entry entries share snapshot
engine:vteEntriesShareSnapshot.description: Every minted entry carries exactly this carrier's snapshot. Internal helper.

engine:vteEntryCountFor.label: Trusted entry entry count for identity
engine:vteEntryCountFor.description: How many minted entries name one occurrence identity. Internal helper.

engine:vteEntryDigest.label: Trusted entry occurrence digest
engine:vteEntryDigest.description: The binding digest for one occurrence: its identity, its resolved occurrence fields, the carrier snapshot, the scheme identity, the derived instance AND the exact authority. Everything that can change what the entry MEANS, not merely what it points at.

engine:vteEntryDigestKeys.label: Trusted entry digest keys
engine:vteEntryDigestKeys.description: The entry-digest vector, in mint order — the admission's TABLE ROOT. Internal helper.

engine:vteEntryDigestOf.label: Trusted entry occurrence digest of entry
engine:vteEntryDigestOf.description: Re-derive a minted entry's digest from the entry itself, so the preflight compares a derivation against a stored value rather than a value against itself. Internal helper.

engine:vteEntryVersion.label: Validation entry version
engine:vteEntryVersion.description: The trusted-entry construction version. It rides in every digest payload because an admission minted by a different construction is not evidence about this one. Bumped to v2 by slice 3h: the request grew two tables and a coordinate, the entry grew three fields, the mint partitions instead of refusing, readiness discharges one typed pending, and the admission carries classes and a verdict — a v1 digest and a v2 digest over the same-looking tuple mean different things.

engine:vteExecutorProfileKey.label: Trusted entry executor profile key
engine:vteExecutorProfileKey.description: The closed tag of an executor profile, for digest payloads and refusal reasons. Internal helper.

engine:vteFirstUndescribed.label: Trusted entry first undescribed target
engine:vteFirstUndescribed.description: The first live occurrence the published inventory does not describe, or Nothing when it describes every one. Class-aware: an entry-bearing use needs an unambiguous scheme row AND arity row; a Γ-class read is described by its binder; a rule-class occurrence by the frozen route row that resolved its kind (with the constructor wire row already proved by the carrier). Inventory facts only. Internal helper.

engine:vteFirstUndischargeable.label: Trusted entry first undischargeable pending
engine:vteFirstUndischargeable.description: The first typed pending demand this slice cannot carry past readiness, or Nothing when every pending row is a certified eta-stage. An unrecognised kind refuses — the safe default, written down rather than inferred from a missing arm.

engine:vteFirstUnsupported.label: Trusted entry first unsupported node
engine:vteFirstUnsupported.description: The first carrier node whose projection is not a supported core form, in walk order. The invariant is `every node's projection is supported; a node that BEARS an identity additionally carries an admissible occurrence` — an unsupported node is refused whether or not it issued an identity, because an unsupported node that issued none is invisible to the carrier's own fence collection.

engine:vteFirstUnsupportedKids.label: Trusted entry first unsupported in children
engine:vteFirstUnsupportedKids.description: Fold the unsupported-projection search over a bundled child list. Internal helper.

engine:vteFromCarrier.label: Trusted entry from carrier
engine:vteFromCarrier.description: The admission pipeline over a built carrier: the total projection walk, the whole-ledger readiness gate, the eligibility verdict, the per-occurrence mint, and the branded preflight. Internal helper.

engine:vteFromCheckedCarrier.label: Trusted entry from a request-bound carrier
engine:vteFromCheckedCarrier.description: The admission pipeline over a carrier already proven to belong to this request: the total projection walk, the whole-ledger readiness gate, the eligibility verdict, the per-occurrence mint, and the branded preflight. Internal helper.

engine:vteInputsDomain.label: Validation inputs domain
engine:vteInputsDomain.description: The domain literal for the combined input digest — every table the carrier's answers depend on, bound together rather than individually.

engine:vteInputsHash.label: Trusted entry inputs digest
engine:vteInputsHash.description: The combined digest of every table the carrier's answers depend on: param names, frozen routes, flat routes, arities, wire projections, published schemes, certificates, the registry generation and the validator version. One digest over a labelled payload, so the COMBINATION is bound and not merely each table.

engine:vteInstanceArrow.label: Trusted entry instance arrow
engine:vteInstanceArrow.description: The projected instance for a declared type at a known formal count: typeToSetProjection widened to SeAll on degradation, with a ZERO-formal declaration wrapped in an explicit zero-parameter arrow over its projected return. foldTypes erases the difference between a 0-formal target and its return type, and the arity table is the only thing that can restore it.

engine:vteInstancesDerive.label: Trusted entry instances derive
engine:vteInstancesDerive.description: Every minted entry's instance is exactly the projection of its target's own published arrow. This is what a caller-supplied table can never satisfy by construction: it would have to carry an arrow it derived from the same scheme row this entry resolves independently.

engine:vteKindCarriesScheme.label: Trusted entry kind carries scheme
engine:vteKindCarriesScheme.description: Does the RESOLVED route kind name a target that publishes a scheme? A constructor, a capability dispatch and an intrinsic rule do not — they are rule-shaped — and the syntactic role cannot distinguish them, because a named call to any of them still carries VurCall. An unrecognised kind is refused: the vocabulary is the registry's, so the safe default is to admit nothing new.

engine:vteLocalityKey.label: Trusted entry locality key
engine:vteLocalityKey.description: The closed tag of a use locality. Internal helper.

engine:vteLocalityOf.label: Trusted entry locality of
engine:vteLocalityOf.description: The occurrence locality a ledger row describes. A resolved row naming a registered target is external here, because a current-SCC use has already been refused. Internal helper.

engine:vteMintGo.label: Trusted entry mint worker
engine:vteMintGo.description: Mint entries for a live identity list, refusing at the FIRST occurrence that cannot be admitted. Refusing early rather than accumulating is deliberate: a partial table is not a weaker admission, it is a different one, and there is no such outcome. Internal helper.

engine:vteMintOne.label: Trusted entry mint one
engine:vteMintOne.description: Mint one occurrence's entry, or the exact reason it cannot be minted. Applies the six admission conditions in order — registered route, published scheme, zero binders, no diagnostics, exact SeAll-free arrow, SC-eff purity-or-attestation — then resolves the exact OccurrenceAuthority, then derives the instance from that same scheme row and digests the whole result.

engine:vteMintTable.label: Trusted entry mint table
engine:vteMintTable.description: Mint one table entry per live carrier identity, then run the branded preflight. The table is BUILT here and never accepted: this is the whole difference between the authoritative path and `vckPreflightTable`. Internal helper.

engine:vteOccurrenceDomain.label: Validation occurrence domain
engine:vteOccurrenceDomain.description: The domain literal for the per-occurrence entry digest — the occurrence identity, its resolved fields, its scheme identity, its instance AND its authority.

engine:vtePreflight.label: Trusted entry preflight
engine:vtePreflight.description: The AUTHORITATIVE preflight. Beyond the bijection and snapshot checks a caller-supplied table can be given, it re-derives every entry's binding digest and refuses a mismatch, so an entry cannot be moved, re-targeted or re-valued; and it binds the whole admission under an outer digest covering the caller, the snapshot, the eligibility and the entry-digest vector as a table root.

engine:vteProfileRefused.label: Trusted entry executor profile refused
engine:vteProfileRefused.description: Is this executor profile one the entry cannot admit? Only the pure evaluate profile is admitted: the ledger and the carrier mirror its reading of the binding, scoping, match-binder, recursion and closure-head forms, and the durable turn diverges on all of them. No unknown arm and no default — the field is a closed ADT and the transport refuses anything else.

engine:vteProjectionForm.label: Trusted entry projection form
engine:vteProjectionForm.description: The closed form label of an unsupported projection, for the refusal reason. Internal helper.

engine:vteProjectionSupported.label: Trusted entry projection supported
engine:vteProjectionSupported.description: Is this carrier projection one of the core forms a consumer may read? The `VcpUnsupported` set is deliberately conservative — `$` applications, `let`, `do` and arrays are fenced for COVERAGE rather than because the checker cannot express them — and widening it is a coverage decision that belongs to a checker-rule slice, not to a reader.

engine:vteReadinessKey.label: Trusted entry readiness key
engine:vteReadinessKey.description: The structured key of a whole-ledger readiness judgment, including the pending count so an admission cannot be moved between two readiness states. Internal helper.

engine:vteReadinessRefusal.label: Trusted entry readiness refusal
engine:vteReadinessRefusal.description: The refusal reason for a whole-ledger readiness this slice cannot proceed from: a final fence, or any pending row whose typed demand nothing here can discharge. The ONE dischargeable demand is the certified eta-stage, which the pre-checker classifier must then actually prove; every other kind refuses exactly as a final fence does.

engine:vteRequestRefusal.label: Trusted entry request refusal
engine:vteRequestRefusal.description: The refusal reason for a request this entry cannot validate at all, independently of its body: an executor profile whose semantics nothing here models, or a declared formal whose spelling the runtime's variable resolution splits. Nothing when the request itself is admissible.

engine:vteResidual.label: Trusted entry residual
engine:vteResidual.description: Does this projected set carry any residual the trusted entry cannot read — the top set, an unresolved name handle, an opaque predicate, a pattern algebra, or a validation rigid? Total over all fifteen SetExpr cases, written without a wildcard so a new constructor cannot default to admissible.

engine:vteResidualFields.label: Trusted entry residual in constructor fields
engine:vteResidualFields.description: Residual walk over a constructor's field sets. Internal helper.

engine:vteResidualList.label: Trusted entry residual in a branch list
engine:vteResidualList.description: Residual walk over a branch list. Internal helper.

engine:vteResidualParams.label: Trusted entry residual in arrow params
engine:vteResidualParams.description: Residual walk over an arrow's parameter sets. Internal helper.

engine:vteRoleCarriesScheme.label: Trusted entry role carries scheme
engine:vteRoleCarriesScheme.description: Does this occurrence role name a target that publishes a SCHEME? A call and a bare registered reference do; a constructor and an intrinsic are rule-shaped, a capability dispatch is scope-dependent, and a lexical binding's monotype comes from a solve. The role tag is the ledger's own closed discriminator, so it does not drift with the registry's kind vocabulary.

engine:vteRoleIsConstructorish.label: Trusted entry role is constructorish
engine:vteRoleIsConstructorish.description: Which syntactic roles can carry a resolved CONSTRUCTOR kind: the construct form's own role, and a named call whose spelling resolved to a constructor. Internal helper.

engine:vteRoleIsIntrinsicish.label: Trusted entry role is intrinsicish
engine:vteRoleIsIntrinsicish.description: Which syntactic roles can carry a resolved INTRINSIC kind: the intrinsic form's own role, and a named call or reference whose spelling resolved to a language rule. Internal helper.

engine:vteRouteKeys.label: Trusted entry route keys
engine:vteRouteKeys.description: One route table as an ordered list of structured keys. ORDER IS PRESERVED, not sorted: two tables differing only in order resolve identically today, and a digest that normalized the order would stop being able to say they were different inputs. Internal helper.

engine:vteRowFor.label: Trusted entry row for identity
engine:vteRowFor.description: The ledger row of the carrier node that ISSUED one occurrence identity. Reached by walking the bundled children — never by a path lookup, because a path lookup is exactly the sibling-occurrence hazard the annotated carrier exists to remove.

engine:vteRowForKids.label: Trusted entry row for identity in children
engine:vteRowForKids.description: Fold the identity-to-row search over a bundled child list. Internal helper.

engine:vteRuleKindKey.label: Trusted entry rule kind key
engine:vteRuleKindKey.description: The closed tag of a rule kind. Internal helper.

engine:vteSaturationKey.label: Trusted entry saturation key
engine:vteSaturationKey.description: The structured key of a use saturation — the closed tag plus its supplied count. Internal helper.

engine:vteSchemeCount.label: Trusted entry scheme count
engine:vteSchemeCount.description: How many published scheme rows name one target. Internal helper.

engine:vteSchemeFirst.label: Trusted entry scheme first
engine:vteSchemeFirst.description: The first published scheme row naming a target, called only after the count is exactly one. Internal helper.

engine:vteSchemeFor.label: Trusted entry scheme for target
engine:vteSchemeFor.description: The published scheme row for a target id, or Nothing. AMBIGUITY IS NOTHING, NOT THE FIRST MATCH: two rows for one target is a table this entry cannot read, and taking the first would make the answer depend on table order. Internal helper.

engine:vteSchemeKeys.label: Trusted entry scheme keys
engine:vteSchemeKeys.description: The published scheme table as an ordered list of structured keys, including the attestation bits and the requires vector — everything the admission conditions read. Internal helper.

engine:vteSchemeRefusal.label: Trusted entry scheme refusal
engine:vteSchemeRefusal.description: The refusal reason for a published scheme row that cannot supply a ground instance: it sits in the CALLER's own SCC, or is not Solved, or carries diagnostics, or is quantified, or is effectful (or a non-Fenel root without a positive attestation), or is not an exact SeAll-free arrow. Nothing when the row is admissible.

engine:vteSegKeys.label: Trusted entry segment keys
engine:vteSegKeys.description: The typed path as a list of structured segment keys — tag, ordinal and name, the same total triple the carrier's own segment equality is decided on. Internal helper.

engine:vteSetKey.label: Trusted entry set key
engine:vteSetKey.description: A total, canonically-encodable structural key for one projected set — enough to distinguish two instances that share a constructor tag. Used as digest material, never as an identity by itself.

engine:vteSetKeyFields.label: Trusted entry set keys in constructor fields
engine:vteSetKeyFields.description: Structural keys for a constructor's fields, carrying the wire name so two same-shaped fields under different names do not collide. Internal helper.

engine:vteSetKeyList.label: Trusted entry set keys in a branch list
engine:vteSetKeyList.description: Structural keys for a branch list, in order. Internal helper.

engine:vteSetKeyParams.label: Trusted entry set keys in arrow params
engine:vteSetKeyParams.description: Structural keys for an arrow's parameters, carrying the wire name and position. Internal helper.

engine:vteValidate.label: Trusted validation entry
engine:vteValidate.description: The ONE authoritative validation entry. Takes a request and returns a closed outcome: it recomputes the body digest, refuses a caller whose own scheme is not ground-and-exact, builds the carrier itself from the frozen routes / flat routes / wire projections, refuses any carrier node that projects to an unsupported form, refuses a ledger that is not structurally ready, computes eligibility from inventory facts, and mints one table entry per live occurrence — each admitted only when its target's published scheme is ground, undiagnosed, an exact arrow, pure-or-attested, SeAll-free, and backed by an exact certificate. It takes NO table and has no fallback anywhere.

engine:vteWireKeys.label: Trusted entry wire keys
engine:vteWireKeys.description: The constructor wire-projection table as an ordered list of structured keys. Internal helper.

engine:walkForDomainPropagation.label: Walk for child domain propagation
engine:walkForDomainPropagation.description: Child-recursion helper for the 4 externref-producing arms (CeClosure / CeConstruct / CeRecord / CeMatch). Mutates env via nested propagateCeVarDomain / inferDomains calls; returns True as a unit-like placeholder. Mirrors compile-wasm.ts:407.

engine:walkInferEach.label: Walk each expr (recurse via inferDomains)
engine:walkInferEach.description: For each expr in a list, recurse via inferDomains and discard the result. Used by walkForDomainPropagation's CeCall + CeDo arms.

engine:walkLetBindings.label: Walk CeLet bindings (recurse via inferDomains)
engine:walkLetBindings.description: For each CeLet binding, recurse on .value via inferDomains and discard the result. Used by walkForDomainPropagation's CeLet arm (does NOT setDomain — distinct from inferLetBindings which is the inference-side walker).

engine:walkMatch.label: Walk CeMatch scrutinee + arms
engine:walkMatch.description: CeMatch walker. Scrutinee propagates DomRef when CeVar (force-externref so PatConstruct patterns get the right signature); each arm body recurses via inferDomains. Env is shared across arms (mirrors the TS oracle's single-env-across-iterations loop body).

engine:walkMatchArms.label: Walk CeMatch arm bodies
engine:walkMatchArms.description: For each CeMatch arm, recurse on .body via inferDomains and discard the result. Splits the per-arm recursion out of walkMatch so the scrutinee + arms walks read uniformly.

engine:walkPropagateOrInfer.label: Walk CeConstruct.args with DomRef propagation
engine:walkPropagateOrInfer.description: CeConstruct.args walker. CeVar fields propagate DomRef; others recurse via inferDomains. Phase 21.5.2 substrate fix — without DomRef propagation here, CeVar fields holding string-typed values unbox to F64 at the call boundary.

engine:walkRecordFields.label: Walk CeRecord.fields with DomRef propagation
engine:walkRecordFields.description: CeRecord.fields walker. Same shape as walkPropagateOrInfer but reaches inside `.value` of each {name, value} field. CeVar values propagate DomRef; others recurse via inferDomains.

engine:walkTypePlan.label: Type traversal visitor plan
engine:walkTypePlan.description: Field-identity Phase 3 — return every raw FenelType node in pre-order. Fenel owns structural classification and recursion; the TS adapter only applies the host callback and short-circuits over this plan.

engine:witInterval.label: solve: witInterval
engine:witInterval.description: Phase 5 — witness of an interval: the hi bound when inclusive, else the lo bound when inclusive, else Nothing (both-exclusive / unbounded-open — the ℝ honesty fence). Representation-neutral over Maybe { value, inclusive } bounds. Internal helper.

engine:witIntervalLo.label: solve: witIntervalLo
engine:witIntervalLo.description: Phase 5 — witInterval fallthrough: the lo bound when inclusive, else Nothing. Internal helper.

engine:withInclusive.label: With interval-bound inclusive flag
engine:withInclusive.description: Attach an `inclusive` flag to a parsed interval bound: a present bound `{present, value}` becomes `{present, value, inclusive}` (`[`/`]` ⇒ true, `(`/`)` ⇒ false); an absent `{present = false}` passes through unchanged. parser-substrate Phase 4h batch 3 (S2).

engine:wrapNestedIIFE.label: Wrap nested IIFE
engine:wrapNestedIIFE.description: Fold a bindings list into nested IIFEs around a body string. The OUTER wrap is bindings[0]; the INNERMOST is bindings[last]. Mirrors the TS oracle's backward loop, written as forward recursion (recurse on tail to build inner first, then wrap with head).

engine:wsBoundaries.label: Ws boundaries
engine:wsBoundaries.description: The membership-transition points a Ws marker induces on the ordered domain (the partition's boundary points): WsInterval ⇒ its lo + hi boundaries; WsEnum ⇒ each value as a singleton; WsUnion/WsIntersect ⇒ union of branch boundaries; WsComplement ⇒ its inner's boundaries (complementing flips membership but not transition points); WsAll/WsNone/opaque ⇒ none. Generalises distinctRanges' `{lo, hi+1}` point collection over the Ws vocabulary. Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:wsMember.label: Ws member
engine:wsMember.description: Decide `x ∈ ws` over the decidable Ws-marker fragment: WsAll ⇒ true; WsNone/WsWhere ⇒ false (WsWhere is the TS `contains`→conservative-false posture); WsEnum ⇒ eq-scan; WsPrefix ⇒ `startsWith x prefix` (the 7g O(prefix) value-class membership — see the Ws-fragment + Design-E notes); WsInterval ⇒ numeric compare honouring each bound's inclusivity + a missing (Nothing) bound = unbounded that side; WsUnion ⇒ any branch; WsIntersect ⇒ all branches; WsComplement ⇒ negation. The missing membership primitive the Ws vocabulary lacked (solve builds markers, enumerate reads extensions, nobody decided `v ∈ ws`). parser-substrate Phase 1.

engine:wsOf.label: Ws of key
engine:wsOf.description: The Ws marker structure precomputed for predicate key `k` (read from the predInfo index `e.ws`); WsWhere when absent. Internal helper (structured partition).

engine:wvToMaybe.label: inhabit: wvToMaybe
engine:wvToMaybe.description: signature-substrate slice 3jw §2 — the thin public projection of the internal WitnessVerdict onto the family's `Maybe` contract: WAccept ⇒ Just its witness; WAbstain AND WContradiction both ⇒ Nothing. Projecting both refusal cases to Nothing loses nothing an existing witness consumer needs — the diagnostic belongs to the internal/audit face. Internal helper.

engine:zipBindings.label: Zip bindings
engine:zipBindings.description: Zip a var list with a value row into a bindings env (a list of { name, value }), stopping at the shorter. Used to bind a tuple's row for matching, residual substitution, and the witness. Internal helper.

engine:zipSubs.label: Zip subs
engine:zipSubs.description: Zip a rule's formal params with the call's argument Exprs into a subs env (a list of { name, expr }), stopping at the shorter (arity is pre-checked equal). Internal helper.
